-- Blox Fruits V75. Touch layout and hosted-file entry point. Test game compatibility in-game.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
assert(localPlayer, "Run this script on the client")
local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local FARM_HEIGHT = 33
local WINDOW_WIDTH,WINDOW_HEIGHT=960,640
local BUILD = "V75"
local ATTACK_INTERVAL = 0.025
local RAID_ATTACK_INTERVAL = 0.1
playerGui:SetAttribute("ViltrumFarmHeight", nil) -- discard the removed height preference
playerGui:SetAttribute("ViltrumAttackRate", nil)
playerGui:SetAttribute("ViltrumStyle",nil) -- slot 1 replaces the old style-name preference

local CONFIG = {
    AutoAura=playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumAutoAura")~=false,
    RaidRadius=100,
    RaidIslandRadius=450,
    RaidClearWait=2,
    RaidHeight=61,
    DodgeRadius=100,
    DodgeSide=60,
    DodgeSpeed=222,
    DodgeGrace=.2,
    WeaponType=playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumWeaponType")=="Gun" and "Gun" or playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumWeaponType")=="Fruit" and "Fruit" or playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumWeaponType")=="Sword" and "Sword" or "Melee",
    SwordSlot=3,
    GunSlot=4,
    FruitSlot=2,
    FruitPercent=20,
    FruitSkills={},
    TravelSpeed = 222,
    WalkSpeed = 32,
    BoatSpeed = 130,
    FarmSideOffset = 0,
    FarmRadius=100,
    RaidSideOffset = 0,
    PositionTolerance = 1.5,
    QuestRange = 5,
    WorkerInterval = 0.025,

    SpawnWait = 8,
    NoDamageTimeout = 15,
}
do
local savedSwordSlot=tonumber(playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumSwordSlot"))
if savedSwordSlot and savedSwordSlot>=1 and savedSwordSlot<=10 then CONFIG.SwordSlot=math.floor(savedSwordSlot)end
for _,key in ipairs({"Z","X","C","V"})do CONFIG.FruitSkills[key]=playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumFruit"..key)==true end
for key,attribute in pairs({GunSlot="ViltrumGunSlot",FruitSlot="ViltrumFruitSlot",FruitPercent="ViltrumFruitPercent"})do
    local saved=tonumber(playerGui:GetAttribute(attribute))
    if saved and saved==saved then CONFIG[key]=math.floor(math.clamp(saved,1,key=="FruitSlot" and 10 or 50))end
end
local savedRaidRadius=tonumber(playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumRaidRadius"))
if savedRaidRadius and savedRaidRadius==savedRaidRadius then CONFIG.RaidRadius=math.floor(math.clamp(savedRaidRadius,50,100))end
local savedBoatSpeed=tonumber(playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumBoatSpeed"))
if savedBoatSpeed and savedBoatSpeed==savedBoatSpeed then CONFIG.BoatSpeed=math.floor(math.clamp(savedBoatSpeed,1,550))end
local savedSpeed=tonumber(playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumWalkSpeed"))
if savedSpeed and savedSpeed==savedSpeed then CONFIG.WalkSpeed=math.floor(math.clamp(savedSpeed,1,250))end
end
local Core = (function()
local Core = {}

Core.SEA_BY_PLACE = {
    [2753915549]=1, [85211729168715]=1,
    [4442272183]=2, [79091703265657]=2,
    [7449423635]=3, [100117331123089]=3,
}

function Core.selectQuest(rows, level, sea)
    if type(level) ~= "number" or level ~= level or not rows then return nil end
    local floorLevel = sea == 1 and 0 or sea == 2 and 700 or 1500
    local ceiling = sea == 1 and 700 or sea == 2 and 1500 or math.huge
    local selected
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        if row[1] >= floorLevel and row[1] < ceiling and row[1] <= level then
            if not selected or row[1] > selected[1] then selected = row end
        end
    end
    return selected
end

function Core.normalizeName(name)
    return string.lower((name:gsub("<.->", ""):gsub("%s*%[.-%]", "")):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
end

function Core.styleKey(value)
    if type(value)~="string"then return "" end
    return (Core.normalizeName(value):gsub("[%s_%-]", ""))
end
local STYLE_NAMES = {
    ["combat"]=true, ["black leg"]=true, ["dark step"]=true,
    ["electro"]=true, ["electric"]=true, ["fishman karate"]=true,
    ["water kung fu"]=true, ["dragon claw"]=true, ["dragon breath"]=true,
    ["superhuman"]=true, ["death step"]=true, ["sharkman karate"]=true,
    ["electric claw"]=true, ["dragon talon"]=true, ["godhuman"]=true,
    ["sanguine art"]=true,
}
local STYLES={}
for name in pairs(STYLE_NAMES)do STYLES[Core.styleKey(name)]=true end
local NON_MELEE={sword=true,gun=true,fruit=true,bloxfruit=true,demonfruit=true}
function Core.isFightingStyle(name, tooltip, category)
    local tag = Core.styleKey(tooltip)
    local kind = Core.styleKey(category)
    if NON_MELEE[tag] or NON_MELEE[kind] then return false end
    return tag == "melee" or tag == "fightingstyle" or kind == "melee" or kind == "fightingstyle"
        or STYLES[Core.styleKey(name)] == true
end
function Core.weaponMatches(mode,name,tooltip,category)
    if mode=="Melee"then return Core.isFightingStyle(name,tooltip,category)end
    if mode=="Fruit"then
        local tag,kind=Core.styleKey(tooltip),Core.styleKey(category)
        local tags={fruit=true,bloxfruit=true,demonfruit=true}
        if tag=="melee" or tag=="sword" or tag=="gun" or kind=="melee" or kind=="sword" or kind=="gun"then return false end
        return tags[tag]==true or tags[kind]==true
    end
    if mode=="Gun"then return Core.styleKey(tooltip)=="gun" or Core.styleKey(category)=="gun"end
    if mode~="Sword"then return false end
    local tag,kind=Core.styleKey(tooltip),Core.styleKey(category)
    if tag=="melee" or tag=="fightingstyle" or tag=="gun" or tag=="fruit" or tag=="bloxfruit" or tag=="demonfruit"then return false end
    if kind=="melee" or kind=="fightingstyle" or kind=="gun" or kind=="fruit" or kind=="bloxfruit" or kind=="demonfruit"then return false end
    return tag=="sword" or kind=="sword"
end
function Core.fruitReady(target,percent,skills)
    if not target or type(target.maxHealth)~="number" or target.maxHealth<=0 or target.health<=0 then return false end
    local selected=false
    for _,key in ipairs({"Z","X","C","V"})do if skills[key]==true then selected=true end end
    return selected and target.health/target.maxHealth*100<=percent
end
function Core.npcSkillCue(info)
    if not info or info.playing==false then return false end
    local name=Core.styleKey(info.name)
    if name=="m1" or name=="basicattack" or name:match("^punch%d*$") or name:match("^hit%d+$")
        or name:match("^slash%d+$") or name:match("^combo") or name:match("^idle")
        or name:match("^walk") or name:match("^run") or name:match("^hurt")
        or name:match("^hitreaction") or name:match("^stun")then return false end
    if info.isSkill==false then return false end
    if info.isSkill==true or info.skillFolder or info.knownId or info.npcCasting then return true end
    local kind=Core.styleKey(info.kind)
    if kind=="skill" or kind=="ability"then return true end
    local key=Core.styleKey(info.key)
    if key=="z" or key=="x" or key=="c" or key=="v" or key=="f"then return true end
    if name=="z" or name=="x" or name=="c" or name=="v" or name=="f"then return true end
    return name:match("^skill")~=nil or name:match("^ability")~=nil or name:match("^cast")~=nil
end
Core.COMBAT_HEIGHTS={11,9,7,5,3}
function Core.updateCombatProbe(probe,weapon,target,health,now,startIndex,startMode)
    if not probe or probe.weapon~=weapon or probe.target~=target then
        return {weapon=weapon,target=target,health=health,heightIndex=startIndex or 1,
            mode=startMode or "Net",attempts=0,startedAt=now,progress=false}
    end
    probe.progress=health<probe.health
    if probe.progress then probe.attempts=0;probe.startedAt=now end
    probe.health=health
    if probe.attempts>=6 and now-probe.startedAt>=2 then
        if probe.mode=="Net" then
            probe.mode="Native"
        elseif probe.heightIndex<#Core.COMBAT_HEIGHTS then
            probe.heightIndex+=1;probe.mode="Native"
        else probe.mode=probe.mode=="Native" and "Net" or "Native"end
        probe.attempts=0;probe.startedAt=now
    end
    return probe
end
function Core.noteCombatAttempt(probe,now)
    if probe.attempts==0 then probe.startedAt=now end
    probe.attempts+=1
end

-- Fixed-height Raid cannot use the old reach ladder: resetting its height index
-- each step left Native selected forever. Retry Net even when Native sends fail.
function Core.updateFixedCombatProbe(probe,weapon,target,health,now)
    if not probe or probe.weapon~=weapon or probe.target~=target then
        return {weapon=weapon,target=target,health=health,heightIndex=1,mode="Net",observedMode="Net",
            modeSince=now,attempts=0,startedAt=now,progress=false}
    end
    if probe.mode~=probe.observedMode then
        probe.observedMode=probe.mode;probe.modeSince=now;probe.attempts=0;probe.startedAt=now
    end
    probe.progress=health<probe.health;probe.health=health
    if probe.progress and probe.mode=="Net"then probe.attempts=0;probe.startedAt=now end
    if probe.mode=="Native"and now-probe.modeSince>=2
        or probe.mode=="Net"and probe.attempts>=6 and now-probe.startedAt>=2 then
        probe.mode=probe.mode=="Native"and "Net"or "Native"
        probe.observedMode=probe.mode;probe.modeSince=now;probe.attempts=0;probe.startedAt=now
    end
    probe.heightIndex=1
    return probe
end

function Core.questMatches(title, mob)
    local text = Core.normalizeName(title)
    local name = Core.normalizeName(mob)
    if string.find(text, name, 1, true) then return true end
    if name:sub(-1) == "y" then
        return string.find(text, name:sub(1, -2) .. "ies", 1, true) ~= nil
    end
    return false
end

function Core.activeQuest(rows, title)
    if not rows or type(title)~="string" then return nil end
    local best,score=nil,0
    for _,row in ipairs(rows)do
        local length=#Core.normalizeName(row[4])
        if length>score and Core.questMatches(title,row[4])then best,score=row,length end
    end
    return best
end

function Core.isBossQuest(title, bossNames)
    if type(title)~="string" then return false end
    if string.find(string.lower(title),"[boss]",1,true)then return true end
    for _,name in ipairs(bossNames or {})do if Core.questMatches(title,name)then return true end end
    return false
end

function Core.nearestTarget(candidates, mob)
    local best, distance = nil, math.huge
    for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        if candidate.health > 0 and candidate.distance < distance
            and (not mob or Core.normalizeName(candidate.name) == Core.normalizeName(mob)) then
            best, distance = candidate, candidate.distance
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- Pure decision function: a step produces at most one effect.
function Core.decide(context)
    if not context.enabled then return "idle" end
    if not context.alive then return "respawn" end
    if context.autoQuest then
        if context.questVisible and context.questBoss then return "abandon_boss" end
        if not context.quest then return "no_quest" end
        if context.questVisible then
            if not context.questTitle then return "unknown_quest" end
            if not Core.questMatches(context.questTitle, context.quest[4]) then return "wrong_quest" end
        else
            if context.npcDistance > context.questRange then return "move_npc" end
            if context.now - context.lastQuest >= context.questCooldown then return "start_quest" end
            return "wait_quest"
        end
    end
    if not context.target then return "wait_mob" end
    if context.target.distance > context.attackRange
        or context.positionDistance and context.positionDistance > context.positionTolerance then return "move_mob" end
    if not context.hasWeapon then return "no_weapon" end
    if context.now - context.lastAttack >= context.attackCooldown then return "attack" end
    return "wait_attack"
end

return Core

end)()

local function connect(signal, callback)
    local c = signal:Connect(callback)
    table.insert(connections, c)
    return c

-- Ground movement uses a world-space X/Z velocity controller so game scripts
-- resetting WalkSpeed cannot silently leave running at the default speed.
do
    function speedHack.brake(limit)
        local root=speedHack.root
        local human=speedHack.human
        if not speedHack.driving or not root or not root.Parent or root.Anchored
            or not human or human.Health<=0 or human.SeatPart or human.Sit
            or human.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air then return end
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local horizontal=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)
        if horizontal.Magnitude>limit then
            horizontal=horizontal.Unit*limit
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(horizontal.X,velocity.Y,horizontal.Z)
        end
    end
    function speedHack.restore()
        if speedHack.drive then speedHack.drive:Destroy()end
        if speedHack.attachment then speedHack.attachment:Destroy()end
        speedHack.drive=nil;speedHack.attachment=nil
        speedHack.brake(math.max(0,speedHack.original or 16))
        if speedHack.human and speedHack.human.Parent then
            if speedHack.human.WalkSpeed==speedHack.applied then speedHack.human.WalkSpeed=speedHack.original end
        end
        speedHack.human=nil;speedHack.root=nil;speedHack.original=nil;speedHack.applied=nil;speedHack.driving=false;speedHack.airDirection=nil
    end
    function speedHack.tick()
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not state.speed or disposed or state.farm or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events or state.berry or state.autofruits
            or state.raid and (raidRunning or raidHost.moving) or teleport.flight or not human or human.Health<=0
            or not root or root.Anchored or human.SeatPart or human.Sit or human.PlatformStand then
            speedHack.restore();return
        end
        if speedHack.human~=human or speedHack.root~=root then
            speedHack.restore();speedHack.human=human;speedHack.root=root;speedHack.original=human.WalkSpeed
        end
        local speed=tonumber(CONFIG.WalkSpeed)
        if not speed or speed~=speed then speed=32 end
        speed=math.clamp(speed,1,250)
        if human.WalkSpeed~=speed then human.WalkSpeed=speed end
        speedHack.applied=speed
        local motion=human:GetState()
        local grounded=human.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and not human.Jump
            and (motion==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or motion==Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics
                or motion==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
        local airborne=human.Jump or motion==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or motion==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
        local direction=human.MoveDirection
        local horizontal=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
        if airborne and horizontal.Magnitude<.01 and speedHack.airDirection then horizontal=speedHack.airDirection end
        local typing=UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil
        local menu=game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen
        if not(grounded or airborne)or horizontal.Magnitude<.01 or typing or menu then
            if speedHack.drive then speedHack.drive.Enabled=false end
            if grounded then speedHack.brake(0)end
            speedHack.driving=false;speedHack.airDirection=nil;return
        end
        if not speedHack.drive or speedHack.drive.Parent~=root or not speedHack.attachment
            or speedHack.attachment.Parent~=root then
            if speedHack.drive then speedHack.drive:Destroy()end
            if speedHack.attachment then speedHack.attachment:Destroy()end
            local attachment=Instance.new("Attachment")
            attachment.Name="ViltrumRunAttachment";attachment.Parent=root
            speedHack.attachment=attachment
            local drive=Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
            drive.Name="ViltrumRunSpeed";drive.Enabled=false;drive.Attachment0=attachment
            drive.RelativeTo=Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
            drive.VelocityConstraintMode=Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
            drive.PrimaryTangentAxis=Vector3.new(1,0,0);drive.SecondaryTangentAxis=Vector3.new(0,0,1)
            drive.ForceLimitsEnabled=true;drive.ForceLimitMode=Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
            drive.Parent=root;speedHack.drive=drive
        end
        -- Normalize diagonal input: the combined X/Z speed is the selected value.
        speedHack.airDirection=horizontal.Unit
        horizontal=horizontal.Unit*speed
        local force=math.max(1,root.AssemblyMass)*3000
        speedHack.drive.MaxPlanarAxesForce=Vector2.new(force,force)
        speedHack.drive.PlaneVelocity=Vector2.new(horizontal.X,horizontal.Z)
        speedHack.drive.Enabled=true;speedHack.driving=true
    end
end
-- Only the local driver's occupied boat is modified; normal steering remains in control.
do
    function boatSpeed.note(message)
        if boatSpeed.label and boatSpeed.label.Text~=message then boatSpeed.label.Text=message end
    end
    function boatSpeed.restore()
        if boatSpeed.seat and boatSpeed.seat.Parent and boatSpeed.seat.MaxSpeed==boatSpeed.applied then
            pcall(function()boatSpeed.seat.MaxSpeed=boatSpeed.original end)
        end
        for object,record in pairs(boatSpeed.controllers or {})do
            if object.Parent then pcall(function()
                if object[record.property]==record.applied then object[record.property]=record.original end
            end)end
        end
        boatSpeed.controllers={};boatSpeed.seat=nil;boatSpeed.model=nil;boatSpeed.applied=nil;boatSpeed.scannedAt=nil
    end
    function boatSpeed.modelFor(seat)
        local boats=workspace:FindFirstChild("Boats") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Ships")
        local current=seat.Parent
        local candidate
        while current and current~=workspace do
            if current:IsA("Model")then
                candidate=candidate or current
                if current:GetAttribute("IsBoat")==true or current:GetAttribute("VehicleType")=="Boat"then return current end
            end
            if boats and current.Parent==boats and current:IsA("Model")then return current end
            current=current.Parent
        end
        -- Boat instances normally live in workspace.Boats; allow explicitly named boat models too.
        if candidate then
            local name=string.lower(candidate.Name)
            if name:find("boat",1,true) or name:find("ship",1,true) or name:find("dinghy",1,true)
                or name:find("sloop",1,true) or name:find("brigade",1,true) or name:find("sentinel",1,true)
                or name:find("beast hunter",1,true)then return candidate end
        end
    end
    function boatSpeed.tick()
        if Core.boatAutomationActive and Core.boatAutomationActive()and progressFarm.mirage and progressFarm.mirage.driving then boatSpeed.restore();return end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local seat=human and human.SeatPart
        if not state.boatspeed or disposed or not human or human.Health<=0
            or not seat or not seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") or seat.Occupant~=human then
            boatSpeed.restore()
            if state.boatspeed then boatSpeed.note("Speed Boat: sit in the boat's driver seat")end
            return
        end
        local model=boatSpeed.seat==seat and boatSpeed.model or boatSpeed.modelFor(seat)
        if not model then boatSpeed.restore();boatSpeed.note("Speed Boat: a boat driver seat is required");return end
        if boatSpeed.seat~=seat then
            boatSpeed.restore();boatSpeed.seat=seat;boatSpeed.model=model;boatSpeed.original=seat.MaxSpeed
        end
        local amount=math.clamp(CONFIG.BoatSpeed,1,550)
        seat.MaxSpeed=amount;boatSpeed.applied=amount
        local root=seat.AssemblyRootPart
        if not root or not root:IsDescendantOf(model)then root=model.PrimaryPart or seat end
        if root.Anchored then boatSpeed.note("Speed Boat: this boat is anchored");return end
        local throttle=seat.ThrottleFloat
        if math.abs(throttle)<.01 then throttle=seat.Throttle end
        local look=seat.CFrame.LookVector
        local direction=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if math.abs(throttle)>.01 and direction.Magnitude>.01 then
            local horizontal=direction.Unit*(amount*math.clamp(throttle,-1,1))
            local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(horizontal.X,velocity.Y,horizontal.Z)
            local now=os.clock()
            if not boatSpeed.scannedAt or now-boatSpeed.scannedAt>=.5 then
                boatSpeed.scannedAt=now
                for _,object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
                    local property=object:IsA("BodyVelocity") and "Velocity"
                        or object:IsA("LinearVelocity") and object.RelativeTo==Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
                        and object.VelocityConstraintMode==Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector and "VectorVelocity" or nil
                    if property and not boatSpeed.controllers[object]then
                        boatSpeed.controllers[object]={property=property,original=object[property]}
                    end
                end
            end
            for object,record in pairs(boatSpeed.controllers)do
                if object.Parent then
                    local old=object[record.property]
                    local applied=Vector3.new(horizontal.X,old.Y,horizontal.Z)
                    object[record.property]=applied;record.applied=applied
                else boatSpeed.controllers[object]=nil end
            end
        end
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local actual=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
        boatSpeed.note("Speed Boat: "..math.floor(actual+.5).." / "..amount.." blocks/s")
    end
end

-- Bound initial discovery work per frame and reuse external HUD / enemy registries.
local perf={hudDirty=true,hudAt=-math.huge,hud={},enemyRecords={}}
function perf.walk(root,visit,valid,finished)
    return task.defer(function()
        local stack={root};local slice=os.clock()
        while #stack>0 and not disposed and valid()do
            local object=table.remove(stack)
            if object==root or object.Parent then
                local descend=visit(object)
                if descend~=false then for _,child in ipairs(object:GetChildren())do table.insert(stack,child)end end
            end
            if os.clock()-slice>=.002 then task.wait();slice=os.clock()end
        end
        if finished then finished()end
    end)
end
function perf.hudObjects()
    if not perf.hudDirty or os.clock()-perf.hudAt<.25 then return perf.hud end
    perf.hudDirty=false;perf.hudAt=os.clock()
    local list,stack={},{playerGui}
    while #stack>0 do
        local parent=table.remove(stack)
        for _,child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren())do
            if child~=perf.gui then table.insert(list,child);table.insert(stack,child)end
        end
    end
    perf.hud=list;return list
end
function perf.enemies(folder)
    if perf.enemyFolder~=folder then
        if perf.enemyAdded then perf.enemyAdded:Disconnect()end
        if perf.enemyRemoved then perf.enemyRemoved:Disconnect()end
        perf.enemyFolder=folder;perf.enemyList=folder:GetChildren();perf.enemyRecords={}
        perf.enemyAdded=connect(folder.ChildAdded,function(object)table.insert(perf.enemyList,object)end)
        perf.enemyRemoved=connect(folder.ChildRemoved,function(object)
            perf.enemyRecords[object]=nil
            local index=table.find(perf.enemyList,object)
            if index then table.remove(perf.enemyList,index)end
        end)
    end
    return perf.enemyList
end

function boss.matches(row,name)
    local key=Core.styleKey(name)
    if key==Core.styleKey(row.name)then return true end
    for _,alias in ipairs(row.aliases or {})do if key==Core.styleKey(alias)then return true end end
    return false
end
function boss.list()
    local sea=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
    local list={}
    for _,row in ipairs(boss.catalog[sea]or{})do table.insert(list,row)end
    local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    if folder then
        for _,model in ipairs(perf.enemies(folder))do
            if model:IsA("Model")and(model:GetAttribute("IsBoss")==true or model.Name:lower():find("[boss]",1,true)
                or model.Name:lower():find("[raid boss]",1,true))then
                local known=false
                for _,row in ipairs(list)do if boss.matches(row,model.Name)then known=true;break end end
                local otherSea=false
                if not known then
                    for world,rows in pairs(boss.catalog)do
                        if world~=sea then for _,row in ipairs(rows)do if boss.matches(row,model.Name)then otherSea=true;break end end end
                    end
                end
                if not known and not otherSea then table.insert(list,{name=Core.normalizeName(model.Name),liveOnly=true})end
            end
        end
    end
    return list,sea
end

-- Keep the character's feet above the contact volume; do not alter health or world damage scripts.
do
    -- The native motor may report Air over a local support collider. Apply walking input
    -- in the horizontal plane, leaving gravity, jumping and character rotation to Roblox.
    function surfaceWalk.drive(human,root,floor)
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if human.PlatformStand or human.Jump or math.abs(root.Position.Y-floor)>1.5 or math.abs(velocity.Y)>6 then
            surfaceWalk.driveActive=false;return
        end
        local direction=human.MoveDirection or Vector3.new()
        local x,z=direction.X,direction.Z
        if combatAssist and combatAssist.inputReady and not combatAssist.inputReady()then x,z=0,0 end
        local magnitude=Vector3.new(x,0,z).Magnitude
        if magnitude>1 then x=x/magnitude;z=z/magnitude end
        local speed=state.speed and tonumber(CONFIG.WalkSpeed)or tonumber(human.WalkSpeed)
        speed=math.clamp(speed or 16,0,250)
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(x*speed,velocity.Y,z*speed)
        surfaceWalk.driveActive=true
    end
    function surfaceWalk.placeSupport(part,root,top,width)
        local center=part.Position
        -- Keep a patch stationary while walking across it. Recenter near its edge,
        -- rather than dragging an anchored floor under the avatar on every frame.
        if not surfaceWalk.patchReady or not center or math.abs(center.Y-(top-1))>.05
            or math.abs(root.Position.X-center.X)>width*.22 or math.abs(root.Position.Z-center.Z)>width*.22 then
            part.CFrame=CFrame.new(root.Position.X,top-1,root.Position.Z)
            surfaceWalk.patchReady=true
        end
        if part.Size.X~=width then part.Size=Vector3.new(width,2,width)end
        part.CanCollide=true;part.CanTouch=false
    end

    function surfaceWalk.feet(character,human,root)
        local leg=character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
        local signature=tostring(human.HipHeight)..":"..tostring(root.Size.Y)..":"..tostring(leg and leg.Size.Y or 0)
        if surfaceWalk.feetSignature==signature then return surfaceWalk.feetHeight end
        local feet=math.max(0,human.HipHeight)+root.Size.Y*.5
        if leg and leg:IsA("BasePart")then feet=feet+leg.Size.Y end
        for _,name in ipairs({"LeftFoot","RightFoot","Left Leg","Right Leg"})do
            local foot=character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if foot and foot:IsA("BasePart")and foot.Position then
                local extent=foot.Size.Y*.5
                if foot.CFrame then
                    local cf=foot.CFrame
                    extent=(math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*foot.Size.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*foot.Size.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*foot.Size.Z)*.5
                end
                feet=math.max(feet,root.Position.Y-foot.Position.Y+extent)
            end
        end
        surfaceWalk.feetSignature=signature;surfaceWalk.feetHeight=feet
        return feet
    end
    function surfaceWalk.stopMotion(destroy)
        surfaceWalk.motionActive=false
        if surfaceWalk.walkTrack and surfaceWalk.walkTrack.IsPlaying then pcall(function()surfaceWalk.walkTrack:Stop(.12)end)end
        if destroy then
            if surfaceWalk.animationConnection then surfaceWalk.animationConnection:Disconnect();surfaceWalk.animationConnection=nil end
            if surfaceWalk.walkTrack then pcall(function()surfaceWalk.walkTrack:Destroy()end)end
            surfaceWalk.walkTrack=nil;surfaceWalk.motionAnimator=nil;surfaceWalk.motionCharacter=nil
            surfaceWalk.animationAt=0;surfaceWalk.trackScanAt=0;surfaceWalk.walkAnimation=nil;surfaceWalk.swimIds=nil
            surfaceWalk.nativeMovementIds=nil;surfaceWalk.nativeWalking=false;surfaceWalk.walkSpeed=nil
            surfaceWalk.walkLoadAt=0;surfaceWalk.motionRetryAt=0;surfaceWalk.motionError=nil
        end
    end
    function surfaceWalk.swimTrack(track)
        local animation=track.Animation
        local key=Core.styleKey(track.Name or "")..Core.styleKey(animation and animation.Name or "")
        return key:find("swim",1,true)~=nil or animation and surfaceWalk.swimIds and surfaceWalk.swimIds[animation.AnimationId]==true
    end
    function surfaceWalk.motion(character,human,root,floor)
        local now=os.clock();local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local nearFloor=math.abs(root.Position.Y-floor)<=1.25
        local grounded=nearFloor and math.abs(velocity.Y)<6 and human.Jump~=true
        local current=human:GetState()
        if nearFloor and current==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming or grounded and current==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            human:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end
        local animator=human:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then return end
        if surfaceWalk.motionAnimator~=animator then
            surfaceWalk.stopMotion(true);surfaceWalk.motionAnimator=animator;surfaceWalk.motionCharacter=character
            surfaceWalk.animationConnection=animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                if surfaceWalk.motionActive and surfaceWalk.part and surfaceWalk.part.CanCollide and surfaceWalk.swimTrack(track)then
                    pcall(function()track:Stop(.08)end)
                end
            end)
        end
        surfaceWalk.motionActive=nearFloor
        if now>=(surfaceWalk.animationAt or 0)then
            surfaceWalk.animationAt=now+.75
            local animateScript=character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
            local swimIds,movementIds={},{}
            if animateScript then
                for _,name in ipairs({"swim","swimidle","walk","run"})do
                    local group=animateScript:FindFirstChild(name)
                    local animation=group and group:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation",true)
                    if animation and animation.AnimationId~=""then
                        if name=="swim"or name=="swimidle"then swimIds[animation.AnimationId]=true
                        else
                            movementIds[animation.AnimationId]=true
                            if name=="walk"or not surfaceWalk.walkAnimation then surfaceWalk.walkAnimation=animation end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            surfaceWalk.swimIds=swimIds;surfaceWalk.nativeMovementIds=movementIds
        end
        if now>=(surfaceWalk.trackScanAt or 0)then
            surfaceWalk.trackScanAt=now+.25;surfaceWalk.nativeWalking=false
            for _,track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks())do
                if nearFloor and surfaceWalk.swimTrack(track)then pcall(function()track:Stop(.08)end)
                elseif track~=surfaceWalk.walkTrack and track.IsPlaying and track.Animation
                    and surfaceWalk.nativeMovementIds and surfaceWalk.nativeMovementIds[track.Animation.AnimationId]then surfaceWalk.nativeWalking=true end
            end
        end
        local direction=human.MoveDirection
        local speed=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
        local moving=grounded and direction and direction.Magnitude>.02 and speed>.1
        if not moving or surfaceWalk.nativeWalking then
            if surfaceWalk.walkTrack and surfaceWalk.walkTrack.IsPlaying then surfaceWalk.walkTrack:Stop(.12)end
            return
        end
        if not surfaceWalk.walkTrack and surfaceWalk.walkAnimation and now>=(surfaceWalk.walkLoadAt or 0)then
            surfaceWalk.walkLoadAt=now+2
            local ok,track=pcall(function()return animator:LoadAnimation(surfaceWalk.walkAnimation)end)
            if ok and track then
                surfaceWalk.walkTrack=track;track.Name="ViltrumSurfaceWalk";track.Looped=true
                track.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
                surfaceWalk.motionError=nil
            else surfaceWalk.motionError="walk animation is unavailable; physical support remains active"
            end
        end
        local track=surfaceWalk.walkTrack
        if track then
            if not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(.12)end
            local rate=math.clamp(speed/16,.5,2.5)
            if not surfaceWalk.walkSpeed or math.abs(rate-surfaceWalk.walkSpeed)>.05 then track:AdjustSpeed(rate);surfaceWalk.walkSpeed=rate end
        end
    end

    function surfaceWalk.enabled(kind)
        return kind=="water"and state.waterwalk or kind=="lava"and state.lavawalk
    end
    function surfaceWalk.release()
        surfaceWalk.driveActive=false;surfaceWalk.patchReady=false;surfaceWalk.floor=nil;surfaceWalk.lastSurface=nil
        surfaceWalk.stopMotion()
        if surfaceWalk.part then surfaceWalk.part.CanCollide=false end
        if surfaceWalk.human and surfaceWalk.swimmingEnabled~=nil then
            pcall(function()surfaceWalk.human:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,surfaceWalk.swimmingEnabled)end)
        end
        surfaceWalk.restoreBody()
        surfaceWalk.swimmingEnabled=nil;surfaceWalk.hit=nil;surfaceWalk.surfaceKind=nil
    end
    function surfaceWalk.reset()
        surfaceWalk.release();surfaceWalk.stopMotion(true);surfaceWalk.feetSignature=nil;surfaceWalk.nextDiscovery=0
        surfaceWalk.voxels=nil;surfaceWalk.voxelAt=0;surfaceWalk.probeError=nil
        if surfaceWalk.body then surfaceWalk.body:Destroy();surfaceWalk.body=nil end
        if surfaceWalk.discovery then task.cancel(surfaceWalk.discovery);surfaceWalk.discovery=nil end
        for _,connection in ipairs(surfaceWalk.listeners or {})do connection:Disconnect()end
        if surfaceWalk.part then surfaceWalk.part:Destroy()end
        surfaceWalk.part=nil;surfaceWalk.character=nil;surfaceWalk.human=nil;surfaceWalk.params=nil
        surfaceWalk.listeners={};surfaceWalk.hazards={};surfaceWalk.nextRay=0;surfaceWalk.nextFilter=0
        surfaceWalk.nextGroup=0;surfaceWalk.contact=nil;surfaceWalk.contactUntil=0
    end
    function surfaceWalk.kind(hit)
        if not hit then return nil end
        if hit.Material==Enum.Material.Water then return "water"end
        if hit.Material==Enum.Material.CrackedLava then return "lava"end
        local object=hit.Instance
        if surfaceWalk.hazards and surfaceWalk.hazards[object]then return surfaceWalk.hazards[object]end
        for _=1,5 do
            if not object or object==workspace then break end
            if object:GetAttribute("IsLava")==true or object:GetAttribute("DamageType")=="Lava"then return "lava"end
            local name=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
            if object:GetAttribute("IsWater")==true or name=="water"or name=="waterplane"or name=="waterbaseplane"
                or name=="waterbase"or name=="seasurface"or name=="ocean"or name=="sea"or name=="watersurface"or name=="watermesh"or name=="seaplane"or name=="oceanplane"then return "water"end
            if name=="lava"or name=="magma"or name=="moltenlava"or name=="lavapool"or name=="magmapool"
                or name=="lavafloor"or name=="lavapart"or name=="lavasurface"or name=="lavablock"then return "lava"end
            object=object.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- Texture/mesh oceans can have generic part names and CanQuery=false.
    -- A screenshot is not an asset ID: recognize scene metadata and ocean geometry instead.
    function surfaceWalk.textureKind(object)
        if not object or not object:IsA("BasePart")then return nil end
        local variant=Core.styleKey(object.MaterialVariant or "")
        if variant:find("water",1,true)or variant:find("ocean",1,true)then return "water"end
        if variant:find("lava",1,true)then return "lava"end
        if not object.Anchored then return nil end
        local size=object.Size
        local textured=object:IsA("MeshPart")and object.TextureID~=""
        for _,child in ipairs(object:GetChildren())do
            if child:IsA("Texture")or child:IsA("Decal")or child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
                textured=true
                local name=Core.styleKey(child.Name)
                if name:find("water",1,true)or name:find("ocean",1,true)or name:find("seafoam",1,true)then return "water"end
                if name:find("lava",1,true)then return "lava"end
            end
        end
        if not size or size.X<256 or size.Z<256 or size.Y>32 or math.abs(object.CFrame.UpVector.Y)<.98 then return nil end
        -- Only enormous, non-solid, horizontal, textured map planes qualify as an unnamed ocean.
        if textured and not object.CanCollide and size.X>=2048 and size.Z>=2048 then return "water"end
    end

    -- A welded foot collider remains solid even when the avatar's standard limbs are noncollidable.
    function surfaceWalk.restoreBody()
        if surfaceWalk.body then surfaceWalk.body.CanCollide=false end
    end
    function surfaceWalk.supportBody(character,human,root)
        local body=surfaceWalk.body
        if not body or body.Parent~=character then
            if body then body:Destroy()end
            body=Instance.new("Part");body.Name="ViltrumWalkContact";body.Transparency=1
            body.Anchored=false;body.Massless=true;body.CanTouch=false;body.CanQuery=false;body.CanCollide=false
            body.CastShadow=false;body.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(.7,0,0,100,100);surfaceWalk.body=body
            local feet=surfaceWalk.feet(character,human,root)
            body.Size=Vector3.new(math.max(1.5,root.Size.X*.8),1,math.max(1.5,root.Size.Z))
            body.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-feet+.5,0)
            local weld=Instance.new("Weld");weld.Part0=root;weld.Part1=body;weld.C0=CFrame.new(0,-feet+.5,0);weld.Parent=body
            surfaceWalk.bodyWeld=weld;surfaceWalk.bodyFeet=feet
            body.Parent=character
        end
        local feet=surfaceWalk.feet(character,human,root)
        if surfaceWalk.bodyFeet~=feet then
            body.Size=Vector3.new(math.max(1.5,root.Size.X*.8),1,math.max(1.5,root.Size.Z))
            surfaceWalk.bodyWeld.C0=CFrame.new(0,-feet+.5,0);surfaceWalk.bodyFeet=feet
        end
        body.CollisionGroup=root.CollisionGroup;body.CanCollide=true
    end
    function surfaceWalk.geometryKind(object)
        if not object.Anchored or object.CanCollide or not object.Color then return nil end
        local size=object.Size;local cf=object.CFrame
        local width=math.abs(cf.RightVector.X)*size.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.X)*size.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.X)*size.Z
        local depth=math.abs(cf.RightVector.Z)*size.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Z)*size.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Z)*size.Z
        local height=math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*size.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*size.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*size.Z
        if width<1024 or depth<1024 or height>64 then return nil end
        local color=object.Color
        if color.B>color.R*1.3 and color.B>.25 then return "water"end
    end
    function surfaceWalk.refreshNearby()
        -- Bounded shallow refresh handles nonqueryable map planes whose material/texture arrived later.
        local stack={{workspace,0}};local visited=0
        while #stack>0 and visited<512 do
            local entry=table.remove(stack);local object,depth=entry[1],entry[2]
            for _,child in ipairs(object:GetChildren())do
                visited=visited+1;surfaceWalk.register(child)
                if visited>=512 then break end
                if depth<2 and not child:IsA("BasePart")and not child:IsA("Terrain")
                    and not(child:IsA("Model")and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))then
                    table.insert(stack,{child,depth+1})
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function surfaceWalk.register(object)
        if object:IsA("Texture")or object:IsA("Decal")or object:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then object=object.Parent end
        if not object or not object:IsA("BasePart")or object==surfaceWalk.part then return end
        local parent=object.Parent
        while parent and parent~=workspace do
            if parent:IsA("Model")and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then return end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        local kind=surfaceWalk.kind({Instance=object,Material=object.Material})or surfaceWalk.textureKind(object)or surfaceWalk.geometryKind(object)
        if kind then surfaceWalk.hazards[object]=kind end
    end
    function surfaceWalk.top(object,position,padding)
        if not object or not object.Parent or not object:IsA("BasePart")then return nil end
        local half=object.Size*.5
        local low,high=-math.huge,math.huge
        for _,row in ipairs({{object.CFrame.RightVector,half.X},{object.CFrame.UpVector,half.Y},{object.CFrame.LookVector,half.Z}})do
            local axis,extent=row[1],row[2]
            local offset=axis.X*(position.X-object.Position.X)+axis.Z*(position.Z-object.Position.Z)
            if math.abs(axis.Y)<.0001 then
                if math.abs(offset)>extent+padding then return nil end
            else
                local a=(-extent-offset)/axis.Y;local b=(extent-offset)/axis.Y
                low=math.max(low,math.min(a,b));high=math.min(high,math.max(a,b))
                if low>high then return nil end
            end
        end
        return object.Position.Y+high
    end
    function surfaceWalk.fallback(root,feet,obstacle)
        local nearest,best=nil,math.huge
        for object,kind in pairs(surfaceWalk.hazards)do
            if not object.Parent then surfaceWalk.hazards[object]=nil
            elseif surfaceWalk.enabled(kind)then
                local top=surfaceWalk.top(object,root.Position,2)
                if top then
                    local distance=math.abs(root.Position.Y-feet-top)
                    -- A solid shore/roof wins over a sea plane extending underneath it.
                    local blocked=obstacle and obstacle.Instance and obstacle.Instance.CanCollide
                        and obstacle.Position.Y>top+.25
                    if not blocked and distance<best and distance<math.max(96,feet+40)then
                        best=distance;nearest={Instance=object,Material=object.Material,Position=Vector3.new(root.Position.X,top,root.Position.Z)}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end
    function surfaceWalk.contactPart(object)
        if disposed or not object or object==surfaceWalk.part then return end
        surfaceWalk.register(object)
        local kind=surfaceWalk.hazards[object]
        if not surfaceWalk.enabled(kind)then return end
        surfaceWalk.contact=object;surfaceWalk.contactUntil=os.clock()+.3;surfaceWalk.nextRay=0
        -- Touched can arrive between physics steps: resolve this contact immediately.
        surfaceWalk.safeTick()
    end
    function surfaceWalk.bindPart(object)
        if object==surfaceWalk.body then return end
        if object:IsA("BasePart")and object.Parent==surfaceWalk.character then
            table.insert(surfaceWalk.listeners,object.Touched:Connect(surfaceWalk.contactPart))
        end
    end
    function surfaceWalk.group(character,root)
        local ok,group=pcall(function()
            local physics=game:GetService("PhysicsService")
            local groups=physics:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups()
            local bodies={root}
            for _,object in ipairs(character:GetChildren())do
                if object:IsA("BasePart")and object.CanCollide then table.insert(bodies,object)end
            end
            local best,score="Default",-1
            for _,entry in ipairs(groups)do
                local current=0
                for _,body in ipairs(bodies)do
                    if physics:CollisionGroupsAreCollidable(entry.name,body.CollisionGroup)then current+=1 end
                end
                if current>score then best=entry.name;score=current end
                if current==#bodies then return entry.name end
            end
            return best
        end)
        if ok then surfaceWalk.part.CollisionGroup=group end
    end
    function surfaceWalk.bind(character,human,root)
        surfaceWalk.reset();surfaceWalk.character=character;surfaceWalk.human=human
        local part=Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name="ViltrumSurfaceWalk";part.Anchored=true;part.Transparency=1;part.CanCollide=false
        part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=true;part.CastShadow=false;part.Size=Vector3.new(64,2,64)
        part.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(.7,0,0,100,100)
        part.Parent=workspace;surfaceWalk.part=part
        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;params.IgnoreWater=false;params.RespectCanCollide=false
        surfaceWalk.params=params
        for _,object in ipairs(character:GetChildren())do surfaceWalk.bindPart(object)end
        table.insert(surfaceWalk.listeners,character.ChildAdded:Connect(surfaceWalk.bindPart))
        -- The common nonqueryable sea plane must work on the first enabled frame.
        local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        for _,name in ipairs({"WaterBase-Plane","WaterBasePlane","WaterBase","Water","Ocean","Sea","Lava","Magma"})do
            local object=workspace:FindFirstChild(name)or map and map:FindFirstChild(name)
            if object then surfaceWalk.register(object)end
        end
        for _,container in ipairs({workspace,map})do
            for _,object in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do surfaceWalk.register(object)end
        end
        surfaceWalk.group(character,root)
        surfaceWalk.discovery=perf.walk(workspace,surfaceWalk.register,
            function()return surfaceWalk.character==character and(state.waterwalk or state.lavawalk)end,
            function()surfaceWalk.discovery=nil end)
    end
    -- Small read-only column probe also sees Terrain water when scene raycasts miss it.
    function surfaceWalk.terrainWater(root,feet,obstacle,now)
        if not state.waterwalk then return nil end
        local terrain=workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
        if not terrain then return nil end
        local position=root.Position
        local sample=surfaceWalk.voxels
        if now>=(surfaceWalk.voxelAt or 0)then
            surfaceWalk.voxelAt=now+.25
            local low=Vector3.new(math.floor((position.X-12)/4)*4,math.floor((position.Y-feet-112)/4)*4,math.floor((position.Z-12)/4)*4)
            local high=Vector3.new(low.X+28,low.Y+192,low.Z+28)
            local region=Region3.new(low,high):ExpandToGrid(4)
            local ok,result=pcall(function()return terrain:ReadVoxelChannels(region,4,{"LiquidOccupancy"})end)
            if ok and result and result.LiquidOccupancy then
                sample={low=low,liquid=result.LiquidOccupancy}
            else
                local legacy,materials,occupancy=pcall(function()return terrain:ReadVoxels(region,4)end)
                if legacy and materials and occupancy then sample={low=low,materials=materials,occupancy=occupancy}
                else sample=nil;surfaceWalk.probeError="Terrain water read unavailable"end
            end
            surfaceWalk.voxels=sample
            if sample then surfaceWalk.probeError=nil end
        end
        if not sample then return nil end
        local x=math.floor((position.X-sample.low.X)/4)+1
        local z=math.floor((position.Z-sample.low.Z)/4)+1
        if x<1 or x>7 or z<1 or z>7 then return nil end
        for y=48,1,-1 do
            local amount
            if sample.liquid then
                local column=sample.liquid[x];local row=column and column[y];amount=row and row[z]
            else
                local column=sample.materials[x];local row=column and column[y]
                local occ=sample.occupancy[x];local values=occ and occ[y]
                if row and row[z]==Enum.Material.Water then amount=values and values[z]end
            end
            if type(amount)=="number"and amount>0 then
                local top=sample.low.Y+(y-1+math.clamp(amount,0,1))*4
                local blocked=obstacle and obstacle.Instance and obstacle.Instance.CanCollide and obstacle.Position.Y>top+.25
                if not blocked and math.abs(position.Y-feet-top)<math.max(96,feet+40)then
                    return {Instance=terrain,Material=Enum.Material.Water,Position=Vector3.new(position.X,top,position.Z)}
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function surfaceWalk.tick()
        if disposed or not(state.waterwalk or state.lavawalk)then
            if surfaceWalk.character then surfaceWalk.reset()end
            return
        end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 then surfaceWalk.reset();return end
        if surfaceWalk.character~=character or not surfaceWalk.part or not surfaceWalk.part.Parent then surfaceWalk.bind(character,human,root)end
        if human.Sit or human.SeatPart or root.Anchored or state.farm or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events or state.berry
            or state.autofruits or state.raid and (raidRunning or raidHost.moving) or teleport.flight then
            surfaceWalk.reason="Пауза · полёт / транспорт / автофарм";surfaceWalk.release();surfaceWalk.nextRay=0;return
        end
        local now=os.clock()
        if now>=(surfaceWalk.nextDiscovery or 0)then surfaceWalk.nextDiscovery=now+2;surfaceWalk.refreshNearby()end
        local part=surfaceWalk.part
        if now>=surfaceWalk.nextGroup then surfaceWalk.group(character,root);surfaceWalk.nextGroup=now+1 end
        if now>=surfaceWalk.nextFilter then
            local filter={character,part}
            local enemies=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies");local npcs=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
            if enemies then table.insert(filter,enemies)end;if npcs then table.insert(filter,npcs)end
            for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
                if player~=localPlayer and player.Character then table.insert(filter,player.Character)end
            end
            surfaceWalk.params.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter;surfaceWalk.nextFilter=now+1
        end
        local feet=surfaceWalk.feet(character,human,root)
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local speed=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
        if now>=surfaceWalk.nextRay then
            local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,feet+32,0)
            local cast=Vector3.new(0,-math.clamp(feet*2+192,224,768),0)
            local hit=workspace:Raycast(origin,cast,surfaceWalk.params)
            local obstacle=hit
            surfaceWalk.blockedSurface=obstacle and(surfaceWalk.kind(obstacle)=="lava"or obstacle.Instance and obstacle.Instance:IsA("BasePart")and obstacle.Instance.CanCollide and surfaceWalk.kind(obstacle)~="water")
            local kind=surfaceWalk.kind(hit)
            if not surfaceWalk.enabled(kind)then
                hit=surfaceWalk.fallback(root,feet,obstacle);kind=surfaceWalk.kind(hit)
            end
            if not hit and surfaceWalk.contact and now<=surfaceWalk.contactUntil then
                local object=surfaceWalk.contact
                local top=surfaceWalk.top(object,root.Position,2)
                if top and not(obstacle and obstacle.Instance and obstacle.Instance.CanCollide and obstacle.Position.Y>top+.25)then
                    hit={Instance=object,Material=object.Material,Position=Vector3.new(root.Position.X,top,root.Position.Z)}
                    kind=surfaceWalk.kind(hit)
                end
            end
            if not surfaceWalk.enabled(kind)then
                local water=surfaceWalk.terrainWater(root,feet,obstacle,now)
                if water then hit=water;kind="water"end
            end
            surfaceWalk.hit=hit;surfaceWalk.surfaceKind=kind;surfaceWalk.nextRay=now+.04
        end
        local hit=surfaceWalk.hit
        if not hit and not surfaceWalk.blockedSurface and surfaceWalk.lastSurface and now-surfaceWalk.lastSurface.at<.35 then
            local previous=surfaceWalk.lastSurface
            if(root.Position-previous.position).Magnitude<80 then hit=previous.hit;surfaceWalk.surfaceKind=previous.kind end
        elseif hit and surfaceWalk.enabled(surfaceWalk.surfaceKind)then
            surfaceWalk.lastSurface={at=now,position=root.Position,hit=hit,kind=surfaceWalk.surfaceKind}
        end
        if not hit or not surfaceWalk.enabled(surfaceWalk.surfaceKind)then surfaceWalk.reason=surfaceWalk.probeError or "No water detected · scene / Terrain search";surfaceWalk.release();return end
        surfaceWalk.reason=nil
        -- Recheck finite part bounds every frame, including at Speed Hack 250.
        local height=hit.Position.Y
        if hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart")then
            height=surfaceWalk.top(hit.Instance,root.Position,2)
            if not height then surfaceWalk.release();surfaceWalk.nextRay=0;return end
        end
        local top=height+(surfaceWalk.surfaceKind=="water"and 6 or 3)
        local width=math.clamp(root.Size.X*4+speed*.4+96,128,320)
        surfaceWalk.placeSupport(part,root,top,width)
        surfaceWalk.supportBody(character,human,root)
        if surfaceWalk.swimmingEnabled==nil then
            surfaceWalk.swimmingEnabled=human:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming)
            human:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
        end
        local floor=top+feet;surfaceWalk.floor=floor
        human:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
        if root.Position.Y<floor then
            root.CFrame=root.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,floor-root.Position.Y,0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(velocity.X,math.max(0,velocity.Y),velocity.Z)
        end
        surfaceWalk.drive(human,root,floor)
        if now>=(surfaceWalk.motionRetryAt or 0)then
            local ok,message=pcall(surfaceWalk.motion,character,human,root,floor)
            if not ok then
                surfaceWalk.stopMotion(true);surfaceWalk.motionError=tostring(message);surfaceWalk.motionRetryAt=now+1
            end
        end
    end
    function surfaceWalk.safeTick()
        if surfaceWalk.busy or os.clock()<(surfaceWalk.retryAt or 0)then return end
        surfaceWalk.busy=true
        local ok,message=pcall(surfaceWalk.tick)
        surfaceWalk.busy=false
        if not ok then
            surfaceWalk.release();surfaceWalk.retryAt=os.clock()+1
            if surfaceWalk.label then surfaceWalk.label.Text="Surface walk error: "..tostring(message)end
        elseif surfaceWalk.label then
            surfaceWalk.label.Text=surfaceWalk.part and surfaceWalk.part.CanCollide and "Walking on "..tostring(surfaceWalk.surfaceKind).." · above the contact volume"..(surfaceWalk.motionError and " · "..surfaceWalk.motionError or "")
                or (state.waterwalk or state.lavawalk)and(surfaceWalk.reason or "Поиск воды / лавы…")or "Water / Lava Walk выключен"
        end
    end
    connect(workspace.DescendantAdded,function(object)
        if (state.waterwalk or state.lavawalk)and surfaceWalk.hazards then surfaceWalk.register(object)end
    end)
end

function progressFarm.islandChoice()
 return progressFarm.islandTypes[progressFarm.islandTarget]or progressFarm.islandTypes.mirage
end
function progressFarm.selectIsland(key)
 if progressFarm.islandInputBusy and progressFarm.islandInputBusy()then return false end
 if not progressFarm.islandTypes[key]then return false end
 if progressFarm.islandTarget==key then return true end
 local active=state.mirage
 if active then progressFarm.stop("Auto Island · switching target")end
 progressFarm.islandTarget=key
 if progressFarm.redrawIsland then progressFarm.redrawIsland()end
 if active then progressFarm.start("mirage")
 else
  local label=progressFarm.labels and progressFarm.labels.mirage
  if label then label.Text="Auto Island · selected "..progressFarm.islandChoice().name end
 end
 return true
end
function progressFarm.mirageIsland()
 local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
 for _,name in ipairs(progressFarm.islandChoice().aliases)do
  local island=map and map:FindFirstChild(name)or workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
  if island and(island:IsA("Model")or island:IsA("BasePart"))then return island end
 end
end
function progressFarm.islandSafeGround(hit,island)
 if not hit or not hit.Instance or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart")or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<=.5 then return false end
 if hit.Material==Enum.Material.CrackedLava then return false end
 local object=hit.Instance
 while object and object~=island do
  if object:GetAttribute("IsLava")==true or object:GetAttribute("DamageType")=="Lava"then return false end
  if object:IsA("Model")and object:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then return false end
  local key=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
  if key:find("lava",1,true)or key:find("magma",1,true)or key:find("leaf",1,true)or key:find("leaves",1,true)then return false end
  object=object.Parent
 end
 return object==island
end
