local function releaseNativeClick()
    if fruit.release then fruit.release()end
    if not mouseHeldBackend then return true end
    local ok=pcall(mouseHeldBackend.mouse,false,mouseHeldPoint)
    if not ok then ok=pcall(mouseHeldBackend.mouse,false,mouseHeldPoint)end
    if ok then mouseHeldBackend,mouseHeldPoint=nil,nil end
    return ok
end
function fruit.release()
    if not fruit.held then return true end
    local held=fruit.held
    local ok=pcall(held.backend.send,false,held.key)
    if not ok then ok=pcall(held.backend.send,false,held.key)end
    if ok then fruit.held=nil end
    return ok
end
function fruit.chooseTarget(list,mob)
    -- Finish the same live eligible NPC even if another one becomes closer.
    if fruit.target and(CONFIG.FruitFinisher or CONFIG.WeaponType=="Fruit")and fruit.skillsSelected()then
        for _,candidate in ipairs(list or{})do
            if candidate.model==fruit.target and candidate.health>0
                and(not mob or Core.normalizeName(candidate.name)==Core.normalizeName(mob))then return candidate end
        end
    end
    return Core.nearestTarget(list,mob)
end
function fruit.mode(target)
    if CONFIG.WeaponType=="Fruit"then
        if fruit.target and(not target or fruit.target~=target.model)then fruit.release()end
        fruit.target=nil;return "Fruit"
    end
    if CONFIG.WeaponType~="Fruit"and not CONFIG.FruitFinisher then fruit.target=nil;return CONFIG.WeaponType end
    if fruit.target and (not target or fruit.target~=target.model or target.health<=0)then fruit.release();fruit.target=nil end
    if fruit.target and not fruit.skillsSelected()then fruit.release();fruit.target=nil end
    if Core.fruitReady(target,CONFIG.FruitPercent,CONFIG.FruitSkills)then fruit.target=target.model end
    return fruit.target and "Fruit"or(CONFIG.WeaponType=="Fruit"and "Melee"or CONFIG.WeaponType)
end
function fruit.skillsSelected()
    for _,key in ipairs({"Z","X","C","V"})do if CONFIG.FruitSkills[key]then return true end end
    return false
end
local function create(class, properties, parent)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end
    object.Parent = parent
    local roles={}
    for property,value in pairs(properties)do
        if property=="BackgroundColor3" or property=="TextColor3" or property=="PlaceholderColor3" or property=="Color" then
            for role,color in pairs(colors)do if value==color then roles[property]=role;break end end
        end
    end
    appearance.bindings[object]=roles
    if (class=="TextLabel"or class=="TextButton"or class=="TextBox")and syncedTheme.faces then
        syncedTheme.font(object,properties.Font==Enum.Font.GothamBold and 700 or(properties.TextSize or 12)>=15 and 600 or 500)
    end
    return object
end
local function round(parent, radius)
    create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)}, parent)
end
local function text(parent, value, position, size, fontSize, color)
    return create("TextLabel", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = value, Position = position, Size = size,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = fontSize,
        TextColor3 = color or colors.text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
    }, parent)
end
local function animate(object, properties)
    if uiTweens[object]then uiTweens[object]:Cancel()end
    local tween=TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out), properties)
    uiTweens[object]=tween;tween:Play()
end
local function status(message)
    if statusLabel and not disposed then
        local now=os.clock()
        if (state.farm or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events or state.berry or state.autofruits or state.raid) and now-lastStatusUpdate<.25 then return end
        local value=message..((state.farm or state.elite or state.raid) and (" · Aura: "..auraStatus) or "")
        if statusLabel.Text~=value then statusLabel.Text=value end
        lastStatusUpdate=now
    end
end
local function stopMovement()
    if movement then movement:Cancel() end
    movement, movementDestination, movingRoot = nil, nil, nil
end
local function stopHover()
    if hoverAlign then hoverAlign:Destroy() end
    if hoverAttachment then hoverAttachment:Destroy() end
    hoverAttachment, hoverAlign, hoverRoot, hoverMob,hoverOffset=nil, nil, nil, nil,nil
end
local function restoreCollisions(force)
    if not force and Core.moduleNoclip and Core.moduleNoclip.wanted()then return end
    if collisionAdded then collisionAdded:Disconnect();collisionAdded=nil end
    if collisionRemoved then collisionRemoved:Disconnect();collisionRemoved=nil end
    for part,value in pairs(savedCollisions)do pcall(function()part.CanCollide=value end)end
    table.clear(savedCollisions)
    table.clear(collisionParts);collisionCharacter=nil
end
local function disableCollisions(character)
    if collisionCharacter~=character then
        restoreCollisions(true);collisionCharacter=character
        local function added(part)
            if part:IsA("BasePart")and part~=surfaceWalk.body then
                collisionParts[part]=true
                if savedCollisions[part]==nil then savedCollisions[part]=part.CanCollide end
            end
        end
        for _,part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do added(part)end
        collisionAdded=character.DescendantAdded:Connect(added)
        collisionRemoved=character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(part)
            collisionParts[part]=nil
            if savedCollisions[part]~=nil then
                pcall(function()part.CanCollide=savedCollisions[part]end)
                savedCollisions[part]=nil
            end
        end)
    end
    for part in pairs(collisionParts)do if part~=surfaceWalk.body and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide=false end end
end
-- Ignore configuration defaults (Distance, Through walls, Auto Quests, Side dodge).
-- Only enabled feature modules own noclip; all owners share the existing collision cache.
Core.moduleNoclip={keys={"farm","elite","boss","swordfarm","gunfarm","resourcefarm","mirage","ectoplasm","bones","dojo",
 "leviathan","autokill","autohaki","autopvp","aimbot","triggerbot","events","boatspeed",
 "autofruits","racev4","berryesp","berry","names","stats","raid","fruits","fruitprice","speed"}}
function Core.moduleNoclip.wanted()
 if disposed then return false end
 if teleport.flight and teleport.flight.transport and teleport.flight.transport.contact
  or state.resourcefarm and progressFarm.transport and progressFarm.transport.contact
  or state.farm and teleport.levelTransport and teleport.levelTransport.contact then return false end
 if surfaceWalk.part and surfaceWalk.part.CanCollide and not hoverAlign and not movement then return false end
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if state.mirage and m and m.portalUntil and os.clock()<m.portalUntil then return false end
 -- Permit real floor contact while the island controller confirms disembarkation.
 if state.mirage and m and m.phase=="landing"and m.settleUntil and os.clock()<m.settleUntil then return false end
 for _,key in ipairs(Core.moduleNoclip.keys)do if state[key]==true then return true end end
 return teleport.flight~=nil
end
function Core.moduleNoclip.ground(character,human,root)
 local n=Core.moduleNoclip
 -- Automated flight and water support already control vertical position.
 if hoverAlign or movement or human.SeatPart or human.Sit or human.PlatformStand or human.Jump
  or root.Anchored or surfaceWalk.part and surfaceWalk.part.CanCollide then n.hit=nil;return end
 local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
 if velocity.Y>6 then n.hit=nil;return end
 local now=os.clock();local feet=surfaceWalk.feet(character,human,root)
 if now>=(n.rayAt or 0)then
  n.rayAt=now+.05
  if not n.params then n.params=RaycastParams.new();n.params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;n.params.IgnoreWater=true;n.params.RespectCanCollide=true end
  if now>=(n.filterAt or 0)then
   n.filterAt=now+1
   local filter={character}
   for _,name in ipairs({"Enemies","NPCs","Boats"})do local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(name);if folder then table.insert(filter,folder)end end
   n.params.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter
  end
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.5,0),Vector3.new(0,-feet-2,0),n.params)
  n.hit=hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide and hit.Normal.Y>.5 and hit.Position.Y<=root.Position.Y-feet+.75 and hit or nil
  n.sample=root.Position
 end
 local hit=n.hit
 if not hit or not hit.Instance.Parent or not n.sample or(Vector3.new(root.Position.X-n.sample.X,0,root.Position.Z-n.sample.Z)).Magnitude>1 then return end
 local floor=hit.Position.Y+feet
 if root.Position.Y<floor then
  root.CFrame=root.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,floor-root.Position.Y,0)
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)
 end
 if math.abs(root.Position.Y-floor)<.5 then
  local mode=human:GetState()
  if mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then human:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)end
 end
end
function Core.moduleNoclip.tick()
 local n=Core.moduleNoclip
 if not n.wanted()then
  if n.applied then n.applied=false;restoreCollisions(true)end
  n.character=nil;n.hit=nil;n.params=nil;n.rayAt=0;n.filterAt=0
  return
 end
 local character=localPlayer.Character
 local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not human or human.Health<=0 or not root then
  if n.applied then n.applied=false;restoreCollisions(true)end
  n.character=nil;n.hit=nil;return
 end
 if n.character~=character then n.character=character;n.params=nil;n.hit=nil;n.rayAt=0;n.filterAt=0 end
 -- Keep floor height without a collidable avatar, so ESP/Stats do not make the player fall through the map.
 if os.clock()>=(n.groundRetryAt or 0)then
  local ok,message=pcall(n.ground,character,human,root)
  if not ok then n.hit=nil;n.groundError=tostring(message);n.groundRetryAt=os.clock()+1 end
 end
 disableCollisions(character);n.applied=true
end

function raidCombat.body(model)
    for _,name in ipairs({"HumanoidRootPart","UpperTorso","Torso","Head"})do
        local part=model:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent==model then return part end
    end
end
function raidCombat.hitPart(model)
    for _,name in ipairs({"Head","UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"})do
        local part=model:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent==model then return part end
    end
end
local function holdPosition(root, position, mob, speed)
    if mob and combatAssist.npcSafePose then
        local evading
        position,evading=combatAssist.npcSafePose(root,mob,position,os.clock())
        if evading then mob=nil;speed=CONFIG.DodgeSpeed end
    end
    if hoverRoot~=root then
        stopHover()
        hoverAttachment=create("Attachment", {Name="ViltrumHoverAttachment"}, root)
        hoverAlign=create("AlignPosition", {Name="ViltrumHover", Attachment0=hoverAttachment,
            Mode=Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment, ApplyAtCenterOfMass=true,
            ReactionForceEnabled=false, MaxForce=100000,
            MaxVelocity=CONFIG.TravelSpeed, Responsiveness=80, RigidityEnabled=false}, root)
        hoverRoot=root
    end
    local mass=tonumber(root.AssemblyMass)
    local force=mass and mass>0 and mass<math.huge and math.max(100000,mass*(workspace.Gravity or 196.2)*8)or 100000
    if hoverAlign.MaxForce~=force then hoverAlign.MaxForce=force end
    local velocity=speed or CONFIG.TravelSpeed
    if hoverAlign.MaxVelocity~=velocity then hoverAlign.MaxVelocity=velocity end
    if (hoverAlign.Position-position).Magnitude>.05 then hoverAlign.Position=position end
    hoverMob=mob
    local mobRoot=mob and raidCombat.body(mob)
    hoverOffset=mobRoot and position-mobRoot.Position or nil
end
local function deactivateWeapon()
    local character = localPlayer.Character
    local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if tool then pcall(function() tool:Deactivate() end) end
end
local function cancelQuestRequest()
    if questTimer then task.cancel(questTimer); questTimer=nil end
    if questRequest then task.cancel(questRequest); questRequest=nil end
end
local function cancelAuraRequest()
    if auraTimer then task.cancel(auraTimer); auraTimer=nil end
    if auraRequest then task.cancel(auraRequest); auraRequest=nil end
end
local function hasAura(character)
    if not character then return false end
    local marker=character:FindFirstChild("HasBuso")
    return character:GetAttribute("HasBuso")==true or marker~=nil and(not marker:IsA("BoolValue")or marker.Value==true)
end
local function ensureAura(character,required)
    if hasAura(character)then auraStatus="on";haki.learned=true;return true end
    if not required and not CONFIG.AutoAura then auraStatus="waiting for M1";return false end
    local now=os.clock()
    if auraRequest or auraRequestedCharacter==character and now-auraSentAt<2 then return false end
    local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then auraStatus="remote unavailable";return false end
    auraRequestedCharacter=character;auraStatus="requested";auraSentAt=now
    local requestThread
    requestThread=task.defer(function()
        if disposed or not(state.autohaki or state.triggerbot or state.farm or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events or state.raid)
            or localPlayer.Character~=character or hasAura(character)then
            if auraRequest==requestThread then auraRequest=nil;if auraTimer then task.cancel(auraTimer);auraTimer=nil end end
            return
        end
        local ok=pcall(function()remote:InvokeServer("Buso")end)
        if auraRequest==requestThread then
            auraRequest=nil
            if auraTimer then task.cancel(auraTimer);auraTimer=nil end
            auraStatus=ok and(hasAura(character)and "on"or "waiting for Haki confirmation")or "Haki request failed"
            if hasAura(character)then haki.learned=true end
        end
    end)
    auraRequest=requestThread
    auraTimer=task.delay(8,function()
        if auraRequest==requestThread then auraTimer=nil;task.cancel(auraRequest);auraRequest=nil;auraStatus="Haki request timed out"end
    end)
    return false
end
function raidCombat.auraReady(character)
    -- First Sea ordinary M1 is usable before Aura is purchased. Activation is
    -- still attempted when requested; a missing marker must not block every
    -- combat module. The existing purchase flow and raid gate remain separate.
    if SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]==1 and not state.raid and not haki.purchasePending then
        ensureAura(character,false);return true
    end
    if ensureAura(character,true)then return true end
    -- Only Auto Farm's initial money stage may punch before learning Aura.
    if (state.farm and(haki.owner==nil or haki.owner=="farm")or state.swordfarm and haki.owner=="swordfarm"or state.gunfarm and haki.owner=="gunfarm")and haki.bootstrap and not haki.learned and not haki.purchasePending and not auraRequest
        and os.clock()-haki.started>=2 then
        local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
        local beli=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
        if beli and tonumber(beli.Value)and beli.Value<25000 then return true end
    end
    releaseNativeClick();return false
end
function haki.cancel()
    if haki.thread then task.cancel(haki.thread);haki.thread=nil end
    if haki.timer then task.cancel(haki.timer);haki.timer=nil end
    haki.owner=nil;haki.bootstrap=false;haki.purchasePending=nil;haki.generation=(haki.generation or 0)+1
end
function haki.begin(character,owner)
    haki.cancel();haki.owner=owner or "farm";haki.started=os.clock();haki.attempts=0;haki.nextPurchase=0
    haki.teacher=nil;haki.teacherAt=0
    haki.bootstrap=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]==1 and not haki.learned and not hasAura(character)
end

do
    -- Require a skill-specific cue; Action priority alone also describes ordinary hits.
    -- Skills with no replicated animation/casting signal remain unobservable.
    local watched,threats,owner={},{},nil
    local active,refreshAt,lastThreatAt,side=nil,-math.huge,-math.huge,1
    local function nearby(part,root)
        local delta=part.Position-root.Position
        return Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude<=CONFIG.DodgeRadius
    end
    local function disconnect(entry)
        if entry.connection then entry.connection:Disconnect()end
        for _,connection in ipairs(entry.casts)do connection:Disconnect()end
    end
    function dodge.reset()
        for _,entry in pairs(watched)do disconnect(entry)end
        table.clear(watched);table.clear(threats)
        owner=nil;active=nil;refreshAt=-math.huge;lastThreatAt=-math.huge;side=1
    end
    local function offensive(track,model,report)
        if not track or track.IsPlaying==false then return false end
        local animation=track.Animation
        if not animation then return false end
        local info={name=animation.Name,playing=track.IsPlaying,isSkill=animation:GetAttribute("IsSkill"),
            key=animation:GetAttribute("SkillKey"),kind=animation:GetAttribute("AttackType")}
        local attack=Core.npcSkillCue(info)
        if not attack and info.isSkill~=false and type(track.Name)=="string"then
            info.name=track.Name;attack=Core.npcSkillCue(info)
        end
        if report then
            local id=tostring(animation.AnimationId or ""):match("%d+")
            playerGui:SetAttribute("ViltrumLastNpcAnimationId",id)
            playerGui:SetAttribute("ViltrumLastNpcAnimationName",animation.Name)
            playerGui:SetAttribute("ViltrumLastNpcAnimationIsAttackCue",attack)
        end
        if report and dodge.cueLabel and attack then dodge.cueLabel.Text="Skill cue: named / tagged clip"end
        return attack
    end
    local function escape(root,caster,track,reason,entry,kind)
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if disposed or not state.raid or not raidRunning or not state.dodge or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0
            or root.Parent~=character or not caster.Parent or not nearby(caster,root)
            or (raidCombat.timer and not raidCombat.timer())then return end
        threats[track]={model=caster.Parent,track=track,reason=reason,entry=entry,kind=kind}
        lastThreatAt=os.clock()
        local started=not active
        if started then
            local forward=caster.CFrame and caster.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
            forward=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
            if forward.Magnitude<.01 then forward=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)end
            active={root=root,anchor=hoverMob or caster.Parent,
                offset=Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X).Unit*side*CONFIG.DodgeSide,
                direction=side==1 and "right"or"left"}
            side=-side
        end
        local body=raidCombat.body(active.anchor)or caster
        local position=body.Position+Vector3.new(0,CONFIG.RaidHeight,0)+active.offset
        releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon()
        if started then root.CFrame=CFrame.new(position)*root.CFrame.Rotation end
        holdPosition(root,position,nil,CONFIG.DodgeSpeed)
    end
    function dodge.step(humanoid,root,list,now)
        if not state.dodge then dodge.reset();return false end
        if owner~=humanoid then dodge.reset();owner=humanoid end
        if now-refreshAt>=.1 then
            refreshAt=now
            local players={}
            for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do if player.Character then players[player.Character]=true end end
            local keep={}
            for _,candidate in ipairs(list)do
                local model=candidate.model
                if not players[model] and candidate.health>0 and nearby(candidate.part,root)then
                    keep[model]=true
                    local animator=candidate.humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                    local entry=watched[model]
                    if not entry or entry.animator~=animator or entry.part~=candidate.part then
                        if entry then disconnect(entry)end
                        entry={animator=animator,part=candidate.part,casts={}};watched[model]=entry
                        local function valid()
                            return watched[model]==entry and model.Parent==workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")and candidate.humanoid.Health>0
                        end
                        local function casting()
                            return model:GetAttribute("UsingSkill")==true
                        end
                        local castTrack=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(_,key)if key=="IsPlaying"then return casting()end end})
                        local function castChanged()
                            if valid()and casting()then escape(root,candidate.part,castTrack,"NPC casting state",entry,"state")end
                        end
                        for _,name in ipairs({"UsingSkill"})do table.insert(entry.casts,model:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(castChanged))end
                        castChanged()
                        if animator then
                            local function played(track)
                                if valid()and offensive(track,model,true)then escape(root,candidate.part,track,"NPC skill animation",entry,"animation")end
                            end
                            entry.connection=animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(played)
                            local ok,tracks=pcall(function()return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()end)
                            if ok then for _,track in ipairs(tracks)do played(track)end end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for model,entry in pairs(watched)do if not keep[model]then disconnect(entry);watched[model]=nil end end
        end
        local danger=false
        for track,threat in pairs(threats)do
            local model=threat.model
            local human=model.Parent and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part=human and raidCombat.body(model)
            if watched[model]~=threat.entry or not human or human.Health<=0 or not part or not nearby(part,root)or track.IsPlaying==false
                or (threat.kind=="animation" and not offensive(track,model,false))then threats[track]=nil
            else danger=true end
        end
        if danger then lastThreatAt=now end
        if active then
            if active.root~=root or (not danger and now-lastThreatAt>=CONFIG.DodgeGrace)then active=nil
            else
                local anchor=raidCombat.body(active.anchor)
                if not anchor then active=nil
                else
                    releaseNativeClick()
                    if dodge.cueLabel then
                        local value=danger and "Active NPC skill · dodging "..active.direction or "Skill ended · returning"
                        if dodge.cueLabel.Text~=value then dodge.cueLabel.Text=value end
                    end
                    holdPosition(root,anchor.Position+Vector3.new(0,CONFIG.RaidHeight,0)+active.offset,nil,CONFIG.DodgeSpeed)
                    return true,active.direction.." 60 studs · NPC skill active"
                end
            end
        end
        if not danger and dodge.cueLabel then
            local name=playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumLastNpcAnimationName")
            local id=playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumLastNpcAnimationId")
            local value="No active NPC skill"..(name and " · Last clip: "..name.." · ID "..tostring(id or "missing")or "")
            if dodge.cueLabel.Text~=value then dodge.cueLabel.Text=value end
        end
        return false
    end
end

local function stopFarm(message)
    if teleport.releaseTransport then teleport.releaseTransport(teleport.levelTransport)end
    teleport.levelTransport=nil
    haki.cancel()
    fruit.target=nil
    state.farm = false
    releaseNativeClick()
    stopMovement()
    stopHover()
    deactivateWeapon()
    cancelQuestRequest()
    cancelAuraRequest()
    restoreCollisions()
    watchedMob, watchedHealth, attackCount = nil, nil, 0
    combatProbe=nil
    spawnRouteKey, spawnRoutePoints, spawnRouteIndex, spawnArrivedAt=nil,nil,nil,nil
    if controls.farm and not disposed then controls.farm(false) end
    if message then status(message) end
end
local function statsStatus(message)
    if statsStatusLabel and not disposed and statsStatusLabel.Text~=message then statsStatusLabel.Text=message end
end
stopRaid=function(message)
    if raidHost.reset then raidHost.reset()end
    fruit.target=nil
    state.raid=false;raidRunning=false
    dodge.reset()
    releaseNativeClick();stopMovement();stopHover();deactivateWeapon();cancelAuraRequest();restoreCollisions()
    raidIndex,raidMarker,raidEmptyAt=0,nil,nil;raidCachedMarkers={};raidMarkersAt=-math.huge;combatProbe=nil
    if controls.raid and not disposed then controls.raid(false)end
    if message then status(message)end
end
function elite.cancelRequest()
    if elite.requestTimer then task.cancel(elite.requestTimer);elite.requestTimer=nil end
    if elite.requestThread then task.cancel(elite.requestThread);elite.requestThread=nil end
end
function elite.stop(message)
    state.elite=false;elite.cancelRequest()
    elite.phase="hunter";elite.target=nil;elite.targetName=nil;elite.searchAt=nil
    elite.hintName=nil;elite.hintPosition=nil;elite.hintAt=nil;elite.questScanAt=nil;elite.questLabel=nil
    fruit.target=nil;releaseNativeClick();stopMovement();stopHover();deactivateWeapon()
    cancelAuraRequest();restoreCollisions();combatProbe=nil
    spawnRouteKey,spawnRoutePoints,spawnRouteIndex,spawnArrivedAt=nil,nil,nil,nil
    if controls.elite and not disposed then controls.elite(false)end
    if message then status(message)end
end
function berry.stop(message)
    state.berry=false
    if berry.release then berry.release()end
    berry.current=nil;berry.idlePosition=nil;berry.idleRoot=nil
    if not berryEsp.running and berry.disconnect then berry.disconnect()end
    stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
    if berry.label then berry.label.Text="All berry colors · Current sea"end
    if controls.berry and not disposed then controls.berry(false)end
    if message then status(message)end
end
function autoFruits.stop(message)
    state.autofruits=false
    if autoFruits.release then autoFruits.release()end
    autoFruits.target=nil;autoFruits.arrivedAt=nil;autoFruits.attempts=0
    autoFruits.collected=false;autoFruits.emptySince=nil;autoFruits.emptyScan=nil
    stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
    if autoFruits.label then autoFruits.label.Text=message or "Disabled · Flight speed: 150 blocks/s"end
    if controls.autofruits and not disposed then controls.autofruits(false)end
    if teleport.updateFlightUI then teleport.updateFlightUI()end
end
function boss.stop(message)
    state.boss=false
    if boss.clearTarget then boss.clearTarget()end
    stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions();cancelAuraRequest();combatProbe=nil
    if controls.boss and not disposed then controls.boss(false)end
    if message and boss.note then boss.note(message)end
end
function haki.fail(message)
    if haki.owner=="swordfarm"then acquisition.error(swordFarm,message)elseif haki.owner=="gunfarm"then acquisition.error(gunFarm,message)else stopFarm(message)end
end
function haki.note(message)
    haki.message=message
    if haki.owner=="swordfarm"then swordFarm.note(message)elseif haki.owner=="gunfarm"then gunFarm.note(message)else status(message)end
end
function haki.step(character,human,root)
    if not haki.bootstrap then return false end
    if hasAura(character)then
        haki.learned=true;haki.bootstrap=false;haki.purchasePending=nil;haki.note("Haki enabled · resuming level farm");return false
    end
    if haki.learned or SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]~=1 then haki.bootstrap=false;return false end
    local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
    local beli=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
    local money=beli and tonumber(beli.Value)
    if not money then releaseNativeClick();haki.note("Haki: waiting for Data.Beli");return true end
    ensureAura(character,true)
    local now=os.clock()
    if now-haki.started<2 then releaseNativeClick();holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil);haki.note("Checking existing Haki…");return true end
    if haki.purchasePending then
        releaseNativeClick();holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil)
        if now-haki.purchasePending<8 then haki.note("Activating purchased Haki · waiting for confirmation");return true end
        haki.purchasePending=nil
        if haki.attempts>=3 then haki.fail("Haki purchase / activation was not confirmed; farm paused");return true end
    end
    if money<25000 then return false end
    -- Aura has no level requirement. Buy it as soon as the first 25,000 Beli is available.
    releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();stopMovement();disableCollisions(character)
    if now>=haki.teacherAt then
        haki.teacherAt=now+1;haki.teacher=nil
        local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
        local best=math.huge
        if folder then for _,npc in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do
            local name=Core.styleKey(npc.Name)
            if name=="abilityteacher"or name=="abilitiesteacher"then
                local body=raidCombat.body(npc)
                if body then local distance=(body.Position-root.Position).Magnitude;if distance<best then best=distance;haki.teacher=body end end
            end
        end end
    end
    local position=haki.teacher and haki.teacher.Parent and haki.teacher.Position
    if not position then
        holdPosition(root,Vector3.new(1298,87,-1344),nil);haki.note("Haki: flying to Frozen Village · waiting for Ability Teacher");return true
    end
    holdPosition(root,position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),nil)
    if (root.Position-position).Magnitude>10 then haki.note("Haki: flying to Ability Teacher · 25,000 Beli");return true end
    if haki.thread or now<haki.nextPurchase then haki.note("Haki: waiting for purchase response");return true end
    if haki.attempts>=3 then haki.fail("Haki purchase was not confirmed; check Ability Teacher requirements");return true end
    local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then haki.fail("Haki purchase remote unavailable");return true end
    local generation=haki.generation
    local thread
    thread=task.defer(function()
        if not(haki.owner=="swordfarm"and state.swordfarm or haki.owner=="gunfarm"and state.gunfarm or haki.owner=="farm"and state.farm)or haki.generation~=generation or localPlayer.Character~=character then return end
        local ok=pcall(function()remote:InvokeServer("BuyHaki","Buso")end)
        if haki.thread~=thread or haki.generation~=generation then return end
        haki.thread=nil
        if haki.timer then task.cancel(haki.timer);haki.timer=nil end
        if not ok then haki.fail("Haki purchase request failed");return end
        haki.purchasePending=os.clock();cancelAuraRequest();auraRequestedCharacter=nil;ensureAura(character,true)
    end)
    haki.thread=thread;haki.attempts+=1;haki.nextPurchase=now+8;haki.purchasePending=now
    haki.timer=task.delay(8,function()
        if haki.thread==thread and haki.generation==generation then haki.timer=nil;haki.fail("Haki purchase timed out; farm paused")end
    end)
    haki.note("Buying Haki · waiting for activation confirmation");return true
end

-- Shared recovery for Sword/Gun acquisition. Never interpret a remote response as ownership.
function acquisition.active(controller)
 return controller.phase~="waiting"and controller.phase~="blocked"and controller.phase~="complete"
end
-- Accept inventory records and recognized containers, never error/status messages as items.
function acquisition.category(value)
 if type(value)~="string"then return nil end
 local key=Core.styleKey(value)
 local kinds={sword="Sword",swords="Sword",gun="Gun",guns="Gun",accessory="Accessory",accessories="Accessory",
  material="Material",materials="Material",fruit="Blox Fruit",fruits="Blox Fruit",bloxfruit="Blox Fruit",demonfruit="Blox Fruit",
  melee="Melee",fightingstyle="Melee",fightingstyles="Melee"}
 return kinds[key]
end
function acquisition.catalogType(name)
 if not acquisition.itemTypes then
  acquisition.itemTypes={}
  for _,source in ipairs({{swordFarm,"Sword"},{gunFarm,"Gun"}})do
   for _,rows in pairs(source[1].catalog or{})do for _,row in ipairs(rows)do
    local names={row.name};for _,alias in ipairs(row.aliases or{})do table.insert(names,alias)end
    for _,value in ipairs(names)do
     local key=Core.normalizeName(value);local old=acquisition.itemTypes[key]
     acquisition.itemTypes[key]=old==nil and source[2]or old==source[2]and old or false
    end
   end end
  end
  acquisition.itemTypes[Core.normalizeName("Ectoplasm")]="Material"
  acquisition.itemTypes[Core.normalizeName("Bones")]="Material"
 end
 return type(name)=="string"and acquisition.itemTypes[Core.normalizeName(name)]or nil
end
function acquisition.shape(result)
 local kind=type(result)
 if kind~="table"then return kind..(kind=="string"and "("..#result..")"or "")end
 local keys={};local count=0
 for key,value in pairs(result)do
  count=count+1
  if #keys<5 then
   local label=type(key)=="number"and "#"or type(key)=="string"and key:sub(1,24)or "key"
   table.insert(keys,label..":"..type(value))
  end
 end
 return "table["..count.."] "..table.concat(keys,",")
end
function acquisition.inventory(result,valid)
 local shape=acquisition.shape(result)
 if type(result)=="string"and #result<=1048576 then
  local first=result:match("^%s*(.)")
  if first=="{"or first=="["then
   local ok,value=pcall(function()return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(result)end)
   if ok then result=value end
  end
 end
 if type(result)~="table"then return nil,false,shape end
 if result.Success==false or result.success==false then return nil,false,"server success=false"end
 local output={};local count,unknown,entries=0,0,0;local truncated=false;local explicit=false;local slice=os.clock()
 local metadata={name=true,type=true,category=true,itemtype=true,count=true,amount=true,quantity=true,mastery=true,
  level=true,id=true,uid=true,equipped=true,owned=true,unlocked=true,success=true,status=true,message=true,error=true,total=true,version=true}
 local wrappers={inventory=true,items=true,data=true,result=true,results=true,weapons=true,owneditems=true}
 local function visit(value,group,hint,depth)
  entries=entries+1
  if entries>10000 or depth>8 then truncated=true;return end
  if entries%32==0 and os.clock()-slice>=.002 then
   task.wait();slice=os.clock();if valid and not valid()then truncated=true;return end
  end
  if valid and not valid()then truncated=true;return end
  if type(value)=="string"then
   local kind=acquisition.catalogType(value)
   if kind and(not group or group==kind)then table.insert(output,{Name=value,Type=kind});count=count+1 else unknown=unknown+1 end
   return
  end
  if type(value)~="table"then
   local kind=group or acquisition.catalogType(hint)
   if hint and kind and(value==true or type(value)=="number"and value>0)then
    table.insert(output,{Name=hint,Type=kind,Count=kind=="Material"and tonumber(value)or nil});count=count+1
   elseif value~=false and value~=nil then unknown=unknown+1 end
   return
  end
  if value.Owned==false or value.owned==false or value.Unlocked==false or value.unlocked==false then return end
  local name=value.Name or value.name or value.ItemName or value.itemName
  if not name and hint and(group or acquisition.catalogType(hint))then name=hint end
  local rawType=value.Type or value.type or value.Category or value.category or value.ItemType or value.itemType
  local kind=acquisition.category(rawType)or group
  if not kind and(not rawType or Core.styleKey(rawType)=="weapon"or Core.styleKey(rawType)=="item")then kind=acquisition.catalogType(name)end
  if type(name)=="string"and kind then
   if group and group~=kind then unknown=unknown+1;return end
   local mastery=value.Mastery or value.mastery or value.Level or value.level
   if type(mastery)=="table"then mastery=mastery.Value or mastery.value end
   table.insert(output,{Name=name,Type=kind,Mastery=tonumber(mastery),
    Count=tonumber(value.Count or value.count or value.Amount or value.amount or value.Quantity or value.quantity)})
   count=count+1;return
  end
  local children=0
  for key,item in pairs(value)do
   local normalized=type(key)=="string"and Core.styleKey(key)or ""
   local category=acquisition.category(type(key)=="string"and key or nil)
   if category then
    explicit=true;children=children+1;visit(item,category,nil,depth+1)
   elseif wrappers[normalized]then
    if normalized=="inventory"or normalized=="items"or normalized=="owneditems"then explicit=true end
    children=children+1;visit(item,group,nil,depth+1)
   elseif not metadata[normalized]then
    children=children+1;visit(item,group,type(key)=="string"and key or nil,depth+1)
   end
   if truncated then return end
  end
  if children==0 and name~=nil then unknown=unknown+1 end
 end
 visit(result,nil,nil,0)
 if valid and not valid()then return nil,false,"cancelled"end
 if truncated then return nil,false,"inventory exceeds parser bounds"end
 if count==0 and not explicit and next(result)~=nil then return nil,false,shape end
 return output,unknown==0,unknown>0 and "partial "..shape or nil
end
function acquisition.readFailure(controller,message)
 controller.inventoryIssue=message;controller.inventoryReliable=false;controller.inventoryAt=os.clock()+6
 -- Read failures do not release a live boss fight or pause the acquisition route.
end
function acquisition.requestFailure(controller,command,message)
 if command=="getInventory"then acquisition.readFailure(controller,message)
 elseif command=="LoadItem"then controller.probeIssue=message;controller.probeAt=os.clock()+5
 else acquisition.error(controller,message)end
end
function acquisition.probe(controller,row,now)
 if controller.inventoryReliable or controller.request or now<(controller.probeAt or 0)then return false end
 if controller.probed and controller.probeName==row.name and now<(controller.probeRefresh or 0)then return false end
 if controller.probeName~=row.name then controller.probeName=row.name;controller.probeIndex=0;controller.probed=false end
 local names={row.name};for _,name in ipairs(row.aliases or{})do table.insert(names,name)end
 controller.probeIndex=(controller.probeIndex or 0)+1
 local name=names[controller.probeIndex]
 if not name then controller.probed=true;controller.probeIndex=0;controller.probeRefresh=now+15;return false end
 if controller.invoke("LoadItem",{name},function()
  controller.probeAt=os.clock()+1
  if controller.probeIndex>=#names then controller.probed=true;controller.probeRefresh=os.clock()+15;controller.probeIndex=0 end
 end)then controller.probeAt=now+2;return true end
 controller.probeIndex=controller.probeIndex-1
 return false
end
function acquisition.purchaseReady(controller,row,root)
 if controller.inventoryReliable then return true end
 if not controller.probed or controller.probeName~=row.name then
  acquisition.probe(controller,row,os.clock());controller.note("Проверяю уже полученный "..row.name.." через LoadItem перед покупкой")
  return false
 end
 if controller.unverifiedBuy==row.name and not acquisition.retryUncharged(controller,row)then
  acquisition.probe(controller,row,os.clock())
  controller.note("Покупка "..row.name.." отправлена · жду предмет / инвентарь; повторно ресурсы не трачу")
  return false
 end
 return true
end
function acquisition.liveMaterial(name)
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
 local folder=data and(data:FindFirstChild("Materials")or data:FindFirstChild("Inventory"))
 local value=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
 if value and(value:IsA("IntValue")or value:IsA("NumberValue"))then return tonumber(value.Value)end
 return nil
end

function acquisition.pause(controller,message,delay)
 controller.issue=message;controller.phase="waiting"
 controller.retryAt=os.clock()+(delay or 3)
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();deactivateWeapon();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions();combatProbe=nil
 controller.note("Пауза: "..message.." · повтор через "..tostring(delay or 3).." с")
end
function acquisition.error(controller,message)
 controller.failures=math.min((controller.failures or 0)+1,4)
 acquisition.pause(controller,tostring(message),math.min(15,2^controller.failures))
end
function acquisition.waiting(controller)
 if os.clock()>=(controller.retryAt or 0)then return false end
 controller.note("Пауза: "..tostring(controller.issue).." · повтор через "..math.ceil(controller.retryAt-os.clock()).." с")
 return true
end
function acquisition.complete(controller,row)
 if controller.phase=="complete"then return end
 controller.phase="complete";controller.issue=nil;controller.retryAt=0
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();deactivateWeapon();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions();combatProbe=nil
 controller.note("Получен / уже есть: "..row.name.." · выберите другой предмет или выключите модуль")
end

function swordFarm.note(message)
    if swordFarm.inventoryIssue then message=message.." · инвентарь недоступен; проверка повторяется"end
    swordFarm.message=message
    if swordFarm.label and swordFarm.label.Text~=message then swordFarm.label.Text=message end
    if swordFarm.lastMessage~=message then swordFarm.lastMessage=message;status("Auto Farm Sword: "..message)end
    if swordFarm.updateUI then swordFarm.updateUI()end
end
function swordFarm.clearRun()
    swordFarm.generation=(swordFarm.generation or 0)+1
    for _,key in ipairs({"request","timer","kickJob"})do
        if swordFarm[key]then task.cancel(swordFarm[key]);swordFarm[key]=nil end
    end
    swordFarm.phase="running";swordFarm.issue=nil;swordFarm.retryAt=0;swordFarm.failures=0
    swordFarm.inventory=nil;swordFarm.inventoryAt=0;swordFarm.pendingBuy=nil;swordFarm.buyAttempts=0
    swordFarm.inventoryReliable=false;swordFarm.inventoryIssue=nil;swordFarm.inventoryReadAt=0
    swordFarm.probeName=nil;swordFarm.probeIndex=0;swordFarm.probed=false;swordFarm.probeAt=0;swordFarm.probeRefresh=0;swordFarm.unverifiedBuy=nil
    swordFarm.questAttempts=0;swordFarm.questFallbackUntil=0;swordFarm.questAt=0;swordFarm.requestAt=0;swordFarm.loadAt=0
    swordFarm.requestCommand=nil
    swordFarm.routeAt=0;swordFarm.routeIndex=1;swordFarm.character=nil
    swordFarm.npcAt=0;swordFarm.npcs=nil
    if haki.owner=="swordfarm"then haki.cancel()end
    fruit.release();fruit.target=nil;releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon();stopMovement();stopHover()
    restoreCollisions();cancelAuraRequest();combatProbe=nil
end
function swordFarm.stop(message)
    state.swordfarm=false;swordFarm.clearRun()
    if controls.swordfarm and not disposed then controls.swordfarm(false)end
    if message then swordFarm.note(message)elseif swordFarm.updateUI then swordFarm.updateUI()end
end
function swordFarm.pauseCharacter()
    if not state.swordfarm then return end
    swordFarm.clearRun();swordFarm.note("Ожидаю возрождения — затем продолжу выбранный меч")
end
function swordFarm.kick()
    if swordFarm.kickJob then task.cancel(swordFarm.kickJob)end
    local generation=swordFarm.generation
    swordFarm.kickJob=task.defer(function()
        swordFarm.kickJob=nil
        if disposed or not state.swordfarm or swordFarm.generation~=generation then return end
        local ok,message=pcall(swordFarm.step)
        if not ok then acquisition.error(swordFarm,message)end
    end)
end
function swordFarm.start()
    local sea=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
    if disposed then return false end
    if game.GameId~=994732206 or not sea then swordFarm.note("Нужно находиться в одном из морей Blox Fruits");return false end
    if swordFarm.sea~=sea then swordFarm.selected=nil;swordFarm.sea=sea end
    teleport.cancel();stopFarm();stopRaid();elite.stop();berry.stop();autoFruits.stop();boss.stop();eventFarm.stop();gunFarm.stop()
    progressFarm.stop();leviFarm.stop();autoKill.stop()
    swordFarm.clearRun();speedHack.restore();lastAttack=-math.huge;slotCharacter=nil
    auraRequestedCharacter=nil;auraStatus="pending"
    state.swordfarm=true
    if controls.swordfarm then controls.swordfarm(true)end
    swordFarm.note(swordFarm.selected and "Запускаю маршрут: "..swordFarm.selected.name or "Включено. Выберите меч ниже — маршрут запустится сразу.")
    swordFarm.kick();return true
end
function swordFarm.setEnabled(enabled)
    if enabled then swordFarm.start()else swordFarm.stop("Остановлено")end
    -- This controller sets state and both buttons itself, including the waiting-for-selection state.
    return false
end
function swordFarm.select(row,sea)
    if sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then swordFarm.note("Море изменилось — обновляю список");swordFarm.refreshUI(true);return end
    local running=state.swordfarm
    if running then swordFarm.clearRun()end
    swordFarm.selected=row;swordFarm.sea=sea
    if row.route=="quest"then
        local message="Маршрут "..row.name.." пока не реализован. Выберите другой меч."
        swordFarm.phase="blocked";swordFarm.note(message)
    elseif running then
        state.swordfarm=true;swordFarm.note("Переключаю маршрут: "..row.name);swordFarm.kick()
    else swordFarm.note("Выбран "..row.name..". Нажмите «Начать фарм».")end
    if swordFarm.redrawSelection then swordFarm.redrawSelection()end
end

function eventFarm.stop(message)
    if eventFarm.releaseSailing then eventFarm.releaseSailing()end
    eventFarm.departed=false;eventFarm.encounter=nil;eventFarm.ignoredSea=nil;eventFarm.course=nil
    state.events=false;eventFarm.generation=(eventFarm.generation or 0)+1
    eventFarm.target=nil;eventFarm.seenAt=nil;eventFarm.extraModels=nil;eventFarm.extraFolder=nil;eventFarm.extraAt=0
    fruit.release();fruit.target=nil;releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon();stopMovement();stopHover()
    restoreCollisions();cancelAuraRequest();combatProbe=nil
    if controls.events and not disposed then controls.events(false)end
    if message and eventFarm.note then eventFarm.note(message)end
end

local function stopStats(message)
    state.stats=false;statsSchedule.generation=(statsSchedule.generation or 0)+1;statsSchedule.retryAt=0
    if statsTimer then task.cancel(statsTimer);statsTimer=nil end
    if statsJob then task.cancel(statsJob);statsJob=nil end
    statsSchedule.pending=nil
    if controls.stats and not disposed then controls.stats(false)end
    if message then statsStatus(message)end
end

function statsSchedule.rule(key)
 for _,rule in ipairs(STAT_RULES)do if rule.key==key then return rule end end
end
function statsSchedule.select(key)
 local rule=statsSchedule.rule(key)
 if not rule then return end
 statsSchedule.selected=key;statsSchedule.generation=(statsSchedule.generation or 0)+1
 -- Cancel an unsent task. An already sent request keeps its confirmation barrier.
 if statsJob and not statsSchedule.pending then
  task.cancel(statsJob);statsJob=nil
  if statsTimer then task.cancel(statsTimer);statsTimer=nil end
 end
 statsSchedule.retryAt=0;statsLastTick=-math.huge
 playerGui:SetAttribute("ViltrumStatTarget",key)
 if statsSchedule.redraw then statsSchedule.redraw()end
 statsStatus("Выбрано "..rule.label.." · все доступные поинты"..(state.stats and " автоматически"or " после включения"))
end
function statsSchedule.setEnabled(enabled)
 if not enabled then stopStats("Auto Stats выключен");return false end
 if game.GameId~=994732206 then statsStatus("Auto Stats работает в Blox Fruits");return false end
 local rule=statsSchedule.rule(statsSchedule.selected)
 if not rule then statsStatus("Сначала выберите Melee, Bloxfruit, Gun, Sword или Defense");return false end
 state.stats=true;statsLastTick=-math.huge;statsSchedule.retryAt=0
 if controls.stats then controls.stats(true)end
 statsStatus("Все доступные и новые поинты → "..rule.label)
 return false
end
function statsSchedule.statValue(data,rule)
 local folder=data and data:FindFirstChild("Stats")
 local node=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(rule.remote)
 node=node or data and data:FindFirstChild(rule.remote)
 if not node then return nil end
 if node:IsA("IntValue")or node:IsA("NumberValue")then return tonumber(node.Value)end
 local value=node:FindFirstChild("Level")
 if value and(value:IsA("IntValue")or value:IsA("NumberValue"))then return tonumber(value.Value)end
end

-- Location discovery runs only when this page opens, or its map data changes.
do
    local function key(name)return tostring(name):lower():gsub("[^%w]","")end
    local function finite(position)
        if not position then return false end
        for _,axis in ipairs({"X","Y","Z"})do
            local value=position[axis]
            if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)>1000000 then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function point(object)
        if not object or not object:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then return nil end
        if object:IsA("BasePart")then return finite(object.Position)and object.Position or nil end
        if object:IsA("Model")then
            local part=object.PrimaryPart or object:FindFirstChild("Entrance",true) or object:FindFirstChild("Spawn",true)
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart")and finite(part.Position)then return part.Position end
            if object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)then
                local ok,pivot=pcall(function()return object:GetPivot()end)
                if ok and finite(pivot.Position)then return pivot.Position end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local ownership={}
    for sea,rows in pairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS)do
        for _,row in ipairs(rows)do
            local names={row[1]};for _,alias in ipairs(row[3]or{})do table.insert(names,alias)end
            for _,name in ipairs(names)do
                local normalized=key(name);ownership[normalized]=ownership[normalized]or{};ownership[normalized][sea]=true
            end
        end
    end
    function teleport.collect()
        local sea=Core.SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
        teleport.sea=sea;teleport.dirty=false;teleport.live={}
        if not sea or game.GameId~=994732206 then return {}end
        local origin=workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
        local locations=origin and origin:FindFirstChild("Locations")
        local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local function add(object,onlyEvents)
            local normalized=key(object.Name)
            local owners=ownership[normalized]
            local declared=object:GetAttribute("Sea")
            if declared~=nil and tonumber(declared)~=sea then return end
            if owners and not owners[sea]then return end
            if normalized:match("^island%d+$")then return end
            if onlyEvents then
                local event=false
                for _,row in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[sea])do
                    if not row[2]then
                        if key(row[1])==normalized then event=true end
                        for _,alias in ipairs(row[3]or{})do if key(alias)==normalized then event=true end end
                    end
                end
                if not event then return end
            end
            if point(object)then teleport.live[normalized]=object end
        end
        if locations then for _,object in ipairs(locations:GetChildren())do add(object,false)end end
        if map then for _,object in ipairs(map:GetChildren())do
            if not teleport.live[key(object.Name)]then add(object,true)end
        end end
        local rows,used={},{}
        for _,source in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[sea])do
            local names={source[1]};for _,alias in ipairs(source[3]or{})do table.insert(names,alias)end
            local marker
            for _,name in ipairs(names)do
                local normalized=key(name);used[normalized]=true
                marker=marker or teleport.live[normalized]
            end
            if source[2]or marker then
                table.insert(rows,{name=source[1],fallback=source[2],marker=marker,sea=sea})
            end
        end
        local extra={}
        for normalized,marker in pairs(teleport.live)do
            if not used[normalized]then table.insert(extra,{name=marker.Name,marker=marker,sea=sea})end
        end
        table.sort(extra,function(a,b)return a.name<b.name end)
        for _,row in ipairs(extra)do table.insert(rows,row)end
        return rows
    end
    function teleport.cancel(message)
        state.teleportplayer=false;if controls.teleportplayer then controls.teleportplayer(false)end
        if not teleport.flight then return end
        teleport.releaseTransport(teleport.flight.transport)
        teleport.flight=nil
        stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
        if teleport.updateFlightUI then teleport.updateFlightUI()end
        if message then status(message)end
    end
    local function destination(row)
        if row.player then
            local player=row.player;local character=player.Parent==Players and player.Character
            local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            return root and human and human.Health>0 and root.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,3)or nil
        end
        local marker=row.marker
        local declared=marker and marker:GetAttribute("Sea")
        local position=row.fallback and Vector3.new(row.fallback[1],row.fallback[2],row.fallback[3])or(declared==nil or tonumber(declared)==row.sea)and point(marker)or nil
        if not position and row.fallback then position=Vector3.new(row.fallback[1],row.fallback[2],row.fallback[3])end
        return finite(position)and teleport.safeDestination(row,position)or nil
    end
    function teleport.begin(row)
        if disposed then return end
        if game.GameId~=994732206 or Core.SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]~=row.sea then
            teleport.dirty=true;status("Location belongs to a different sea. Refresh Teleports.");return
        end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart")or not human or human.Health<=0 then status("Teleport: wait for your character to spawn.");return end
        local current
        for _,candidate in ipairs(teleport.collect())do if candidate.name==row.name then current=candidate;break end end
        teleport.dirty=true
        if not current then status("Location is no longer available. Refresh Teleports.");return end
        row=current
        local position=row.name=="Submerged Island"and Vector3.new(-16541,80,1051)or destination(row)
        if not position then teleport.dirty=true;status("Location is no longer available. Refresh Teleports.");return end
        teleport.cancel()
        stopFarm();stopRaid();elite.stop();berry.stop();autoFruits.stop();boss.stop();swordFarm.stop("Stopped by teleport");gunFarm.stop("Остановлено телепортом");progressFarm.stop("Остановлено телепортом");leviFarm.stop("Остановлено телепортом");autoKill.stop("Остановлено телепортом");eventFarm.stop("Stopped by teleport")
        human.Sit=false
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0);root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        teleport.flight={row=row,character=character,root=root,human=human,statusAt=-math.huge}
        if row.name=="Submerged Island"then teleport.flight.transport={}end
        disableCollisions(character)
        holdPosition(root,position,nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
        if teleport.updateFlightUI then teleport.updateFlightUI()end
        status("Flying: "..row.name.." · "..CONFIG.TravelSpeed.." studs/s · Farm / Raid / Elite Hunter / Berry stopped.")
    end
    function teleport.tick()
        local flight=teleport.flight
        if not flight then return end
        if game.GameId~=994732206 or Core.SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]~=flight.row.sea then
            teleport.cancel("Flight stopped: world changed.");return
        end
        if localPlayer.Character~=flight.character or flight.human.Health<=0
            or flight.human.Parent~=flight.character or flight.root.Parent~=flight.character then
            teleport.cancel("Flight stopped: character unavailable.");return
        end
        if flight.transport then
            local done,message=teleport.submergedStep(flight.transport,flight.root,flight.human,os.clock())
            if done then teleport.cancel(message)else status(message)end
            return
        end
        local target=destination(flight.row)
        if not target then teleport.cancel("Flight stopped: location disappeared.");return end
        local distance=(flight.root.Position-target).Magnitude
        if distance<=(flight.row.player and 5 or CONFIG.PositionTolerance)then
            if not flight.row.player and not flight.row.safePoint then
                holdPosition(flight.root,target,nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed);status("Waiting for a clear landing surface: "..flight.row.name);return
            end
            flight.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            flight.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            teleport.cancel("Arrived: "..flight.row.name);return
        end
        holdPosition(flight.root,target,nil,flight.row.player and 150 or CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
        if os.clock()-flight.statusAt>=.25 then
            flight.statusAt=os.clock();status("Flying: "..flight.row.name.." · "..math.ceil(distance).." studs left")
        end
    end
    local function changed(object)
        local origin=workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
        local locations=origin and origin:FindFirstChild("Locations")
        local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        if object.Name=="_WorldOrigin" or object.Name=="Locations" or object.Name=="Map"
            or locations and (object.Parent==locations or object:IsDescendantOf(locations))
            or map and (object.Parent==map or object:IsDescendantOf(map))then teleport.dirty=true end
    end
    connect(workspace.DescendantAdded,changed);connect(workspace.DescendantRemoving,changed)
end

syncedTheme.specs={["cat"]={["x"]=2,["y"]=2,["width"]=20,["height"]=20,["logicalWidth"]=10,["logicalHeight"]=10},["combat"]={["x"]=26,["y"]=2,["width"]=24,["height"]=24,["logicalWidth"]=12,["logicalHeight"]=12},["general"]={["x"]=54,["y"]=2,["width"]=24,["height"]=24,["logicalWidth"]=12,["logicalHeight"]=12},["skinchanger"]={["x"]=82,["y"]=2,["width"]=24,["height"]=24,["logicalWidth"]=12,["logicalHeight"]=12},["close"]={["x"]=110,["y"]=2,["width"]=24,["height"]=24,["logicalWidth"]=12,["logicalHeight"]=12},["avatar"]={["x"]=138,["y"]=2,["width"]=60,["height"]=60,["logicalWidth"]=30,["logicalHeight"]=30},["launcher"]={["x"]=202,["y"]=2,["width"]=186,["height"]=76,["logicalWidth"]=93,["logicalHeight"]=38}}
-- Visual assets supplied by the user. Asset/font failures do not stop gameplay modules.
function syncedTheme.font(object,weight)
    if not syncedTheme.faces then return end
    weight=weight or 500;syncedTheme.texts[object]=weight
    object.FontFace=syncedTheme.faces[weight]or syncedTheme.faces[500]
end
function syncedTheme.sprite(parent,name,x,y)
    local spec=syncedTheme.specs[name]
    if not spec then return nil end
    local picture=create("ImageLabel",{Name="Synced_"..name,BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(spec.logicalWidth,spec.logicalHeight),
        Image=syncedTheme.assets and syncedTheme.assets["atlas.png"]or "",ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(spec.x,spec.y),
        ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(spec.width,spec.height),ZIndex=5},parent)
    table.insert(syncedTheme.pictures,{object=picture,key="atlas.png"})
    return picture
end
function syncedTheme.decode(data)
    local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";local lookup={}
    for index=1,#alphabet do lookup[string.byte(alphabet,index)]=index-1 end
    local output,buffer,bits={},0,0
    for index=1,#data do
        local value=lookup[string.byte(data,index)]
        if value then
            buffer=buffer*64+value;bits=bits+6
            if bits>=8 then bits=bits-8;local power=2^bits;output[#output+1]=string.char(math.floor(buffer/power)%256);buffer=buffer%power end
        end
        if index%8192==0 then task.wait();if disposed then return nil end end
    end
    return table.concat(output)
end
function syncedTheme.attach(gui)
    syncedTheme.texts=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"});syncedTheme.pictures={};syncedTheme.assets={};syncedTheme.faces={}
    for weight,enum in pairs({[500]=Enum.FontWeight.Medium,[600]=Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold,[700]=Enum.FontWeight.Bold})do
        syncedTheme.faces[weight]=Font.fromName("BuilderSans",enum,Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    end
    syncedTheme.job=task.defer(function()
        local register=getcustomasset or getsynasset
        local options=type(shared)=="table"and shared.SyncedUIOptions or nil
        if type(getgenv)=="function"then local ok,scope=pcall(getgenv);if ok and type(scope)=="table"then options=scope.SyncedUIOptions or options end end
        options=type(options)=="table"and options or{}
        for _,name in ipairs({"atlas.png","shadow-0.png","shadow-1.png","shadow-2.png","shadow-3.png","shadow-4.png","shadow-5.png","Inter-500.ttf","Inter-600.ttf","Inter-700.ttf"})do
            if disposed then return end
            local supplied=options.AssetIds and options.AssetIds[name]
            if supplied then syncedTheme.assets[name]=type(supplied)=="number"and "rbxassetid://"..supplied or tostring(supplied)
            elseif type(register)=="function"and type(writefile)=="function"then
                local ok,value=pcall(function()
                    local bytes=syncedTheme.decode(syncedTheme.data[name]);if not bytes then return nil end
                    local file="synced-blox-v52-"..name;writefile(file,bytes);return register(file)
                end)
                if ok and type(value)=="string"then syncedTheme.assets[name]=value end
            end
        end
        local family=options.FontFamily
        if not family and type(register)=="function"and type(writefile)=="function"and syncedTheme.assets["Inter-500.ttf"]and syncedTheme.assets["Inter-600.ttf"]and syncedTheme.assets["Inter-700.ttf"]then
            local ok,value=pcall(function()
                local faces={}
                for _,weight in ipairs({500,600,700})do table.insert(faces,{name=tostring(weight),weight=weight,style="normal",assetId=syncedTheme.assets["Inter-"..weight..".ttf"]})end
                local file="synced-blox-v52-Inter.json";writefile(file,game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({name="Synced Inter",faces=faces}));return register(file)
            end)
            if ok then family=value end
        end
        if family then for weight,enum in pairs({[500]=Enum.FontWeight.Medium,[600]=Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold,[700]=Enum.FontWeight.Bold})do
            local ok,face=pcall(function()return Font.new(family,enum,Enum.FontStyle.Normal)end)
            if ok then syncedTheme.faces[weight]=face end
        end end
        local slice=os.clock()
        for object,weight in pairs(syncedTheme.texts)do
            if object.Parent then object.FontFace=syncedTheme.faces[weight]end
            if os.clock()-slice>=.002 then task.wait();slice=os.clock();if disposed then return end end
        end
        for _,entry in ipairs(syncedTheme.pictures)do
            if entry.object.Parent then entry.object.Image=syncedTheme.assets[entry.key]or ""end
        end
        if gui.Parent then gui:SetAttribute("SyncedFont",family and "Inter"or "BuilderSans fallback");gui:SetAttribute("SyncedAssetsReady",syncedTheme.assets["atlas.png"]~=nil)end
        syncedTheme.data=nil;syncedTheme.job=nil
    end)
end
function syncedTheme.shadow(window,gui,scale)
    local root=create("Frame",{Name="SyncedShadow",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=window.Position,
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(1056,736),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=1},gui)
    local shadowScale=create("UIScale",{Scale=scale.Scale},root)
    for index=0,5 do
        local picture=create("ImageLabel",{Name="OriginalShadow"..index,BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(index%3*352,math.floor(index/3)*368),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(352,368),Image="",ZIndex=1},root)
        table.insert(syncedTheme.pictures,{object=picture,key="shadow-"..index..".png"})
    end
    connect(window:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"),function()root.Position=window.Position end)
    connect(window:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function()root.Visible=window.Visible end)
    connect(scale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"),function()shadowScale.Scale=scale.Scale end)
end

local restoreDragInput,restoreDragStart,restoreStart,restoreDragged=nil,nil,nil,false
local restoreSuppressUntil=0
local function setMenuVisible(visible)
    if not visible and ui then ui.close()end
    if mobile then mobile.closeDrawer()end
    menuShown=visible;menuTransition+=1
    local transition=menuTransition
    if menuHideTask then task.cancel(menuHideTask);menuHideTask=nil end
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    resize()
    local baseScale=uiScale.Scale
    if visible then
        window.Visible=true;restore.Visible=false
        uiScale.Scale=baseScale*.97;window.BackgroundTransparency=.15
        animate(uiScale,{Scale=baseScale});animate(window,{BackgroundTransparency=0})
    else
        animate(uiScale,{Scale=baseScale*.97});animate(window,{BackgroundTransparency=.15})
        menuHideTask=task.delay(.16,function()
            if disposed or transition~=menuTransition or menuShown then return end
            menuHideTask=nil;window.Visible=false;restore.Visible=true
        end)
    end
end

    if os.clock()<restoreSuppressUntil then return end
    setMenuVisible(true)
end)

    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        restoreDragged=false;restoreSuppressUntil=0
    end
end)

    if not restoreDragInput then return end
    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input==restoreDragInput then

        if restoreDragged and workspace.CurrentCamera then

            restore.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(restoreStart.X+delta.X,8,math.max(8,gui.AbsoluteSize.X-restore.AbsoluteSize.X-8)),
                math.clamp(restoreStart.Y+delta.Y,8,math.max(8,gui.AbsoluteSize.Y-restore.AbsoluteSize.Y-8)))
            restoreSuppressUntil=os.clock()+.25
        end
    end
end)

    if input==restoreDragInput then
        if restoreDragged then restoreSuppressUntil=os.clock()+.25 end
        restoreDragInput=nil
    end
end)

    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input==dragInput then

        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera

            local viewport,scaled=gui.AbsoluteSize,window.AbsoluteSize
            window.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(
                math.clamp(viewport.X*windowStart.X.Scale+windowStart.X.Offset+delta.X,scaled.X/2,viewport.X-scaled.X/2),
                math.clamp(viewport.Y*windowStart.Y.Scale+windowStart.Y.Offset+delta.Y,scaled.Y/2,viewport.Y-scaled.Y/2))
        end
    end
end)

local pages,tabButtons,columns,cards={},{},{},{}
local currentPage="farm"
for _,name in ipairs({"farm","raid","combat","stats","teleports","esp","settings"}) do
    pages[name]=create("CanvasGroup",{Name="Page_"..name,BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=name=="farm",GroupTransparency=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(contentX,pageY),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(674,550)},window)
    columns[pages[name]]={}
    for index=1,2 do
        local column=create("ScrollingFrame",{Name="Column"..index,BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset((index-1)*347,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(368,550*368/327),
            CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),ScrollBarThickness=3,ScrollBarImageColor3=colors.border,ClipsDescendants=true},pages[name])
        create("UIScale",{Scale=327/368},column)
        columns[pages[name]][index]=column;cards[column]={}
    end
end
local function selectPage(name)
    if ui then ui.close()end
    if mobile then mobile.selectPage(name)end
    currentPage=name
    for id,p in pairs(pages)do p.Visible=id==name end
    local titles={farm="Auto Farm",raid="Auto Raid",combat="Combat",stats="Auto Stats",teleports="Teleports",esp="ESP",settings="Seting"}
    profile.Text=titles[name]
    if name=="teleports" and teleport.refreshUI then teleport.refreshUI()end
    pages[name].GroupTransparency=1;pages[name].Position=UDim2.fromOffset(contentX,pageY+4)
    animate(pages[name],{GroupTransparency=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(contentX,pageY)})
    for id,b in pairs(tabButtons)do
        animate(b,{BackgroundTransparency=id==name and 0 or 1})
        b:FindFirstChild("Indicator").Visible=id==name
        b:FindFirstChild("Caption").TextColor3=id==name and colors.text or colors.muted
        for _,part in ipairs(b:FindFirstChild("Icon"):GetDescendants())do
            if part:IsA("Frame")then animate(part,{BackgroundColor3=id==name and colors.accentText or colors.muted})end
            if part:IsA("UIStroke")then part.Color=id==name and colors.accentText or colors.muted end
        end
    end
end
local function icon(parent,name,x,y,color)
    local group=create("Frame",{Name="Icon",BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(20,20)},parent)
    if (name=="combat"or name=="settings")and not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        local picture=syncedTheme.sprite(group,name=="combat"and "combat"or "general",4,4)
        picture.ImageColor3=color;return group
    end
    local function line(px,py,w,h,rotation)
        local f=create("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=color,BorderSizePixel=0,Rotation=rotation or 0,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px,py),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)},group)
        round(f,1);return f
    end
    if name=="farm"then
        for _,size in ipairs({17,8})do
            local f=line((20-size)/2,(20-size)/2,size,size);f.BackgroundTransparency=1;round(f,size/2)
            create("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=1.3},f)
        end
    elseif name=="raid"then
        line(6,4,2,9,30);line(11,10,2,9,30);line(5,9,7,1.5);line(9,5,7,1.5);line(12,2,1.5,5)
    elseif name=="stats"then
        line(2,10,3,8);line(8,6,3,12);line(14,2,3,16)
    elseif name=="combat"then
        line(4,3,2,15,-35);line(14,3,2,15,35)
        line(1,12,8,1.5,-35);line(11,12,8,1.5,35)
    elseif name=="esp"then
        local eye=line(1,5,18,11);eye.BackgroundTransparency=1;round(eye,6)
        create("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=1.2},eye)
        local pupil=line(7,7,6,6);pupil.BackgroundTransparency=1;round(pupil,3)
        create("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=1.2},pupil)
    elseif name=="players"then
        for _,bounds in ipairs({{4,2,6,6,3},{1,11,12,7,4},{12,3,5,5,3},{13,11,6,6,3}})do
            local part=line(bounds[1],bounds[2],bounds[3],bounds[4]);part.BackgroundTransparency=1;round(part,bounds[5])
            create("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=1.2},part)
        end
    elseif name=="fruits"then
        local body=line(3,7,14,12);round(body,6)
        line(9,2,2,7,-20);local leaf=line(11,3,6,3,-25);round(leaf,2)
    elseif name=="teleports"then
        local globe=line(2,2,16,16);globe.BackgroundTransparency=1;round(globe,8)
        create("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=1.3},globe)
        local longitude=line(6,2,8,16);longitude.BackgroundTransparency=1;round(longitude,4)
        create("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=1},longitude);line(2,10,16,1)
    else
        for index,y in ipairs({4,10,16})do
            line(2,y,16,1)
            local knob=line(index==2 and 12 or 6,y-2,4,4);knob.BackgroundColor3=colors.card;round(knob,2)
            create("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=1.2},knob)
        end
    end
    return group
end
local function navigation(name,label,y)
    local b=create("TextButton",{Name="Tab_"..name,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0,
        BackgroundColor3=colors.selected,BackgroundTransparency=name=="farm" and 0 or 1,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(226,40)},navigationBar)
    round(b,20)
    icon(b,name,12,10,name=="farm" and colors.accentText or colors.muted)
    local indicator=create("Frame",{Name="Indicator",BackgroundColor3=colors.accent,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(24,24),BackgroundTransparency=.7,Visible=name=="farm"},b)
    round(indicator,12)
    local caption=text(b,label,UDim2.fromOffset(40,0),UDim2.fromOffset(175,40),13,name=="farm" and colors.text or colors.muted)
    caption.Name="Caption";syncedTheme.font(caption,700)
    tabButtons[name]=b
    connect(b.Activated,function()selectPage(name)end)
end
navigation("farm","Auto Farm",0)
navigation("raid","Auto Raid",51)
navigation("combat","Combat",102)
navigation("stats","Auto Stats",153)
navigation("teleports","Teleports",204)
navigation("esp","ESP",255)
navigation("settings","Seting",306)
appButton.Text="";icon(appButton,"settings",7,7,colors.muted)
do
    local order={"farm","raid","combat","stats","teleports","esp","settings"}
    local function shift(offset)
        for index,name in ipairs(order)do if name==currentPage then selectPage(order[(index-1+offset)%#order+1]);return end end
    end
    connect(previous.Activated,function()shift(-1)end);connect(nextPage.Activated,function()shift(1)end)
end
do
    local page=pages.teleports
    local heading=text(page,"Current sea",UDim2.fromOffset(2,0),UDim2.fromOffset(530,36),13,colors.text)
    heading.Name="TeleportSea"
    local refresh=create("TextButton",{Name="RefreshTeleports",Text="Refresh",Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize=12,TextColor3=colors.accentText,BackgroundColor3=colors.card,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(664,2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(88,30),AutoButtonColor=false},page)
    round(refresh,10)
    local cancel=create("TextButton",{Name="CancelFlight",Text="Stop flight",Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize=12,TextColor3=colors.muted,BackgroundColor3=colors.card,BorderSizePixel=0,Visible=false,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(558,2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(98,30),AutoButtonColor=false},page)
    round(cancel,10)
    function teleport.updateFlightUI()cancel.Visible=teleport.flight~=nil or state.autofruits end
    connect(cancel.Activated,function()
        if state.autofruits then autoFruits.stop("Stopped")end
        teleport.cancel("Flight stopped.")
    end)
    for _,column in ipairs(columns[page])do
        column.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(column.Position.X.Offset,44)
        column.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(368,(page.Size.Y.Offset-44)*368/327)
    end
    function teleport.clearUI()
        for _,connection in ipairs(teleport.rowConnections)do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(teleport.rowConnections)
        for _,column in ipairs({columns[page][2]})do
            for _,entry in ipairs(cards[column])do entry.card:Destroy()end
            table.clear(cards[column])
        end
    end
    function teleport.refreshUI()
        teleport.clearUI()
        local rows=teleport.collect()
        heading.Text=#rows>0 and ("Sea "..teleport.sea.." · "..#rows.." locations")or "Current sea is unsupported or unavailable"
        for index,row in ipairs(rows)do
            local column=columns[page][2]
            local button=create("TextButton",{Name="Teleport_"..row.name:gsub("%W",""),Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,
                BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=colors.card,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(368,58)},column)
            round(button,14);icon(button,"teleports",14,19,colors.accentText)
            text(button,row.name,UDim2.fromOffset(44,8),UDim2.fromOffset(276,24),13,colors.text)
            text(button,row.marker and "Live location · Fly here"or "Island / landmark · Fly here",
                UDim2.fromOffset(44,31),UDim2.fromOffset(280,18),10,colors.muted)
            text(button,"›",UDim2.fromOffset(340,15),UDim2.fromOffset(18,28),20,colors.accentText)
            button:SetAttribute("Sea",row.sea);button:SetAttribute("Location",row.name)
            button.Visible=row.name:lower():find(searchBox.Text:lower(),1,true)~=nil
            table.insert(cards[column],{card=button,label=row.name})
            table.insert(teleport.rowConnections,button.Activated:Connect(function()teleport.begin(row)end))
        end
        for _,column in ipairs({columns[page][2]})do
            local function reflow()
                local y=0
                for _,entry in ipairs(cards[column])do
                    if entry.card.Visible then entry.card.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,y);y+=68 end
                end
                column.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.max(0,y-10))
            end
            for _,entry in ipairs(cards[column])do entry.reflow=reflow end
            reflow()
        end
    end
    connect(refresh.Activated,teleport.refreshUI)
    local elapsed=0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
        if not menuShown or currentPage~="teleports" then return end
        elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<1 then return end;elapsed=0
        if teleport.dirty or teleport.sea~=Core.SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then teleport.refreshUI()end
    end)
end

end

        local y=math.clamp(origin.Y/math.max(.1,scale.Scale)+18,12,math.max(12,window.Size.Y.Offset-popup.Size.Y.Offset-12))

        entry.body.GroupTransparency=1;animate(entry.body,{GroupTransparency=0})
    end
    function ui.openApp()
        ui.close()
        if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then app.Position=UDim2.fromOffset((window.Size.X.Offset-302)/2,12)end
        reveal(app)
    end
    function ui.openChoices(anchor,rows)
        choiceCallbacks={}
        for i,b in ipairs(choiceRows)do
            b.Visible=rows[i]~=nil
            if rows[i]then b.Text=rows[i][1];choiceCallbacks[i]=rows[i][2]end
        end
        local p=(anchor.AbsolutePosition-window.AbsolutePosition)/math.max(.1,scale.Scale)
