        reveal(options)
    end
    function ui.setTheme(name)
        if not api.palettes[name]then return end
        ui.theme=name;api.applyTheme(name)
        for id,b in pairs(themes)do b.BackgroundColor3=id==name and colors.selected or colors.input;b.TextColor3=id==name and colors.text or colors.muted end
        themes.Dark:FindFirstChild("MoonCutout").BackgroundColor3=themes.Dark.BackgroundColor3
        api.playerGui:SetAttribute("BakaTheme",name)
    end
    local function rgb(color)return math.floor(color.R*255+.5),math.floor(color.G*255+.5),math.floor(color.B*255+.5)end
    function ui.setAccent(color)
        ui.h,ui.s,ui.v=color:ToHSV()
        api.applyAccent(color);accentButton.BackgroundColor3=color;satTrack.BackgroundColor3=color;valueTrack.BackgroundColor3=color

        rgbLabel.Text=string.format("RGB: %d %d %d",r,g,b);swatch.BackgroundColor3=color;saveColor.Text="Save the selected color."

        valueGradient.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),Color3.fromHSV(ui.h,ui.s,1))
        satKnob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(ui.s,.5);valueKnob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(ui.v,.5)
        api.playerGui:SetAttribute("BakaAccent",hex.Text)
    end
    connect(hex.FocusLost,function()
        local value=hex.Text:gsub("#","")
        if value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$")then ui.setAccent(Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(value:sub(1,2),16),tonumber(value:sub(3,4),16),tonumber(value:sub(5,6),16)))
        else local r,g,b=rgb(colors.accent);hex.Text=string.format("#%02X%02X%02X",r,g,b)end
    end)
    dragging=nil
    local function updatePointer(object,position)
        if object==wheel then
            local size=wheel.AbsoluteSize;local dx=(position.X-wheel.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,size.X)*2-1
            local dy=(position.Y-wheel.AbsolutePosition.Y)/math.max(1,size.Y)*2-1
            ui.setAccent(Color3.fromHSV((.9-math.atan2(dy,dx)/(2*math.pi)+1)%1,math.min(1,math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)),ui.v))
        else
            local fraction=math.clamp((position.X-object.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,object.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)
            if object==scaleSlider then
                api.appearance.scale=math.floor(60+65*fraction+.5)

            else ui.setAccent(Color3.fromHSV(ui.h,ui.s,fraction))end
        end

                dragging={object=object,input=input};updatePointer(object,input.Position)
            end
        end)
    end
    connect(api.input.InputChanged,function(input)
        if dragging and layer.Visible and (input==dragging.input or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)then updatePointer(dragging.object,input.Position)end
    end)
    connect(api.input.InputEnded,function(input)if dragging and input==dragging.input then dragging=nil end end)
    connect(shade.Activated,function()dragging=nil;ui.close()end);connect(moduleClose.Activated,ui.close);connect(appClose.Activated,ui.close)

        end

local assets=(function()
-- Locally generated HSV wheel; no external requests.
return {wheel=""}

end)()
local assetCache
local function wheelAsset()
    if assetCache then return assetCache end
    if playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumHeadlessUI")then assetCache="bakaasset://wheel";return assetCache end
    local loader=getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if type(loader)~="function" or type(writefile)~="function"then return nil end
    local ok,result=pcall(function()
        local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local lookup={};for i=1,#alphabet do lookup[alphabet:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
        local bytes={};local buffer,bits=0,0
        for i=1,#assets.wheel do
            local value=lookup[assets.wheel:sub(i,i)]
            if value then
                buffer=buffer*64+value;bits+=6
                if bits>=8 then bits-=8;local power=2^bits;bytes[#bytes+1]=string.char(math.floor(buffer/power)%256);buffer%=power end
            end
        end
        local path="baka-color-wheel-v29.png"
        writefile(path,table.concat(bytes));return loader(path)
    end)
    if ok and type(result)=="string"then assetCache=result;return result end
    return nil
end

local function refreshAppearance()
    for object,roles in pairs(appearance.bindings)do
        if object.Parent and object:GetAttribute("FixedColor")~=true then
            for property,role in pairs(roles)do if colors[role]then object[property]=colors[role]end end
            if object:IsA("TextButton")and object:GetAttribute("Selected")~=nil then
                object.BackgroundColor3=object:GetAttribute("Selected")and colors.selected or colors.input
                object.TextColor3=object:GetAttribute("Selected")and colors.accentText or colors.muted
            end
        end
    end
    for key,refresh in pairs(controls)do refresh(state[key])end
    if appearance.refresh then appearance.refresh()end
end

local function toggle(parent,y,key,label,callback)
    local moduleHeader=label=="Enabled"

            entry.button.BackgroundColor3=selected and colors.selected or colors.input
            entry.button.TextColor3=selected and colors.accentText or colors.muted
        end

    function eventFarm.refreshUI(force)
        local rows,sea=eventFarm.list()
        local names={tostring(sea)}
        for _,row in ipairs(rows)do table.insert(names,row.name)end
        local key=table.concat(names,"|")
        if key==eventFarm.uiKey and not force then return end
        eventFarm.uiKey=key

        end

    end

        elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<2 then return end;elapsed=0
        if state.events or currentPage=="farm"then eventFarm.refreshUI()end
    end)

local function updateAuraChoice()
    auraOffButton:SetAttribute("Selected",not CONFIG.AutoAura)
    auraOnButton:SetAttribute("Selected",CONFIG.AutoAura)
    animate(auraOffButton,{BackgroundColor3=not CONFIG.AutoAura and colors.selected or colors.input})
    animate(auraOnButton,{BackgroundColor3=CONFIG.AutoAura and colors.selected or colors.input})
    auraOffButton.TextColor3=not CONFIG.AutoAura and colors.accentText or colors.muted
    auraOnButton.TextColor3=CONFIG.AutoAura and colors.accentText or colors.muted

local function selectAura(enabled)
    if CONFIG.AutoAura==enabled then return end
    cancelAuraRequest();auraRequestedCharacter=nil;CONFIG.AutoAura=enabled
    updateAuraChoice()
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    if character then
        if state.farm or state.elite or state.raid then ensureAura(character)
        else auraStatus=hasAura(character) and "on" or enabled and "pending" or "auto off"end
    end
    status(enabled and "Haki: pre-activation enabled; required before every M1." or "Haki: activate immediately before M1; confirmation is always required.")
end

function Core.boatAutomationActive()
 return state.mirage or state.events and eventFarm.sailing==true
end
function raidHost.restoreCamera()
 local saved=raidHost.camera
 if saved and not raidHost.mouse then
  pcall(function()saved.camera.CFrame=saved.frame;saved.camera.CameraType=saved.kind end)
  raidHost.camera=nil
 end
end
function surfaceWalk.afterStep()
 local human,root=surfaceWalk.human,surfaceWalk.character and surfaceWalk.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if disposed or not human or human.Health<=0 or not root or not surfaceWalk.part or not surfaceWalk.part.CanCollide or not surfaceWalk.floor then return end
 if human.Sit or human.SeatPart then return end
 human:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
 local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
 if root.Position.Y<surfaceWalk.floor and not human.Jump then
  root.CFrame=root.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,surfaceWalk.floor-root.Position.Y,0)
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(velocity.X,math.max(velocity.Y,0),velocity.Z)
 end
 if human:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then human:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)end
end
function eventFarm.seaEvent(row)
 return row and not row.island and(row.skills or row.family=="seabeast")
end
function eventFarm.releaseSailing()
 if not eventFarm.sailing then return end
 progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();Core.cancelGameCall("islandBoat")
 eventFarm.sailing=false
end
function eventFarm.sail(root,human,now)
 if not eventFarm.sailing then
  progressFarm.mirageReset();eventFarm.sailing=true
  eventFarm.course=Vector3.new(-1,0,0)
  progressFarm.mirage.eventGeneration=eventFarm.generation
  progressFarm.mirage.departureReady=eventFarm.departed==true
 end
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 local departure=eventFarm.position({island=eventFarm.sea==3 and "Tiki Outpost"or "Cold Side"})
 if not m.departureReady then
  if not departure then eventFarm.note("Waiting for sea exploration dock waypoint");return end
  if(root.Position-departure).Magnitude>900 then
   human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character);holdPosition(root,departure+Vector3.new(0,12,0),nil,150)
   eventFarm.note("Flying to "..(eventFarm.sea==3 and "Tiki Outpost"or "Cold Side").." · buy a boat");return
  end
  m.departureReady=true
 end
 local boat,seat=progressFarm.mirageBoat(root,human,now)
 if not boat then
  human.Sit=false;progressFarm.islandBuyDirect(root,now)
  eventFarm.note("Sea event · "..(progressFarm.lastNote or "buying a boat / waiting for owned boat"));return
 end
 if human.SeatPart~=seat or seat.Occupant~=human then
  progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();human.Sit=false
  local position=seat.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,0)
  disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character);holdPosition(root,position,nil,150)
  if(root.Position-position).Magnitude<3 then stopHover();restoreCollisions(true);seat:Sit(human)end
  eventFarm.note("Boarding your boat · searching for "..eventFarm.selected.name);return
 end
 stopHover();restoreCollisions()
 progressFarm.mirageDrive(boat,seat,root,human,now)
 if progressFarm.mirage.driving then eventFarm.departed=true end
 eventFarm.note("Sailing straight / noclip · searching for "..eventFarm.selected.name)
end
function teleport.beginPlayer(player)
 if not player or player==localPlayer or player.Parent~=Players then return false end
 local character,human,root=combatAssist.localBody()
 if not character then teleport.cancel();status("Teleport Player: wait for respawn");return false end
 teleport.cancel();stopFarm();stopRaid();elite.stop();berry.stop();autoFruits.stop();boss.stop();swordFarm.stop();gunFarm.stop();progressFarm.stop();leviFarm.stop();autoKill.stop();eventFarm.stop()
 teleport.selectedPlayer=player;state.teleportplayer=true
 if controls.teleportplayer then controls.teleportplayer(true)end
 teleport.flight={row={name="@"..player.Name,player=player,sea=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]},character=character,human=human,root=root,statusAt=-math.huge}
 human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character)
 if teleport.updateFlightUI then teleport.updateFlightUI()end
 status("Flying to @"..player.Name.." · 150 studs/s")
 return true
end
function teleport.setPlayerEnabled(enabled)
 if not enabled then teleport.cancel("Teleport Player disabled");return false end
 if teleport.selectedPlayer then teleport.beginPlayer(teleport.selectedPlayer)
 else state.teleportplayer=true;if controls.teleportplayer then controls.teleportplayer(true)end;status("Teleport Player: select a player")end
 return false
end

do
local priceCore=(function()
local PriceCore={}
function PriceCore.plain(value)
    return tostring(value or ""):gsub("<[^>]*>",""):gsub("&amp;","&"):gsub("&nbsp;"," "):gsub("&#39;","'")
        :gsub("&quot;",'"'):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
end
function PriceCore.name(value)
    local name=PriceCore.plain(value):lower():gsub("%s+"," "):gsub(" fruit$","")
    if name=="lighting"then name="lightning"end
    return name
end
function PriceCore.category(value)
    local plain=PriceCore.plain(value):lower():gsub("%s+"," ")
    return plain=="blox fruit" or plain=="bloxfruit"
end
function PriceCore.parseValue(raw)
    local token=PriceCore.plain(raw):upper():gsub(",",""):gsub("%s","")
    local digits,suffix=token:match("^(%d+%.?%d*)([KMB]?)$")
    local number=tonumber(digits)
    if not number or number~=number then return nil end
    local amount=number*({K=1000,M=1000000,B=1000000000,[""]=1})[suffix]
    if amount<=0 or amount>1e15 then return nil end
    return {amount=amount,display=token}
end
function PriceCore.parseHTML(html)
    if type(html)~="string" or #html>2000000 then return nil,"invalid response size"end
    local result,count={},0
    for name,after in html:gmatch('class=["\'][^"\']*cos%-unit%-card%-name[^"\']*["\'][^>]*>(.-)</div>()')do
        local nextCard=html:find('cos%-unit%-card%-name',after)
        local boundary=math.min(after+2000,nextCard and nextCard-1 or #html)
        local body=html:sub(after,boundary)
        local raw=body:match('Normal:%s*</span>%s*<span[^>]*>%s*([^<]+)')
        local price=raw and PriceCore.parseValue(raw)
        local key=PriceCore.name(name)
        if price and key~="" then result[key]=price;count+=1 end
    end
    if count<5 then return nil,"value list layout unavailable"end
    return result,count
end
return PriceCore

end)()

local makePrices=(function()
-- Inventory/trade presentation only. Fetches public HTML as data, never executes it.
return function(api)
    local Core=api.core
    local controller={label=api.label,running=false,request=nil,timeout=nil,lastAttempt=-math.huge,lastSuccess=-math.huge,generation=0}
    local values={};for name,price in pairs(api.snapshot.values)do values[Core.name(name)]=price end
    local records,categories,dirty,rootConnections={},{},{},{}
    local elapsed=0
    local tradeTitles={}
    local function note(message)
        if controller.label and controller.label.Parent then controller.label.Text=message end
    end
    local function ignored(object)
        if object:IsDescendantOf(api.gui)then return true end
        local parent=object
        while parent and parent~=api.playerGui do
            if parent.Name=="ExperienceChat" or parent.Name=="Chat" or parent.Name=="BubbleChat"then return true end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function markAll()
        for object in pairs(categories)do dirty[object]=true end
    end
    local function originalText(object)
        return records[object]and records[object].base or object.Text
    end
    local function isText(object)return object:IsA("TextLabel")or object:IsA("TextButton")end
    local function isTradeTitle(value)
        local title=Core.plain(value):lower():gsub("%s+"," ")
        return title=="treasure trade" or title=="fruit trade"
    end
    local function tradeContext(object)
        local parent=object.Parent
        while parent and parent~=api.playerGui do
            local name=parent.Name:lower():gsub("[^%a]","")
            if name=="trade" or name=="trading" or name=="treasuretrade" or name=="tradewindow"
                or name=="tradingwindow" or name=="tradegui"then return true end
            for title in pairs(tradeTitles)do
                if title.Parent and not ignored(title)then
                    local root=title.Parent
                    for _=1,2 do
                        if not root or root==api.playerGui or root:IsA("LayerCollector")or root.Name=="Main"then break end
                        if root==parent then return true end
                        root=root.Parent
                    end
                end
            end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function restore(record)
        record.writing=true
        if record.object.Parent then
            if record.ours and record.object.Text==record.ours then record.object.Text=record.base end
            if record.originalScaled~=nil then record.object.TextScaled=record.originalScaled end
            if record.originalTruncate~=nil then record.object.TextTruncate=record.originalTruncate end
        end
        record.ours=nil;record.writing=false
    end
    local function findFruit(record)
        local parent=record.object.Parent
        for _=1,3 do
            if not parent or parent==api.playerGui or parent:IsA("LayerCollector")then return nil end
            if parent:IsA("GuiObject")then
                local names,categoryCount,imageCount,total={},0,0,0
                local declared=parent:GetAttribute("FruitName")
                if type(declared)=="string" and values[Core.name(declared)]then names[Core.name(declared)]=true end
                for _,child in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants())do
                    total+=1;if total>100 then break end
                    if child:IsA("ImageLabel")or child:IsA("ImageButton")then imageCount+=1 end
                    if isText(child)then
                        local plain=originalText(child)
                        if Core.category(plain)then categoryCount+=1 end
                        local key=Core.name(plain)
                        if child~=record.object and values[key]then names[key]=true end
                    end
                end
                local count,found=0,nil;for name in pairs(names)do count+=1;found=name end
                if categoryCount>1 then return nil end
                if total<=100 and categoryCount==1 and count==1 and (imageCount>0 or declared)then return found end
            end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function findTradeFruit(record)
        local key=Core.name(record.base)
        if not values[key]or not tradeContext(record.object)then return nil end
        local parent=record.object.Parent
        for _=1,3 do
            if not parent or parent==api.playerGui or parent:IsA("LayerCollector")then return nil end
            if parent:IsA("GuiObject")then
                local imageCount,knownLabels,costLabels,categoryCount,total=0,0,0,0,0
                for _,child in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants())do
                    total+=1;if total>60 then break end
                    if child:IsA("ImageLabel")or child:IsA("ImageButton")then imageCount+=1 end
                    if isText(child)then
                        local plain=Core.plain(originalText(child))
                        if values[Core.name(plain)]then knownLabels+=1 end
                        if Core.category(plain)then categoryCount+=1 end
                        if plain:match("^%$[%d,%.]+$")or plain:lower()=="special"then costLabels+=1 end
                    end
                end
                if total<=60 and categoryCount==0 and imageCount>=1 and knownLabels==1 and costLabels==1 then return key end
                if knownLabels>1 or categoryCount>0 or costLabels>1 then return nil end
            end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function update(record)
        if not record.object.Parent then restore(record);return end
        local key=Core.category(record.base)and findFruit(record)or findTradeFruit(record)
        local price=key and values[key]
        if not price then restore(record);return end
        local desired=record.base.." · "..price.display
        record.writing=true
        if record.originalScaled==nil then record.originalScaled=record.object.TextScaled or false end
        if record.originalTruncate==nil then record.originalTruncate=record.object.TextTruncate end
        record.object.TextScaled=true;record.object.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None
        record.ours=desired
        if record.object.Text~=desired then record.object.Text=desired end
        record.writing=false
    end
    function controller.flush()
        if not controller.running then return end
        local pending=dirty;dirty={}
        for object in pairs(pending)do if records[object]then update(records[object])end end
    end
    local function unwatch(object)
        local record=records[object]
        if not record then return end
        record.textConnection:Disconnect();record.parentConnection:Disconnect()
        restore(record);records[object]=nil;categories[object]=nil;dirty[object]=nil;tradeTitles[object]=nil
    end
    local function watch(object)
        if not isText(object)or records[object]or ignored(object)then return end
        local record={object=object,base=object.Text,writing=false}
        records[object]=record
        local function changed()
            if record.writing then return end
            local previous=record.base
            record.base=object.Text;record.ours=nil
            if isTradeTitle(record.base)then tradeTitles[object]=true else tradeTitles[object]=nil end
            if Core.category(record.base)or values[Core.name(record.base)]then categories[object]=true;dirty[object]=true
            else
                if categories[object]then restore(record)end
                categories[object]=nil;dirty[object]=nil
            end
            if values[Core.name(previous)]or values[Core.name(record.base)]or isTradeTitle(previous)or isTradeTitle(record.base)
                or Core.plain(previous):match("^%$")or Core.plain(record.base):match("^%$")
                or Core.plain(previous):lower()=="special"or Core.plain(record.base):lower()=="special"then markAll()end
        end
        record.textConnection=object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(changed)
        record.parentConnection=object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()if categories[object]then dirty[object]=true end end)
        if isTradeTitle(record.base)then tradeTitles[object]=true end
        if Core.category(record.base)or values[Core.name(record.base)]then categories[object]=true;dirty[object]=true end
    end
    local function cancelRequest()
        controller.generation+=1
        if controller.timeout then task.cancel(controller.timeout);controller.timeout=nil end
        if controller.request then task.cancel(controller.request);controller.request=nil end
    end
    local function fetch()
        local requester=request or http_request or syn and syn.request
        if type(requester)=="function"then
            local response=requester({Url=api.snapshot.source,Method="GET",Timeout=15,Headers={["Cache-Control"]="no-cache",Pragma="no-cache"}})
            if type(response)~="table"then error("unsupported HTTP response")end
            local code=tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.Status)
            if code and (code<200 or code>=300)then error("HTTP status rejected")end
            return response.Body or response.body
        end
        return game:HttpGet(api.snapshot.source)
    end
    function controller.refresh(manual)
        if not controller.running or controller.request then return false end
        local now=os.clock()
        if now-controller.lastAttempt<10 or not manual and (now-controller.lastAttempt<300 or now-controller.lastSuccess<300)then return false end
        controller.lastAttempt=now;controller.generation+=1
        local generation=controller.generation
        note("Updating · Game.Guide")
        controller.request=task.defer(function()
            local ok,html=pcall(fetch)
            if not controller.running or api.disposed()or generation~=controller.generation then return end
            local parsed=ok and Core.parseHTML(html)
            if parsed then
                for key,price in pairs(parsed)do values[key]=price end
                controller.lastSuccess=os.clock();markAll();controller.flush();note("Game.Guide · Normal · updated")
            else note("Game.Guide · Normal · cached")end
            controller.request=nil
            if controller.timeout then task.cancel(controller.timeout);controller.timeout=nil end
        end)
        controller.timeout=task.delay(15,function()
            if generation~=controller.generation or not controller.request then return end
            cancelRequest();note("Game.Guide · Normal · cached")
        end)
        return true
    end
    function controller.set(enabled)
        if controller.running==enabled then return end
        controller.running=enabled
        if enabled then
            for _,object in ipairs(api.hudObjects())do watch(object)end
            table.insert(rootConnections,api.playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
                if ignored(object)then return end
                watch(object)
                if object:IsA("ImageLabel")or object:IsA("ImageButton")or isText(object)then markAll()end
            end))
            table.insert(rootConnections,api.playerGui.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object)
                if ignored(object)then return end
                unwatch(object);markAll()
            end))
            table.insert(rootConnections,api.heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<.15 then return end;elapsed=0;controller.flush();controller.refresh(false)
            end))
            controller.flush();note("Game.Guide · Normal · cached");controller.refresh(false)
        else
            cancelRequest()
            for _,connection in ipairs(rootConnections)do connection:Disconnect()end
            table.clear(rootConnections)
            local tracked={};for object in pairs(records)do tracked[#tracked+1]=object end
            for _,object in ipairs(tracked)do unwatch(object)end
            table.clear(dirty);table.clear(categories);table.clear(tradeTitles);elapsed=0
            note("Game.Guide · Normal")
        end
    end
    return controller
end

end)()
fruitPrice=makePrices({core=priceCore,snapshot=priceData,hudObjects=perf.hudObjects,playerGui=playerGui,gui=gui,heartbeat=RunService.Heartbeat,label=fruitPrice.label,disposed=function()return disposed end})
end

sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=847,["y"]=698,["w"]=169,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["sand"]={["name"]="Sand",["sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=0,["y"]=865,["w"]=169,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["smoke"]={["name"]="Smoke",["sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=169,["y"]=865,["w"]=170,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["dark"]={["name"]="Dark",["sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=339,["y"]=865,["w"]=169,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["rocket"]={["name"]="Rocket",["sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=508,["y"]=865,["w"]=169,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["spike"]={["name"]="Spike",["sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=677,["y"]=865,["w"]=170,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["spring"]={["name"]="Spring",["sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=847,["y"]=865,["w"]=169,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["spin"]={["name"]="Spin",["sheet"]="atlas",["x"]=1016,["y"]=865,["w"]=169,["h"]=167,["sheetW"]=1524,["sheetH"]=1032},["magnet"]={["name"]="Magnet",["sheet"]="magnet",["x"]=0,["y"]=0,["w"]=1224,["h"]=1285,["sheetW"]=1224,["sheetH"]=1285}}
    fruitEsp.imageData={["atlas"]="",["magnet"]=""}
    fruitEsp.loadedImages={};fruitEsp.items={}
    fruitEsp.aliases={rumble="lightning",falcon="eagle",barrier="creation",chop="blade",paw="pain",revive="ghost",
        door="portal",soul="spirit",string="spider",eastdragon="dragon",westdragon="dragon"}
    function fruitEsp.key(value)
        if type(value)~="string"then return ""end
        local key=Core.styleKey(value):gsub("fruits$",""):gsub("fruit$","")
        if #key%2==0 and key:sub(1,#key/2)==key:sub(#key/2+1)then key=key:sub(1,#key/2)end
        return fruitEsp.aliases[key] or key
    end
    function fruitEsp.identity(owner)
        local declared=owner:GetAttribute("FruitName")
        local name=type(declared)=="string" and declared~="" and declared or owner.Name
        local key=fruitEsp.key(name)
        return fruitEsp.catalog[key],key
    end
    function fruitEsp.asset(kind)
        if fruitEsp.loadedImages[kind]~=nil then return fruitEsp.loadedImages[kind] or nil end
        fruitEsp.loadedImages[kind]=false
        if playerGui:GetAttribute("ViltrumHeadlessUI")then
            fruitEsp.loadedImages[kind]="bakaasset://fruit-"..kind;return fruitEsp.loadedImages[kind]
        end
        local loader=getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(loader)~="function" or type(writefile)~="function"then return nil end
        local encoded=fruitEsp.imageData[kind]
        if not encoded then return nil end
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
            local lookup={};for i=1,#alphabet do lookup[alphabet:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
            local bytes,chunks={},{};local buffer,bits=0,0;local slice=os.clock()
            for i=1,#encoded do
                local value=lookup[encoded:sub(i,i)]
                if value then
                    buffer=buffer*64+value;bits+=6
                    if bits>=8 then bits-=8;local power=2^bits;bytes[#bytes+1]=string.char(math.floor(buffer/power)%256);buffer%=power end
                    if #bytes>=16384 then
                        chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(bytes);table.clear(bytes)
                        if os.clock()-slice>=.002 then task.wait();slice=os.clock()end
                    end
                end
            end
            chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(bytes)
            local path="viltrum-fruit-"..kind.."-v38.png"
            writefile(path,table.concat(chunks));return loader(path)
        end)
        if ok and type(result)=="string"then fruitEsp.loadedImages[kind]=result;return result end
        return nil
    end
    function fruitEsp.owner(object)
        local current,candidate=object,nil
        while current and current~=workspace do
            if current:IsA("Model")and current:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then return nil end
            if current:IsA("Backpack")or current.Name=="Inventory" or current.Name=="Storage"then return nil end
            if current:IsA("Tool")or current:IsA("Model")then
                local named=current.Name:lower():match("fruits?$")~=nil
                    or current:IsA("Tool") and fruitEsp.catalog[fruitEsp.key(current.Name)]~=nil
                local declared=current:GetAttribute("FruitName")
                if current:GetAttribute("IsFruit")~=false and (named or current:GetAttribute("IsFruit")==true or type(declared)=="string" and declared~="")then candidate=current end
            end
            current=current.Parent
        end
        if current==workspace and candidate then return candidate end
    end
    function fruitEsp.handle(owner)
        local part=owner and owner:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
        if not part and owner and owner:IsA("Model")then part=owner.PrimaryPart end
        return part and part:IsA("BasePart")and part or nil
    end
    function fruitEsp.remove(owner)
        local entry=fruitEsp.entries[owner]
        if entry then entry.gui:Destroy();fruitEsp.entries[owner]=nil end
    end
    function fruitEsp.consider(object,force)
        if not object:IsA("Tool")and not object:IsA("Model")and not object:IsA("BasePart")then return end
        if not force and not fruitEsp.running and not state.autofruits then return end
        local owner=fruitEsp.owner(object)
        local part=fruitEsp.handle(owner)
        if owner and part and not fruitEsp.items[owner]then fruitEsp.items[owner]={owner=owner,part=part,blockedUntil=0}end
    end
    function fruitEsp.discover()
        if fruitEsp.discoveryJob then return end
        fruitEsp.discoveryJob=perf.walk(workspace,function(object)fruitEsp.consider(object,true)end,
            function()return fruitEsp.running or state.autofruits end,function()fruitEsp.discoveryJob=nil;fruitEsp.scanVersion=(fruitEsp.scanVersion or 0)+1 end)
    end
    function fruitEsp.list(root)
        local list={}
        for owner,item in pairs(fruitEsp.items)do
            local part=fruitEsp.handle(owner)
            if fruitEsp.owner(owner)~=owner or not part or owner:GetAttribute("IsDisabled")==true then
                fruitEsp.remove(owner);fruitEsp.items[owner]=nil
            else
                item.part=part;item.distance=root and (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                table.insert(list,item)
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    function fruitEsp.update()
        if not fruitEsp.running then return end
        for _,item in ipairs(fruitEsp.list())do
            local owner,part=item.owner,item.part
            local definition=fruitEsp.identity(owner)
            local entry=fruitEsp.entries[owner]
            if not entry then
                local billboard=create("BillboardGui",{Name="ViltrumFruitESP",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,112),
                    StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0),ResetOnSpawn=false,AlwaysOnTop=true,
                    MaxDistance=math.huge,LightInfluence=0,Active=false,Adornee=part},gui)
                local crop=create("Frame",{Name="FruitPhotoCrop",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
                    Position=UDim2.fromOffset(44,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(72,72),ClipsDescendants=true},billboard)
                local picture=create("ImageLabel",{Name="FruitPhoto",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
                    Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,0),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),Image="",Visible=false,
                    ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Stretch},crop)
                local label=text(billboard,"",UDim2.fromOffset(-30,76),UDim2.fromOffset(220,36),22,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
                label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;label.TextStrokeTransparency=.05
                label.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0);label.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None
                entry={gui=billboard,crop=crop,picture=picture,label=label};fruitEsp.entries[owner]=entry
            end
            entry.gui.Adornee=part
            if definition then
                local asset=fruitEsp.asset(definition.sheet)
                if disposed or not fruitEsp.running or not entry.gui.Parent then return end
                if asset then
                    entry.picture.Image=asset
                    -- Clip in normalized GUI coordinates; image importer resizing cannot shift the fruit cells.
                    entry.picture.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.zero;entry.picture.ImageRectSize=Vector2.zero
                    entry.picture.Size=UDim2.fromScale(definition.sheetW/definition.w,definition.sheetH/definition.h)
                    entry.picture.Position=UDim2.fromScale(-definition.x/definition.w,-definition.y/definition.h)
                    entry.picture.Visible=true
                else
                    -- Native Tool icons remain a fallback if the local image API is unavailable.
                    local native=owner:IsA("Tool")and owner.TextureId or ""
                    entry.picture.Image=native;entry.picture.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.zero;entry.picture.ImageRectSize=Vector2.zero
                    entry.picture.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);entry.picture.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
                    entry.picture.Visible=native~=""
                    if fruitEsp.label then fruitEsp.label.Text="Local photos need the existing local asset API."end
                end
                entry.label.Text=definition.name;entry.label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(-30,76)
            else
                -- Unknown natural spawns keep their identity hidden: text only, never a guessed image.
                entry.picture.Visible=false;entry.picture.Image=""
                entry.label.Text="Fruits";entry.label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(-30,40)
            end
        end
    end
    function fruitEsp.set(enabled)
        fruitEsp.running=enabled
        if enabled then fruitEsp.discover();fruitEsp.update()
        else
            for owner in pairs(fruitEsp.entries)do fruitEsp.remove(owner)end
            if not state.autofruits then fruitEsp.items={}end
        end
    end
    connect(workspace.DescendantAdded,function(object)fruitEsp.consider(object)end)
    connect(workspace.DescendantRemoving,function(object)
        for owner,item in pairs(fruitEsp.items)do
            if owner==object or item.part==object or owner:IsDescendantOf(object)or item.part:IsDescendantOf(object)then
                fruitEsp.remove(owner);fruitEsp.items[owner]=nil
            end
        end
    end)
    local elapsed=0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
        if disposed or not fruitEsp.running and not state.autofruits then return end
        elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<.2 then return end;elapsed=0
        if fruitEsp.busy then return end
        fruitEsp.busy=true
        local ok,message=pcall(function()if fruitEsp.running then fruitEsp.update()else fruitEsp.list()end end)
        fruitEsp.busy=false
        if not ok then status("Fruit ESP: "..tostring(message))end
    end)
end

function playerEsp.prepare()
    if playerEsp.ready or playerEsp.loading or playerEsp.failed then return end
    playerEsp.loading=true
    playerEsp.loadingJob=task.defer(function()
        playerEsp.chrome=fruitEsp.asset("espChromeV42")
        playerEsp.distanceIcon=fruitEsp.asset("espDistanceV42")
        playerEsp.ready=playerEsp.chrome~=nil and playerEsp.distanceIcon~=nil
        playerEsp.loading=false;playerEsp.loadingJob=nil;playerEsp.failed=not playerEsp.ready
        if playerEsp.failed and not disposed then status("Player ESP: SVG assets require the existing local image asset API.")end
    end)
end
function playerEsp.line(parent,name,x,width,role)
    local frame=create("Frame",{Name=name,BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,42),ClipsDescendants=true},parent)
    return {frame=frame,Text="",sprites={},width=width,role=role}
end
function playerEsp.write(run,value)
    if run.Text==value and run.label then return end
    run.Text=value
    if not run.label then
        run.label=create("TextLabel",{Name="ReadableText",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(250,250,252),
            TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0),TextStrokeTransparency=.25,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize=run.role=="name"and 16 or 14,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Text=""},run.frame)
    end
    run.label.Text=run.role=="stats"and value:gsub(" / ","\n")or value
end
function playerEsp.value(player,character,names)
    local sources={player}
    local data=player:FindFirstChild("Data")
    if data then table.insert(sources,data)end
    if character then table.insert(sources,character)end
    for _,name in ipairs(names)do
        for _,source in ipairs(sources)do
            local attribute=source:GetAttribute(name)
            if attribute~=nil then return attribute end
            local value=source:FindFirstChild(name)
            if value and value:IsA("ValueBase")then return value.Value end
        end
    end
end
function playerEsp.number(value)
    return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
        and tostring(math.max(0,math.floor(value+.5)))or "—"
end
function playerEsp.race(player,character)
    local race=playerEsp.value(player,character,{"Race"})
    if type(race)~="string"or race==""then return "—"end
    local version=playerEsp.value(player,character,{"RaceVersion","RaceTier"})
    local transformed=playerEsp.value(player,character,{"RaceTransformed"})
    if transformed==true then version=4 end
    if type(version)=="string"then version=tonumber((version:gsub("[vV]","")))end
    if type(version)=="number"and version>=1 and version<=4 then return race.." v"..math.floor(version)end
    return race
end

function playerEsp.tagScale(distance,viewportHeight,fov,width)
    local pixels=(viewportHeight or 720)*(width or 5)/(2*math.tan(math.rad((fov or 70)*.5))*math.max(distance,1))
    return math.clamp(pixels/570,.75,1.2)
end
function playerEsp.resize(tag,position)
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end
    local distance=(camera.CFrame.Position-position).Magnitude
    local scale=playerEsp.tagScale(distance,camera.ViewportSize.Y,camera.FieldOfView,tag.bodyWidth or 5)
    if tag.lastScale and math.abs(tag.lastScale-scale)<.0005 then return end
    tag.lastScale=scale;tag.scale.Scale=scale;tag.gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(570*scale,42*scale)
end
function playerEsp.add(player)
    if player==localPlayer or tags[player]then return end
    local billboard=create("BillboardGui",{Name="Tag_"..player.UserId,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(570,42),
        StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,3,0),ResetOnSpawn=false,Enabled=false,
        MaxDistance=math.huge,LightInfluence=0,Active=false,ClipsDescendants=false},gui)
    tags[player]={gui=billboard,nextDetails=0}
    if state.names and playerEsp.ready then playerEsp.populate(player,tags[player])end
end
function playerEsp.populate(player,tag)
    local billboard=tag.gui
    local capsule=create("Frame",{Name="PlayerCapsule",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(570,42)},billboard)
    local chrome=create("ImageLabel",{Name="OriginalSVGArtwork",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(570,42),Image="",ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Stretch},capsule)
    local avatar=create("ImageLabel",{Name="Avatar",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,6),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
        Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..player.UserId.."&w=150&h=150"},capsule)
    round(avatar,15)
    local slots={}
    for index,mode in ipairs({"Melee","Fruit","Sword","Gun"})do
        local x=index==4 and 399 or 316+(index-1)*28
        local cell=create("Frame",{Name=mode.."Slot",BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,11),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(index==3 and 19 or 20,20),ClipsDescendants=true},capsule)
        local image=create("ImageLabel",{Name=mode.."Icon",BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
            Image="",ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,Visible=false},cell)
        local fallback=create("Frame",{Name="EmptySlot",BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)},cell)
        slots[mode]={image=image,fallback=fallback}
    end
    local distanceBadge=create("ImageLabel",{Name="DistanceBadge",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(486,9),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(24,24),Image=""},capsule)
    local scale=create("UIScale",{Name="DistanceScale",Scale=1},capsule)
    local record={gui=billboard,capsule=capsule,chrome=chrome,scale=scale,
        name=playerEsp.line(capsule,"Username",48,90,"name"),
        vitals=playerEsp.line(capsule,"HealthEnergy",176,100,"stats"),slots=slots,
        race=playerEsp.line(capsule,"Race",427,54,"race"),distance=playerEsp.line(capsule,"Distance",518,46,"distance"),
        distanceBadge=distanceBadge,nextDetails=0}
    for key,value in pairs(record)do tag[key]=value end
end
function playerEsp.equipment(player,character,tag)
    local found={}
    -- Other players' Backpacks may not replicate. Missing icons stay blank/—.
    for _,container in pairs({character,player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")})do
        for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
            if tool:IsA("Tool")then
                local category=tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType")or tool:GetAttribute("Category")or tool:GetAttribute("Type")
                for _,mode in ipairs({"Melee","Fruit","Sword","Gun"})do
                    local matches=mode=="Gun"and (Core.styleKey(tool.ToolTip)=="gun"or Core.styleKey(category)=="gun")
                        or mode~="Gun"and Core.weaponMatches(mode,tool.Name,tool.ToolTip,category)
                    if matches and not found[mode]then found[mode]=tool end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for mode,slot in pairs(tag.slots)do
        local tool=found[mode]
        local asset=tool and tool.TextureId or ""
        slot.image.Image=asset;slot.image.Visible=asset~="";slot.fallback.Visible=asset==""
    end
end

function playerEsp.update(player,tag,origin,now)
    playerEsp.prepare()
    local character=player.Character
    local head=character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    tag.gui.Enabled=playerEsp.ready==true and state.names and head~=nil and root~=nil and human~=nil and human.Health>0
    tag.gui.Adornee=head;tag.gui.AlwaysOnTop=state.walls
    if not tag.gui.Enabled then tag.nextDetails=0;return end
    if not tag.capsule then playerEsp.populate(player,tag)end
    playerEsp.resize(tag,head.Position)
    if tag.chrome.Image~=playerEsp.chrome then tag.chrome.Image=playerEsp.chrome;tag.distanceBadge.Image=playerEsp.distanceIcon end
    local energy=playerEsp.value(player,character,{"Energy"})
    playerEsp.write(tag.vitals,playerEsp.number(human.Health).."hp / "..playerEsp.number(energy).."en")
    tag.distance.frame.Visible=state.distance;tag.distanceBadge.Visible=state.distance
    if state.distance then playerEsp.write(tag.distance,origin and tostring(math.floor((origin.Position-root.Position).Magnitude+.5)).."m"or "—m")end
    if now>=tag.nextDetails or tag.character~=character then
        tag.character=character;tag.nextDetails=now+1
        tag.bodyWidth=math.max(root.Size.X,head.Size.X)*2.5
        playerEsp.write(tag.name,player.Name);playerEsp.write(tag.race,playerEsp.race(player,character))
        playerEsp.equipment(player,character,tag)
    end
end

local visualElapsed=0
connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
    if berry.held and berry.release and (not state.berry or os.clock()>=berry.held.untilTime)then berry.release()end
    if fruit.held then
        local held=fruit.held
        local alive
        if held.healthCheck then local ok,value=pcall(held.healthCheck);alive=ok and value
        else local human=held.target.Parent and held.target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");alive=human and human.Health>0 end
        if os.clock()>=held.untilTime or not alive then fruit.release()end
    end
    if mouseHeldBackend and os.clock()>=mouseHeldUntil then releaseNativeClick()end
    if (state.farm or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events or state.raid and (raidRunning or raidHost.moving)) and hoverAlign and hoverRoot and hoverMob and hoverMob.Parent then
        local mobRoot=raidCombat.body(hoverMob)
        if mobRoot and mobRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
            local position=mobRoot.Position+(hoverOffset or Vector3.new(CONFIG.FarmSideOffset,FARM_HEIGHT,0))
            if (hoverAlign.Position-position).Magnitude>.05 then hoverAlign.Position=position end
        end
    end
    visualElapsed+=dt
    if visualElapsed<.1 then return end
    visualElapsed=0
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local origin=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not state.names then
        if playerEsp.visible then for _,tag in pairs(tags)do tag.gui.Enabled=false end end
        playerEsp.visible=false;return
    end
    if playerEsp.updating then return end
    playerEsp.visible=true;playerEsp.updating=true
    local slice=os.clock()
    local ok,message=pcall(function()
        for player,tag in pairs(tags)do
            if disposed or not state.names then break end
            if tag.gui.Parent then playerEsp.update(player,tag,origin,os.clock())end
            if os.clock()-slice>=.002 then task.wait();slice=os.clock()end
        end
    end)
    playerEsp.updating=false
    if not ok then status("Player ESP: "..tostring(message))end
end)

    Core.moduleNoclip.tick()
    if progressFarm.islandPhysics then progressFarm.islandPhysics()end
end)

local function moveTo(root, destination)
    if movement and movingRoot==root and movementDestination
        and (movementDestination-destination).Magnitude<2
        and movement.PlaybackState==Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then return end
    stopMovement()
    local distance=(root.Position-destination).Magnitude
    movementDestination, movingRoot=destination, root
    movement=TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(math.max(.1, distance/CONFIG.TravelSpeed), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
        {CFrame=CFrame.new(destination) * root.CFrame.Rotation})
    movement:Play()
end
local inventorySummary
local function findWeapon(character,mode)
    mode=mode or CONFIG.WeaponType
    local backpack=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    local fallback,count=nil,0
    for _, container in ipairs({character, backpack}) do
        if container then for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
            if tool:IsA("Tool")then
                local category=tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType") or tool:GetAttribute("Category") or tool:GetAttribute("Type")
                if Core.weaponMatches(mode,tool.Name,tool.ToolTip,category)then
                    if container==character then return tool end
                    fallback=tool;count+=1
                end
            end
        end end
    end
    -- GetChildren order is not hotbar order. Only a unique matching Tool is an unambiguous fallback.
    return count==1 and fallback or nil
end
local function initializeInput()
    if not slotInputInitialized then
        slotInputInitialized=true
        local ok,input=pcall(function()return UserInputService:CreateVirtualInput()end)
        if ok and input then
            table.insert(slotInputBackends,{name="VirtualInput",send=function(down,key)input:SendKey(down,key,false)end,
                mouse=function(down,point)input:SendMouseButton(point,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,down,0)end,
                aim=function(point)
                    if not pcall(function()input:SendMousePosition(point)end)then
                        input:SendMouseDelta(point-UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
                    end
                end})
        end
        -- Optional legacy API; ordinary LocalScripts may not have access.
        local legacyOk,legacy=pcall(function()return game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")end)
        if legacyOk and legacy then
            table.insert(slotInputBackends,{name="legacy input",send=function(down,key)legacy:SendKeyEvent(down,key,false,game)end,
                mouse=function(down,point)legacy:SendMouseButtonEvent(point.X,point.Y,0,down,game,0)end,
                aim=function(point)legacy:SendMouseMoveEvent(point.X,point.Y,game)end})
        end
    end
end
local function pressFirstSlot(mode,slotOverride)
    initializeInput()
    local keys={Enum.KeyCode.One,Enum.KeyCode.Two,Enum.KeyCode.Three,Enum.KeyCode.Four,Enum.KeyCode.Five,
        Enum.KeyCode.Six,Enum.KeyCode.Seven,Enum.KeyCode.Eight,Enum.KeyCode.Nine,Enum.KeyCode.Zero}
    local key=keys[slotOverride or (mode=="Melee" and 1 or mode=="Fruit" and CONFIG.FruitSlot or mode=="Gun" and CONFIG.GunSlot or CONFIG.SwordSlot)]
    for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
        local downOk=pcall(backend.send,true,key)
        local upOk=pcall(backend.send,false,key) -- always release, even when key-down failed
        if not upOk then pcall(backend.send,false,key)end
        if downOk and upOk then return true,backend.name end
    end
    return false,"input unavailable"
end
local function prepareFirstSlot(character,humanoid,now,mode)
    mode=mode or CONFIG.WeaponType
    if slotCharacter~=character or slotMode~=mode then
        releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon()
        slotCharacter=character;slotMode=mode;slotLastKey,slotLastEquip,slotWaitUntil=-math.huge,-math.huge,0
    end
    local weapon=findWeapon(character,mode)
    if weapon and weapon.Parent==character then return weapon end
    local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
    local slot=mode=="Melee" and 1 or mode=="Fruit" and CONFIG.FruitSlot or mode=="Gun" and CONFIG.GunSlot or CONFIG.SwordSlot
    local prefix="Slot "..slot.." ("..mode.."): "
    if focusOk and focused then return nil,prefix.."finish typing before equipping."end
    if now<slotWaitUntil then return nil,prefix.."waiting for selection…"end
    if now-slotLastKey>=1 then
        slotLastKey=now
        local sent,source=pressFirstSlot(mode)
        if sent then
            slotWaitUntil=now+.15
            local selected=findWeapon(character,mode)
            if selected and selected.Parent==character then return selected end
            return nil,prefix.."key sent via "..source.."; waiting for weapon…"
        end
    end
    -- If virtual input is unavailable or ignored, equip only a unique recognized Melee.
    weapon=findWeapon(character,mode)
    if weapon and now-slotLastEquip>=1 then
        slotLastEquip=now
        pcall(function()humanoid:EquipTool(weapon)end)
        if weapon.Parent==character then return weapon end
    end
    return nil,prefix.."selection not confirmed. Inventory: "..inventorySummary(character)
end
function fruit.cast(weapon,target,now,skills)
    skills=skills or CONFIG.FruitSkills
    if not target.model.Parent or target.humanoid.Health<=0 or weapon.Parent~=localPlayer.Character then fruit.release();return "Target changed"end
    local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
    local menuOk,menu=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
    if (focusOk and focused)or(menuOk and menu)then fruit.release();return "Finish typing / close Roblox menu"end
    if fruit.held or now-fruit.lastCast<1 then return "Fruit: waiting for next cast"end
    local keys={"Z","X","C","V"}
    local selected
    for _=1,4 do fruit.index=fruit.index%4+1;if skills[keys[fruit.index]]then selected=keys[fruit.index];break end end
    if not selected then fruit.target=nil;return "Fruit: select Z / X / C / V"end
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    local ok,point,visible=pcall(function()return camera:WorldToViewportPoint(target.part.Position)end)
    if not ok or not visible or point.Z<=0 then return "Fruit: target must be on screen for aiming"end
    initializeInput();releaseNativeClick()
    for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
        if pcall(backend.aim,Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y))then
            local key=Enum.KeyCode[selected]
            fruit.held={backend=backend,key=key,untilTime=now+.15,target=target.model}
            if pcall(backend.send,true,key)then fruit.lastCast=now;return weapon.Name.." · Fruit "..selected.." · HP "..math.ceil(target.humanoid.Health)end
            if not fruit.release()then return "Fruit: key release failed"end
        end
    end
    return "Fruit: aiming / key input unavailable"
end
-- Fruit mode keeps the fruit equipped. Finisher mode continues to use only its selected skills.
function fruit.identityKey(tool)
 local raw=tool:GetAttribute("FruitName")or tool:GetAttribute("FruitId")or tool.Name
 local key=Core.styleKey(raw):gsub("[^a-z0-9]",""):gsub("fruits$",""):gsub("fruit$","")
 if key==""then
  local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
  key=Core.styleKey(value and value.Value):gsub("[^a-z0-9]","")
 end
 if #key%2==0 and key:sub(1,#key/2)==key:sub(#key/2+1)then key=key:sub(1,#key/2)end
 return key
end
function fruit.hasM1(tool)
 if not tool then return false end
 if fruit.identityKey(tool)=="kitsune"then return true end
 for _,key in ipairs({"HasM1","M1Enabled","HasClickAttack","CanM1"})do
  local value=tool:GetAttribute(key)
  if type(value)=="boolean"then return value end
  local child=tool:FindFirstChild(key)
  if child and child:IsA("BoolValue")then return child.Value end
 end
 for _,key in ipairs({"M1","MouseButton1","ClickAttack","Tap"})do
  if tool:FindFirstChild(key)then return true end
 end
 -- Unconditional click attacks. Conditional awakenings/forms need a live capability marker.
 local key=fruit.identityKey(tool)
 local known={blade=true,bomb=true,creation=true,diamond=true,dragon=true,eagle=true,gas=true,
  gravity=true,ice=true,kitsune=true,light=true,lightning=true,pain=true,rubber=true,trex=true,yeti=true}
 if known[key]then return true end
 local main=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Main");local skills=main and main:FindFirstChild("Skills")
 local panel=skills and skills:FindFirstChild(tool.Name)
 if panel and progressFarm.visible(panel)then
  for _,widget in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants())do
   if(widget:IsA("TextLabel")or widget:IsA("TextButton"))and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
    local text=Core.styleKey(widget.Text)
    if text=="m1"or text=="tap"or text=="lmb"or text=="click"or text=="normalattack"
      or text:match("^tapnormal")or text:match("^m1normal")then return true end
   end
  end
 end
 return false
end
function fruit.attackHeight(tool,normal,direct)
 return (direct or CONFIG.WeaponType=="Fruit")and fruit.hasM1(tool)and 5 or normal
end
function fruit.attack(tool,target,now,finisher)
 local character=localPlayer.Character;local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root and combatAssist.npcEvading and combatAssist.npcEvading(root,now)then fruit.release();return "Evading NPC attack"end
 if finisher or not fruit.hasM1(tool)then
  local skills=finisher and CONFIG.FruitSkills or(fruit.skillsSelected()and CONFIG.FruitSkills or{Z=true,X=true,C=true,V=true})
  local point,reason=elite.aim(target)
  if not point then fruit.release();return reason end
  return fruit.cast(tool,target,now,skills)
 end
 fruit.release();releaseNativeClick()
 if not target.model.Parent or target.humanoid.Health<=0 or tool.Parent~=localPlayer.Character or tool.Enabled==false then return "Fruit M1: waiting for live target / Tool"end
 if not combatAssist.inputReady()then return "Fruit M1: finish typing / close menu"end
 if now-(fruit.lastM1 or -math.huge)<.2 then return "Fruit M1: waiting"end
 local point,reason=elite.aim(target)
 if not point then return reason end
 if(target.part.Position-localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude>12 then return "Fruit M1: approaching target"end
 fruit.lastM1=now;fruit.nativeM1(tool,point,now)
 return tool.Name.." · M1"
end

inventorySummary=function(character)
    local names={}
    for _, container in ipairs({character, localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")}) do
        if container then for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") and #names<4 then table.insert(names, item.Name.." ["..tostring(item.ToolTip).."]") end
        end end
    end
    return #names>0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "no tools in Character/Backpack"
end
local function nativeClickPosition()
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return nil end
    local viewport=camera.ViewportSize
    local function safe(point)
        if point.X<12 or point.X>viewport.X-12 or point.Y<40 or point.Y>viewport.Y-12 then return false end
        if window.Visible then
            local p,s=window.AbsolutePosition,window.AbsoluteSize
            if point.X>=p.X and point.X<=p.X+s.X and point.Y>=p.Y and point.Y<=p.Y+s.Y then return false end
        end
        local ok,widgets=pcall(function()return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X,point.Y)end)
        if not ok then return false end
        for _,widget in ipairs(widgets)do
            if widget:IsA("GuiButton") or widget:IsA("TextBox") or widget.Active then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    if nativeClickPoint and safe(nativeClickPoint)then return nativeClickPoint end
    for _,uv in ipairs({{.85,.55},{.65,.8},{.2,.5},{.5,.25},{.85,.8},{.15,.75}})do
        local point=Vector2.new(viewport.X*uv[1],viewport.Y*uv[2])
        if safe(point)then nativeClickPoint=point;return point end
    end
    nativeClickPoint=nil
end
local function nativeAttack(weapon,now,holdSeconds)
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root and combatAssist.npcEvading and combatAssist.npcEvading(root,now)then return nil,"Evading NPC attack"end
    if not raidCombat.auraReady(localPlayer.Character)then return nil,"Waiting for active Haki · "..auraStatus end
    if mouseHeldBackend then
        if now>=mouseHeldUntil then releaseNativeClick()end
        if mouseHeldBackend then return nil,"waiting for mouse release"end
    end
    local point=nativeClickPosition()
    if point then
        initializeInput()
        for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
            local ok=pcall(backend.mouse,true,point)
            if ok then
                mouseHeldBackend,mouseHeldPoint,mouseHeldUntil=backend,point,now+(holdSeconds or .04)
                return "M1 · "..backend.name
            end
            pcall(backend.mouse,false,point)
        end
    end
    weapon:Deactivate();weapon:Activate()
    return "Tool fallback"
end
function fruit.nativeM1(tool,point,now)
 -- Use the native mouse path for fruit scripts that listen to MouseButton1,
 -- retaining Tool.Activate as the fallback when virtual input is unavailable.
 initializeInput()
 if combatAssist.pointerSafe(point)then
  for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
   if pcall(backend.aim,point)and pcall(backend.mouse,true,point)then
    mouseHeldBackend=backend;mouseHeldPoint=point;mouseHeldUntil=now+.045;return
   end
   pcall(backend.mouse,false,point)
  end
 end
 tool:Deactivate();tool:Activate()
end
function raidCombat.primeMelee(weapon,now)
    if raidCombat.meleeWeapon==weapon and now-(raidCombat.meleeAt or -math.huge)<.1 then return nil end
    raidCombat.meleeWeapon=weapon;raidCombat.meleeAt=now
    local ok,backend=pcall(nativeAttack,weapon,now,.015)
    return ok and backend or nil
end
local function attackTarget(weapon, target, requiredMob,mode,now)
    if not raidCombat.auraReady(localPlayer.Character)then return nil,"Waiting for active Haki · "..auraStatus end
    if requiredMob and Core.normalizeName(target.name)~=Core.normalizeName(requiredMob)then return nil end
    local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
    local menuOk,menuOpen=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
    if focusOk and focused or menuOk and menuOpen then return nil,"close text input/menu to attack"end
    if mode=="Native"then return nativeAttack(weapon,now)end
    local part=target.model:FindFirstChild("Head") or target.part
    local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    local net=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("Net")
    local registerAttack=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterAttack")
    local registerHit=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit")
    if registerAttack and registerHit and registerAttack:IsA("RemoteEvent") and registerHit:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        -- One nearby NPC only. Never include other players in the hit list.
        local ok=pcall(function()
            registerAttack:FireServer(ATTACK_INTERVAL)
            registerHit:FireServer(part, {{target.model, part}})
        end)
        if ok then return "Net"end
        if combatProbe then combatProbe.mode="Native"end
    end
    return nativeAttack(weapon,now)
end
function raidCombat.npcModel(model)
 local enemies=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
 if not model or not enemies or model.Parent~=enemies or not model:IsA("Model")then return false end
 if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)then return false end
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  local character=player.Character
  if character and(model==character or model:IsDescendantOf(character))then return false end
 end
 local human=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 return human and human.Health>0 or false
end
function raidCombat.raidNPC(target,root,markers)
 if not target or not raidCombat.npcModel(target.model)or not target.part or not target.part:IsDescendantOf(target.model)then return false end
 local owner,nearest=0,CONFIG.RaidIslandRadius
 for index,marker in pairs(markers or{})do
  if marker.Parent then
   local d=(target.part.Position-marker.Position).Magnitude
   if d<nearest then owner,nearest=index,d end
  end
 end
 return owner==raidIndex and(target.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=CONFIG.RaidRadius
end
function raidCombat.playersNearCast(target,root,markers)
 local radius=math.max(CONFIG.RaidIslandRadius,CONFIG.RaidRadius+100)
 local marker=markers and markers[raidIndex]
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=localPlayer then
   local character=player.Character
   local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   local body=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   if human and human.Health>0 and body and body:IsA("BasePart")then
    if(body.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=radius or(body.Position-target.part.Position).Magnitude<=radius
     or marker and marker.Parent and(body.Position-marker.Position).Magnitude<=radius then return true end
   end
  end
 end
 return false
end
function raidCombat.fruitAttack(weapon,target,root,markers,now,finisher)
 local function ready()
  return state.raid and raidRunning and localPlayer.Character==root.Parent
   and weapon.Parent==localPlayer.Character and weapon.Enabled~=false
   and raidCombat.raidNPC(target,root,markers)and not raidCombat.playersNearCast(target,root,markers)
 end
 if not ready()then
  releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();weapon:Deactivate()
  return "NPC-only: fruit attack paused · another player nearby / target changed"
 end
 local result=fruit.attack(weapon,target,now,finisher)
 if fruit.held then fruit.held.healthCheck=ready end
 return result
end

function raidCombat.hits(list,root,markers,requiredMob)
    local hits,seen={},{}
    local enemies=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    local playerCharacters={}
    for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do if player.Character then playerCharacters[player.Character]=true end end
    for _,candidate in ipairs(list)do
        local model=candidate.model
        if raidCombat.npcModel(model)and not seen[model] and not playerCharacters[model]
            and (not requiredMob or Core.normalizeName(model.Name)==Core.normalizeName(requiredMob))then
            local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local body=raidCombat.body(model)
            local part=raidCombat.hitPart(model)
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and body and part and (body.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=(markers and CONFIG.RaidRadius or CONFIG.FarmRadius) then
                local owner,nearest=markers and 0 or raidIndex,CONFIG.RaidIslandRadius
                for index,marker in pairs(markers or {})do
                    if marker.Parent then
                        local distance=(body.Position-marker.Position).Magnitude
                        if distance<nearest then owner,nearest=index,distance end
                    end
                end
                if owner==raidIndex then
                    seen[model]=true
                    if not markers or #hits<12 then table.insert(hits,{model,part})
                    else
                        local farthest,distance=1,-1
                        for index,hit in ipairs(hits)do
                            local current=(hit[2].Position-root.Position).Magnitude
                            if current>distance then farthest,distance=index,current end
                        end
                        if (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<distance then hits[farthest]={model,part}end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(hits,function(a,b)return (a[2].Position-root.Position).Magnitude<(b[2].Position-root.Position).Magnitude end)
    if markers then while #hits>12 do table.remove(hits)end end
    return hits
end
function raidCombat.attack(weapon,list,root,markers,mode,now,requiredMob,scopeCheck)
    local farm=markers==nil
    if not farm then releaseNativeClick();weapon:Deactivate()end
    local function ready()
        local humanoid=localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return not disposed and (farm and (state.farm or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events) or not farm and state.raid and (raidRunning or raidHost.moving)) and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
            and (farm or not raidCombat.timer or raidCombat.timer()) and (not scopeCheck or scopeCheck())
            and raidCombat.auraReady(localPlayer.Character)
            and(not farm or not combatAssist.npcEvading or not combatAssist.npcEvading(root,os.clock()))
            and root.Parent==localPlayer.Character and weapon.Parent==localPlayer.Character and weapon.Enabled~=false
    end
    if not raidCombat.auraReady(localPlayer.Character)then return nil,"Waiting for active Haki · "..auraStatus end
    if not ready()then releaseNativeClick();return nil,"Combat/weapon no longer ready"end
    local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
    local menuOk,menu=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
    if (focusOk and focused)or(menuOk and menu)then releaseNativeClick();return nil,"close text input/menu to attack"end
    local hits=raidCombat.hits(list,root,markers,requiredMob)
    if #hits==0 then return nil,"No current eligible nearby NPCs"end
    if farm and mode=="Native"then return nativeAttack(weapon,now,.015)end
    local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    local net=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("Net")
    local registerAttack=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterAttack")
    local registerHit=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit")
    if registerAttack and registerHit and registerAttack:IsA("RemoteEvent") and registerHit:IsA("RemoteEvent")then
        local meleePulse
        if farm and slotMode=="Melee"then
            meleePulse=raidCombat.primeMelee(weapon,now)
            if not ready()then releaseNativeClick();return nil,"Combat changed during Melee activation"end
        end
        local sent=false
        local ok=pcall(function()
            registerAttack:FireServer(RAID_ATTACK_INTERVAL)
            if not ready()then return end
            -- Revalidate only the already selected batch after native activation.
            local current={}
            for _,hit in ipairs(hits)do
                local model,part=hit[1],hit[2]
                local human=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if raidCombat.npcModel(model)and human and human.Health>0 and part.Parent==model
                    and (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=(markers and CONFIG.RaidRadius or CONFIG.FarmRadius)then
                    local owner,nearest=markers and 0 or raidIndex,CONFIG.RaidIslandRadius
                    for index,marker in pairs(markers or{})do
                        if marker.Parent then
                            local distance=(part.Position-marker.Position).Magnitude
                            if distance<nearest then owner,nearest=index,distance end
                        end
                    end
                    if owner==raidIndex then table.insert(current,hit)end
                end
            end
            hits=current
            if #hits==0 then return end
            registerHit:FireServer(hits[1][2],hits);sent=true
        end)
        if ok then return sent and ("Net · "..#hits.." NPCs"..(meleePulse and " · M1"or "")) or nil,"Targets changed before hit"end
        if combatProbe then combatProbe.mode="Native"end
    end
    if not ready()then return nil,"Raid stopped"end
    if not farm then
        releaseNativeClick();weapon:Deactivate()
        return nil,"Auto Raid NPC-only: targeted hit channel unavailable · native M1 paused"
    end
    return nativeAttack(weapon,now,.015)
end
local function widgetVisible(node)
    local current=node
    while current and current~=playerGui do
        if current.Name=="ViltrumModules" or current.Name=="ExperienceChat"
            or current.Name=="Chat" or current.Name=="BubbleChat" or current.Name=="PlayerList"then return false end
        if current:IsA("GuiObject") and not current.Visible then return false end
        if current:IsA("LayerCollector") and current.Enabled==false then return false end
        current=current.Parent
    end
    return current==playerGui
end
local function isTextWidget(node)
    return node:IsA("TextLabel") or node:IsA("TextButton")
end
local questLabel,questCounter,questDescriptors=nil,nil,{}
local questDiscoveryAt=-math.huge
local questGuiDirty=true
local function markQuestDirty(node)
    if not isTextWidget(node)then return end
    local current=node
    while current and current~=playerGui do
        if current.Name=="ViltrumModules" or current.Name=="ExperienceChat" or current.Name=="Chat"then return end
        current=current.Parent
    end
    questGuiDirty=true
end
connect(playerGui.DescendantAdded,markQuestDirty)
connect(playerGui.DescendantRemoving,markQuestDirty)
local function readObjective(label,counter)
    if not label or not counter or not label.Parent or not counter.Parent then return nil end
    if not widgetVisible(label) or not widgetVisible(counter)then return nil end
    local title=label.Text
    local count=tonumber(Core.normalizeName(title):match("^defeat%s+(%d+)%s+"))
    local done,total=Core.normalizeName(counter.Text):match("^(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)$")
    if count and tonumber(total)==count and tonumber(done)<=count then return title,tonumber(done)>=count end
end
local function questUI()
    local currentTitle,currentComplete=readObjective(questLabel,questCounter)
    if currentTitle then return true,currentTitle,currentComplete,"cached objective+counter"end
    for _,pair in ipairs(questDescriptors)do
        local title,complete=readObjective(pair[1],pair[2])
        if title then questLabel,questCounter=pair[1],pair[2];return true,title,complete,"cached objective+counter"end
    end
    local now=os.clock()
    if questGuiDirty or now-questDiscoveryAt>=1 then
        questGuiDirty=false;questDiscoveryAt=now;questDescriptors={}
    -- Read the real visible objective; Main.Quest can be a hidden legacy widget.
    for _,label in ipairs(perf.hudObjects())do
        if isTextWidget(label) and widgetVisible(label)then
            local title=label.Text
            local count=tonumber(Core.normalizeName(title):match("^defeat%s+(%d+)%s+"))
            if count then
                local ancestor=label.Parent
                for _=1,3 do
                    if not ancestor or ancestor==playerGui or ancestor:IsA("LayerCollector")then break end
                    for _,counter in ipairs(ancestor:GetDescendants())do
                        if isTextWidget(counter) and widgetVisible(counter)then
                            local done,total=Core.normalizeName(counter.Text):match("^(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)$")
                            if tonumber(total)==count and tonumber(done)<=count then
                                questLabel,questCounter=label,counter
                                table.insert(questDescriptors,{label,counter})
                                return true,title,tonumber(done)>=count,"objective+counter"
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    ancestor=ancestor.Parent
                end
            end
        end
    end
    end
    local main=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
    local quest=main and main:FindFirstChild("Quest")
    if not quest then return nil,nil,false,"panel missing"end
    if not widgetVisible(quest)then return false,nil,false,"legacy panel hidden"end
    local titleContainer=quest:FindFirstChild("QuestTitle", true)
    local title=titleContainer and (titleContainer:IsA("TextLabel") and titleContainer or titleContainer:FindFirstChild("Title", true))
    if title and isTextWidget(title) then return true,title.Text,false,"legacy title"end
    return true,nil,false,"legacy title missing"
end
local QUEST_NPC_NAMES = {Area1Quest="Area 1 Quest Giver", Area2Quest="Area 2 Quest Giver"}
local function questNpcPosition(quest)
    local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
    if folder then
        for _, npc in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            local matches=npc.Name==QUEST_NPC_NAMES[quest[2]] or npc:GetAttribute("QuestId")==quest[2]
                or npc:GetAttribute("QuestName")==quest[2]
            if matches then
                local part=npc:IsA("BasePart") and npc or npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part.Position end
            end
        end
    end
    return Vector3.new(quest[5], quest[6], quest[7])
end
local function candidates(root)
    local list={}
    local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    if not folder then return nil end
    for _, mob in ipairs(perf.enemies(folder)) do
        if mob:IsA("Model") then
            local record=perf.enemyRecords[mob]
            local humanoid=record and record.humanoid
            local part=record and record.part
            if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then humanoid=mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")end
            if not part or not part.Parent then part=raidCombat.body(mob)end
            if not record then record={};perf.enemyRecords[mob]=record end
            record.humanoid=humanoid;record.part=part
            if humanoid and part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                record.model=mob;record.name=mob.Name;record.health=humanoid.Health;record.maxHealth=humanoid.MaxHealth
                record.distance=(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude;table.insert(list,record)
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end
local function spawnPoints(quest)
    if not quest then return {}, "none" end
    local origin=workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
    local folder=origin and origin:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawns") or workspace:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawns")
    local cache=perf.spawnCache
    local key=quest[2]..":"..quest[3]
    local now=os.clock()
    if cache and cache.folder==folder and cache.key==key and now-cache.at<.75 then return cache.points,cache.source end
    local points={}
    if folder then
        for _,part in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants())do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and Core.normalizeName(part.Name)==Core.normalizeName(quest[4]) then
                table.insert(points,part.Position)
            end
        end
    end
    local sourceName="live"
    if #points==0 then
        local fallback=FARM_AREAS[key]
        if fallback then points={Vector3.new(fallback[1],fallback[2],fallback[3])};sourceName="reference"else sourceName="none"end
    end
    perf.spawnCache={folder=folder,key=key,at=now,points=points,source=sourceName}
    return points,sourceName
end
local function approachSpawn(root,quest,now)
    local points,source=spawnPoints(quest)
    if #points==0 then return false end
    local key=quest[2]..":"..quest[3]..":"..source
    if spawnRouteKey~=key then
        spawnRouteKey,spawnRoutePoints,spawnRouteIndex,spawnArrivedAt=key,points,1,nil
        local nearest=math.huge
        for i,p in ipairs(points)do
            local distance=(root.Position-p).Magnitude
            if distance<nearest then spawnRouteIndex,nearest=i,distance end
        end
    end
    local position=spawnRoutePoints[spawnRouteIndex]+Vector3.new(CONFIG.FarmSideOffset,FARM_HEIGHT,0)
    if (position-root.Position).Magnitude<=CONFIG.PositionTolerance then
        spawnArrivedAt=spawnArrivedAt or now
        if #spawnRoutePoints>1 and now-spawnArrivedAt>=CONFIG.SpawnWait then
            spawnRouteIndex=spawnRouteIndex%#spawnRoutePoints+1;spawnArrivedAt=nil
