            position=spawnRoutePoints[spawnRouteIndex]+Vector3.new(CONFIG.FarmSideOffset,FARM_HEIGHT,0)
        end
    else spawnArrivedAt=nil end
    stopMovement();holdPosition(root,position,nil)
    status("Searching "..quest[4].." · spawn "..spawnRouteIndex.."/"..#spawnRoutePoints.." · "..source)
    return true
end
-- Shared contact positioning for short-range tools. Search / skill height is
-- separate from the position at which normal melee swings can reach a body.
function combatAssist.contactWeapon(tool)
    if not tool then return false end
    local category=tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType")or tool:GetAttribute("Category")or tool:GetAttribute("Type")
    return Core.isFightingStyle(tool.Name,tool.ToolTip,category)
        or Core.weaponMatches("Sword",tool.Name,tool.ToolTip,category)
        or CONFIG.WeaponType=="Fruit"and fruit.hasM1(tool)
end
function combatAssist.contactOffset(target,sideOffset)
    local forward=target.part.CFrame.LookVector
    local horizontal=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
    if horizontal.Magnitude<.01 then horizontal=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)else horizontal=horizontal.Unit end
    -- Six studs above and 2.5 behind: raised above basic swings while inside the eight-stud contact gate.
    local side=math.clamp(tonumber(sideOffset)or CONFIG.FarmSideOffset or 0,-1,1)
    return horizontal*(-2.5)+Vector3.new(side,6,0)
end
function combatAssist.farmInRange(root,target,tool)
    if combatAssist.npcEvading and combatAssist.npcEvading(root,os.clock())then return false end
    if not target or not target.model.Parent or target.humanoid.Health<=0 or not target.part.Parent
        or not target.part:IsDescendantOf(target.model)then return false end
    local range=combatAssist.contactWeapon(tool)and 8 or fruit.hasM1(tool)and 12 or nil
    return not range or(target.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=range
end

-- Brief movement-only evasions for contact farming. Server damage and NPC
-- properties are never changed; ranged / area skills can still cause damage.
function combatAssist.npcSafetyOwner()
    return state.farm or state.boss or state.elite or state.swordfarm or state.gunfarm or state.resourcefarm or state.events
end
function combatAssist.npcEvading(root,now)
    local guard=combatAssist.npcSafety
    return guard~=nil and combatAssist.npcSafetyOwner()and not state.raid
        and guard.root==root and root.Parent==localPlayer.Character and guard.mob.Parent~=nil
        and now<(guard.untilTime or 0)
end
function combatAssist.npcSafePose(root,mob,position,now)
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local tool=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    local enemy=mob and mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not combatAssist.npcSafetyOwner()or state.raid or not human or human.Health<=0 or root.Parent~=character
        or not mob or mob.Parent~=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mob)
        or not enemy or enemy.Health<=0 or not combatAssist.contactWeapon(tool)then return position,false end
    local part=raidCombat.body(mob)
    if not part then return position,false end
    local guard=combatAssist.npcSafety
    if not guard or guard.root~=root or guard.mob~=mob then
        guard={root=root,mob=mob,health=human.Health,skill=false,side=1};combatAssist.npcSafety=guard
    end
    local skill=mob:GetAttribute("UsingSkill")==true
    local damaged=human.Health<guard.health
    guard.health=human.Health
    if damaged or skill and not guard.skill then
        local forward=part.CFrame.LookVector;forward=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
        if forward.Magnitude<.01 then forward=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)else forward=forward.Unit end
        local side=Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
        guard.side=-guard.side;guard.untilTime=now+1
        guard.position=part.Position+side*(guard.side*18)-forward*7+Vector3.new(0,14,0)
    end
    guard.skill=skill
    if combatAssist.npcEvading(root,now)then
        releaseNativeClick();fruit.release()
        return guard.position,true
    end
    return position,false
end

local function combatPosition(weapon,target,now,sideOffset)
    combatProbe=Core.updateFixedCombatProbe(combatProbe,weapon,target.model,target.health,now)
    local height=fruit.attackHeight(weapon,FARM_HEIGHT)
    if combatProbe.progress then learnedHeights[weapon]={heightIndex=combatProbe.heightIndex,mode=combatProbe.mode}end
    if combatAssist.contactWeapon(weapon)then
        local offset=combatAssist.contactOffset(target,sideOffset)
        return target.part.Position+offset,offset.Y
    end
    return target.part.Position+Vector3.new(sideOffset or CONFIG.FarmSideOffset,height,0),height
end
local function farmStep()
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root then
        releaseNativeClick();combatProbe=nil;stopMovement();stopHover();status("Waiting for your character…");return
    end
    if haki.step(character,humanoid,root)then return end
    disableCollisions(character)
    ensureAura(character)
    if movingRoot and movingRoot~=root then stopMovement() end
    local now=os.clock()
    local weapon,equipStatus
    local sea=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
    local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
    local level=data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
    local visible,title,questComplete,questSource=questUI()
    if state.quests and visible==nil then stopFarm("Quest UI not found. This game build needs an adapter update."); return end
    if visible and questComplete then
        releaseNativeClick();fruit.target=nil
        stopMovement();holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil)
        status("Quest complete; waiting for the objective to disappear…");return
    end
    local bossQuest=visible and Core.isBossQuest(title,BOSS_NAMES)
    local quest=state.quests and Core.selectQuest(QUESTS[sea], level and level.Value, sea) or nil
    if visible and not bossQuest then
        quest=Core.activeQuest(QUESTS[sea],title)
        if not quest then
            stopFarm("Active quest is not recognized; keeping it. Title: "..tostring(title));return
        end
        questAttempts=0
    end
    if visible and bossQuest and not state.quests then
        status("Boss quest active. Enable Auto Quests to cancel it and choose a normal quest.");return
    end
    if not visible then bossAttempts=0 end
    if state.quests and not quest and not bossQuest then stopFarm("No eligible quest in the source snapshot for this sea/level."); return end
    if sea==3 and quest and quest[2]:match("^Submerged")and not teleport.submergedHere(root)then
        teleport.levelAccess(root,humanoid,now);return
    end
    if teleport.levelTransport and teleport.submergedHere(root)then
        teleport.releaseTransport(teleport.levelTransport);teleport.levelTransport=nil
    end
    local npc=quest and questNpcPosition(quest) or nil
    local list=candidates(root)
    if not list then stopFarm("workspace.Enemies not found. This game build needs an adapter update."); return end
    local target=fruit.chooseTarget(list, quest and quest[4] or nil)
    if sea==3 and target and target.part.Position.Y< -1000 and not teleport.submergedHere(root)then
        teleport.levelAccess(root,humanoid,now);return
    end
    local attackMode=fruit.mode(target)
    weapon,equipStatus=prepareFirstSlot(character,humanoid,now,attackMode)
    if not weapon then holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil);status(equipStatus);return end
    local farmPosition,height=nil,FARM_HEIGHT
    if target then
        if attackMode=="Fruit"then
            height=fruit.attackHeight(weapon,FARM_HEIGHT);farmPosition=target.part.Position+Vector3.new(CONFIG.FarmSideOffset,height,0)
            if combatAssist.contactWeapon(weapon)then
                local offset=combatAssist.contactOffset(target);height=offset.Y;farmPosition=target.part.Position+offset
            end
        else farmPosition,height=combatPosition(weapon,target,now);fruit.height=height end
    end
    if state.quests and visible and title and Core.questMatches(title, quest[4]) then questAttempts=0 end
    local action=Core.decide({enabled=state.farm,alive=true,autoQuest=state.quests,quest=quest,
        questVisible=visible,questTitle=title,npcDistance=npc and (npc-root.Position).Magnitude or 0,
        questBoss=bossQuest,
        questRange=CONFIG.QuestRange,now=now,lastQuest=lastQuest,questCooldown=CONFIG.QuestCooldown,
        target=target,attackRange=combatAssist.contactWeapon(weapon)and 8 or CONFIG.FarmRadius,hasWeapon=weapon~=nil,
        positionDistance=nil,
        positionTolerance=CONFIG.PositionTolerance,
        lastAttack=lastAttack,attackCooldown=ATTACK_INTERVAL-1e-6})
    if action=="wrong_quest" or action=="unknown_quest" then
        stopFarm("Finish/cancel the current quest manually, then restart Auto Farm.")
    elseif action=="abandon_boss" then
        stopMovement();holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil)
        if questRequest then status("Waiting for boss quest cancellation…");return end
        if now-lastAbandon<CONFIG.QuestCooldown then status("Waiting for boss quest to disappear…");return end
        if bossAttempts>=3 then stopFarm("Boss quest cancellation was not confirmed after 3 attempts.");return end
        local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then stopFarm("AbandonQuest RemoteFunction not found.");return end
        lastAbandon=now;bossAttempts+=1;status("Cancelling boss quest…")
        local requestThread
        requestThread=task.defer(function()
            local ok,result=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer("AbandonQuest")end)
            if questRequest==requestThread then
                questRequest=nil
                if questTimer then task.cancel(questTimer);questTimer=nil end
                if state.farm and not ok then stopFarm("AbandonQuest failed: "..tostring(result))end
            end
        end)
        questRequest=requestThread
        questTimer=task.delay(8,function()
            questTimer=nil
            if questRequest==requestThread then stopFarm("AbandonQuest response timed out after 8 seconds.")end
        end)
    elseif action=="move_npc" then
        stopMovement()
        status("Quest NPC: "..quest[2]);holdPosition(root,npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0),nil)
    elseif action=="start_quest" then
        stopMovement()
        holdPosition(root,npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0),nil)
        if questRequest then status("Waiting for quest response…"); return end
        if questAttempts>=3 then
            stopFarm("Quest unconfirmed: "..quest[2].."/"..quest[3].." · UI="..questSource.." · Reply="..lastQuestReply)
            return
        end
        local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then stopFarm("StartQuest RemoteFunction not found."); return end
        lastQuest=now; questAttempts+=1; status("Requesting quest: "..quest[4])
        local requestThread
        -- defer allows the thread handle to be set before the callback runs.
        requestThread=task.defer(function()
            local ok, result=pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("StartQuest", quest[2], quest[3]) end)
            if questRequest==requestThread then
                questRequest=nil
                local kind=type(result)
                lastQuestReply=(kind=="number" or kind=="boolean" or kind=="nil") and tostring(result)
                    or kind=="string" and result:sub(1,60):gsub("%c"," ") or kind
                if questTimer then task.cancel(questTimer); questTimer=nil end
                if state.farm and not ok then stopFarm("StartQuest failed: "..tostring(result)) end
            end
        end)
        questRequest=requestThread
        questTimer=task.delay(8, function()
            questTimer=nil
            if questRequest==requestThread then stopFarm("StartQuest response timed out after 8 seconds.") end
        end)
    elseif action=="wait_quest" then
        stopMovement();holdPosition(root,npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0),nil)
        status("Waiting for quest confirmation…")
    elseif action=="wait_mob" then
        releaseNativeClick()
        hoverMob=nil
        watchedMob=nil
        if not approachSpawn(root,quest,now)then
            stopMovement();status("No live mob/spawn position: "..(quest and quest[4] or "nearest live enemy"))
        end
    elseif action=="move_mob" then
        releaseNativeClick()
        spawnRouteKey=nil
        stopMovement()
        status("Approaching: "..target.name)
        holdPosition(root, farmPosition, target.model)
    elseif action=="no_weapon" then
        stopMovement();holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil)
        status("Waiting for "..CONFIG.WeaponType..". Inventory: "..inventorySummary(character))
    elseif action=="attack" or action=="wait_attack" then
        spawnRouteKey=nil
        stopMovement()
        holdPosition(root, farmPosition, target.model)
        if not combatAssist.farmInRange(root,target,weapon)then
            releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();status("Approaching attack range: "..target.name);return
        end
        if watchedMob~=target.model then
            watchedMob, watchedHealth, lastDamageAt, attackCount=target.model, target.health, now, 0
        elseif target.health<watchedHealth then lastDamageAt=now; watchedHealth=target.health end
        local progress=attackCount>=4 and now-lastDamageAt>CONFIG.NoDamageTimeout and " · HP unchanged; continuing" or ""
        if action~="attack"then status("Attacking: "..target.name.." · HP "..math.ceil(target.health)..progress)end
        if action=="attack" then
            -- Re-read the objective at the effect boundary, including with Auto Quests off.
            local active,activeTitle=questUI()
            local activeRow=active and Core.activeQuest(QUESTS[sea],activeTitle)or nil
            if active and (Core.isBossQuest(activeTitle,BOSS_NAMES) or not activeRow
                or Core.normalizeName(target.name)~=Core.normalizeName(activeRow[4]))then
                releaseNativeClick();status("Quest target changed; updating target without attacking.");return
            end
            if weapon.Parent~=character or weapon.Enabled==false then
                status("Waiting for "..CONFIG.WeaponType.." to be equipped/ready: "..weapon.Name);return
            end
            local facing=Vector3.new(target.part.Position.X,root.Position.Y,target.part.Position.Z)
            if (facing-root.Position).Magnitude>.01 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,facing) end
            lastAttack=now
            if attackMode=="Fruit"then status(fruit.attack(weapon,target,now,CONFIG.WeaponType~="Fruit"));return end
            local requiredMob=quest and quest[4]
            local function scopeReady()
                local visible,currentTitle,complete=questUI()
                if complete or not combatAssist.farmInRange(root,target,weapon)then return false end
                if visible then
                    local row=Core.activeQuest(QUESTS[sea],currentTitle)
                    return row~=nil and not Core.isBossQuest(currentTitle,BOSS_NAMES)
                        and requiredMob~=nil and Core.normalizeName(row[4])==Core.normalizeName(requiredMob)
                end
                return not state.quests
            end
            if attackMode=="Gun"then
                local backend,reason=elite.shoot(weapon,target,now,function()return state.farm and CONFIG.WeaponType=="Gun"and target.humanoid.Health>0 and scopeReady()end)
                status(tostring(backend or reason));return
            end
            local backend,reason=raidCombat.attack(weapon,{target},root,nil,combatProbe.mode,now,requiredMob,scopeReady)
            if not backend then status(reason or "Target mismatch; no hit sent.");return end
            attackCount+=1;Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)
            status(weapon.Name.." · "..backend.." · "..target.name.." · HP "..math.ceil(target.health).." · Height "..height..progress)
        end
    end
end
local raidActive
do
    local hud={labels={},dirty=true,scannedAt=-math.huge}
    local function remainingTime(node)
        if not isTextWidget(node)then return nil end
        local value=node.Text:gsub("<[^>]*>",""):lower():gsub("%s+"," "):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local minutes,seconds=value:match("^time left%s*:%s*(%d+)%s*:%s*(%d%d)$")
        minutes,seconds=tonumber(minutes),tonumber(seconds)
        if not minutes or minutes>60 or not seconds or seconds>=60 then return nil end
        return minutes*60+seconds
    end
    local function readLabels()
        local expired=false
        for _,label in ipairs(hud.labels)do
            if label.Parent and widgetVisible(label)then
                local seconds=remainingTime(label)
                if seconds and seconds>0 then return true,"HUD Time Left"end
                if seconds==0 then expired=true end
            end
        end
        return false,expired
    end
    local function invalidate(node)
        if isTextWidget(node)then hud.dirty=true end
    end
    connect(playerGui.DescendantAdded,invalidate)
    connect(playerGui.DescendantRemoving,invalidate)
    raidActive=function()
        local active,expired=readLabels()
        if active then return true,expired end
        local now=os.clock()
        if hud.dirty or now-hud.scannedAt>=1 then
            hud.dirty=false;hud.scannedAt=now;hud.labels={}
            for _,label in ipairs(perf.hudObjects())do
                -- Cache hidden timers too, so showing the same widget needs no rediscovery.
                if remainingTime(label)~=nil then table.insert(hud.labels,label)end
            end
            active,expired=readLabels()
            if active then return true,expired end
        end
        if expired then return false,"raid timer reached 00:00"end
        local main=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
        local timer=main and main:FindFirstChild("Timer")
        if timer and timer:IsA("GuiObject") and widgetVisible(timer)then
            local seconds=remainingTime(timer)
            if seconds==0 then return false,"raid timer reached 00:00"end
            return true,"legacy Main.Timer"
        end
        return false,"no visible raid timer (Time Left / Main.Timer)"
    end
end
raidCombat.timer=raidActive
local function raidMarkers(root,now)
    if now-raidMarkersAt<.25 then return raidCachedMarkers end
    raidMarkersAt=now;raidCachedMarkers={}
    local origin=workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
    local locations=origin and origin:FindFirstChild("Locations")
    if locations then
        for _,part in ipairs(locations:GetChildren())do
            local index=part:IsA("BasePart") and tonumber(part.Name:match("^Island ([1-5])$"))
            if index and (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=3000 then
                local current=raidCachedMarkers[index]
                if not current or (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<(current.Position-root.Position).Magnitude then
                    raidCachedMarkers[index]=part
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return raidCachedMarkers
end
-- Native raid preparation: no guessed purchase/start remotes and no virtual ownership proof.
function raidHost.note(message)
 if raidHost.label and raidHost.label.Text~=message then raidHost.label.Text=message end
 status("Auto Raid: "..message)
end
function raidHost.releaseInput()
 if raidHost.mouse then pcall(raidHost.mouse.backend.mouse,false,raidHost.mouse.point);raidHost.mouse=nil end
 if raidHost.prompt then pcall(function()raidHost.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);raidHost.prompt=nil end
 raidHost.restoreGUI()
end

function raidHost.reset()
 if Core.cancelGameCall then Core.cancelGameCall("raidChip");Core.cancelGameCall("raidFruit")end
 if raidHost.uiJob then task.cancel(raidHost.uiJob);raidHost.uiJob=nil end
 raidHost.uiWidgets=nil;raidHost.uiAt=0;raidHost.choiceAt=0;raidHost.npcAt=0;raidHost.npc=nil;raidHost.npcBody=nil;raidHost.atScientist=false;raidHost.pendingFruit=nil;raidHost.pendingBeli=nil
 raidHost.generation=(raidHost.generation or 0)+1
 if raidHost.scanJob then task.cancel(raidHost.scanJob);raidHost.scanJob=nil end
 raidHost.cancelStorageRead();raidHost.storedAt=0;raidHost.storedReliable=false;raidHost.storedItems=nil
 raidHost.withdrawSentAt=nil;raidHost.withdrawing=false;raidHost.storageFiltered=false
 raidHost.routeRoot=nil;raidHost.routeGoal=nil;raidHost.routeMob=nil;raidHost.routeEscape=nil;raidHost.routeAt=0
 raidHost.releaseInput();raidHost.moving=false;raidHost.scanAt=0;raidHost.controls=nil
 raidHost.nextAt=0;raidHost.clickAt=0;raidHost.retryAt=0;raidHost.wasActive=false;raidHost.awaitStart=0
 raidHost.transactionUntil=0;raidHost.character=nil;raidHost.dialogue=nil
end
function raidHost.configure(field,value)
 if field=="kind"then
  local found=false;for _,name in ipairs(raidHost.types)do if name==value then found=true end end
  if not found then return end
 elseif field=="payment"then if value~="Beli"and value~="Fruit"then return end
 elseif field~="fruitName"then return end
 raidHost.reset();raidHost[field]=value
 if raidHost.redraw then raidHost.redraw()end
end
function raidHost.toolList(character)
 local list={};local chip
 for _,container in ipairs({character,localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")})do
  if container then for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if tool:IsA("Tool")then
    local key=Core.styleKey(tool.Name)
    if key=="specialmicrochip"or tool:GetAttribute("RaidMicrochip")==true then chip=tool
    elseif key:sub(-5)=="fruit"and not tool:FindFirstChild("Level")and not tool:FindFirstChild("Mastery")then table.insert(list,tool)end
   end
  end end
 end
 return list,chip
end
-- Only the selected fruit can leave storage; real Backpack Tools confirm withdrawal.
function raidHost.fruitKey(name)
 return fruitEsp.key(name)
end
function raidHost.sameFruit(a,b)
 local key=raidHost.fruitKey(a)
 return key~=""and key==raidHost.fruitKey(b)
end
function raidHost.fruitLabel(name)
 local row=fruitEsp.catalog[raidHost.fruitKey(name)]
 return row and row.name or name
end
function raidHost.cancelStorageRead()
 for _,key in ipairs({"storageRequest","storageTimer"})do
  if raidHost[key]then task.cancel(raidHost[key]);raidHost[key]=nil end
 end
end
function raidHost.readStored(now)
 if disposed or raidHost.storageRequest or now<(raidHost.storedAt or 0)then return end
 local folder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes");local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then
  raidHost.storedReliable=false;raidHost.storedAt=now+8;raidHost.storageIssue="Inventory is unavailable; checking the selected fruit through the game UI"
  return
 end
 local generation=raidHost.generation;local thread
 thread=task.defer(function()
  if disposed or raidHost.generation~=generation or raidHost.storageRequest~=thread then return end
  local ok,result,extra=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer("getInventory")end)
  if disposed or raidHost.generation~=generation or raidHost.storageRequest~=thread then return end
  raidHost.storageRequest=nil
  if raidHost.storageTimer then task.cancel(raidHost.storageTimer);raidHost.storageTimer=nil end
  if(result==true or result==nil)and type(extra)=="table"then result=extra end
  local function valid()return not disposed and raidHost.generation==generation end
  local rows,reliable,issue
  if ok then rows,reliable,issue=acquisition.inventory(result,valid)end
  if not valid()then return end
  raidHost.storedAt=os.clock()+6;raidHost.storedReliable=rows~=nil and reliable==true;raidHost.storageIssue=issue
  if rows then
   raidHost.storedItems={}
   for _,item in pairs(rows)do
    if item.Type=="Blox Fruit"and type(item.Name)=="string"and(tonumber(item.Count)or 1)>0 then table.insert(raidHost.storedItems,item)end
   end
  else raidHost.storedItems=nil;raidHost.storageIssue="Storage response unavailable; native inventory will be checked"end
  if raidHost.redrawFruitOptions then raidHost.redrawFruitOptions()end
 end)
 raidHost.storageRequest=thread;raidHost.storedAt=now+6
 raidHost.storageTimer=task.delay(8,function()
  if raidHost.generation==generation and raidHost.storageRequest==thread then
   raidHost.storageTimer=nil;task.cancel(thread);raidHost.storageRequest=nil;raidHost.storedReliable=false;raidHost.storedAt=os.clock()+8
   raidHost.storageIssue="Storage read timed out; native inventory will be checked"
   if raidHost.redrawFruitOptions then raidHost.redrawFruitOptions()end
  end
 end)
end
function raidHost.fruitOptions()
 local options,seen={},{}
 local function add(name,count,source)
  local key=raidHost.fruitKey(name)
  if key~=""and not seen[key]then seen[key]=true;table.insert(options,{name=name,label=raidHost.fruitLabel(name),count=count,source=source})end
 end
 local fruits=raidHost.toolList(localPlayer.Character)
 for _,tool in ipairs(fruits)do add(tool.Name,1,"Backpack")end
 for _,item in ipairs(raidHost.storedItems or{})do add(item.Name,tonumber(item.Count)or 1,"Storage")end
 if not raidHost.storedReliable then
  for _,item in pairs(fruitEsp.catalog)do add(item.name,nil,"Check storage")end
 end
 table.sort(options,function(a,b)
  if(a.count~=nil)~=(b.count~=nil)then return a.count~=nil end
  return a.label:lower()<b.label:lower()
 end)
 return options
end
function raidHost.storageRoot(object)
 local current=object
 for _=1,12 do
  if not current or current==playerGui then break end
  local key=Core.styleKey(current.Name)
  if current:IsA("GuiObject")and not current:IsA("GuiButton")and not current:IsA("TextLabel")
   and(key=="items"or key=="inventory"or key=="storage"or key=="inventoryframe"or key=="iteminventory")then return current end
  current=current.Parent
 end
end
function raidHost.widgetKey(object)
 local value=object:IsA("TextButton")and object.Text or ""
 if value==""then
  local child=object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel",true);value=child and child.Text or object.Name
 end
 return Core.styleKey(value)
end
function raidHost.storageButton(object,root)
 local current=object
 for _=1,4 do
  if not current or current==root then break end
  if current:IsA("GuiButton")then return current end
  if current==object.Parent and not current:IsA("ScrollingFrame")then
   local candidate,count=nil,0
   for _,child in ipairs(current:GetChildren())do if child:IsA("GuiButton")then candidate=child;count=count+1 end end
   if count==1 then return candidate end
  end
  current=current.Parent
 end
 if object:IsA("GuiObject")then return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton",true)end
end
function raidHost.storageSelection(button,widgets,root)
 local parent=button.Parent
 for _=1,5 do
  if not parent then break end
  if raidHost.sameFruit(parent.Name,raidHost.fruitName)then return true end
  for _,widget in ipairs(widgets)do
   if widget.Parent and widget:IsDescendantOf(parent)and(parent~=root or widget.Parent==root)and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
    local role=Core.styleKey(widget.Name)
    if(role=="title"or role=="itemname"or role=="fruitname"or role=="itemtitle"or role=="name")
     and(widget:IsA("TextLabel")or widget:IsA("TextButton"))and raidHost.sameFruit(widget.Text,raidHost.fruitName)then return true end
   end
  end
  if parent==root then break end
  parent=parent.Parent
 end
 return false
end
function raidHost.scrollStorage(button,root)
 local parent=button.Parent
 while parent and parent~=root do
  if parent:IsA("ScrollingFrame")then
   local p,size=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize;local origin,viewport=parent.AbsolutePosition,parent.AbsoluteSize
   if p.Y<origin.Y+2 or p.Y+size.Y>origin.Y+viewport.Y-2 then
    local offset=parent.CanvasPosition
    local y=math.clamp(offset.Y+p.Y-origin.Y-viewport.Y*.5,0,math.max(0,parent.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-viewport.Y))
    parent.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(offset.X,y);return true
   end
  end
  parent=parent.Parent
 end
 return false
end
function raidHost.clickWidget(button,now,root)
 if root and raidHost.scrollStorage(button,root)then return false end
 local p,size=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize
 return raidHost.click(Vector2.new(p.X+size.X/2,p.Y+size.Y/2),now)
end
function raidHost.findStorage(widgets)
 local root,opener,menu
 for _,object in ipairs(widgets)do
  if object.Parent and progressFarm.visible(object)then
   root=root or raidHost.storageRoot(object)
   if object:IsA("GuiButton")then
    local key=raidHost.widgetKey(object);local name=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
    if key=="items"or key=="inventory"or name=="itemsbutton"or name=="inventorybutton"then opener=object end
    if key=="menu"or name=="menubutton"then menu=object end
   end
  end
 end
 return root,opener,menu
end
function raidHost.withdrawStored(character,now)
 raidHost.moving=false;stopHover();restoreCollisions();raidHost.readStored(now)
 if raidHost.withdrawDirect(now)then return end
 if raidHost.withdrawSentAt then raidHost.note("Waiting for physical "..raidHost.fruitLabel(raidHost.fruitName).." in Backpack · no duplicate withdrawal");return end
 local widgets=raidHost.hudSnapshot(os.clock())
 if raidHost.uiJob and not raidHost.uiWidgets then raidHost.note("Reading native inventory…");return end
 local root,opener,menu=raidHost.findStorage(widgets)
 if not root then
  if opener or menu then raidHost.clickWidget(opener or menu,now)end
  raidHost.note("Opening game inventory to withdraw "..raidHost.fruitLabel(raidHost.fruitName));return
 end
 raidHost.withdrawing=true
 local target,unstore,filter
 for _,object in ipairs(widgets)do
  if object.Parent and object:IsDescendantOf(root)and progressFarm.visible(object)then
   if object:IsA("GuiButton")then
    local key=raidHost.widgetKey(object)
    if key=="unstore"or key=="withdraw"or key=="retrieve"or key=="takeout"or key=="извлечь"or key=="достать"then
     if raidHost.storageSelection(object,widgets,root)then unstore=object end
    elseif key=="bloxfruits"or key=="fruits"or key=="bloxfruit"then filter=object end
   end
   local name=(object:IsA("TextLabel")or object:IsA("TextButton"))and object.Text or object.Name
   if raidHost.sameFruit(name,raidHost.fruitName)then target=target or raidHost.storageButton(object,root)end
  end
 end
 if unstore then
  if raidHost.clickWidget(unstore,now,root)then raidHost.withdrawSentAt=now;raidHost.storedAt=0 end
  raidHost.note("Withdrawing selected "..raidHost.fruitLabel(raidHost.fruitName).." · waiting for actual Tool");return
 end
 if filter and not raidHost.storageFiltered then
  if raidHost.clickWidget(filter,now,root)then raidHost.storageFiltered=true end
  return
 end
 if target then raidHost.clickWidget(target,now,root);raidHost.note("Selecting stored "..raidHost.fruitLabel(raidHost.fruitName));return end
 raidHost.note("Waiting for selected "..raidHost.fruitLabel(raidHost.fruitName).." in game inventory · other fruits are not withdrawn")
end
function raidHost.closeStorage(now)
 if not raidHost.withdrawing then return true end
 local widgets=raidHost.hudSnapshot(os.clock())
 if raidHost.uiJob and not raidHost.uiWidgets then return false end
 local root,opener=raidHost.findStorage(widgets)
 if not root then raidHost.withdrawing=false;return true end
 for _,object in ipairs(widgets)do
  if object.Parent and object:IsA("GuiButton")and object:IsDescendantOf(root)and progressFarm.visible(object)then
   local key=raidHost.widgetKey(object);local name=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
   if key=="close"or key=="exit"or key=="×"or name=="close"or name=="closebutton"then raidHost.clickWidget(object,now,root);return false end
  end
 end
 if opener then raidHost.clickWidget(opener,now)end
 raidHost.note("Closing game inventory before chip exchange");return false
end

function raidHost.paymentTool(character)
 local fruits=raidHost.toolList(character)
 if raidHost.payment=="Fruit"then
  if not raidHost.fruitName then return nil,"Choose a fruit from Storage / Backpack below"end
  local selected
  for _,tool in ipairs(fruits)do
   if not raidHost.sameFruit(tool.Name,raidHost.fruitName)then return nil,"Store other physical fruits first; only the selected fruit may be exchanged"end
   selected=tool
  end
  if not selected then return nil,"Extracting selected "..raidHost.fruitLabel(raidHost.fruitName).." from storage","withdraw"end
  if #fruits~=1 then return nil,"Keep exactly one selected physical fruit for this exchange"end
  return selected
 end
 if #fruits>0 then return nil,"Beli only: store physical fruits first so the NPC cannot exchange them"end
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local beli=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
 if not beli or(tonumber(beli.Value)or 0)<100000 then return nil,"Waiting for 100,000 Beli for a normal raid chip"end
 return true
end

function raidHost.point(body)
 if body:IsA("BasePart")then return body.Position end
 if body:IsA("Attachment")then return body.WorldPosition end
 local part=raidCombat.body(body);return part and part.Position
end
function raidHost.interact(object,body,now)
 if now<(raidHost.clickAt or 0)then return false end
 if object and object:IsA("ClickDetector")then
  local character=localPlayer.Character;local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local position=body and raidHost.point(body)
  if root and position and(root.Position-position).Magnitude<=math.min(12,tonumber(object.MaxActivationDistance)or 12)then
   local ok,environment=pcall(function()return type(getgenv)=="function"and getgenv()or _G end)
   local activate=ok and environment and environment.fireclickdetector
   if type(activate)=="function"and pcall(activate,object)then raidHost.clickAt=now+3;raidHost.note("Raid start button activated · waiting for raid timer");return true end
  end
 end
 if object and object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")and object.Enabled then
  raidHost.prompt=object;raidHost.promptUntil=now+object.HoldDuration+.1
  object:InputHoldBegin();raidHost.clickAt=raidHost.promptUntil+1.25;return true
 end
 local position=body and raidHost.point(body);local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 if not position or not camera then return end
 -- Camera aiming is required for native clicks on a 3D NPC / button.
 if not raidHost.camera then raidHost.camera={camera=camera,frame=camera.CFrame,kind=camera.CameraType}end
 if Enum.CameraType then camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
 camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(position+Vector3.new(0,2,6),position)
 local point,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(position)
 if visible and point.Z>0 and raidHost.click(Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y),now)then return true end
 raidHost.restoreCamera()
 return false
end
function raidHost.travel(character,root,position,message)
 raidHost.moving=position~=nil
 if not position then raidHost.note(message.." · waiting for map streaming");return false end
 disableCollisions(character);raidHost.route(root,position,nil)
 raidHost.note(message)
 return(root.Position-position).Magnitude<7
end
function raidHost.waypoint(sea,name)
 for _,row in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[sea]or{})do if row[1]==name then return Vector3.new(row[2][1],row[2][2],row[2][3])end end
end

function raidHost.dialogButtons()
 local widgets=raidHost.hudSnapshot(os.clock());local dialogue
 if raidHost.uiJob and not raidHost.uiWidgets then return {}end
 for _,widget in ipairs(widgets)do
  if(widget:IsA("TextLabel")or widget:IsA("TextButton"))and progressFarm.visible(widget)
   and Core.styleKey(widget.Text)=="mysteriousscientist"then
   local parent=widget.Parent
   for _=1,4 do
    if not parent or parent==playerGui or parent:IsA("ScreenGui")then break end
    dialogue=parent
    if Core.styleKey(parent.Name):find("dialog",1,true)then break end
    parent=parent.Parent
   end
   break
  end
 end
 if not dialogue then return nil end
 local buttons={}
 for _,widget in ipairs(widgets)do
  if widget.Parent and widget:IsA("GuiButton")and widget:IsDescendantOf(dialogue)and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
   local value=widget:IsA("TextButton")and widget.Text or ""
   if value==""then local label=widget:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel",true);value=label and label.Text or ""end
   table.insert(buttons,{button=widget,key=Core.styleKey(Core.normalizeName(value))})
  elseif widget.Parent and progressFarm.visible(widget)and widget:IsDescendantOf(dialogue)and(widget:IsA("TextLabel")or widget:IsA("TextButton"))then
   local key=Core.styleKey(widget.Text)
   if key:find("comebacklater",1,true)or key:find("wait",1,true)and(key:find("hour",1,true)or key:find("minute",1,true))
    or key:find("cooldown",1,true)and(key:find("remaining",1,true)or key:find("active",1,true))then
    raidHost.retryAt=os.clock()+30;raidHost.note("NPC purchase cooldown · retrying in 30 seconds");return {}
   end
  end
 end
 return buttons
end

function raidHost.discover(now)
 if raidHost.scanJob or now<(raidHost.scanAt or 0)then return end
 raidHost.scanAt=now+3;local generation=raidHost.generation;local controls={}
 raidHost.scanJob=perf.walk(workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")or workspace,function(object)
  if object:IsA("Model")and object:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then return false end
  if not(object:IsA("ClickDetector")or object:IsA("ProximityPrompt"))then return end
  local parent=object.Parent;local body=parent;local raid=false;local priority=0
  for _=1,7 do
   if not parent or parent==workspace then break end
   local key=Core.styleKey(parent.Name)
   if key:find("raidsummon",1,true)or key=="raidstart"or key=="raidbutton"then raid=true;if key=="raidsummon2"then priority=2 end end
   if not body or not(body:IsA("BasePart")or body:IsA("Attachment"))then
    if parent:IsA("BasePart")or parent:IsA("Attachment")then body=parent end
   end
   parent=parent.Parent
  end
  if raid and body and raidHost.point(body)then table.insert(controls,{object=object,body=body,priority=priority})end
 end,function()return state.raid and not disposed and raidHost.generation==generation end,function()
  if raidHost.generation==generation then raidHost.scanJob=nil;raidHost.controls=controls end
 end)
end
function raidHost.route(root,destination,mob)
 local now=os.clock()
 local changed=raidHost.routeRoot~=root or raidHost.routeMob~=mob or not raidHost.routeGoal
  or(raidHost.routeGoal-destination).Magnitude>32
 if changed then
  raidHost.routeRoot=root;raidHost.routeMob=mob;raidHost.routeGoal=destination
  raidHost.routeAnchor=root.Position;raidHost.routeAt=now;raidHost.routeDistance=(root.Position-destination).Magnitude
  raidHost.routeNoProgressAt=now
  raidHost.routeEscape=nil;raidHost.routeEscapeUntil=0;raidHost.routeAttempts=0
 end
 raidHost.routeGoal=destination
 local distance=(root.Position-destination).Magnitude
 if root.Anchored then raidHost.note("Waiting for the game to release character movement");return end
 if raidHost.routeEscape and now<(raidHost.routeEscapeUntil or 0)then
  holdPosition(root,raidHost.routeEscape,nil);return
 end
 if distance<=8 then
  raidHost.routeAnchor=root.Position;raidHost.routeAt=now;raidHost.routeDistance=distance;raidHost.routeEscape=nil;raidHost.routeNoProgressAt=now
 elseif now-(raidHost.routeAt or now)>=1.5 then
  local moved=(root.Position-raidHost.routeAnchor).Magnitude
  local progress=(raidHost.routeDistance or distance)-distance
  if progress>=1 then raidHost.routeNoProgressAt=now end
  if moved<2 and progress<1 or now-(raidHost.routeNoProgressAt or now)>=3 then
   raidHost.routeAttempts=(raidHost.routeAttempts or 0)+1
   local side=raidHost.routeAttempts%2==0 and -1 or 1
   raidHost.routeEscape=root.Position+Vector3.new(side*20,28+(raidHost.routeAttempts%3)*10,-side*16)
   raidHost.routeEscapeUntil=now+.85
   stopMovement();stopHover()
   local character=localPlayer.Character
   if character then disableCollisions(character)end
   holdPosition(root,raidHost.routeEscape,nil)
   raidHost.routeAnchor=root.Position;raidHost.routeAt=now;raidHost.routeDistance=distance
   raidHost.routeNoProgressAt=now
   raidHost.note("Route recovery · moving above / around the obstruction");return
  end
  raidHost.routeAnchor=root.Position;raidHost.routeAt=now;raidHost.routeDistance=distance
 end
 holdPosition(root,destination,mob)
end

function raidHost.hudSnapshot(now)
 if not raidHost.uiJob and now>=(raidHost.uiAt or 0)then
  raidHost.uiAt=now+.75
  local generation=raidHost.generation;local widgets={}
  raidHost.uiJob=perf.walk(playerGui,function(object)
   if object==gui then return false end
   if object:IsA("GuiObject")and not object.Visible or object:IsA("ScreenGui")and not object.Enabled then return false end
   local key=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
   if key=="chat"or key=="experiencechat"or key=="bubblechat"or key=="playerlist"then return false end
   if object~=playerGui then table.insert(widgets,object)end
  end,function()return not disposed and state.raid and raidHost.generation==generation end,function()
   if raidHost.generation==generation then raidHost.uiJob=nil;raidHost.uiWidgets=widgets end
  end)
 end
 return raidHost.uiWidgets or{}
end
function raidHost.click(point,now)
 if raidHost.mouse or now<(raidHost.clickAt or 0)or not combatAssist.inputReady()or progressFarm.islandInputBusy()then return false end
 local generation=raidHost.generation
 if progressFarm.islandSavedGUI==nil then progressFarm.islandSavedGUI=gui.Enabled end
 gui.Enabled=false;progressFarm.islandInputUntil=os.clock()+.4
 task.wait(.05)
 if disposed or not state.raid or raidHost.generation~=generation or not combatAssist.inputReady()then progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI(disposed);return false end
 initializeInput()
 for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
  if pcall(backend.aim,point)then
   raidHost.mouse={backend=backend,point=point,untilTime=os.clock()+.1}
   if pcall(backend.mouse,true,point)then raidHost.clickAt=os.clock()+1.5;return true end
   pcall(backend.mouse,false,point);raidHost.mouse=nil
  end
 end
 progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI(disposed);return false
end
function raidHost.restoreGUI()
 if raidHost.restoreCamera then raidHost.restoreCamera()end
 progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI(disposed)
end
function raidHost.scientist()
 local now=os.clock()
 if now<(raidHost.npcAt or 0)and raidHost.npc and raidHost.npc.Parent and raidHost.npcBody and raidHost.npcBody.Parent then return raidHost.npc,raidHost.npcBody end
 raidHost.npcAt=now+1.5
 local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
 for _,npc in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren()or{})do
  local key=Core.styleKey(npc.Name)
  if key:find("mysteriousscientist",1,true)or key=="raidsnpc"then
   local body=raidCombat.body(npc)or npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
   if body then raidHost.npc=npc;raidHost.npcBody=body;return npc,body end
  end
 end
 raidHost.npc=nil;raidHost.npcBody=nil
end
function raidHost.chooseDialog(buttons,now)
 if now<(raidHost.choiceAt or 0)then return end
 local payment=raidHost.paymentTool(localPlayer.Character)
 if not payment then raidHost.note("Payment no longer ready · checking selected fruit / Beli");return end
 if raidHost.payment=="Fruit"and payment.Parent~=localPlayer.Character then raidHost.note("Equip selected fruit before exchange");return end
 local selected=Core.styleKey(raidHost.kind);local button,key
 for _,entry in ipairs(buttons)do
  if entry.key==selected then button=entry.button;key=entry.key;break end
 end
 if not button then
  local navigation={normal=true,normalraids=true,basic=true,basicraids=true,regular=true,raids=true,talk=true,next=true,continue=true,
   buyachip=true,buyamicrochip=true,buyaspecialmicrochip=true,microchip=true,specialmicrochip=true,selectaraid=true,buy=true,purchase=true}
  for _,entry in ipairs(buttons)do
   local exchange=raidHost.payment=="Fruit"and(entry.key=="trade"or entry.key=="exchange"or entry.key=="fruit"or entry.key=="tradeafruit"or entry.key=="exchangefruit")
   local money=raidHost.payment=="Beli"and(entry.key=="money"or entry.key=="beli")
   if navigation[entry.key]or exchange or money or entry.key=="yes"or entry.key=="confirm"then button=entry.button;key=entry.key;break end
  end
 end
 if not button then raidHost.note("Scientist dialogue: waiting for normal raid / chip / "..raidHost.kind.." choice");return end
 local p,size=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local amount=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
 local beforeBeli=amount and tonumber(amount.Value)
 if raidHost.click(Vector2.new(p.X+size.X/2,p.Y+size.Y/2),now)then
  raidHost.choiceAt=now+1.5;raidHost.uiAt=0
  if key==selected or key=="yes"or key=="confirm"then
   if raidHost.payment=="Fruit"then raidHost.pendingFruit=payment
   else raidHost.pendingBeli=raidHost.pendingBeli or beforeBeli end
  end
  if key==selected then raidHost.transactionUntil=now+2
  elseif key=="yes"or key=="confirm"then raidHost.transactionUntil=now+8 end
  raidHost.note("Scientist · "..key.." · waiting for server response / actual chip")
 end
end

-- Bounded, asynchronous access to the game's own existing command endpoint.
Core.gameCalls={}
function Core.gameCall(key,command,args,valid,callback,delay)
 local now=os.clock();local old=Core.gameCalls[key]
 if old and(old.thread or now<old.untilTime)then return false end
 local folder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes");local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")or not valid()then return false end
 local job={untilTime=now+(delay or 6)};Core.gameCalls[key]=job
 job.thread=task.defer(function()
  if disposed or not valid()then job.thread=nil;return end
  local ok,result=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer(command,table.unpack(args))end)
  job.thread=nil
  if job.timer then task.cancel(job.timer);job.timer=nil end
  if not disposed and valid()then callback(ok,result)end
 end)
 job.timer=task.delay(8,function()
  job.timer=nil
  if job.thread then task.cancel(job.thread);job.thread=nil;job.untilTime=os.clock()+5
   if not disposed and valid()then callback(false,"Server request timed out")end
  end
 end)
 return true
end
function Core.cancelGameCall(key)
 local job=Core.gameCalls[key]
 if job then
  if job.thread then task.cancel(job.thread)end
  if job.timer then task.cancel(job.timer)end
  Core.gameCalls[key]=nil
 end
end
function raidHost.exchange(now,payment)
 local generation=raidHost.generation;local character=localPlayer.Character
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local amount=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
 local before=amount and tonumber(amount.Value)
 local accepted=Core.gameCall("raidChip","RaidsNpc",{"Select",raidHost.kind},function()
  return state.raid and raidHost.generation==generation and localPlayer.Character==character
 end,function(ok,result)
  raidHost.transactionUntil=os.clock()+(ok and 5 or 1)
  raidHost.note(ok and("Chip request sent · waiting for Special Microchip · "..tostring(result))or("Chip request failed: "..tostring(result)))
 end,8)
 if accepted then
  if raidHost.payment=="Fruit"then raidHost.pendingFruit=payment else raidHost.pendingBeli=before end
  raidHost.transactionUntil=now+8;raidHost.note("Requesting "..raidHost.kind.." chip · "..raidHost.payment)
 end
 return accepted
end
function raidHost.withdrawDirect(now)
 if raidHost.withdrawSentAt then return true end
 local name=raidHost.fruitName
 if not name then return false end
 for _,row in ipairs(raidHost.storedItems or{})do
  if raidHost.sameFruit(row.Name,name)then name=row.Name;break end
 end
 -- Internal fruit IDs come from actual storage, or the selected canonical ID.
 if not name:find("-",1,true)then return false end
 local generation=raidHost.generation;local selected=raidHost.fruitName
 local accepted=Core.gameCall("raidFruit","LoadFruit",{name},function()
  return state.raid and raidHost.generation==generation and raidHost.fruitName==selected
 end,function(ok,result)
  if not ok then raidHost.withdrawSentAt=nil;raidHost.note("Fruit withdrawal failed: "..tostring(result))
  else raidHost.note("Selected fruit requested · waiting for real Backpack Tool")end
 end,10)
 if accepted then raidHost.withdrawSentAt=now;raidHost.note("Withdrawing selected "..name.." from storage")end
 return accepted
end
function progressFarm.islandBuyDirect(root,now)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if now<(m.directAt or 0)then return end
 m.directAt=now+.5
 local money=progressFarm.islandMoney()
 if m.intent and m.intent.sent then
  if money and m.intent.before-money>=5000 then progressFarm.note("Boat paid for · waiting for your boat to replicate");return end
  if now<(m.intent.at or now)+12 then progressFarm.note("Boat purchase requested · waiting for your boat");return end
  m.intent=nil;progressFarm.islandPendingPurchase=nil
 end
 if not money or money<5000 then progressFarm.note("Auto Island · need $5,000 Beli");return end
 local npc,body=m.dealerNPC,m.dealerBody
 if not body or not body.Parent or now>=(m.npcAt or 0)then
  m.npcAt=now+2;local nearest=math.huge
  local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
  for _,candidate in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren()or{})do
   if Core.styleKey(candidate.Name):find("boatdealer",1,true)then
    local part=raidCombat.body(candidate)
    if part and(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<nearest then npc=candidate;body=part;nearest=(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude end
   end
  end
  m.dealerNPC=npc;m.dealerBody=body
 end
 if not body then
  local position=state.events and eventFarm.position({island=eventFarm.sea==3 and "Tiki Outpost"or "Cold Side"})or progressFarm.island("Tiki Outpost")
  holdPosition(root,position or root.Position,nil,150);return
 end
 if(root.Position-body.Position).Magnitude>8 then progressFarm.travel(root,body.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,4),"Flying to Boat Dealer");return end
 stopHover();stopMovement()
 local choices={"Guardian","Lantern","Beast Hunter"};local name=choices[(m.directIndex or 0)%#choices+1]
 local intent={name=name,key=Core.styleKey(name),before=money,known={},at=now,sent=true}
 local boats=workspace:FindFirstChild("Boats")
 for _,boat in ipairs(boats and boats:GetChildren()or{})do intent.known[boat]=true end
 local generation=progressFarm.generation
 if Core.gameCall("islandBoat","BuyBoat",{name},function()
  return Core.boatAutomationActive()and progressFarm.mirage==m and progressFarm.generation==generation
 end,function(ok,result)
  progressFarm.note(ok and("Boat request: "..name.." · waiting for owned boat · "..tostring(result))or("Boat purchase failed: "..tostring(result)))
 end,12)then
  m.intent=intent;progressFarm.islandPendingPurchase=intent;m.directIndex=(m.directIndex or 0)+1
 end
end
-- Choose once per departure. A boat is always checked before this route runs.
function progressFarm.islandRoute(position,tiki,portal)
 if portal and portal.Parent and(portal.Position-position).Magnitude<(tiki-position).Magnitude then return "portal"end
 return "direct"
end
function progressFarm.islandDirect(root,tiki)
 if(root.Position-tiki).Magnitude>300 then
  progressFarm.travel(root,tiki+Vector3.new(0,12,0),"Flying directly to Tiki Outpost · Boat Dealer")
  return true
 end
 return false
end

function progressFarm.islandPortal(root,now)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if not m or m.driving then return false end
 if m.portalEntry and(root.Position-m.portalEntry).Magnitude>200 then m.portalComplete=true;m.portalUntil=nil;m.route="direct" end
 local tiki=progressFarm.island("Tiki Outpost")
 if not tiki then progressFarm.note("Waiting for Tiki waypoint");return true end
 if m.route=="direct"or m.portalComplete then return progressFarm.islandDirect(root,tiki)end
 local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
 if not map then m.route="direct";return progressFarm.islandDirect(root,tiki)end
 if now>=(m.portalAt or 0)then
  m.portalAt=now+3
  if not m.portalJob then
   local generation=progressFarm.generation;local best,score=nil,-math.huge
   m.portalJob=perf.walk(map,function(part)
    if part.Parent==map then
     local key=Core.styleKey(part.Name)
     if not(key:find("tiki",1,true)or key:find("portal",1,true)or key:find("teleport",1,true)or key:find("submerged",1,true))then return false end
    end
    if part:IsA("BasePart")and(part.Position-tiki).Magnitude<1800 then
     local ancestor=part;local named=false
     for _=1,6 do
      if not ancestor or ancestor==map then break end
      local key=Core.styleKey(ancestor.Name)
      if key:find("portal",1,true)or key:find("teleport",1,true)or key:find("submerged",1,true)or key:find("seaentrance",1,true)then named=true;break end
      ancestor=ancestor.Parent
     end
     if named then
      local key=Core.styleKey(part.Name)
      local rank=part:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")and 10000 or 0
      if key:find("trigger",1,true)or key:find("touch",1,true)or key:find("hitbox",1,true)then rank=rank+5000 end
      rank=rank-(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
      if rank>score then best=part;score=rank end
     end
    end
   end,function()return state.mirage and progressFarm.mirage==m and progressFarm.generation==generation end,function()
    if progressFarm.mirage==m then m.portal=best;m.portalJob=nil;m.portalScanned=true end
   end)
  end
 end
 local portal=m.portal
 if not m.route then
  if not m.portalScanned and m.portalJob then
   m.routeScanStarted=m.routeScanStarted or now
   if now-m.routeScanStarted<1 then stopHover();progressFarm.note("Choosing the nearest Tiki route");return true end
  end
  m.route=progressFarm.islandRoute(root.Position,tiki,portal)
 end
 if m.route=="direct"or not portal or not portal.Parent then
  m.route="direct";return progressFarm.islandDirect(root,tiki)
 end
 if m.portalAttemptAt and now-m.portalAttemptAt>8 then
  m.portalComplete=true;m.route="direct";m.portalUntil=nil
  return progressFarm.islandDirect(root,tiki)
 end
 local destination=portal.Position
 if not m.portalEntry and(root.Position-destination).Magnitude<80 then m.portalEntry=root.Position end
 if(root.Position-destination).Magnitude>5 then progressFarm.travel(root,destination,"Entering island portal");return true end
 -- Portal entry uses native contact, not noclip through its trigger.
 if not m.portalUntil then m.portalUntil=now+3;m.portalEntry=root.Position;m.portalAttemptAt=m.portalAttemptAt or now end
 if now<m.portalUntil then
  stopHover();restoreCollisions(true)
  local human=localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if human then human.Sit=false;human:MoveTo(destination)end
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,0)
  local prompt=portal:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)or portal.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
  if prompt and prompt.Enabled and not progressFarm.prompt and now>=(m.portalPromptAt or 0)then
   if pcall(function()prompt:InputHoldBegin()end)then
    progressFarm.prompt=prompt;progressFarm.promptUntil=now+prompt.HoldDuration+.1;m.portalPromptAt=now+3
   end
  end
  return true
 end
 m.portalUntil=nil;progressFarm.note("Tiki portal: entry not confirmed · retrying native contact");return true
end
function acquisition.destination(controller,row,root)
 local now=os.clock()
 if not controller.spawnHintAt or now>=controller.spawnHintAt or controller.spawnHintName~=row.name then
  controller.spawnHintAt=now+2;controller.spawnHintName=row.name;controller.spawnHint=nil
  local origin=workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
  local folder=origin and origin:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawns")or workspace:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawns")
  local nearest=math.huge
  for _,part in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren()or{})do
   if part:IsA("BasePart")then
    for _,name in ipairs(row.enemies or{})do
     if Core.normalizeName(part.Name)==Core.normalizeName(name)and(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<nearest then
      controller.spawnHint=part.Position;nearest=(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return controller.spawnHint or controller.island(row.island)
end
function acquisition.balance(controller,row)
 if row.price then return controller.money()end
 if row.fragments then
  local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("Fragments")
  return value and tonumber(value.Value)
 end
 if row.route=="ectoplasm"then return acquisition.liveMaterial("Ectoplasm")end
end
function acquisition.retryUncharged(controller,row)
 local pending=controller.pendingBuy
 if not pending or pending.spent or not pending.replied or controller.request or os.clock()-pending.at<15 or pending.balance==nil then return false end
 local balance=acquisition.balance(controller,row)
 if balance==nil or balance~=pending.balance then return false end
 controller.unverifiedBuy=nil;controller.pendingBuy=nil;controller.buyAttempts=0
 controller.note("Purchase was not charged or granted · retrying "..row.name)
 return true
end
function acquisition.awaitingPaid(controller,row)
 local pending=controller.pendingBuy
 if not pending or pending.name~=row.name then return false end
 local balance=acquisition.balance(controller,row)
 if pending.balance and balance and balance<pending.balance then pending.spent=true end
 if not pending.spent then return false end
 acquisition.probe(controller,row,os.clock())
 controller.note("Payment confirmed · waiting for actual "..row.name.." in Backpack / inventory")
 return true
end

function raidHost.prepare(now)
 if disposed or not state.raid then return end
 local character,human,root=combatAssist.localBody()
 if not character then raidHost.moving=false;raidHost.note("Waiting for your character / respawn");return end
 if raidHost.character~=character then raidHost.reset();raidHost.character=character end
 if raidHost.wasActive then
  raidHost.wasActive=false;raidHost.retryAt=now+8;raidHost.transactionUntil=0;raidHost.awaitStart=0
  raidHost.withdrawSentAt=nil;raidHost.withdrawing=false;raidHost.storageFiltered=false;raidHost.storedAt=0
  raidHost.note("Raid ended · preparing the next chip");return
 end
 if now<(raidHost.retryAt or 0)or now<(raidHost.nextAt or 0)then return end
 raidHost.nextAt=now+.2
 local sea=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
 if sea~=2 and sea~=3 then raidHost.note("Raids require the Second or Third Sea");return end
 local fruits,chip=raidHost.toolList(character)
 if not chip then
  if now<(raidHost.awaitStart or 0)then raidHost.note("Chip consumed · waiting for the raid timer");return end
  if now<(raidHost.transactionUntil or 0)then raidHost.note("Waiting for the actual Special Microchip");return end
  local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local level=data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
  if not level or(tonumber(level.Value)or 0)<1100 then raidHost.note("Level 1100 is required to host a normal raid");return end
  if raidHost.pendingFruit and not raidHost.pendingFruit.Parent then raidHost.note("Fruit removed / exchanged · waiting for actual chip; no second fruit consumed");return end
  local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local money=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
  if raidHost.pendingBeli and money and raidHost.pendingBeli-(tonumber(money.Value)or raidHost.pendingBeli)>=100000 then raidHost.note("Beli paid · waiting for actual chip; no duplicate purchase");return end
  local payment,reason,action=raidHost.paymentTool(character)
  if not payment then
   if action=="withdraw"then raidHost.withdrawStored(character,now)
   else raidHost.moving=false;stopHover();restoreCollisions();raidHost.note(reason)end
   return
  end
  if not raidHost.closeStorage(now)then return end
  if raidHost.payment=="Fruit"then if payment.Parent~=character then human:EquipTool(payment);return end
  else human:UnequipTools()end
  local npc,body=raidHost.scientist()
  if not body then raidHost.travel(character,root,raidHost.waypoint(sea,sea==2 and "Cold Side"or "Castle on the Sea"),"Flying to the raid laboratory / Mysterious Scientist");return end
  if(root.Position-(body.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,4))).Magnitude>3 then raidHost.atScientist=false;raidHost.travel(character,root,body.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,4),"Flying to Mysterious Scientist · "..raidHost.kind);return end
  if not raidHost.atScientist then stopHover();stopMovement();raidHost.atScientist=true end
  raidHost.moving=false
  if raidHost.exchange(now,payment)then return end
  local buttons=raidHost.dialogButtons()
  if now<(raidHost.retryAt or 0)then return end
  if buttons then raidHost.chooseDialog(buttons,now)
  else raidHost.interact(npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true),body,now)end
  return
 end
 human:UnequipTools();raidHost.pendingFruit=nil;raidHost.pendingBeli=nil;raidHost.transactionUntil=0;raidHost.discover(now)
 local nearest,distance
 for _,entry in ipairs(raidHost.controls or{})do
  if entry.object.Parent and entry.body.Parent then
   local point=raidHost.point(entry.body);local delta=point and(point-root.Position).Magnitude
   if delta and(not nearest or(entry.priority or 0)>(nearest.priority or 0)or(entry.priority or 0)==(nearest.priority or 0)and delta<distance)then nearest=entry;distance=delta end
  end
 end
 if not nearest then raidHost.travel(character,root,raidHost.waypoint(sea,sea==2 and "Cold Side"or "Castle on the Sea"),"Chip ready · finding the native raid start button");return end
 local point=raidHost.point(nearest.body)
 if not raidHost.travel(character,root,point+Vector3.new(0,2,3),"Chip ready · flying to the raid start button")then return end
 if now<(raidHost.awaitStart or 0)then raidHost.note("Waiting for raid transport / timer");return end
 if raidHost.interact(nearest.object,nearest.body,now)then raidHost.awaitStart=now+15 end
end

local function raidStep()
    local active,timerSource=raidActive()
    if active then raidHost.wasActive=true;raidHost.moving=false;raidHost.releaseInput()end
    if not active then
        if raidRunning then
            deactivateWeapon();cancelAuraRequest();auraRequestedCharacter=nil
        end
        dodge.reset();raidRunning=false
        releaseNativeClick()
        if not raidHost.moving then stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()end
        raidIndex,raidMarker,raidEmptyAt=0,nil,nil;combatProbe=nil;raidMarkersAt=-math.huge
        if raidIslandLabel and raidIslandLabel.Text~="Waiting"then raidIslandLabel.Text="Waiting"end
        raidHost.prepare(os.clock());return
    end
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root then
        dodge.reset();raidRunning=false
        releaseNativeClick();combatProbe=nil;stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
        status("Auto Raid: waiting for your character…");return
    end
    local now=os.clock()
    local markers=raidMarkers(root,now)
    if raidIndex==0 then
        local nearest=math.huge
        for index,part in pairs(markers)do
            if part.Parent and (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<nearest then
                raidIndex,raidMarker,nearest=index,part,(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
            end
        end
    else raidMarker=markers[raidIndex]end
    if not raidMarker or not raidMarker.Parent then
        dodge.reset();raidRunning=false
        releaseNativeClick();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions();raidEmptyAt=nil
        status("Auto Raid: timer found · waiting for island "..(raidIndex>0 and tostring(raidIndex)or "markers").." in _WorldOrigin.Locations.");return
    end
    if raidIslandLabel and raidIslandLabel.Text~=tostring(raidIndex).." / 5"then raidIslandLabel.Text=tostring(raidIndex).." / 5"end
    raidRunning=true;disableCollisions(character);ensureAura(character)
    local weapon,equipStatus
    local list=candidates(root)
    if not list then stopRaid("Auto Raid: workspace.Enemies not found.");return end
    local nearby,scout={},{}
    local playerCharacters={}
    for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do if player.Character then playerCharacters[player.Character]=true end end
    for _,candidate in ipairs(list)do
        if raidCombat.npcModel(candidate.model)and candidate.part:IsDescendantOf(candidate.model)and not playerCharacters[candidate.model] and candidate.health>0 then
            -- Assign each NPC to its nearest published raid island, excluding world enemies.
            local owner,nearest=0,CONFIG.RaidIslandRadius
            for index,part in pairs(markers)do
                if part.Parent then
                    local distance=(candidate.part.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance<nearest then owner,nearest=index,distance end
                end
            end
            if owner==raidIndex then
                table.insert(scout,candidate)
                if candidate.distance<=CONFIG.RaidRadius then table.insert(nearby,candidate)end
            end
        end
    end
    local evading,reason=dodge.step(humanoid,root,scout,now)
    if evading then status("Auto Raid: side dodge · "..reason);return end
    local target=fruit.chooseTarget(nearby,nil)
    local attackMode=fruit.mode(target)
    weapon,equipStatus=prepareFirstSlot(character,humanoid,now,attackMode)
    if not weapon then dodge.reset();releaseNativeClick();raidHost.route(root,root.Position,nil);status(equipStatus);return end
    if not target then
        releaseNativeClick();combatProbe=nil
        local distant=Core.nearestTarget(scout,nil)
        if distant then
            raidEmptyAt=nil;raidHost.route(root,distant.part.Position+Vector3.new(CONFIG.RaidSideOffset,CONFIG.RaidHeight,0),nil)
            status("Auto Raid: approaching NPC · island "..raidIndex);return
        end
        local position=raidMarker.Position+Vector3.new(0,CONFIG.RaidHeight,0)
        raidHost.route(root,position,nil)
        if (root.Position-position).Magnitude>CONFIG.PositionTolerance then raidEmptyAt=nil;status("Auto Raid: flying to island "..raidIndex);return end
        raidEmptyAt=raidEmptyAt or now
        local nextMarker=markers[raidIndex+1]
        if now-raidEmptyAt>=CONFIG.RaidClearWait and nextMarker and nextMarker.Parent then
            raidIndex+=1;raidMarker=nextMarker;raidEmptyAt=nil
            raidHost.route(root,nextMarker.Position+Vector3.new(0,CONFIG.RaidHeight,0),nil)
            status("Auto Raid: flying to island "..raidIndex)
        else status("Auto Raid: island "..raidIndex.." clear · waiting for "..(raidIndex==5 and "raid completion"or "next island"))end
        return
    end
    raidEmptyAt=nil
    local height=attackMode=="Fruit"and fruit.attackHeight(weapon,CONFIG.RaidHeight)or CONFIG.RaidHeight
    local position=target.part.Position+Vector3.new(CONFIG.RaidSideOffset,height,0)
    if attackMode~="Fruit"then
        combatProbe=Core.updateFixedCombatProbe(combatProbe,weapon,target.model,target.health,now)
    end
    raidHost.route(root,position,target.model)
    if now-lastAttack<RAID_ATTACK_INTERVAL-1e-6 then return end
    if not raidActive()or not state.raid or weapon.Parent~=character or weapon.Enabled==false then releaseNativeClick();return end
    local facing=Vector3.new(target.part.Position.X,root.Position.Y,target.part.Position.Z)
    if (facing-root.Position).Magnitude>.01 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,facing)end
    lastAttack=now
    if attackMode=="Fruit"then status("Auto Raid: "..raidCombat.fruitAttack(weapon,target,root,markers,now,CONFIG.WeaponType~="Fruit"));return end
    local backend,reason=raidCombat.attack(weapon,scout,root,markers,combatProbe.mode,now)
    if backend then
        Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)
        status("Auto Raid: "..target.name.." · HP "..math.ceil(target.health).." · "..backend.." · Height "..height)
    else status(reason or "Auto Raid: attack unavailable.")end
end
-- Elite Hunter uses the shared flight/combat controller, with its own quest requests.
do
    elite.aliases={deandre="Deandre",deadre="Deandre",diablo="Diablo",urban="Urban"}
    function elite.name(value)
        return type(value)=="string" and elite.aliases[Core.normalizeName(value)] or nil
    end
    function elite.objective(title)
        if type(title)~="string" then return nil end
        for alias,name in pairs(elite.aliases)do
            if Core.questMatches(title,alias)then return name end
        end
    end
    function elite.readQuest()
        local visible,title,complete,source=questUI()
        -- Elite objectives may omit the number before the enemy name.
        local function read(label)
            if not isTextWidget(label) or not widgetVisible(label) or not elite.objective(label.Text)then return nil end
            local plain=Core.normalizeName(label.Text)
            if not plain:find("defeat",1,true) and not plain:find("kill",1,true)then return nil end
            local done,total=plain:match("(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)")
            if tonumber(total)==1 then return label.Text,tonumber(done)>=1 end
            local ancestor=label.Parent
            for _=1,3 do
                if not ancestor or ancestor==playerGui or ancestor:IsA("LayerCollector")then break end
                for _,counter in ipairs(ancestor:GetDescendants())do
                    if isTextWidget(counter) and widgetVisible(counter)then
                        local n,max=Core.normalizeName(counter.Text):match("^%s*%(?(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)%)?%s*$")
                        if tonumber(max)==1 then return label.Text,tonumber(n)>=1 end
                    end
                end
                ancestor=ancestor.Parent
            end
        end
        if visible and elite.objective(title)then
            local done,total=Core.normalizeName(title):match("(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)")
            if tonumber(total)==1 then complete=complete or tonumber(done)>=1 end
        end
        if not elite.questScanAt or os.clock()-elite.questScanAt>=.5 then
            elite.questScanAt=os.clock();elite.questLabel=nil
            for _,label in ipairs(perf.hudObjects())do
                local objective,finished=read(label)
                if objective then
                    elite.questLabel=label
                    return true,objective,finished,"elite objective+counter"
                end
            end
        elseif elite.questLabel then
            local objective,finished=read(elite.questLabel)
            if objective then return true,objective,finished,"cached elite objective+counter"end
        end
        return visible,title,complete,source
    end
    function elite.hunterPosition()
        local now=os.clock()
        if elite.hunterAt and now-elite.hunterAt<.5 then
            return elite.hunter or Vector3.new(-5073,315,-3153),elite.hunter~=nil
        end
        elite.hunterAt=now
        local npcs=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
        if npcs then
            for _,npc in ipairs(npcs:GetDescendants())do
                if Core.normalizeName(npc.Name)=="elite hunter"then
                    local part=npc:IsA("BasePart") and npc or npc:IsA("Model") and raidCombat.body(npc)
                    if part then elite.hunter=part.Position;return part.Position,true end
                end
            end
        end
        -- The original script's Castle on the Sea waypoint loads the NPC's area.
        return elite.hunter or Vector3.new(-5073,315,-3153),elite.hunter~=nil
    end
    function elite.clearCombat()
        releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon();fruit.target=nil;combatProbe=nil
        watchedMob,watchedHealth,attackCount=nil,nil,0
        spawnRouteKey,spawnRoutePoints,spawnRouteIndex,spawnArrivedAt=nil,nil,nil,nil
    end
    function elite.returnHome()
        elite.cancelRequest();elite.clearCombat()
        elite.phase="return";elite.target=nil;elite.targetName=nil;elite.searchAt=nil
    end
    function elite.request(command,now)
        if elite.requestThread or now-(elite.lastRequest or -math.huge)<(command=="EliteHunter" and 8 or CONFIG.QuestCooldown)then return end
        local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then elite.stop("Elite Hunter: CommF_ RemoteFunction not found.");return end
        elite.lastRequest=now
        local requestThread
        requestThread=task.defer(function()
            if disposed or not state.elite or SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]~=3 then return end
            local ok,result=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer(command)end)
            if elite.requestThread~=requestThread then return end
            elite.requestThread=nil
            if elite.requestTimer then task.cancel(elite.requestTimer);elite.requestTimer=nil end
            elite.reply=ok and (type(result)=="string" and result:sub(1,100):gsub("%c"," ") or "Waiting for quest confirmation") or "Quest request failed; retrying"
            -- Quest UI, rather than the reply text, confirms the assignment.
            elite.questScanAt=nil
        end)
        elite.requestThread=requestThread
        elite.requestTimer=task.delay(8,function()
            elite.requestTimer=nil
            if elite.requestThread==requestThread then
                task.cancel(requestThread);elite.requestThread=nil;elite.reply="Quest request timed out; retrying"
            end
        end)
    end
    function elite.hint(name,now)
        if elite.hintName==name and now-(elite.hintAt or -math.huge)<1 then return elite.hintPosition end
        elite.hintName=name;elite.hintAt=now;elite.hintPosition=nil
        local function inspect(model)
            if model:IsA("Model") and elite.name(model.Name)==name then
                local body=raidCombat.body(model)
                -- Replicated models are navigation hints only, never attack targets.
                if body and math.abs(body.Position.X)+math.abs(body.Position.Z)>100 then
                    elite.hintPosition=body.Position
                end
            end
        end
        for _,object in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetChildren())do inspect(object)end
        local enemies=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
        if enemies then for _,object in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren())do inspect(object)end end
        return elite.hintPosition
    end
    -- Numeric hotbar input is authoritative; do not infer slot order from Backpack children.
    function elite.equip(character,humanoid,now)
        local mode=elite.weaponType
        local slot=elite.slots[mode]
        local prefix="Elite Hunter: "..mode.." · Slot "..slot.." · "
        local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
        local menuOk,menu=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
        if focusOk and focused or menuOk and menu then releaseNativeClick();return nil,prefix.."finish typing / close the menu"end
        local current=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if elite.equipCharacter~=character or elite.equipMode~=mode
            or elite.equipTool and current and current~=elite.equipTool then
            releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon()
            humanoid:UnequipTools() -- Prevent pressing an already selected number from toggling it off.
            elite.equipCharacter=character;elite.equipMode=mode
            elite.equipTool=nil;elite.equipSent=false;elite.equipAt=-math.huge
            current=nil
        end
        if elite.equipSent and current and (not elite.equipTool or current==elite.equipTool)then
            elite.equipTool=current;slotMode=mode
            return current
        end
        if now-(elite.equipAt or -math.huge)<1 then return nil,prefix.."waiting for the selected weapon…"end
        elite.equipAt=now
        local sent,backend=pressFirstSlot(mode,slot)
        elite.equipSent=sent
        if not sent then return nil,prefix.."number-key input unavailable"end
        return nil,prefix.."selecting via "..backend
    end
    function elite.aim(target)
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil,"camera unavailable"end
        local position=target.part.Position
        local ok,point,visible=pcall(function()
            if (position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude>.01 then
                camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position,position)
            end
            return camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
        end)
        if not ok or not visible or point.Z<=0 then return nil,"waiting for the target to appear on screen"end
        return Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)
    end
    function elite.shoot(weapon,target,now,scopeReady)
        if not raidCombat.auraReady(localPlayer.Character)then return nil,"Waiting for active Haki · "..auraStatus end
        if now-(elite.shotAt or -math.huge)<.15 then return nil,"waiting for the next shot"end
        if mouseHeldBackend then return nil,"waiting for mouse release"end
        local point,reason=elite.aim(target)
        if not point then return nil,reason end
        initializeInput()
        local canClick=true
        local ok,widgets=pcall(function()return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X,point.Y)end)
        if not ok then canClick=false
        else
            for _,widget in ipairs(widgets)do
                if widget:IsA("GuiButton") or widget:IsA("TextBox") or widget.Active then canClick=false;break end
            end
        end
        for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
            if pcall(backend.aim,point)then
                if not scopeReady()then releaseNativeClick();return nil,"target or weapon changed"end
                if canClick then
                    local downOk=pcall(backend.mouse,true,point)
                    if downOk then
                        mouseHeldBackend,mouseHeldPoint,mouseHeldUntil=backend,point,now+.04
                        elite.shotAt=now;return "Gun · "..backend.name
                    end
                    pcall(backend.mouse,false,point)
                end
                -- Activate the aimed Tool directly when the menu covers the target.
                -- Never inject a click into the module's controls.
                weapon:Deactivate();weapon:Activate();elite.shotAt=now
                return "Gun · aimed Tool activation"
            end
        end
        return nil,"aim input unavailable"
    end

    function elite.step()
        if game.GameId~=994732206 or SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]~=3 then
            elite.stop("Farm Elite Hunter requires Blox Fruits sea 3.");return
        end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root then
            elite.cancelRequest();elite.clearCombat();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
            status("Elite Hunter: waiting for your character…");return
        end
        local now=os.clock()
        humanoid.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character);ensureAura(character);stopMovement()
        local home,foundHunter=elite.hunterPosition()
        home=home+Vector3.new(0,2,0)
        if elite.phase=="return"then
            holdPosition(root,home,nil)
            if not foundHunter or (root.Position-home).Magnitude>CONFIG.QuestRange then
                status("Elite Hunter: returning to Castle on the Sea…");return
            end
            elite.phase="hunter";elite.lastRequest=-math.huge;elite.reply=nil
            status("Elite Hunter: back at Castle on the Sea.");return
        end
