        local visible,title,complete=elite.readQuest()
        local assigned=visible and elite.objective(title) or nil
        if visible==nil then elite.stop("Elite Hunter: quest UI not found; adapter update required.");return end
        if elite.phase=="hunt" and (not visible or complete)then elite.returnHome();holdPosition(root,home,nil);return end
        if complete then
            elite.clearCombat();holdPosition(root,home,nil)
            status("Elite Hunter: quest complete; waiting for the objective to close…");return
        end
        if not assigned then
            if elite.phase=="hunt"then elite.returnHome();holdPosition(root,home,nil);return end
            elite.clearCombat();holdPosition(root,home,nil)
            if not foundHunter then status("Elite Hunter: flying to Castle on the Sea; waiting for NPC to load…");return end
            if (root.Position-home).Magnitude>CONFIG.QuestRange then status("Elite Hunter: flying to the quest giver…");return end
            if visible then
                elite.request("AbandonQuest",now)
                status("Elite Hunter: replacing the current quest…");return
            end
            elite.request("EliteHunter",now)
            status("Elite Hunter: waiting for Deandre / Diablo / Urban · "..(elite.reply or "requesting a quest"));return
        end
        if elite.targetName~=assigned then
            elite.clearCombat();elite.target=nil;elite.targetName=assigned;elite.searchAt=now
            elite.hintAt=nil
        end
        elite.phase="hunt"
        local list=candidates(root)
        if not list then elite.stop("Elite Hunter: workspace.Enemies not found.");return end
        if elite.target and (elite.target.Parent~=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
            or not elite.target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or elite.target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health<=0)then
            elite.returnHome();holdPosition(root,home,nil)
            status("Elite Hunter: target defeated or despawned; returning to Castle on the Sea…");return
        end
        local target
        for _,candidate in ipairs(list)do
            if candidate.health>0 and elite.name(candidate.name)==assigned
                and (not target or candidate.model==elite.target or not elite.target and candidate.distance<target.distance)then
                target=candidate
            end
        end
        if not target then
            releaseNativeClick();fruit.target=nil;combatProbe=nil
            local hint=elite.hint(assigned,now)
            if hint then
                holdPosition(root,hint+Vector3.new(0,FARM_HEIGHT,0),nil)
                status("Elite Hunter: flying to "..assigned.."; waiting for the live NPC…")
            elseif not approachSpawn(root,{0,"EliteHunter",1,assigned},now)then
                holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil)
                status("Elite Hunter: "..assigned.." assigned; waiting for its position to replicate…")
            end
            -- A stale replicated hint must not leave the module stranded indefinitely.
            if now-(elite.searchAt or now)>90 then elite.returnHome()end
            return
        end
        elite.target=target.model;elite.searchAt=now
        local attackMode=elite.weaponType
        local weapon,equipStatus=elite.equip(character,humanoid,now)
        if not weapon then releaseNativeClick();holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil);status(equipStatus);return end
        local position,height
        if attackMode=="Fruit" or attackMode=="Gun"then height=attackMode=="Fruit"and fruit.attackHeight(weapon,FARM_HEIGHT,true)or FARM_HEIGHT;position=target.part.Position+Vector3.new(0,height,0)
        else position,height=combatPosition(weapon,target,now)end
        holdPosition(root,position,target.model)
        if target.distance>CONFIG.FarmRadius then releaseNativeClick();status("Elite Hunter: approaching "..assigned.."…");return end
        if now-lastAttack<ATTACK_INTERVAL-1e-6 then return end
        local function scopeReady()
            local active,currentTitle,finished=elite.readQuest()
            return state.elite and elite.weaponType==attackMode and weapon.Parent==character and weapon.Enabled~=false
                and SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]==3 and elite.phase=="hunt"
                and active and not finished and elite.objective(currentTitle)==assigned
                and target.model.Parent==workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies") and target.humanoid.Health>0
        end
        if not scopeReady() or weapon.Parent~=character or weapon.Enabled==false then releaseNativeClick();return end
        local facing=Vector3.new(target.part.Position.X,root.Position.Y,target.part.Position.Z)
        if (facing-root.Position).Magnitude>.01 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,facing)end
        lastAttack=now
        if attackMode=="Fruit"then
            local point,reason=elite.aim(target)
            if not point then releaseNativeClick();status("Elite Hunter: "..reason);return end
            -- Fruit is used from the start of combat. With no selected skills, use Z.
            local skills=fruit.skillsSelected() and CONFIG.FruitSkills or elite.defaultFruitSkills
            status("Elite Hunter: "..fruit.attack(weapon,target,now,false));return
        end
        if attackMode=="Gun"then
            local backend,reason=elite.shoot(weapon,target,now,scopeReady)
            status("Elite Hunter: "..assigned.." · "..tostring(backend or reason));return
        end
        local backend,reason=raidCombat.attack(weapon,{target},root,nil,combatProbe.mode,now,target.name,scopeReady)
        if backend then
            Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)
            status("Elite Hunter: "..assigned.." · HP "..math.ceil(target.health).." · "..backend.." · Height "..height)
        else status("Elite Hunter: "..tostring(reason or "waiting for attack"))end
    end
end

-- One confirmed boss death ends this run. Streaming out is not a kill confirmation.
function boss.note(message)
    if boss.label and boss.label.Text~=message then boss.label.Text=message end
end
function boss.clearTarget()
    if boss.died then boss.died:Disconnect();boss.died=nil end
    boss.target=nil;boss.human=nil;boss.killed=false;boss.hintAt=nil
    fruit.release();fruit.target=nil;releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon();combatProbe=nil
end
function boss.select(row,sea)
    if state.boss then boss.clearTarget();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()end
    boss.selected=row;boss.sea=sea
    boss.note("Selected: "..row.name.." · Weapon: Auto Farm")
    if boss.redrawSelection then boss.redrawSelection()end
end
function boss.finish(model)
    if state.boss and boss.target==model then boss.stop("Defeated · flight released");return true end
    return false
end
function boss.hint(row,now)
    if boss.hintAt and now-boss.hintAt<1 then return boss.hintPosition end
    boss.hintAt=now;boss.hintPosition=nil
    local function inspect(object)
        if object:IsA("Model")and boss.matches(row,object.Name)then
            local part=raidCombat.body(object)
            if part and part.Position.Magnitude>100 then boss.hintPosition=part.Position end
        elseif object:IsA("BasePart")and boss.matches(row,object.Name)then boss.hintPosition=object.Position end
    end
    local storage=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    if storage then for _,object in ipairs(storage:GetChildren())do inspect(object)end end
    local origin=workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
    local spawns=origin and origin:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawns")or workspace:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawns")
    if spawns then for _,object in ipairs(spawns:GetChildren())do inspect(object)end end
    if not boss.hintPosition and row.island then
        for _,island in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[boss.sea]or{})do
            if island[1]==row.island then boss.hintPosition=Vector3.new(island[2][1],island[2][2],island[2][3]);break end
        end
    end
    return boss.hintPosition
end
function boss.step()
    if disposed or not state.boss then return end
    local row=boss.selected
    if game.GameId~=994732206 or not SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then boss.stop("Blox Fruits sea required");return end
    if not row then boss.note("Choose a boss from the current sea");return end
    if boss.sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then boss.stop("Sea changed; choose a boss again");return end
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 then boss.stop("Character unavailable · stopped");return end
    if boss.killed or boss.human and boss.human.Health<=0 then boss.finish(boss.target);return end
    local now=os.clock()
    local target,distance=nil,math.huge
    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates(root)or{})do
        if candidate.health>0 and boss.matches(row,candidate.name)and candidate.distance<distance then target=candidate;distance=candidate.distance end
    end
    human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character);ensureAura(character);stopMovement()
    if not target then
        if boss.target and boss.human and boss.human.Health<=0 then boss.finish(boss.target);return end
        local position=boss.hint(row,now)
        holdPosition(root,position and position+Vector3.new(0,FARM_HEIGHT,0)or root.Position,nil)
        boss.note("Waiting for "..row.name.." · spawn / quest unlock required");return
    end
    if boss.target~=target.model then
        boss.clearTarget();boss.target=target.model;boss.human=target.humanoid
        local model=target.model
        boss.died=target.humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            if state.boss and boss.target==model then boss.killed=true;boss.finish(model)end
        end)
    end
    local mode=CONFIG.WeaponType
    local weapon,equipStatus=prepareFirstSlot(character,human,now,mode)
    if not weapon then holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil);boss.note(equipStatus or "Waiting for weapon");return end
    local position,height=combatPosition(weapon,target,now)
    holdPosition(root,position,target.model)
    if target.distance>CONFIG.FarmRadius then releaseNativeClick();boss.note("Flying to "..row.name);return end
    if now-lastAttack<ATTACK_INTERVAL-1e-6 then return end
    local function ready()
        return state.boss and boss.selected==row and boss.target==target.model and boss.sea==SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
            and CONFIG.WeaponType==mode and target.model.Parent==workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
            and target.humanoid.Health>0 and weapon.Parent==character and weapon.Enabled~=false
    end
    if not ready()then releaseNativeClick();return end
    local facing=Vector3.new(target.part.Position.X,root.Position.Y,target.part.Position.Z)
    if (facing-root.Position).Magnitude>.01 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,facing)end
    lastAttack=now
    if mode=="Fruit"then
        local point,reason=elite.aim(target)
        if not point then boss.note(reason or "Waiting for aim");return end
        local skills=fruit.skillsSelected()and CONFIG.FruitSkills or elite.defaultFruitSkills
        boss.note(fruit.attack(weapon,target,now,false));return
    elseif mode=="Gun"then
        local backend,reason=elite.shoot(weapon,target,now,ready)
        boss.note(tostring(backend or reason));return
    end
    local backend,reason=raidCombat.attack(weapon,{target},root,nil,combatProbe.mode,now,target.name,ready)
    if backend then Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)end
    boss.note(row.name.." · HP "..math.ceil(target.humanoid.Health).." · "..tostring(backend or reason or "waiting"))
end

-- Berry adapter: world items + tagged bush attributes, without color filters.
-- Standard prompt hold API: https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/ProximityPrompt
do
    function berry.isName(value)
        if type(value)~="string"then return false end
        local name=string.lower(value)
        return name:find("berry",1,true)~=nil or name:find("berries",1,true)~=nil
    end
    function berry.isBush(value)
        if not berry.isName(value)then return false end
        local name=string.lower(value)
        return name:find("bush",1,true)~=nil or name:find("spawn",1,true)~=nil
    end
    function berry.world(object)
        if not object or not object:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then return false end
        local ancestor=object
        while ancestor and ancestor~=workspace do
            if ancestor:IsA("Model") and ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then return false end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
        return true
    end
    function berry.point(object)
        if not object then return nil end
        if object:IsA("Attachment")then return object.WorldPosition end
        if object:IsA("BasePart")then return object.Position end
        if object:IsA("Model")then return object:GetPivot().Position end
        local part=object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
        return part and part.Position or nil
    end
    function berry.root(bush)
        if bush:IsA("Model")then return bush end
        if bush.Parent and bush.Parent:IsA("Model")then return bush.Parent end
        if bush:IsA("BasePart")then return bush end
        return bush.Parent
    end
    function berry.owner(object)
        local owner=object
        while owner.Parent and (owner.Parent:IsA("Model") or owner.Parent:IsA("Tool"))
            and berry.isName(owner.Parent.Name) and not berry.isBush(owner.Parent.Name)do
            owner=owner.Parent
        end
        return owner
    end
    function berry.prompt(object,name)
        if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")then return object end
        local fallback,matched,count=nil,nil,0
        for _,child in ipairs(object:GetDescendants())do
            if child:IsA("ProximityPrompt")then
                if name and Core.normalizeName(child.ObjectText)==Core.normalizeName(name)then
                    if child.Enabled then return child end
                    matched=child
                end
                fallback=child;count+=1
            end
        end
        return matched or count==1 and fallback or nil
    end
    function berry.watch(object)
        if berry.watched[object]then return end
        berry.watched[object]=object.AttributeChanged:Connect(function()berry.dirty=true end)
    end
    function berry.register(object,tag)
        if not tag and not berry.isName(object.Name)
            and not(object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")and berry.isName(object.ObjectText))then return end
        if not berry.world(object)then return end
        if tag=="BerryBush" or tag=="Berry Bush" or berry.isBush(object.Name)then
            berry.bushes[object]=true;berry.watch(object)
        elseif tag=="Berry" or tag=="Berries" or berry.isName(object.Name)then
            if object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Attachment") or object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or object:IsA("Tool")then
                berry.objects[berry.owner(object)]=true
            end
        elseif object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and berry.isName(object.ObjectText)then
            berry.objects[object]=true
        end
        berry.dirty=true
    end
    function berry.disconnect()
        if berry.discoveryJob then task.cancel(berry.discoveryJob);berry.discoveryJob=nil end
        berry.tracking=false
        for _,connection in ipairs(berry.connections)do connection:Disconnect()end
        for _,connection in pairs(berry.watched)do connection:Disconnect()end
        berry.connections={};berry.watched={};berry.bushes={};berry.objects={}
        berry.items={};berry.list={};berry.current=nil;berry.idlePosition=nil;berry.idleRoot=nil
    end
    function berry.start()
        if berry.tracking then return end
        berry.disconnect();berry.tracking=true;berry.dirty=true;berry.scannedAt=-math.huge;berry.revision=0
        local service=berry.collection
        local function listen(signal,callback)table.insert(berry.connections,signal:Connect(callback))end
        for _,tag in ipairs(berry.tags)do
            local watchedTag=tag
            listen(service:GetInstanceAddedSignal(watchedTag),function(object)berry.register(object,watchedTag)end)
            listen(service:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(watchedTag),function(object)
                if watchedTag=="BerryBush" or watchedTag=="Berry Bush"then
                    berry.bushes[object]=nil
                    if berry.watched[object]then berry.watched[object]:Disconnect();berry.watched[object]=nil end
                else berry.objects[berry.owner(object)]=nil end
                berry.dirty=true
            end)
            for _,object in ipairs(service:GetTagged(watchedTag))do berry.register(object,watchedTag)end
        end
        listen(workspace.DescendantAdded,function(object)berry.register(object)end)
        listen(workspace.DescendantRemoving,function(object)
            berry.objects[object]=nil;berry.bushes[object]=nil;berry.items[object]=nil
            if berry.watched[object]then berry.watched[object]:Disconnect();berry.watched[object]=nil end
            berry.dirty=true
        end)
        -- One initial discovery; subsequent scans use the registry instead of the whole map.
        berry.discoveryJob=perf.walk(workspace,function(object)berry.register(object)end,
            function()return berry.tracking end,function()berry.discoveryJob=nil end)
    end
    function berry.available(entry)
        if not entry or not berry.world(entry.object)then return false end
        if entry.attribute and (not berry.world(entry.attributeOwner) or entry.attributeOwner:GetAttribute(entry.attribute)~=entry.value)then return false end
        if entry.object:GetAttribute("IsDisabled")==true then return false end
        if entry.prompt and (not entry.prompt.Parent or not entry.prompt.Enabled or entry.prompt.MaxActivationDistance<=0)then return false end
        if not entry.attribute and not entry.prompt then
            local visible=false
            if entry.object:IsA("BasePart")then visible=entry.object.Transparency<.99
            else
                for _,part in ipairs(entry.object:GetDescendants())do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency<.99 then visible=true;break end
                end
            end
            if not visible then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function berry.scan(now)
        if now-(berry.scannedAt or -math.huge)<(berry.dirty and .15 or .75)then return end
        berry.dirty=false;berry.scannedAt=now;berry.revision+=1
        local list,claimed={},{}
        local function add(owner,slot,object,name,attributeOwner,attribute,value)
            if not object or not berry.world(object)then return end
            if attribute and object~=berry.root(owner)then object=berry.owner(object)end
            local prompt=berry.prompt(object,name)
            local point=prompt and berry.point(prompt.Parent) or berry.point(object)
            if not point then return end
            local identity=prompt or (not attribute or object~=berry.root(owner)) and object or nil
            if identity and claimed[identity]then return end
            local bucket=berry.items[owner]
            if not bucket then bucket={};berry.items[owner]=bucket end
            local entry=bucket[slot]
            if not entry or entry.value~=value or entry.object~=object then
                entry={attempts=0,blockedUntil=0,lastAttempt=-math.huge};bucket[slot]=entry
            end
            entry.object=object;entry.name=name;entry.prompt=prompt;entry.position=point
            entry.attributeOwner=attributeOwner;entry.attribute=attribute;entry.value=value;entry.revision=berry.revision
            if berry.available(entry)then
                table.insert(list,entry)
                if identity then claimed[identity]=true end
            end
        end
        for bush in pairs(berry.bushes)do
            if berry.world(bush)then
                local root=berry.root(bush)
                if root then
                    for attribute,value in pairs(bush:GetAttributes())do
                        -- A spawned berry's type is normally the attribute value.
                        -- Ignore setup flags and empty spawn markers.
                        if berry.isName(value)then
                            local object=root:FindFirstChild(attribute,true) or bush:FindFirstChild(attribute,true)
                            add(bush,attribute,object or root,value,bush,attribute,value)
                        elseif berry.isName(attribute) and not berry.isBush(attribute) and value~=false and value~=nil then
                            local object=root:FindFirstChild(attribute,true)
                            if object and (object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Attachment"))then
                                add(bush,attribute,object,attribute,bush,attribute,value)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            else berry.bushes[bush]=nil end
        end
        for object in pairs(berry.objects)do
            if berry.world(object)then
                local name=object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and object.ObjectText or object.Name
                add(object,"item",object,name)
            else berry.objects[object]=nil end
        end
        for owner,bucket in pairs(berry.items)do
            for slot,entry in pairs(bucket)do if entry.revision~=berry.revision then bucket[slot]=nil end end
            if next(bucket)==nil then berry.items[owner]=nil end
        end
        berry.list=list
    end
    function berry.release()
        local held=berry.held
        if not held then return true end
        local ok=true
        if held.prompt and held.prompt.Parent then ok=pcall(function()held.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end)end
        if held.backend then
            ok=pcall(held.backend.send,false,held.key)
            if not ok then ok=pcall(held.backend.send,false,held.key)end
        end
        if ok or not held.backend then berry.held=nil end
        return ok
    end
    function berry.interact(entry,root,now)
        local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
        local menuOk,menu=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
        if focusOk and focused or menuOk and menu then return "finish typing / close the menu to collect"end
        if berry.held then return "collecting "..entry.name end
        if now-entry.lastAttempt<(entry.holdDuration or 0)+1 then return "waiting for pickup confirmation"end
        if entry.attempts>=3 then
            entry.attempts=0;entry.blockedUntil=now+12;berry.current=nil
            return "pickup unconfirmed; trying other berries before retrying"
        end
        local prompt=entry.prompt
        local range=prompt and prompt.MaxActivationDistance or 4
        if (entry.position-root.Position).Magnitude>range then return "approaching "..entry.name end
        entry.attempts+=1;entry.lastAttempt=now
        entry.holdDuration=prompt and prompt.HoldDuration or .6
        if prompt and entry.attempts%2==1 then
            local ok=pcall(function()prompt:InputHoldBegin()end)
            if ok then
                berry.held={prompt=prompt,entry=entry,untilTime=now+entry.holdDuration+.1}
                return "collecting "..entry.name
            end
        end
        initializeInput()
        local key=prompt and prompt.KeyboardKeyCode or Enum.KeyCode.E
        if key==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then key=Enum.KeyCode.E end
        for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
            if pcall(backend.send,true,key)then
                berry.held={backend=backend,key=key,entry=entry,untilTime=now+entry.holdDuration+.1}
                return "collecting "..entry.name
            end
            pcall(backend.send,false,key)
        end
        return "collection input unavailable; retrying"
    end
    function berry.step()
        if game.GameId~=994732206 or not SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then berry.stop("Auto Farm Berry: unsupported world.");return end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not human or human.Health<=0 or not root then
            berry.release();berry.current=nil;berry.idlePosition=nil;berry.idleRoot=nil
            stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
            status("Auto Farm Berry: waiting for your character…");return
        end
        local now=os.clock()
        human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character);stopMovement()
        berry.scan(now)
        if berry.held then
            local held=berry.held
            local entry=held.entry
            local range=entry.prompt and entry.prompt.MaxActivationDistance or 4
            local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
            local menuOk,menu=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
            if now>=held.untilTime or not berry.available(entry) or (entry.position-root.Position).Magnitude>range
                or focusOk and focused or menuOk and menu then berry.release()end
        end
        local target=berry.current
        if not target or target.revision~=berry.revision or not berry.available(target) or now<target.blockedUntil then
            if berry.held then berry.release()end
            target=nil
            local distance=math.huge
            for _,entry in ipairs(berry.list)do
                local candidateDistance=(entry.position-root.Position).Magnitude
                if now>=entry.blockedUntil and berry.available(entry) and candidateDistance<distance then
                    target=entry;distance=candidateDistance
                end
            end
            berry.current=target
        end
        if not target then
            if not berry.idlePosition or berry.idleRoot~=root then
                berry.idlePosition=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,6,0);berry.idleRoot=root
            end
            holdPosition(root,berry.idlePosition,nil)
            local message=#berry.list==0 and "no berries; hovering and waiting for spawn" or "hovering; waiting to retry unconfirmed pickups"
            if berry.label then berry.label.Text="All colors · Available: "..#berry.list end
            status("Auto Farm Berry: "..message);return
        end
        berry.idlePosition=nil;berry.idleRoot=nil
        local range=target.prompt and target.prompt.MaxActivationDistance or 4
        local height=math.min(2,math.max(.1,range*.4))
        holdPosition(root,target.position+Vector3.new(0,height,0),nil)
        if berry.label then berry.label.Text="All colors · Available: "..#berry.list end
        local distance=(target.position-root.Position).Magnitude
        if distance>math.min(4,math.max(.2,range-.1))then
            status("Auto Farm Berry: flying to "..target.name.." · "..math.floor(distance).." studs");return
        end
        status("Auto Farm Berry: "..berry.interact(target,root,now))
    end
end

-- Berry ESP shares discovery with Auto Farm Berry; enabling it never starts flight.
do
    berryEsp.palette={
        {"White",Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245)}, {"Blue",Color3.fromRGB(55,135,245)},
        {"Red",Color3.fromRGB(235,50,65)}, {"Pink",Color3.fromRGB(255,110,185)},
        {"Purple",Color3.fromRGB(150,65,205)}, {"Green",Color3.fromRGB(95,195,45)},
        {"Orange",Color3.fromRGB(255,150,35)}, {"Yellow",Color3.fromRGB(250,220,55)},
    }
    function berryEsp.part(object)
        if object:IsA("BasePart")then return object end
        if object:IsA("Attachment") and object.Parent and object.Parent:IsA("BasePart")then return object.Parent end
        if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")then return object.Parent and berryEsp.part(object.Parent)end
        local fallback
        for _,part in ipairs(object:GetDescendants())do
            if part:IsA("BasePart")then
                if part.Transparency<.99 then return part end
                fallback=fallback or part
            end
        end
        return fallback
    end
    function berryEsp.displayName(entry,part)
        local function clean(value)
            if type(value)~="string" or value==""then return nil end
            return (value:gsub("<.->",""):gsub("_"," "):gsub("(%l)(%u)","%1 %2"):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
        end
        local function specific(value)
            if not value or not berry.isName(value) or berry.isBush(value)then return false end
            local key=Core.styleKey(value)
            return key~="berry" and key~="berries" and key~="berrypart" and key~="berrymodel"
                and key~="berrypickup" and key~="berryitem" and key~="berrymesh"
        end
        local name=clean(entry.name)
        if entry.attribute and specific(name)then return name end
        -- Preserve the actual type name supplied by the bush/berry/prompt.
        for _,attribute in ipairs({"BerryName","BerryType","ItemName"})do
            local declared=clean(entry.object:GetAttribute(attribute))
            if specific(declared)then return declared end
            if declared and declared~="" and not berry.isName(declared)then return declared.." Berry"end
        end
        if specific(name)then return name end
        if entry.prompt then
            local declared=clean(entry.prompt.ObjectText)
            if specific(declared)then return declared end
        end
        -- Some simple pickups are named only "Berry"; use their visible color then.
        if part then
            local color=part.Color
            local nearest,best="",math.huge
            for _,row in ipairs(berryEsp.palette)do
                local sample=row[2]
                local distance=(color.R-sample.R)^2+(color.G-sample.G)^2+(color.B-sample.B)^2
                if distance<best then nearest,best=row[1],distance end
            end
            return nearest.." Berry"
        end
        return name or "Berry"
    end
    function berryEsp.remove(entry)
        local mark=berryEsp.entries[entry]
        if not mark then return end
        mark.gui:Destroy()
        if mark.highlight then mark.highlight:Destroy()end
        berryEsp.entries[entry]=nil
    end
    function berryEsp.update()
        if not berryEsp.running or disposed then return end
        berry.scan(os.clock())
        local seen={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(berry.list)do
            if berry.available(entry)then
                local part=berryEsp.part(entry.prompt and entry.prompt.Parent or entry.object)
                if part and part:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then
                    seen[entry]=true
                    local mark=berryEsp.entries[entry]
                    if not mark then
                        local billboard=create("BillboardGui",{Name="ViltrumBerryESP",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(260,58),
                            ResetOnSpawn=false,AlwaysOnTop=true,MaxDistance=math.huge,LightInfluence=0,
                            Active=false,Adornee=part},gui)
                        local dot=text(billboard,"●",UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(260,22),16,part.Color)
                        dot.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;dot.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                        dot.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                        local label=text(billboard,"",UDim2.fromOffset(0,22),UDim2.fromOffset(260,32),13,Color3.new(1,1,1))
                        label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;label.TextStrokeTransparency=.1
                        label.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0);label.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None
                        mark={gui=billboard,label=label,dot=dot};berryEsp.entries[entry]=mark
                        local exact=not entry.attribute or entry.object~=berry.root(entry.attributeOwner)
                        if exact then
                            local adornee=entry.object:IsA("Model") and entry.object or part
                            mark.highlight=create("Highlight",{Name="ViltrumBerryHighlight",Adornee=adornee,
                                DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop,FillColor=part.Color,OutlineColor=Color3.new(1,1,1),
                                FillTransparency=.25,OutlineTransparency=0},gui)
                        end
                    end
                    mark.gui.Adornee=part
                    mark.gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=entry.position-part.Position+Vector3.new(0,-1,0)
                    mark.label.Text=berryEsp.displayName(entry,part)
                    mark.dot.TextColor3=part.Color
                    if mark.highlight then
                        mark.highlight.Adornee=entry.object:IsA("Model") and entry.object or part
                        mark.highlight.FillColor=part.Color
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for entry in pairs(berryEsp.entries)do if not seen[entry]then berryEsp.remove(entry)end end
    end
    function berryEsp.set(enabled)
        berryEsp.running=enabled
        if enabled then berry.start();berryEsp.update()
        else
            for entry in pairs(berryEsp.entries)do berryEsp.remove(entry)end
            if not state.berry then berry.disconnect()end
        end
    end
    local elapsed=0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
        if not berryEsp.running or disposed then return end
        elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<.25 then return end;elapsed=0
        local ok,message=pcall(berryEsp.update)
        if not ok then
            berryEsp.set(false);state.berryesp=false
            if controls.berryesp then controls.berryesp(false)end
            status("Berry ESP error: "..tostring(message))
        end
    end)
end

-- Auto Race V4 confirms a full meter and retries real Y input until activation is observed.
do
    function raceV4.note(message)
        if raceV4.label and raceV4.label.Text~=message then raceV4.label.Text=message end
    end
    function raceV4.ratio(value,maximum)
        if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or value==math.huge or value==-math.huge or value<0 then return nil end
        if maximum~=nil then
            if type(maximum)~="number" or maximum~=maximum or maximum<=0 or maximum==math.huge then return nil end
            return math.clamp(value/maximum,0,1)
        end
        -- RaceEnergy commonly uses a normalized 0..1 meter. Other ranges need an explicit maximum.
        if value<=1 then return value end
        return nil
    end
    function raceV4.meterRatio(width,trackWidth,leftInset,scale,offset,referenceWidth)
        if trackWidth<=0 or width<0 then return nil end
        local expected=trackWidth
        if referenceWidth and referenceWidth>0 and trackWidth>referenceWidth*1.4 then expected=referenceWidth
        elseif leftInset>0 and leftInset<trackWidth*.08 then expected=trackWidth-2*leftInset
        elseif scale>0 and offset<0 then expected=trackWidth+offset end
        if expected<=0 then return nil end
        if width>0 and expected-width<=.75 then return 1 end
        return math.clamp(width/expected,0,1)
    end
    -- Discover once in small batches. Empty/hidden fill frames remain candidates;
    -- charging the meter no longer triggers a fresh recursive HUD traversal.
    function raceV4.startDiscovery(now)
        if raceV4.scanJob then return end
        raceV4.discoveryAt=now;raceV4.hudDirty=false
        local bars={}
        local root=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Main")or playerGui
        raceV4.scanJob=perf.walk(root,function(object)
            if object==gui or object.Name=="ExperienceChat"or object.Name=="Chat"or object.Name=="PlayerList"then return false end
            if not(object:IsA("Frame")or object:IsA("ImageLabel")or object:IsA("ImageButton"))then return end
            local parent=object.Parent
            if not parent or not parent:IsA("GuiObject")then return end
            local size,position=object.AbsoluteSize,object.AbsolutePosition
            local width=size.X
            if width<60 then
                local track=parent.AbsoluteSize
                if track.Y<2 or track.Y>40 or track.X<60 or track.X/track.Y<6 then return end
                width=track.X
            end
            local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
            if size.Y<2 or size.Y>40 or width<60 or width/size.Y<6 then return end
            if camera and(position.X>camera.ViewportSize.X*.55 or position.Y<camera.ViewportSize.Y*.4)then return end
            if #bars<96 then table.insert(bars,object)end
        end,function()return state.racev4 end,function()
            raceV4.bars=bars;raceV4.scanJob=nil;raceV4.matchAt=nil
        end)
    end
    function raceV4.choose(now)
        if now-(raceV4.matchAt or -math.huge)<.25 then return nil end
        raceV4.matchAt=now
        local red,blue={},{}
        local chosen,score=nil,-math.huge
        for _,object in ipairs(raceV4.bars or {})do
            if object.Parent and widgetVisible(object)then
                local image=object:IsA("ImageLabel")or object:IsA("ImageButton")
                local color=image and object.ImageColor3 or object.BackgroundColor3
                local visible=image and object.ImageTransparency<.95 or not image and object.BackgroundTransparency<.95
                if visible then
                    local redColor=color.R>.55 and color.G<.45 and color.B<.45
                    local context=object
                    for _=1,5 do
                        if not context or context==playerGui then break end
                        local id=Core.styleKey(context.Name)
                        if id=="raceenergy"or id=="raceenergybar"or id=="raceenergyfill"or id=="racev4"
                            or id=="racebar"or id=="racemeter"or id=="awakeningbar"or id=="racetransformation"then
                            if redColor or image and color.R>.8 and color.G>.8 and color.B>.8 then
                                local key=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
                                local rank=(key=="bar"or key=="fill"or key=="frame"or key=="progress")and 110 or 100
                                if rank>score then chosen,score=object,rank end
                            end
                            break
                        end
                        context=context.Parent
                    end
                    if redColor and #red<24 then table.insert(red,object)end
                    if color.R<.45 and color.G>.3 and color.B>.45 and #blue<24 then table.insert(blue,object)end
                end
            end
        end
        for _,candidate in ipairs(red)do
            local p,s=candidate.AbsolutePosition,candidate.AbsoluteSize
            local track=candidate.Parent.AbsoluteSize
            local width=track.Y<=40 and math.max(s.X,track.X)or s.X
            if width/s.Y>=12 then
                for _,energy in ipairs(blue)do
                    local ep,es=energy.AbsolutePosition,energy.AbsoluteSize
                    local gap=p.Y-(ep.Y+es.Y)
                    local energyWidth=es.X
                    if energy.Parent and energy.Parent:IsA("GuiObject")and energy.Parent.AbsoluteSize.X<width*1.4 then energyWidth=math.max(energyWidth,energy.Parent.AbsoluteSize.X)end
                    if gap>=-1 and gap<=math.max(30,s.Y*5)and math.abs(p.X-ep.X)<=math.max(12,width*.05)
                        and energyWidth>=width*.8 and energyWidth<=width*1.35 and score<90 then
                        chosen,score=candidate,90;raceV4.reference=energy
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return chosen
    end
    function raceV4.uiRatio(now)
        local fill=raceV4.fill
        if fill and not fill.Parent then raceV4.fill=nil;fill=nil end
        if not fill then
            if not raceV4.bars or raceV4.hudDirty and now-(raceV4.discoveryAt or -math.huge)>2
                or now-(raceV4.discoveryAt or -math.huge)>10 then raceV4.startDiscovery(now)end
            fill=raceV4.choose(now);raceV4.fill=fill
        elseif not widgetVisible(fill)then
            if raceV4.hudDirty and now-(raceV4.discoveryAt or -math.huge)>2 then
                raceV4.fill=nil;raceV4.startDiscovery(now)
            end
            return nil
        end
        if not fill or not fill.Parent or not widgetVisible(fill)then return nil end
        local parent=fill.Parent
        if not parent:IsA("GuiObject")then return nil end
        local reference=raceV4.reference
        local width=reference and reference.Parent and reference.AbsoluteSize.X or nil
        return raceV4.meterRatio(fill.AbsoluteSize.X,parent.AbsoluteSize.X,
            fill.AbsolutePosition.X-parent.AbsolutePosition.X,fill.Size.X.Scale,fill.Size.X.Offset,width)
    end
    function raceV4.value(name)
        local cached=raceV4.valueNodes and raceV4.valueNodes[name]
        if cached and cached.Parent then return cached.Value,cached end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
        for _,owner in ipairs({character or false,data or false,localPlayer})do
            if owner then
                local attribute=owner:GetAttribute(name)
                if attribute~=nil then return attribute,owner end
            end
        end
        local now=os.clock()
        raceV4.valueAt=raceV4.valueAt or {};raceV4.valueNodes=raceV4.valueNodes or {}
        if now-(raceV4.valueAt[name]or -math.huge)<1 then return nil end
        raceV4.valueAt[name]=now
        for _,owner in ipairs({character or false,data or false,localPlayer})do
            if owner then
                local node=owner:FindFirstChild(name)
                if node and(node:IsA("NumberValue")or node:IsA("IntValue")or node:IsA("BoolValue"))then
                    raceV4.valueNodes[name]=node;return node.Value,node
                end
            end
        end
        if character and raceV4.valuesCharacter~=character then
            raceV4.valuesCharacter=character
            raceV4.valueJob=perf.walk(character,function(object)
                local id=object.Name
                if (id=="RaceEnergy"or id=="RaceTransformed"or id=="RaceEnergyMax"or id=="MaxRaceEnergy")
                    and(object:IsA("NumberValue")or object:IsA("IntValue")or object:IsA("BoolValue"))then raceV4.valueNodes[id]=object end
            end,function()return state.racev4 and localPlayer.Character==character end,function()raceV4.valueJob=nil end)
        end
        return nil
    end

    function raceV4.read(now)
        local transformed=raceV4.value("RaceTransformed")
        if transformed==true then return nil,true,"RaceTransformed"end
        local energy,node=raceV4.value("RaceEnergy")
        local maximum=raceV4.value("RaceEnergyMax")
        if maximum==nil then maximum=raceV4.value("MaxRaceEnergy")end
        if maximum==nil and node then
            maximum=node:GetAttribute("MaxValue") or node:GetAttribute("MaxEnergy") or node:GetAttribute("Max")
        end
        local ui=raceV4.uiRatio(now)
        if ui~=nil then return ui,transformed==true,"visible Race V4 bar"end
        return raceV4.ratio(energy,maximum),transformed==true,"RaceEnergy"
    end
    function raceV4.backends()
        initializeInput()
        local list={}
        for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do table.insert(list,backend)end
        if not raceV4.virtualUser then
            local ok,user=pcall(function()return game:GetService("VirtualUser")end)
            if ok and user then raceV4.virtualUser={name="VirtualUser",send=function(down)
                if down then user:CaptureController();user:SetKeyDown("0x79")else user:SetKeyUp("0x79")end
            end}end
        end
        if raceV4.virtualUser then table.insert(list,raceV4.virtualUser)end
        return list
    end
    function raceV4.release()
        local held=raceV4.held
        if not held then return true end
        local ok=pcall(held.backend.send,false,Enum.KeyCode.Y)
        if not ok then ok=pcall(held.backend.send,false,Enum.KeyCode.Y)end
        if ok then raceV4.held=nil end
        return ok
    end
    function raceV4.reset()
        if raceV4.scanJob then task.cancel(raceV4.scanJob);raceV4.scanJob=nil end
        if raceV4.valueJob then task.cancel(raceV4.valueJob);raceV4.valueJob=nil end
        raceV4.bars=nil;raceV4.matchAt=nil;raceV4.hudDirty=true
        raceV4.valueNodes={};raceV4.valueAt={};raceV4.valuesCharacter=nil
        raceV4.release();raceV4.character=nil;raceV4.latched=false;raceV4.fullSince=nil
        raceV4.fill=nil;raceV4.discoveryAt=-math.huge;raceV4.lastAttempt=-math.huge
        raceV4.backendIndex=0;raceV4.sentCount=0
    end
    function raceV4.stop(message)
        state.racev4=false;raceV4.reset();raceV4.note(message or "Disabled · Activation key: Y / Н")
        if controls.racev4 and not disposed then controls.racev4(false)end
    end
    function raceV4.step(now)
        if disposed or not state.racev4 then raceV4.release();return end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not human or human.Health<=0 then raceV4.reset();raceV4.note("Waiting for your character…");return end
        if raceV4.character~=character then raceV4.reset();raceV4.character=character end
        local ratio,transformed,source=raceV4.read(now)
        if transformed then
            raceV4.latched=true;raceV4.fullSince=nil;raceV4.release()
            raceV4.note("Race V4 is active");return
        end
        if ratio==nil then raceV4.fullSince=nil;raceV4.note("Waiting for the Race V4 meter…");return end
        if ratio<.98 then raceV4.latched=false end
        if ratio<1-1e-6 then
            raceV4.fullSince=nil;raceV4.note("Charge: "..math.floor(ratio*100).."% · Waiting for 100%");return
        end
        if raceV4.latched then raceV4.note("Transformation confirmed · Waiting for the next charge cycle");return end
        raceV4.fullSince=raceV4.fullSince or now
        if now-raceV4.fullSince<.2 then raceV4.note("Charge: 100% · Confirming full meter…");return end
        local focusOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
        local menuOk,menu=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
        local windowOk,windowFocused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:IsWindowFocused()end)
        if focusOk and focused or menuOk and menu or windowOk and not windowFocused then
            raceV4.note("Charge: 100% · Close text input / menu and focus the game");return
        end
        if raceV4.held then return end
        if now-(raceV4.lastAttempt or -math.huge)<2.5 then return end
        raceV4.lastAttempt=now
        local backends=raceV4.backends()
        for _=1,#backends do
            local index=(raceV4.backendIndex or 0)%#backends+1
            local backend=backends[index];raceV4.backendIndex=index
            if pcall(backend.send,true,Enum.KeyCode.Y)then
                raceV4.held={backend=backend,untilTime=now+.15}
                raceV4.sentCount=(raceV4.sentCount or 0)+1
                raceV4.note("100% · Y #"..raceV4.sentCount.." via "..backend.name.." · "..source.." · Waiting for confirmation")
                return
            end
            pcall(backend.send,false,Enum.KeyCode.Y)
        end
        raceV4.note("Charge: 100% · Key input unavailable; retrying")
    end
    connect(playerGui.DescendantAdded,function(object)
        if state.racev4 and object:IsA("GuiObject")and not object:IsDescendantOf(gui)then raceV4.hudDirty=true end
    end)
    connect(playerGui.DescendantRemoving,function(object)
        if state.racev4 and object:IsA("GuiObject")and not object:IsDescendantOf(gui)then raceV4.hudDirty=true end
    end)
    local elapsed=0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
        if raceV4.held then
            local human=localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if disposed or not state.racev4 or not human or human.Health<=0 or os.clock()>=raceV4.held.untilTime then raceV4.release()end
        end
        if not state.racev4 or disposed then return end
        elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<.1 then return end;elapsed=0
        local ok,message=pcall(raceV4.step,os.clock())
        if not ok then raceV4.stop("Race V4 error: "..tostring(message))end
    end)
end

-- Same-server fruit flight and pickup. Fixed speed: 150 studs/s.
do
    function autoFruits.note(message)
        if autoFruits.label and autoFruits.label.Text~=message then autoFruits.label.Text=message end
    end
    function autoFruits.release()
        if autoFruits.held then
            local prompt=autoFruits.held.prompt
            if prompt.Parent then pcall(function()prompt:InputHoldEnd()end)end
            autoFruits.held=nil
        end
    end
    function autoFruits.step()
        if game.GameId~=994732206 or not SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then autoFruits.stop("Unsupported world");return end
        local character=localPlayer.Character
        local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not human or human.Health<=0 or not root then
            autoFruits.release();autoFruits.target=nil;autoFruits.arrivedAt=nil;stopHover();restoreCollisions()
            autoFruits.note("Waiting for your character…");return
        end
        local now=os.clock()
        if teleport.updateFlightUI then teleport.updateFlightUI()end
        local list=fruitEsp.list(root)
        local target=autoFruits.target
        if target and fruitEsp.items[target.owner]~=target then
            if autoFruits.arrivedAt and target.part and(root.Position-target.part.Position).Magnitude<=10 then
                autoFruits.collected=true
            end
            autoFruits.release();target=nil
        elseif target and now<target.blockedUntil then autoFruits.release();target=nil end
        if not target then
            local distance=math.huge
            for _,item in ipairs(list)do
                if now>=item.blockedUntil and item.distance<distance then target=item;distance=item.distance end
            end
            autoFruits.target=target;autoFruits.arrivedAt=nil;autoFruits.attempts=0;autoFruits.lastPickup=-math.huge
        end
        if #list>0 then autoFruits.emptySince=nil;autoFruits.emptyScan=nil end
        if #list==0 then
            stopHover();restoreCollisions()
            if not autoFruits.emptySince then
                autoFruits.emptySince=now;autoFruits.emptyScan=(fruitEsp.scanVersion or 0)+1;fruitEsp.discover()
            elseif not fruitEsp.discoveryJob and(fruitEsp.scanVersion or 0)>=autoFruits.emptyScan then
                autoFruits.stop("No spawned fruits · Disabled");return
            end
            autoFruits.note("Checking for spawned fruits…");return
        end
        stopMovement();disableCollisions(character);human.Sit=false
        if not target then
            holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil,150)
            autoFruits.note(#list==0 and "Waiting for spawned fruits…"or "Waiting to retry unconfirmed pickups…");return
        end
        local definition=fruitEsp.identity(target.owner)
        local name=definition and definition.name or "Fruits"
        local position=target.part.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
        holdPosition(root,position,nil,150)
        if (root.Position-position).Magnitude>4 then
            autoFruits.release();autoFruits.arrivedAt=nil
            autoFruits.note("Flying to "..name.." · 150 blocks/s");return
        end
        if not autoFruits.arrivedAt then autoFruits.arrivedAt=now end
        if autoFruits.held then
            if now>=autoFruits.held.untilTime then autoFruits.release()end
            autoFruits.note("Picking up "..name.."…");return
        end
        if now-autoFruits.arrivedAt<.5 then autoFruits.note("Picking up "..name.."…");return end
        local focusedOk,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()end)
        local menuOk,menu=pcall(function()return game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen end)
        if focusedOk and focused or menuOk and menu then autoFruits.note("Close text input / menu to collect");return end
        if now-(autoFruits.lastPickup or -math.huge)<1 then return end
        autoFruits.lastPickup=now;autoFruits.attempts+=1
        if autoFruits.attempts>3 then
            autoFruits.release();target.blockedUntil=now+10;autoFruits.target=nil;autoFruits.arrivedAt=nil
            autoFruits.note("Pickup not confirmed; trying other fruits");return
        end
        local prompt=target.owner:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
        if prompt and prompt.Enabled and (root.Position-target.part.Position).Magnitude<=prompt.MaxActivationDistance then
            if pcall(function()prompt:InputHoldBegin()end)then autoFruits.held={prompt=prompt,untilTime=now+prompt.HoldDuration+.1}end
        end
        -- Tool pickups without prompts are collected by contact; disappearance confirms progress.
        autoFruits.note("Picking up "..name.." · waiting for confirmation")
    end
end

function swordFarm.invoke(command,args,callback)
 if swordFarm.request or os.clock()<(swordFarm.requestAt or 0)then return false end
 local folder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
 local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then acquisition.requestFailure(swordFarm,command,"Жду CommF_ / загрузку Remotes");return false end
 local generation=swordFarm.generation
 local thread
 thread=task.defer(function()
  if swordFarm.generation~=generation or not state.swordfarm or swordFarm.request~=thread then return end
  local ok,result,extra=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer(command,table.unpack(args or{}))end)
  if swordFarm.request~=thread or swordFarm.generation~=generation or not state.swordfarm then return end
  swordFarm.request=nil;swordFarm.requestCommand=nil
  if swordFarm.timer then task.cancel(swordFarm.timer);swordFarm.timer=nil end
  swordFarm.requestAt=os.clock()+.4
  if not ok then acquisition.requestFailure(swordFarm,command,command..": "..tostring(result));return end
  if command=="getInventory"and(result==true or result==nil)and type(extra)=="table"then result=extra end
  local applied,message=pcall(callback,result)
  if not applied then acquisition.requestFailure(swordFarm,command,"Ошибка ответа: "..tostring(message))end
 end)
 swordFarm.request=thread;swordFarm.requestCommand=command
 swordFarm.timer=task.delay(8,function()
  if swordFarm.request==thread and swordFarm.generation==generation then swordFarm.timer=nil;task.cancel(thread);swordFarm.request=nil;swordFarm.requestCommand=nil;acquisition.requestFailure(swordFarm,command,command..": таймаут сервера")end
 end)
 return true
end
function swordFarm.owned(row)
 for _,container in ipairs({localPlayer.Character,localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")})do
  if container then for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if tool:IsA("Tool")and swordFarm.matches(row,tool.Name)then return {Name=tool.Name,Type="Sword",Mastery=tool:FindFirstChild("Level")and tool.Level.Value or 0}end
  end end
 end
 for _,item in pairs(swordFarm.inventory or{})do
  if type(item)=="table"and type(item.Name)=="string"and item.Type=="Sword"and swordFarm.matches(row,item.Name)then return item end
 end
end
function swordFarm.tool(row)
 for _,container in ipairs({localPlayer.Character,localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")})do
  if container then for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if tool:IsA("Tool")and swordFarm.matches(row,tool.Name)then return tool end
  end end
 end
end
function swordFarm.material(name)
 local live=acquisition.liveMaterial(name);if live~=nil then return live end
 for _,item in pairs(swordFarm.inventory or{})do
  if type(item)=="table"and item.Name==name then return tonumber(item.Count)or 0 end
 end
 return 0
end
function swordFarm.readInventory(now)
 if now<(swordFarm.inventoryAt or 0)then return swordFarm.inventory~=nil end
 local generation=swordFarm.generation
 local accepted=swordFarm.invoke("getInventory",{},function(result)
  local function valid()return state.swordfarm and swordFarm.generation==generation end
  local inventory,reliable,diagnostic=acquisition.inventory(result,valid)
  if not valid()then return end
  if not inventory then acquisition.readFailure(swordFarm,"getInventory: "..tostring(diagnostic));return end
  swordFarm.inventory=inventory;swordFarm.inventoryReliable=reliable;swordFarm.inventoryIssue=diagnostic
  swordFarm.inventoryReadAt=os.clock();swordFarm.inventoryAt=os.clock()+3;swordFarm.failures=0
 end)
 if accepted then swordFarm.inventoryAt=now+3 end
 return swordFarm.inventory~=nil
end
function swordFarm.money()
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
 local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
 return value and tonumber(value.Value)
end
function swordFarm.npc(name)
 if not name then return nil end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now>=(swordFarm.npcAt or 0)then
  swordFarm.npcAt=now+.75;swordFarm.npcs={}
  local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
  if folder then for _,object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do
   local body=raidCombat.body(object)
   if body then swordFarm.npcs[Core.styleKey(Core.normalizeName(object.Name))]=body end
  end end
 end
 local body=swordFarm.npcs and swordFarm.npcs[Core.styleKey(Core.normalizeName(name))]
 if body and body.Parent then return body.Position end
end
function swordFarm.island(name)
 for _,row in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[swordFarm.sea]or{})do
  if row[1]==name then return Vector3.new(row[2][1],row[2][2],row[2][3])end
 end
end
function swordFarm.travel(root,position,message)
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release()
 if not position then holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil);swordFarm.note(message.." · жду загрузки места");return false end
 holdPosition(root,position,nil)
 if (root.Position-position).Magnitude>8 then swordFarm.note("Лечу: "..message);return false end
 return true
end
function swordFarm.purchase(root,row,command,args,npc,island)
 local now=os.clock()
 local position=swordFarm.npc(npc or row.npc)
 if not position then
  swordFarm.travel(root,swordFarm.island(island or row.island),"Ищу "..tostring(npc or row.npc));return
 end
 if not swordFarm.travel(root,position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),row.name.." — торговец")then return end
 if not acquisition.purchaseReady(swordFarm,row,root)then return end
 if swordFarm.pendingBuy and swordFarm.pendingBuy.name~=row.name then swordFarm.pendingBuy=nil;swordFarm.buyAttempts=0 end
 if swordFarm.pendingBuy then
  if now-swordFarm.pendingBuy.at<4 then swordFarm.note("Проверяю получение: "..row.name);return end
  swordFarm.buyAttempts=(swordFarm.buyAttempts or 0)+1;swordFarm.pendingBuy=nil
  if swordFarm.buyAttempts>=3 then
   if row.route=="dealer"then swordFarm.buyAttempts=0;swordFarm.requestAt=now+15;swordFarm.note("Waiting for — торговец stock: "..row.name)
   else acquisition.pause(swordFarm,"Покупка не подтвердилась: "..row.name.." · проверю требования и товар снова")end
   return
  end
 end
 if command=="BuyItem"and row.aliases and(swordFarm.buyAttempts or 0)>0 then args={row.aliases[swordFarm.buyAttempts]or row.name}end
 if swordFarm.invoke(command,args,function(reply)
  if swordFarm.pendingBuy then swordFarm.pendingBuy.replied=true end
  swordFarm.note("NPC reply: "..tostring(reply).." · checking actual "..row.name)
  swordFarm.inventoryAt=0
  if not swordFarm.inventoryReliable then swordFarm.probed=false;swordFarm.probeAt=os.clock()+1;swordFarm.probeIndex=0 end
 end)then
  if not swordFarm.inventoryReliable then swordFarm.unverifiedBuy=row.name end
  swordFarm.pendingBuy={at=now,name=row.name,balance=acquisition.balance(swordFarm,row)};swordFarm.note("Покупаю "..row.name.." · жду подтверждения в инвентаре")
 end
end
function swordFarm.dealer(root,row)
 local now=os.clock()
 if not swordFarm.npc("Legendary Sword Dealer")then
  local islands=TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[swordFarm.sea]or{}
  swordFarm.routeIndex=swordFarm.routeIndex or 1
  local island=islands[swordFarm.routeIndex]
  if island then
   local position=Vector3.new(island[2][1],island[2][2],island[2][3])+Vector3.new(0,20,0)
   if swordFarm.travel(root,position,"Ищу Legendary Sword Dealer")then
    if now>(swordFarm.routeAt or 0)then swordFarm.routeIndex=swordFarm.routeIndex%#islands+1;swordFarm.routeAt=now+2 end
   end
  end
  return
 end
 swordFarm.purchase(root,row,"LegendarySwordDealer",{row.dealer},"Legendary Sword Dealer")
end
function swordFarm.fight(root,human,rows,mastery)
 local target,distance=nil,math.huge
 for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates(root)or{})do
  if candidate.health>0 then
   for _,name in ipairs(rows)do
    if Core.normalizeName(candidate.name)==Core.normalizeName(name)and candidate.distance<distance then target=candidate;distance=candidate.distance end
   end
  end
 end
 if not target then releaseNativeClick();return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 local mode=mastery and "Sword"or CONFIG.WeaponType
 local weapon,reason
 if mastery then
  weapon=swordFarm.tool(mastery)
  if not weapon then
   local item=swordFarm.owned(mastery)
   if item and now>=(swordFarm.loadAt or 0)then
    swordFarm.invoke("LoadItem",{item.Name},function()swordFarm.loadAt=os.clock()+3 end)
   end
   if not state.swordfarm then return true end
   swordFarm.note("Достаю меч для мастерства: "..mastery.name);return true
  end
  if weapon.Parent~=localPlayer.Character then human:EquipTool(weapon);releaseNativeClick();return true end
 else weapon,reason=prepareFirstSlot(localPlayer.Character,human,now,mode)end
 if not weapon then swordFarm.note(reason or "Ожидаю оружие из Auto Farm");return true end
 local position=combatPosition(weapon,target,now)
 holdPosition(root,position,target.model)
 if target.distance>CONFIG.FarmRadius then releaseNativeClick();swordFarm.note("Лечу к "..target.name);return true end
 if now-lastAttack<ATTACK_INTERVAL then return true end
 local generation=swordFarm.generation
 local function ready()
  return state.swordfarm and swordFarm.generation==generation and swordFarm.sea==SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
   and target.humanoid.Health>0 and weapon.Parent==localPlayer.Character and weapon.Enabled~=false
 end
 if not ready()then return true end
 lastAttack=now
 local backend,message
 if mode=="Fruit"then
  local point,aimReason=elite.aim(target)
  if point then backend=fruit.attack(weapon,target,now,false)else message=aimReason end
 elseif mode=="Gun"then backend,message=elite.shoot(weapon,target,now,ready)
 else
  backend,message=raidCombat.attack(weapon,{target},root,nil,combatProbe.mode,now,target.name,ready)
  if backend then Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)end
 end
 swordFarm.note((mastery and "Мастерство: "..mastery.name or swordFarm.selected.name).." · "..target.name.." · "..tostring(backend or message or "waiting"))
 return true
end
function swordFarm.grind(root,human,reason,mastery)
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
 local level=data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
 local quest=Core.selectQuest(QUESTS[swordFarm.sea],level and level.Value,swordFarm.sea)
 if not quest then acquisition.pause(swordFarm,"Жду подходящий квест / данные уровня для этого моря");return end
 local visible,title,complete=questUI()
 if visible==nil then
  if not swordFarm.fight(root,human,{quest[4]},mastery)then approachSpawn(root,quest,os.clock())end
  swordFarm.note(reason.." · farming enemies while quest UI is unavailable");return
 end
 if visible and complete then releaseNativeClick();swordFarm.note(reason.." · жду награду за квест");return end
 if visible and not Core.questMatches(title,quest[4])then
  -- Keep an existing normal quest; never abandon player progress to force a money route.
  local active=Core.activeQuest(QUESTS[swordFarm.sea],title)
  if not active then acquisition.pause(swordFarm,"Завершите или отмените неизвестный текущий квест",5);return end
  quest=active
 end
 if not visible then
  if os.clock()<(swordFarm.questFallbackUntil or 0)then
   if not swordFarm.fight(root,human,{quest[4]},mastery)then approachSpawn(root,quest,os.clock())end
   swordFarm.note(reason.." · farming enemies; retrying unconfirmed quest shortly");return
  end
  local position=questNpcPosition(quest)
  if not swordFarm.travel(root,position and position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),reason.." · к NPC квеста")then return end
  local now=os.clock()
  if now<(swordFarm.questAt or 0)then swordFarm.note("Жду подтверждения квеста");return end
  swordFarm.questAttempts=(swordFarm.questAttempts or 0)+1
  if swordFarm.questAttempts>3 then swordFarm.questAttempts=0;swordFarm.questFallbackUntil=now+30;swordFarm.note("Quest not confirmed · continuing enemy farm");return end
  if swordFarm.invoke("StartQuest",{quest[2],quest[3]},function()end)then swordFarm.questAt=now+4 end
  return
 end
 swordFarm.questAttempts=0
 if not swordFarm.fight(root,human,{quest[4]},mastery)then
  approachSpawn(root,quest,os.clock());swordFarm.note(reason.." · ожидаю "..quest[4])
 end
end
function swordFarm.initialDestination(row,root)
 if row.price then
  local money=swordFarm.money()
  if money and money<row.price then
   local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
   local level=data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
   local quest=Core.selectQuest(QUESTS[swordFarm.sea],level and level.Value,swordFarm.sea)
   local npc=quest and questNpcPosition(quest)
   if npc then return npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0)end
  end
 end
 local npc=row.npc and swordFarm.npc(row.npc)
 if npc then return npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0)end
 if row.route=="dealer"or row.route=="ttk"then
  npc=swordFarm.npc("Legendary Sword Dealer")
  if npc then return npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0)end
 end
 local position=swordFarm.island(row.island or(row.route=="dealer"and "Green Zone"))
 return position and position+Vector3.new(0,FARM_HEIGHT,0)
end
function swordFarm.step()
 if disposed or not state.swordfarm then return end
 if swordFarm.sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then swordFarm.stop("Sea changed; choose a sword again");return end
 if swordFarm.phase=="complete"or swordFarm.phase=="blocked"then return end
 if acquisition.waiting(swordFarm)then return end
 swordFarm.phase="running"
 local row=swordFarm.selected
 if not row then swordFarm.note("Включено. Выберите меч ниже — маршрут запустится сразу.");return end
 if row.route=="quest"then swordFarm.phase="blocked";swordFarm.note("Маршрут "..row.name.." пока не реализован. Выберите другой меч.");return end
 local character=localPlayer.Character
 local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 then swordFarm.note("Ожидаю персонажа / возрождения…");return end
 if swordFarm.character~=character then
  swordFarm.character=character;haki.begin(character,"swordfarm")
 end
 if swordFarm.owned(row)then acquisition.complete(swordFarm,row);return end
 human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character);stopMovement()
 if haki.step(character,human,root)then return end
 if haki.bootstrap and not haki.learned then
  local money=swordFarm.money()or 0
  swordFarm.grind(root,human,"Haki: коплю "..math.floor(money).." / 25000 Beli");return
 end
 local now=os.clock()
 if swordFarm.owned(row)then acquisition.complete(swordFarm,row);return end
 local loaded=swordFarm.readInventory(now)
 if not state.swordfarm or swordFarm.phase=="waiting"then return end
 if swordFarm.owned(row)then acquisition.complete(swordFarm,row);return end
 if acquisition.awaitingPaid(swordFarm,row)then return end
 if not swordFarm.inventoryReliable then acquisition.probe(swordFarm,row,now)end
 if row.price then
  local money=swordFarm.money()
  if not money then acquisition.pause(swordFarm,"Data.Beli недоступно — покупка приостановлена",5);return end
  if money<row.price then swordFarm.grind(root,human,"Коплю Beli: "..math.floor(money).." / "..row.price);return end
 end
 if row.route=="shop"then swordFarm.purchase(root,row,"BuyItem",{row.name});return end
 if row.route=="dealer"then swordFarm.dealer(root,row);return end
 if row.route=="drop"then
  if not swordFarm.fight(root,human,row.enemies)then
   local hint=acquisition.destination(swordFarm,row,root)
   holdPosition(root,hint and hint+Vector3.new(0,FARM_HEIGHT,0)or root.Position,nil)
   swordFarm.note(row.name.." · ожидаю "..table.concat(row.enemies," / ")..(row.detail and " · "..row.detail or ""))
  end
  return
 end
 if row.route=="ectoplasm"then
  local count=swordFarm.material("Ectoplasm")
  if count>=100 then swordFarm.purchase(root,row,"Ectoplasm",{"Buy",3});return end
  if not swordFarm.fight(root,human,{"Ship Deckhand","Ship Engineer","Ship Steward","Ship Officer","Cursed Captain"})then
   swordFarm.travel(root,swordFarm.island("Cursed Ship"),"Ectoplasm "..count.." / 100")
  end
  return
 end
 if row.route=="key"then
  local key=swordFarm.tool({name="Hidden Key"})
  if key then
   if key.Parent~=character then human:EquipTool(key);return end
   -- Existing Ice Castle chest; contact consumes the key and inventory confirms Rengoku.
   swordFarm.travel(root,Vector3.new(6571,297,-6967),"Открываю сундук Rengoku");return
  end
  if not swordFarm.fight(root,human,{"Awakened Ice Admiral","Arctic Warrior","Snow Lurker"})then
   swordFarm.travel(root,swordFarm.island("Ice Castle"),"Hidden Key · ожидаю Ice Castle enemies")
  end
  return
 end
 if row.route=="ttk"then
  for _,blade in ipairs(swordFarm.catalog[2])do
   if blade.route=="dealer"then
    local item=swordFarm.owned(blade)
    if not item then
     swordFarm.dealer(root,blade);return
    end
    local tool=swordFarm.tool(blade)
    local level=tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Level")
    local mastery=level and tonumber(level.Value)or tonumber(item.Mastery)or 0
    if mastery<300 then swordFarm.grind(root,human,blade.name.." — мастерство "..mastery.." / 300",blade);return end
   end
  end
  swordFarm.purchase(root,row,"MysteriousMan",{"2"});return
 end
end

function gunFarm.invoke(command,args,callback)
 if gunFarm.request or os.clock()<(gunFarm.requestAt or 0)then return false end
 local folder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
 local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then acquisition.requestFailure(gunFarm,command,"Жду CommF_ / загрузку Remotes");return false end
 local generation=gunFarm.generation
 local thread
 thread=task.defer(function()
  if gunFarm.generation~=generation or not state.gunfarm or gunFarm.request~=thread then return end
  local ok,result,extra=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer(command,table.unpack(args or{}))end)
  if gunFarm.request~=thread or gunFarm.generation~=generation or not state.gunfarm then return end
  gunFarm.request=nil;gunFarm.requestCommand=nil
  if gunFarm.timer then task.cancel(gunFarm.timer);gunFarm.timer=nil end
  gunFarm.requestAt=os.clock()+.4
  if not ok then acquisition.requestFailure(gunFarm,command,command..": "..tostring(result));return end
  if command=="getInventory"and(result==true or result==nil)and type(extra)=="table"then result=extra end
  local applied,message=pcall(callback,result)
  if not applied then acquisition.requestFailure(gunFarm,command,"Ошибка ответа: "..tostring(message))end
 end)
 gunFarm.request=thread;gunFarm.requestCommand=command
 gunFarm.timer=task.delay(8,function()
  if gunFarm.request==thread and gunFarm.generation==generation then gunFarm.timer=nil;task.cancel(thread);gunFarm.request=nil;gunFarm.requestCommand=nil;acquisition.requestFailure(gunFarm,command,command..": таймаут сервера")end
 end)
 return true
end
function gunFarm.owned(row)
 for _,container in ipairs({localPlayer.Character,localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")})do
  if container then for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if tool:IsA("Tool")and gunFarm.matches(row,tool.Name)then return {Name=tool.Name,Type="Gun",Mastery=tool:FindFirstChild("Level")and tool.Level.Value or 0}end
  end end
 end
 for _,item in pairs(gunFarm.inventory or{})do
  if type(item)=="table"and type(item.Name)=="string"and item.Type=="Gun"and gunFarm.matches(row,item.Name)then return item end
 end
end
function gunFarm.tool(row)
 for _,container in ipairs({localPlayer.Character,localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")})do
  if container then for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if tool:IsA("Tool")and gunFarm.matches(row,tool.Name)then return tool end
  end end
 end
end
function gunFarm.material(name)
 local live=acquisition.liveMaterial(name);if live~=nil then return live end
 for _,item in pairs(gunFarm.inventory or{})do
  if type(item)=="table"and item.Name==name then return tonumber(item.Count)or 0 end
 end
 return 0
end
function gunFarm.readInventory(now)
 if now<(gunFarm.inventoryAt or 0)then return gunFarm.inventory~=nil end
 local generation=gunFarm.generation
 local accepted=gunFarm.invoke("getInventory",{},function(result)
  local function valid()return state.gunfarm and gunFarm.generation==generation end
  local inventory,reliable,diagnostic=acquisition.inventory(result,valid)
  if not valid()then return end
  if not inventory then acquisition.readFailure(gunFarm,"getInventory: "..tostring(diagnostic));return end
  gunFarm.inventory=inventory;gunFarm.inventoryReliable=reliable;gunFarm.inventoryIssue=diagnostic
  gunFarm.inventoryReadAt=os.clock();gunFarm.inventoryAt=os.clock()+3;gunFarm.failures=0
 end)
 if accepted then gunFarm.inventoryAt=now+3 end
 return gunFarm.inventory~=nil
end
function gunFarm.money()
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
 local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
 return value and tonumber(value.Value)
end
function gunFarm.npc(name)
 if not name then return nil end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now>=(gunFarm.npcAt or 0)then
  gunFarm.npcAt=now+.75;gunFarm.npcs={}
  local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
  if folder then for _,object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do
   local body=raidCombat.body(object)
   if body then gunFarm.npcs[Core.styleKey(Core.normalizeName(object.Name))]=body end
  end end
 end
 local body=gunFarm.npcs and gunFarm.npcs[Core.styleKey(Core.normalizeName(name))]
 if body and body.Parent then return body.Position end
end
function gunFarm.island(name)
 for _,row in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[gunFarm.sea]or{})do
  if row[1]==name then return Vector3.new(row[2][1],row[2][2],row[2][3])end
 end
end
function gunFarm.travel(root,position,message)
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release()
 if not position then holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil);gunFarm.note(message.." · жду загрузки места");return false end
 holdPosition(root,position,nil)
 if (root.Position-position).Magnitude>8 then gunFarm.note("Лечу: "..message);return false end
 return true
end
function gunFarm.purchase(root,row,command,args,npc,island)
 local now=os.clock()
 local position=gunFarm.npc(npc or row.npc)
 if not position then
  gunFarm.travel(root,gunFarm.island(island or row.island),"Ищу "..tostring(npc or row.npc));return
 end
 if not gunFarm.travel(root,position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),row.name.." — торговец")then return end
 if not acquisition.purchaseReady(gunFarm,row,root)then return end
 if gunFarm.pendingBuy and gunFarm.pendingBuy.name~=row.name then gunFarm.pendingBuy=nil;gunFarm.buyAttempts=0 end
 if gunFarm.pendingBuy then
  if now-gunFarm.pendingBuy.at<4 then gunFarm.note("Проверяю получение: "..row.name);return end
  gunFarm.buyAttempts=(gunFarm.buyAttempts or 0)+1;gunFarm.pendingBuy=nil
  if gunFarm.buyAttempts>=3 then
   if row.route=="dealer"then gunFarm.buyAttempts=0;gunFarm.requestAt=now+15;gunFarm.note("Waiting for — торговец stock: "..row.name)
   else acquisition.pause(gunFarm,"Покупка не подтвердилась: "..row.name.." · проверю требования и товар снова")end
   return
  end
 end
 if command=="BuyItem"and row.aliases and(gunFarm.buyAttempts or 0)>0 then args={row.aliases[gunFarm.buyAttempts]or row.name}end
 if gunFarm.invoke(command,args,function(reply)
  if gunFarm.pendingBuy then gunFarm.pendingBuy.replied=true end
  gunFarm.note("NPC reply: "..tostring(reply).." · checking actual "..row.name)
  gunFarm.inventoryAt=0
  if not gunFarm.inventoryReliable then gunFarm.probed=false;gunFarm.probeAt=os.clock()+1;gunFarm.probeIndex=0 end
 end)then
  if not gunFarm.inventoryReliable then gunFarm.unverifiedBuy=row.name end
  gunFarm.pendingBuy={at=now,name=row.name,balance=acquisition.balance(gunFarm,row)};gunFarm.note("Покупаю "..row.name.." · жду подтверждения в инвентаре")
 end
end
function gunFarm.dealer(root,row)
 local now=os.clock()
 if not gunFarm.npc("Legendary Gun Dealer")then
  local islands=TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[gunFarm.sea]or{}
  gunFarm.routeIndex=gunFarm.routeIndex or 1
  local island=islands[gunFarm.routeIndex]
  if island then
   local position=Vector3.new(island[2][1],island[2][2],island[2][3])+Vector3.new(0,20,0)
   if gunFarm.travel(root,position,"Ищу Legendary Gun Dealer")then
    if now>(gunFarm.routeAt or 0)then gunFarm.routeIndex=gunFarm.routeIndex%#islands+1;gunFarm.routeAt=now+2 end
   end
  end
  return
 end
 gunFarm.purchase(root,row,"LegendaryGunDealer",{row.dealer},"Legendary Gun Dealer")
end
function gunFarm.fight(root,human,rows,mastery)
 local target,distance=nil,math.huge
 for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates(root)or{})do
  if candidate.health>0 then
   for _,name in ipairs(rows)do
    if Core.normalizeName(candidate.name)==Core.normalizeName(name)and candidate.distance<distance then target=candidate;distance=candidate.distance end
   end
  end
 end
 if not target then releaseNativeClick();return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 local mode=mastery and "Gun"or CONFIG.WeaponType
 local weapon,reason
 if mastery then
  weapon=gunFarm.tool(mastery)
  if not weapon then
   local item=gunFarm.owned(mastery)
   if item and now>=(gunFarm.loadAt or 0)then
    gunFarm.invoke("LoadItem",{item.Name},function()gunFarm.loadAt=os.clock()+3 end)
   end
   if not state.gunfarm then return true end
   gunFarm.note("Достаю оружие для мастерства: "..mastery.name);return true
  end
  if weapon.Parent~=localPlayer.Character then human:EquipTool(weapon);releaseNativeClick();return true end
 else weapon,reason=prepareFirstSlot(localPlayer.Character,human,now,mode)end
 if not weapon then gunFarm.note(reason or "Ожидаю оружие из Auto Farm");return true end
 local position=combatPosition(weapon,target,now)
 holdPosition(root,position,target.model)
 if target.distance>CONFIG.FarmRadius then releaseNativeClick();gunFarm.note("Лечу к "..target.name);return true end
 if now-lastAttack<ATTACK_INTERVAL then return true end
 local generation=gunFarm.generation
 local function ready()
  return state.gunfarm and gunFarm.generation==generation and gunFarm.sea==SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
   and target.humanoid.Health>0 and weapon.Parent==localPlayer.Character and weapon.Enabled~=false
 end
 if not ready()then return true end
 lastAttack=now
 local backend,message
 if mode=="Fruit"then
  local point,aimReason=elite.aim(target)
  if point then backend=fruit.attack(weapon,target,now,false)else message=aimReason end
 elseif mode=="Gun"then backend,message=elite.shoot(weapon,target,now,ready)
 else
  backend,message=raidCombat.attack(weapon,{target},root,nil,combatProbe.mode,now,target.name,ready)
  if backend then Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)end
 end
 gunFarm.note((mastery and "Мастерство: "..mastery.name or gunFarm.selected.name).." · "..target.name.." · "..tostring(backend or message or "waiting"))
 return true
end
function gunFarm.grind(root,human,reason,mastery)
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
