 local level=data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
 local quest=Core.selectQuest(QUESTS[gunFarm.sea],level and level.Value,gunFarm.sea)
 if not quest then acquisition.pause(gunFarm,"Жду подходящий квест / данные уровня для этого моря");return end
 local visible,title,complete=questUI()
 if visible==nil then
  if not gunFarm.fight(root,human,{quest[4]},mastery)then approachSpawn(root,quest,os.clock())end
  gunFarm.note(reason.." · farming enemies while quest UI is unavailable");return
 end
 if visible and complete then releaseNativeClick();gunFarm.note(reason.." · жду награду за квест");return end
 if visible and not Core.questMatches(title,quest[4])then
  -- Keep an existing normal quest; never abandon player progress to force a money route.
  local active=Core.activeQuest(QUESTS[gunFarm.sea],title)
  if not active then acquisition.pause(gunFarm,"Завершите или отмените неизвестный текущий квест",5);return end
  quest=active
 end
 if not visible then
  if os.clock()<(gunFarm.questFallbackUntil or 0)then
   if not gunFarm.fight(root,human,{quest[4]},mastery)then approachSpawn(root,quest,os.clock())end
   gunFarm.note(reason.." · farming enemies; retrying unconfirmed quest shortly");return
  end
  local position=questNpcPosition(quest)
  if not gunFarm.travel(root,position and position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),reason.." · к NPC квеста")then return end
  local now=os.clock()
  if now<(gunFarm.questAt or 0)then gunFarm.note("Жду подтверждения квеста");return end
  gunFarm.questAttempts=(gunFarm.questAttempts or 0)+1
  if gunFarm.questAttempts>3 then gunFarm.questAttempts=0;gunFarm.questFallbackUntil=now+30;gunFarm.note("Quest not confirmed · continuing enemy farm");return end
  if gunFarm.invoke("StartQuest",{quest[2],quest[3]},function()end)then gunFarm.questAt=now+4 end
  return
 end
 gunFarm.questAttempts=0
 if not gunFarm.fight(root,human,{quest[4]},mastery)then
  approachSpawn(root,quest,os.clock());gunFarm.note(reason.." · ожидаю "..quest[4])
 end
end
function gunFarm.initialDestination(row,root)
 if row.price then
  local money=gunFarm.money()
  if money and money<row.price then
   local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
   local level=data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
   local quest=Core.selectQuest(QUESTS[gunFarm.sea],level and level.Value,gunFarm.sea)
   local npc=quest and questNpcPosition(quest)
   if npc then return npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0)end
  end
 end
 local npc=row.npc and gunFarm.npc(row.npc)
 if npc then return npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0)end
 if row.route=="dealer"or row.route=="ttk"then
  npc=gunFarm.npc("Legendary Gun Dealer")
  if npc then return npc+Vector3.new(0,2,0)end
 end
 local position=gunFarm.island(row.island or(row.route=="dealer"and "Green Zone"))
 return position and position+Vector3.new(0,FARM_HEIGHT,0)
end
function gunFarm.step()
 if disposed or not state.gunfarm then return end
 if gunFarm.sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then gunFarm.stop("Sea changed; choose a sword again");return end
 if gunFarm.phase=="complete"or gunFarm.phase=="blocked"then return end
 if acquisition.waiting(gunFarm)then return end
 gunFarm.phase="running"
 local row=gunFarm.selected
 if not row then gunFarm.note("Включено. Выберите оружие ниже — маршрут запустится сразу.");return end
 if row.route=="quest"then gunFarm.phase="blocked";gunFarm.note("Маршрут "..row.name.." пока не реализован. Выберите другое оружие.");return end
 local character=localPlayer.Character
 local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 then gunFarm.note("Ожидаю персонажа / возрождения…");return end
 if gunFarm.character~=character then
  gunFarm.character=character;haki.begin(character,"gunfarm")
 end
 if gunFarm.owned(row)then acquisition.complete(gunFarm,row);return end
 human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character);stopMovement()
 if haki.step(character,human,root)then return end
 if haki.bootstrap and not haki.learned then
  local money=gunFarm.money()or 0
  gunFarm.grind(root,human,"Haki: коплю "..math.floor(money).." / 25000 Beli");return
 end
 local now=os.clock()
 if gunFarm.owned(row)then acquisition.complete(gunFarm,row);return end
 local loaded=gunFarm.readInventory(now)
 if not state.gunfarm or gunFarm.phase=="waiting"then return end
 if gunFarm.owned(row)then acquisition.complete(gunFarm,row);return end
 if acquisition.awaitingPaid(gunFarm,row)then return end
 if not gunFarm.inventoryReliable then acquisition.probe(gunFarm,row,now)end
 if row.price then
  local money=gunFarm.money()
  if not money then acquisition.pause(gunFarm,"Data.Beli недоступно — покупка приостановлена",5);return end
  if money<row.price then gunFarm.grind(root,human,"Коплю Beli: "..math.floor(money).." / "..row.price);return end
 end
 if row.route=="fragments"then
  local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
  local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("Fragments")
  local count=value and tonumber(value.Value)
  if not count then gunFarm.note("Жду значение Fragments");return end
  if count<row.fragments then
   -- Farm fragments from a supported naturally recurring NPC event; do not buy/consume a raid chip.
   if not gunFarm.fight(root,human,{"Darkbeard","Cursed Captain"})then
    gunFarm.travel(root,gunFarm.island("Cursed Ship"),"Фрагменты "..count.." / "..row.fragments.." · жду Cursed Captain / Darkbeard")
   end
   return
  end
  gunFarm.purchase(root,row,row.command,row.args);return
 end
 if row.route=="shop"then gunFarm.purchase(root,row,"BuyItem",{row.name});return end
 if row.route=="dealer"then gunFarm.dealer(root,row);return end
 if row.route=="drop"then
  if not gunFarm.fight(root,human,row.enemies)then
   local hint=acquisition.destination(gunFarm,row,root)
   holdPosition(root,hint and hint+Vector3.new(0,FARM_HEIGHT,0)or root.Position,nil)
   gunFarm.note(row.name.." · ожидаю "..table.concat(row.enemies," / ")..(row.detail and " · "..row.detail or ""))
  end
  return
 end
 if row.route=="ectoplasm"then
  local count=gunFarm.material("Ectoplasm")
  if count>=(row.materialCount or 25)then gunFarm.purchase(root,row,"Ectoplasm",{"Buy",row.ectoplasmId or 1});return end
  if not gunFarm.fight(root,human,{"Ship Deckhand","Ship Engineer","Ship Steward","Ship Officer","Cursed Captain"})then
   gunFarm.travel(root,gunFarm.island("Cursed Ship"),"Ectoplasm "..count.." / "..tostring(row.materialCount or 25))
  end
  return
 end
 if row.route=="key"then
  local key=gunFarm.tool({name="Hidden Key"})
  if key then
   if key.Parent~=character then human:EquipTool(key);return end
   -- Existing Ice Castle chest; contact consumes the key and inventory confirms Rengoku.
   gunFarm.travel(root,Vector3.new(6571,297,-6967),"Открываю сундук Rengoku");return
  end
  if not gunFarm.fight(root,human,{"Awakened Ice Admiral","Arctic Warrior","Snow Lurker"})then
   gunFarm.travel(root,gunFarm.island("Ice Castle"),"Hidden Key · ожидаю Ice Castle enemies")
  end
  return
 end
 if row.route=="ttk"then
  for _,blade in ipairs(gunFarm.catalog[2])do
   if blade.route=="dealer"then
    local item=gunFarm.owned(blade)
    if not item then
     gunFarm.dealer(root,blade);return
    end
    local tool=gunFarm.tool(blade)
    local level=tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Level")
    local mastery=level and tonumber(level.Value)or tonumber(item.Mastery)or 0
    if mastery<300 then gunFarm.grind(root,human,blade.name.." — мастерство "..mastery.." / 300",blade);return end
   end
  end
  gunFarm.purchase(root,row,"MysteriousMan",{"2"});return
 end
end


function eventFarm.note(message)
 if eventFarm.label and eventFarm.label.Text~=message then eventFarm.label.Text=message end
end
function eventFarm.position(row)
 for _,island in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[eventFarm.sea]or{})do
  if island[1]==row.island then return Vector3.new(island[2][1],island[2][2],island[2][3])end
 end
end
function eventFarm.matches(row,candidate)
 if row.family=="seabeast"then
  local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("SeaBeasts")
  return candidate.model.Parent==folder or Core.styleKey(candidate.name):find("seabeast",1,true)~=nil
 end
 local matches=false
 for _,name in ipairs(row.enemies or{})do
  if Core.normalizeName(candidate.name)==Core.normalizeName(name)then matches=true;break end
 end
 if not matches then return false end
 if row.radius then
  local center=eventFarm.position(row)
  if not center or(candidate.part.Position-center).Magnitude>row.radius then return false end
 end
 return true
end
function eventFarm.health(model)
 local human=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if human then return human.Health,human end
 local value=model:FindFirstChild("Health")
 if value and(value:IsA("NumberValue")or value:IsA("IntValue"))then return value.Value end
 return tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Health"))
end
function eventFarm.targets(root)
 local list=candidates(root)or{}
 local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("SeaBeasts")
 if folder~=eventFarm.extraFolder or os.clock()>=(eventFarm.extraAt or 0)then
  eventFarm.extraFolder=folder;eventFarm.extraModels=folder and folder:GetChildren()or{};eventFarm.extraAt=os.clock()+.5
 end
 for _,model in ipairs(eventFarm.extraModels or{})do
  if model.Parent==folder and model:IsA("Model")then
   local health,human=eventFarm.health(model)
   local part=raidCombat.body(model)or model.PrimaryPart
   if health and health>0 and part and part:IsA("BasePart")then
    table.insert(list,{model=model,name=model.Name,humanoid=human or{Health=health},health=health,
     part=part,distance=(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude})
   end
  end
 end
 return list
end
function eventFarm.ignoreSeaTarget(model,now)
 eventFarm.ignoredSea=eventFarm.ignoredSea or{}
 table.insert(eventFarm.ignoredSea,{model=model,untilTime=now+45})
end
function eventFarm.seaTargetIgnored(model,now)
 local live={};local ignored=false
 for _,entry in ipairs(eventFarm.ignoredSea or{})do
  if entry.untilTime>now and entry.model.Parent then
   table.insert(live,entry);if entry.model==model then ignored=true end
  end
 end
 eventFarm.ignoredSea=live;return ignored
end
function eventFarm.chooseTarget(root,row,now)
 local sea=eventFarm.seaEvent(row);local best,distance=nil,math.huge
 local locked=eventFarm.encounter
 for _,candidate in ipairs(eventFarm.targets(root))do
  if candidate.model.Parent and candidate.part.Parent and candidate.health>0 and eventFarm.matches(row,candidate)then
   local d=(candidate.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
   local owned=false
   if row.family=="seabeast"then
    for _,key in ipairs({"Owner","OwnerName","OwnerUserId","PlayerOwner","Summoner"})do
     local value=candidate.model:GetAttribute(key);local child=candidate.model:FindFirstChild(key)
     if child and child:IsA("ValueBase")then value=child.Value end
     if value~=nil and value~=false and value~=""and value~=0 then owned=true;break end
    end
   end
   if not owned and(not sea or d<=(locked and locked.model==candidate.model and 2400 or 1600))and not eventFarm.seaTargetIgnored(candidate.model,now)then
    candidate.distance=d
    if locked and locked.model==candidate.model then return candidate end
    if d<distance then best=candidate;distance=d end
   end
  end
 end
 -- A transient streamed-out list must not immediately switch between boat and combat.
 if sea and locked and now-(locked.lastSeen or 0)<1.25 and locked.model.Parent and locked.part.Parent then
  local health=eventFarm.health(locked.model)
  local d=(locked.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
  if health and health>0 and d<=2400 and not eventFarm.seaTargetIgnored(locked.model,now)then
   locked.entry.health=health;locked.entry.distance=d;return locked.entry
  end
 end
 return best
end
function eventFarm.trackEncounter(target,now)
 local e=eventFarm.encounter
 if not e or e.model~=target.model then
  e={model=target.model,part=target.part,entry=target,lastHealth=target.health,lastSeen=now,
   progressAt=now,approachDistance=target.distance};eventFarm.encounter=e
 end
 e.lastSeen=now;e.entry=target;e.part=target.part
 if target.health<e.lastHealth or target.distance<e.approachDistance-10 then e.progressAt=now;e.approachDistance=target.distance end
 e.lastHealth=target.health
 if target.distance>CONFIG.FarmRadius then e.inRangeAt=nil;return false end
 e.inRangeAt=e.inRangeAt or now
 if now-math.max(e.inRangeAt,e.progressAt)>20 then
  eventFarm.ignoreSeaTarget(target.model,now);eventFarm.encounter=nil
  releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();stopHover()
  return true
 end
 return false
end

function eventFarm.step()
 if disposed or not state.events then return end
 if eventFarm.sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then eventFarm.stop("Sea changed · choose an event again");return end
 local row=eventFarm.selected
 if not row then eventFarm.note("Choose an event from the current sea");return end
 local character=localPlayer.Character
 local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 then eventFarm.stop("Character unavailable · stopped");return end
 stopMovement();ensureAura(character,true)
 local now=os.clock()
 local target,distance=nil,math.huge
 if eventFarm.seaEvent(row)and not eventFarm.departed then eventFarm.sail(root,human,now);return end
 target=eventFarm.chooseTarget(root,row,now)
 if not target then
  releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();eventFarm.target=nil;eventFarm.seenAt=nil
  if eventFarm.seaEvent(row)then eventFarm.encounter=nil;eventFarm.sail(root,human,now);return end
  human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character)
  local position=eventFarm.position(row)
  holdPosition(root,position and position+Vector3.new(0,50,0)or root.Position,nil)
  eventFarm.note("Waiting for "..row.name..(row.island and " at "..row.island or " · needs a live sea event / nearby boat"));return
 end
 if eventFarm.seaEvent(row)and eventFarm.trackEncounter(target,now)then
  eventFarm.sail(root,human,now);eventFarm.note("No confirmed damage · sailing to search for another "..row.name);return
 end
 eventFarm.releaseSailing();human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(character)
 if human.SeatPart then human:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp);return end
 if eventFarm.target~=target.model then eventFarm.target=target.model;eventFarm.seenAt=now;fruit.release();combatProbe=nil end
 if row.factory and now-eventFarm.seenAt>285 then
  releaseNativeClick();fruit.release()
  local outside=eventFarm.position(row)
  holdPosition(root,outside and outside+Vector3.new(0,80,0)or root.Position+Vector3.new(0,80,0),nil)
  eventFarm.note("Factory timeout · retreating; waiting for next event");return
 end
 local mode=CONFIG.WeaponType
 local weapon,reason=prepareFirstSlot(character,human,now,mode)
 if not weapon then holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil);eventFarm.note(reason or "Waiting for Auto Farm weapon");return end
 local position=combatPosition(weapon,target,now)
 holdPosition(root,position,target.model)
 if target.distance>CONFIG.FarmRadius then releaseNativeClick();eventFarm.note("Flying to "..row.name);return end
 local generation=eventFarm.generation
 local function ready()
  local health=eventFarm.health(target.model)
  return state.events and eventFarm.generation==generation and eventFarm.selected==row and eventFarm.sea==SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
   and CONFIG.WeaponType==mode and target.model.Parent and health and health>0 and eventFarm.matches(row,target)
   and weapon.Parent==character and weapon.Enabled~=false
 end
 if not ready()or now-lastAttack<ATTACK_INTERVAL then return end
 lastAttack=now
 local backend,message
 if mode=="Fruit"or row.skills then
  local point,aimReason=elite.aim(target)
  if point then
   local skills=mode=="Fruit"and(fruit.skillsSelected()and CONFIG.FruitSkills or elite.defaultFruitSkills)or{Z=true,X=true,C=true,V=true}
   backend=fruit.cast(weapon,target,now,skills)
  else message=aimReason end
 elseif mode=="Gun"then backend,message=elite.shoot(weapon,target,now,ready)
 else
  backend,message=raidCombat.attack(weapon,{target},root,nil,combatProbe.mode,now,target.name,ready)
  if backend then Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)end
 end
 eventFarm.note(row.name.." · "..mode.." · HP "..math.ceil(target.health).." · "..tostring(backend or message or "waiting"))
end

-- Camera/cursor aim and fighting-style M1 automation. Server hit rules and cooldowns still apply.
function combatAssist.note(kind,message)
    local control=combatAssist[kind]
    if control.label and control.label.Text~=message then control.label.Text=message end
end
function combatAssist.busy()
    return state.farm or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events or state.berry
        or state.autofruits or state.raid and (raidRunning or raidHost.moving) or teleport.flight
end
function combatAssist.inputReady()
    if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
    if combatAssist.guiService and combatAssist.guiService.MenuIsOpen then return false end
    local ok,focused=pcall(function()return UserInputService:IsWindowFocused()end)
    return not ok or focused
end
function combatAssist.localBody()
    local character=localPlayer.Character
    local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if human and human.Health>0 and root then return character,human,root end
end
function combatAssist.aimTarget()
    local selected=combatAssist.aim.player
    if not selected or selected==localPlayer or selected.Parent~=Players then return nil end
    local character=selected.Character
    local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local part=character and(character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or character:FindFirstChild("Head"))
    if human and human.Health>0 and part and part:IsA("BasePart")then return selected,character,human,part end
end
function combatAssist.releaseAim()
    local aim=combatAssist.aim
    if aim.human and aim.autoRotate~=nil then pcall(function()aim.human.AutoRotate=aim.autoRotate end)end
    aim.human=nil;aim.autoRotate=nil;aim.nextPointer=0
end
function combatAssist.setAim(enabled)
    if not enabled then
        state.aimbot=false;combatAssist.releaseAim()
        if combatAssist.aim.bound then RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(combatAssist.aim.bindName);combatAssist.aim.bound=false end
        if controls.aimbot and not disposed then controls.aimbot(false)end
        combatAssist.note("aim","Выключено");return
    end
    if not combatAssist.aim.player or combatAssist.aim.player.Parent~=Players then
        combatAssist.note("aim","Сначала выберите игрока из списка сервера");return
    end
    state.aimbot=true;initializeInput()
    if controls.aimbot then controls.aimbot(true)end
    if not combatAssist.aim.bound then
        combatAssist.aim.bindName=combatAssist.aim.bindName or "ViltrumAim_"..tostring(os.clock())
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(combatAssist.aim.bindName,Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,function()
            local ok,message=pcall(combatAssist.aimTick)
            if not ok then combatAssist.setAim(false);combatAssist.note("aim","Ошибка наведения: "..tostring(message))end
        end)
        combatAssist.aim.bound=true
    end
    combatAssist.note("aim","Наведение: @"..combatAssist.aim.player.Name)
end
function combatAssist.selectPlayer(player)
    if player==localPlayer or player.Parent~=Players then return end
    combatAssist.releaseAim();combatAssist.aim.player=player
    combatAssist.note("aim",(state.aimbot and "Наведение: @"or "Выбран @")..player.Name)
    if combatAssist.redrawPlayers then combatAssist.redrawPlayers()end
end
function combatAssist.pointerSafe(point)
    if not window.Visible then return true end
    local p,s=window.AbsolutePosition,window.AbsoluteSize
    return point.X<p.X or point.X>p.X+s.X or point.Y<p.Y or point.Y>p.Y+s.Y
end
function combatAssist.aimTick()
    if disposed or not state.aimbot then return end
    if combatAssist.busy()or not combatAssist.inputReady()then combatAssist.releaseAim();combatAssist.note("aim","Пауза: фарм, полёт или ввод текста");return end
    local character,human,root=combatAssist.localBody()
    local player,target,targetHuman,part=combatAssist.aimTarget()
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not character or not player or not camera then combatAssist.releaseAim();combatAssist.note("aim","Ожидаю живого персонажа / выбранного игрока");return end
    if camera.CameraType==Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then combatAssist.releaseAim();combatAssist.note("aim","Пауза: камера занята сценой игры");return end
    local position=part.Position
    if(position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude>.01 then camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position,position)end
    if not human.Sit and not root.Anchored then
        if combatAssist.aim.human~=human then
            combatAssist.releaseAim();combatAssist.aim.human=human;combatAssist.aim.autoRotate=human.AutoRotate;human.AutoRotate=false
        end
        local facing=Vector3.new(position.X,root.Position.Y,position.Z)
        if(facing-root.Position).Magnitude>.01 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,facing)end
    else combatAssist.releaseAim()end
    local now=os.clock()
    if now>=(combatAssist.aim.nextPointer or 0)then
        combatAssist.aim.nextPointer=now+.05
        local point,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(position)
        local aimed=false
        if visible and point.Z>0 and combatAssist.pointerSafe(point)then
            for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
                if pcall(backend.aim,Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y))then aimed=true;break end
            end
        end
        combatAssist.note("aim","@"..player.Name..(aimed and " · камера + курсор"or " · камера; курсор недоступен / закрыт меню"))
    end
end
function combatAssist.releaseTrigger()
    if combatAssist.trigger.tool then pcall(function()combatAssist.trigger.tool:Deactivate()end)end
    combatAssist.trigger.tool=nil
end
function combatAssist.setTrigger(enabled)
    state.triggerbot=enabled==true;combatAssist.releaseTrigger()
    combatAssist.trigger.lastPunch=-math.huge;combatAssist.trigger.nextScan=0
    combatAssist.trigger.revision=(combatAssist.trigger.revision or 0)+1
    if controls.triggerbot and not disposed then controls.triggerbot(state.triggerbot)end
    combatAssist.note("trigger",state.triggerbot and "Включено · ожидаю цели в радиусе"or "Выключено")
end
function combatAssist.configure(key,value)
    if key=="radius"then value=math.floor(math.clamp(tonumber(value)or 25,10,45))
    elseif key=="mode"then if value~="Fast Attack"and value~="Normal Attack"then return end
    elseif key=="scope"then if value~="players"and value~="npcs"and value~="bosses"and value~="all"then return end
    else return end
    combatAssist.trigger[key]=value;combatAssist.trigger.nextScan=0
    combatAssist.trigger.revision=(combatAssist.trigger.revision or 0)+1;combatAssist.releaseTrigger()
    if combatAssist.redrawTrigger then combatAssist.redrawTrigger()end
end
function combatAssist.isBoss(model)
    return model:GetAttribute("IsBoss")==true or combatAssist.bossNames[Core.normalizeName(model.Name)]==true
        or model.Name:lower():find("[boss]",1,true)~=nil or model.Name:lower():find("[raid boss]",1,true)~=nil
end
function combatAssist.validTarget(entry,root)
    if not entry or not entry.model.Parent or entry.model==localPlayer.Character or entry.part.Parent~=entry.model
        or entry.human.Parent~=entry.model or entry.human.Health<=0 then return false end
    if entry.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")then return false end
    if entry.player then
        if entry.player==localPlayer or entry.player.Parent~=Players or entry.player.Character~=entry.model then return false end
    elseif entry.model.Parent~=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")then return false end
    local scope=combatAssist.trigger.scope
    if scope~="all"and(scope=="players"and not entry.player or scope=="npcs"and(entry.player or entry.boss)
        or scope=="bosses"and(entry.player or not entry.boss))then return false end
    return(entry.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=combatAssist.trigger.radius
end
function combatAssist.targets(root,now)
    local trigger=combatAssist.trigger
    if now>=(trigger.nextScan or 0)then
        trigger.nextScan=now+.1;trigger.candidates={}
        if trigger.scope=="players"or trigger.scope=="all"then
            for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
                if player~=localPlayer then
                    local model=player.Character
                    local human=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local part=model and raidCombat.body(model)
                    if human and part then table.insert(trigger.candidates,{player=player,model=model,human=human,part=part})end
                end
            end
        end
        if trigger.scope~="players"then
            for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates(root)or{})do
                if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(candidate.model)then
                    table.insert(trigger.candidates,{model=candidate.model,human=candidate.humanoid,part=candidate.part,boss=combatAssist.isBoss(candidate.model)})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local hits,primary,nearest={},nil,math.huge
    for _,entry in ipairs(trigger.candidates or{})do
        if combatAssist.validTarget(entry,root)then
            table.insert(hits,{entry.model,raidCombat.hitPart(entry.model)or entry.part})
            local distance=(entry.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
            if distance<nearest then nearest=distance;primary=entry end
        end
    end
    return hits,primary
end
function combatAssist.melee(tool,character)
    if not tool or tool.Parent~=character or tool.Enabled==false or not tool:IsA("Tool")then return false end
    local category=tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType")or tool:GetAttribute("Category")or tool:GetAttribute("Type")
    return Core.isFightingStyle(tool.Name,tool.ToolTip,category)
end
function combatAssist.triggerTick(now)
    if disposed or not state.triggerbot then return end
    if combatAssist.busy()or not combatAssist.inputReady()or fruit.held then
        combatAssist.releaseTrigger();combatAssist.note("trigger","Пауза: фарм, навык, полёт или ввод текста");return
    end
    local character,human,root=combatAssist.localBody()
    if not character then combatAssist.releaseTrigger();combatAssist.note("trigger","Ожидаю персонажа");return end
    local hits,primary=combatAssist.targets(root,now)
    if #hits==0 then combatAssist.releaseTrigger();combatAssist.note("trigger","Нет выбранных целей в радиусе "..combatAssist.trigger.radius);return end
    local tool,reason=prepareFirstSlot(character,human,now,"Melee")
    if not combatAssist.melee(tool,character)then
        combatAssist.releaseTrigger();combatAssist.note("trigger",reason or "Нужен файтинговый стиль — только кулаки");return
    end
    if not raidCombat.auraReady(character)then combatAssist.releaseTrigger();combatAssist.note("trigger","Жду включения Haki · "..auraStatus);return end
    local trigger=combatAssist.trigger
    local interval=trigger.mode=="Fast Attack"and .05 or .35
    if now-(trigger.lastPunch or -math.huge)<interval then return end
    local revision=trigger.revision
    local function ready()
        return not disposed and state.triggerbot and trigger.revision==revision and not combatAssist.busy()
            and combatAssist.inputReady()and human.Health>0 and localPlayer.Character==character
            and combatAssist.melee(tool,character)and raidCombat.auraReady(character)
    end
    if not ready()then combatAssist.releaseTrigger();return end
    hits,primary=combatAssist.targets(root,now)
    if #hits==0 then combatAssist.releaseTrigger();return end
    trigger.lastPunch=now;trigger.tool=tool
    if not state.aimbot then
        local position=Vector3.new(primary.part.Position.X,root.Position.Y,primary.part.Position.Z)
        if(position-root.Position).Magnitude>.01 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,position)end
    end
    -- Some First Sea fighting styles listen to native mouse input rather than
    -- Tool.Activate. Use the shared input path, including its Tool fallback.
    local backend,attackReason=nativeAttack(tool,now,.04)
    if not backend then combatAssist.note("trigger",attackReason or "Waiting for M1 input");return end
    if trigger.mode=="Fast Attack"and ready()then
        local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local net=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("Net")
        local attack=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterAttack")
        local hit=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit")
        if attack and hit and attack:IsA("RemoteEvent")and hit:IsA("RemoteEvent")then
            if not ready()then return end
            attack:FireServer(interval)
            if not ready()then return end
            hits=combatAssist.targets(root,now)
            if #hits>0 then hit:FireServer(hits[1][2],hits)end
        end
    end
    combatAssist.note("trigger",trigger.mode.." · M1 · "..#hits.." целей · "..trigger.radius.." блоков")
end
do
    combatAssist.guiService=game:GetService("GuiService");combatAssist.bossNames={}
    for _,rows in pairs(boss.catalog)do for _,row in ipairs(rows)do
        combatAssist.bossNames[Core.normalizeName(row.name)]=true
        for _,alias in ipairs(row.aliases or{})do combatAssist.bossNames[Core.normalizeName(alias)]=true end
    end end
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function()
        if not state.triggerbot then return end
        local ok,message=pcall(combatAssist.triggerTick,os.clock())
        if not ok then combatAssist.setTrigger(false);combatAssist.note("trigger","Ошибка M1: "..tostring(message))end
    end)
end

function progressFarm.note(message)
 local label=progressFarm.labels and progressFarm.labels[progressFarm.mode]
 if label and label.Text~=message then label.Text=message end
 progressFarm.message=message
end
function progressFarm.releaseDelegate()
 if progressFarm.elite then elite.stop();progressFarm.elite=nil end
 if progressFarm.event then
  eventFarm.stop();eventFarm.selected=progressFarm.previousEvent;eventFarm.sea=progressFarm.previousSea
  progressFarm.previousEvent=nil;progressFarm.previousSea=nil;progressFarm.event=nil
  if eventFarm.redrawSelection then eventFarm.redrawSelection()end
 end
end
function progressFarm.stop(message)
 progressFarm.chestStop()
 teleport.releaseTransport(progressFarm.transport);progressFarm.transport=nil;progressFarm.allIslandArrived=nil
 progressFarm.mirageReset()
 local active=state.resourcefarm
 if message then progressFarm.note(message)end
 state.resourcefarm=false
 for _,key in ipairs({"ectoplasm","bones","metal","dojo","mirage","allisland","chest"})do
  state[key]=false;if controls[key]and not disposed then controls[key](false)end
 end
 progressFarm.generation=(progressFarm.generation or 0)+1
 for _,key in ipairs({"request","timer","scanJob","hudJob"})do
  if progressFarm[key]then task.cancel(progressFarm[key]);progressFarm[key]=nil end
 end
 if progressFarm.mouse then pcall(progressFarm.mouse.backend.mouse,false,progressFarm.mouse.point);progressFarm.mouse=nil end
 if progressFarm.prompt then pcall(function()progressFarm.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);progressFarm.prompt=nil end
 progressFarm.sailStop();progressFarm.checkTrainerAt=0
 progressFarm.releaseDelegate();progressFarm.inventory=nil;progressFarm.inventoryAt=0
 progressFarm.stage=nil;progressFarm.accepted=nil;progressFarm.npc=nil;progressFarm.npcPrompt=nil;progressFarm.widgets=nil;progressFarm.hudAt=0;progressFarm.manual=false
 if active then fruit.release();releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions();cancelAuraRequest();combatProbe=nil end
end
function progressFarm.start(mode)
 if mode=="chest"then progressFarm.presets.chest={name="Auto Farm Chest",sea=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]}end
 if mode=="allisland"then
  local selected=progressFarm.farmIsland
  if not selected or selected.sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then
   if progressFarm.labels.allisland then progressFarm.labels.allisland.Text="Select an island in your current sea first"end
   return false
  end
  selected.safeAt=nil;selected.safePoint=nil
  progressFarm.presets.allisland={name="Auto Farm All Island",sea=selected.sea,island=selected.name}
 end
 local row=progressFarm.presets[mode]
 if not row then return false end
 local sea=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]
 if game.GameId~=994732206 or sea~=row.sea then
  local label=progressFarm.labels and progressFarm.labels[mode]
  if label then label.Text="Нужно море "..row.sea.." · модуль не включён"end
  return false
 end
 teleport.cancel();stopFarm();stopRaid();elite.stop();berry.stop();autoFruits.stop();boss.stop();swordFarm.stop();gunFarm.stop();eventFarm.stop()
 leviFarm.stop();autoKill.stop();progressFarm.stop()
 progressFarm.mode=mode;progressFarm.sea=sea;progressFarm.inventoryAt=0;progressFarm.hudAt=0
 state.resourcefarm=true;state[mode]=true
 if controls[mode]then controls[mode](true)end
 speedHack.restore();lastAttack=-math.huge;slotCharacter=nil
 progressFarm.note(mode=="mirage"and "Auto Island · проверяю лодку / Boat Dealer"or mode=="dojo"and "Проверяю Dragon Talon и пояса. Обмен / чужой фрукт требуют другого игрока."or "Лечу к NPC · оружие из Auto Farm")
 return false
end
function progressFarm.island(name)
 for _,row in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[progressFarm.sea]or{})do
  if row[1]==name then return Vector3.new(row[2][1],row[2][2],row[2][3])end
 end
 return progressFarm.presets[progressFarm.mode].fallback
end
function progressFarm.travel(root,position,message)
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release()
 holdPosition(root,position or root.Position,nil)
 progressFarm.lastNote=message;progressFarm.note(message)
 return position and(root.Position-position).Magnitude<10
end
function progressFarm.inventoryRead(now)
 if progressFarm.request or now<(progressFarm.inventoryAt or 0)then return end
 local folder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
 local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then progressFarm.note("Нет чтения инвентаря · Dojo приостановлен");return end
 local generation=progressFarm.generation;local thread
 thread=task.defer(function()
  if not state.resourcefarm or progressFarm.generation~=generation then return end
  local ok,result=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer("getInventory")end)
  if progressFarm.generation~=generation or progressFarm.request~=thread then return end
  progressFarm.request=nil
  if progressFarm.timer then task.cancel(progressFarm.timer);progressFarm.timer=nil end
  progressFarm.inventoryAt=os.clock()+5
  local items=ok and acquisition.inventory(result,function()return state.resourcefarm and progressFarm.generation==generation end)
  if progressFarm.generation~=generation then return end
  if items then progressFarm.inventory=items
  else progressFarm.note("Инвентарь не прочитан · повторю проверку")end
 end)
 progressFarm.request=thread
 progressFarm.timer=task.delay(8,function()
  if progressFarm.generation==generation and progressFarm.request==thread then
   progressFarm.timer=nil;task.cancel(thread);progressFarm.request=nil;progressFarm.inventoryAt=os.clock()+5
   progressFarm.note("Инвентарь не ответил · жду сервер")
  end
 end)
end
function progressFarm.beltStage()
 local highest=0
 for _,item in pairs(progressFarm.inventory or{})do
  if type(item)=="table"and type(item.Name)=="string"then
   local name=Core.styleKey(item.Name)
   for index,color in ipairs(progressFarm.belts)do
    if name==Core.styleKey("Dojo Belt ("..color..")")or name==Core.styleKey(color.." Belt")then highest=math.max(highest,index)end
   end
  end
 end
 return highest+1
end
function progressFarm.talon()
 for _,container in ipairs({localPlayer.Character,localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")})do
  if container then for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if tool:IsA("Tool")and Core.styleKey(tool.Name)=="dragontalon"then
    local level=tool:FindFirstChild("Level")
    return tool,level and tonumber(level.Value)or tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Mastery"))
   end
  end end
 end
end
function progressFarm.fight(root,human,rows,exactTool,skillsOnly,filter)
 local target,nearest=nil,math.huge
 for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates(root)or{})do
  if candidate.health>0 and(not filter or filter(candidate))then for _,name in ipairs(rows)do
   if Core.normalizeName(candidate.name)==Core.normalizeName(name)and candidate.distance<nearest then target=candidate;nearest=candidate.distance end
  end end
 end
 if not target then releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();return false end
 local character=localPlayer.Character;local now=os.clock();local mode=exactTool and "Melee"or CONFIG.WeaponType
 local tool,reason
 if exactTool then
  tool=exactTool
  if tool.Parent~=character then releaseNativeClick();human:EquipTool(tool);return true end
 else tool,reason=prepareFirstSlot(character,human,now,mode)end
 if not tool then progressFarm.note(reason or "Жду выбранный предмет");return true end
 if exactTool then slotMode="Melee"end
 local position=mode=="Fruit"and target.part.Position+Vector3.new(0,fruit.attackHeight(tool,FARM_HEIGHT),0)or combatPosition(tool,target,now)
 holdPosition(root,position,target.model)
 if nearest>CONFIG.FarmRadius then releaseNativeClick();progressFarm.note("Лечу к "..target.name);return true end
 local generation=progressFarm.generation
 local function ready()
  return state.resourcefarm and progressFarm.generation==generation and SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]==progressFarm.sea
   and localPlayer.Character==character and human.Health>0 and target.model.Parent==workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
   and target.humanoid.Health>0 and tool.Parent==character and tool.Enabled~=false
   and(not filter or filter(target))and(exactTool~=nil or CONFIG.WeaponType==mode)
 end
 if not ready()or now-lastAttack<ATTACK_INTERVAL then return true end
 lastAttack=now
 local backend,message
 if mode=="Fruit"or skillsOnly then
  local point,why=elite.aim(target)
  if point and ready()then backend=mode=="Fruit"and fruit.attack(tool,target,now,false)or fruit.cast(tool,target,now,{Z=true,X=true,C=true,V=true})else message=why end
 elseif mode=="Gun"then backend,message=elite.shoot(tool,target,now,ready)
 else
  backend,message=raidCombat.attack(tool,{target},root,nil,combatProbe.mode,now,target.name,ready)
  if backend then Core.noteCombatAttempt(combatProbe,now)end
 end
 progressFarm.note(target.name.." · "..mode.." · "..tostring(backend or message or "жду Haki / атаку"));return true
end
function progressFarm.levelFarm(root,human,tool)
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
 local level=value and tonumber(value.Value)
 local quest=Core.selectQuest(QUESTS[progressFarm.sea],level,progressFarm.sea)
 if not quest or not level or math.abs(level-quest[1])>100 then
  progressFarm.note("Нет проверенного NPC в пределах 100 уровней · нужен новый маршрут");return
 end
 if not progressFarm.fight(root,human,{quest[4]},tool)then
  approachSpawn(root,quest,os.clock());progressFarm.note("Лечу к "..quest[4]..(tool and " · мастерство Dragon Talon"or " · задание Dojo"))
 end
end
function progressFarm.visible(object)
 local current=object
 while current and current~=playerGui do
  if current:IsA("GuiObject")and not current.Visible then return false end
  if current:IsA("ScreenGui")and not current.Enabled then return false end
  current=current.Parent
 end
 return current==playerGui
end
function progressFarm.hud(now)
 if progressFarm.hudJob or now<(progressFarm.hudAt or 0)then return end
 progressFarm.hudAt=now+.75;local generation=progressFarm.generation;local widgets={}
 progressFarm.hudJob=perf.walk(playerGui,function(object)
  if object==gui then return false end
  if object:IsA("TextLabel")or object:IsA("TextButton")then table.insert(widgets,object)end
 end,function()return(state.dojo or state.mirage)and progressFarm.generation==generation end,function()
  if progressFarm.generation==generation then progressFarm.hudJob=nil;progressFarm.widgets=widgets end
 end)
end
function progressFarm.questAccepted(stage)
 local lesson=Core.styleKey(progressFarm.lessons[stage]);local active=false;local done=false
 for _,object in ipairs(progressFarm.widgets or{})do
  if object.Parent and progressFarm.visible(object)and type(object.Text)=="string"then
   local name=Core.styleKey(object.Text)
   if name:find(lesson,1,true)then
    local parent=object.Parent
    while parent and parent~=playerGui do
     if Core.styleKey(parent.Name):find("quest",1,true)then
      active=true
      local count,total=object.Text:match("(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)")
      if count and tonumber(total)>0 and tonumber(count)>=tonumber(total)then done=true end
      if name:find("completed",1,true)or name:find("returntotrainer",1,true)then done=true end
      break
     end
     parent=parent.Parent
    end
   end
  end
 end
 if active then progressFarm.accepted=stage;progressFarm.questSeenAt=os.clock()end
 -- A missing/streamed-out HUD is not proof of a completed objective.
 progressFarm.questVisible=active;progressFarm.questDone=done
 return progressFarm.accepted==stage
end
function progressFarm.islandInputBusy()
 return os.clock()<(progressFarm.islandInputUntil or 0)
end
function progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI(force)
 if progressFarm.islandSavedGUI==nil then return end
 if not force and(progressFarm.mouse or raidHost.mouse or progressFarm.islandInputBusy())then return end
 gui.Enabled=progressFarm.islandSavedGUI;progressFarm.islandSavedGUI=nil
end
function progressFarm.click(point,now)
 if progressFarm.mouse or now<(progressFarm.clickAt or 0)or not combatAssist.inputReady()then return false end
 if state.mirage then
  if progressFarm.islandInputBusy()then return false end
  local generation=progressFarm.generation
  if progressFarm.islandSavedGUI==nil then progressFarm.islandSavedGUI=gui.Enabled end
  gui.Enabled=false;progressFarm.islandInputUntil=os.clock()+.4
  task.wait(.05)
  if disposed or not state.mirage or progressFarm.generation~=generation or not combatAssist.inputReady()then
   progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI(disposed);return false
  end
 elseif not combatAssist.pointerSafe(point)then return false end
 initializeInput()
 for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
  if pcall(backend.aim,point)then
   progressFarm.mouse={backend=backend,point=point,untilTime=os.clock()+.1}
   if pcall(backend.mouse,true,point)then progressFarm.clickAt=os.clock()+1.5;return true end
   pcall(backend.mouse,false,point);progressFarm.mouse=nil
  end
 end
 progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI(disposed)
 return false
end

function progressFarm.trainer(root,stage,now)
 local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
 local npc=folder and(folder:FindFirstChild("Dojo Trainer")or folder:FindFirstChild("DojoTrainer"))
 local body=npc and raidCombat.body(npc)
 if not body then
  progressFarm.travel(root,progressFarm.island("Hydra Island"),"Ищу Dojo Trainer на Hydra Island · NPC должен загрузиться");return
 end
 if not progressFarm.travel(root,body.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,4),"Лечу к Dojo Trainer · "..progressFarm.lessons[stage])then return end
 if not progressFarm.widgets then return end
 -- Only buttons inside a visible dialogue that explicitly names this trainer may be clicked.
 local dialogue
 for _,widget in ipairs(progressFarm.widgets)do
  if widget.Parent and progressFarm.visible(widget)and Core.styleKey(widget.Text)=="dojotrainer"then
   local parent=widget.Parent
   for _=1,3 do
    if parent and parent~=playerGui and parent:IsA("GuiObject")then dialogue=parent;parent=parent.Parent else break end
   end
   break
  end
 end
 if dialogue then
  local allowed={yes=true,accept=true,continue=true,claim=true,train=true,training=true,next=true,["да"]=true,["принять"]=true,["продолжить"]=true,["забрать"]=true}
  for _,widget in ipairs(progressFarm.widgets)do
   if widget.Parent and widget:IsDescendantOf(dialogue)and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
    local message=string.lower(widget.Text or "")
    if message:find("cooldown",1,true)or message:find("come back",1,true)or message:find("12 hours",1,true)then
     progressFarm.checkTrainerAt=now+60;progressFarm.clickAt=now+60
     progressFarm.note("Dojo Trainer cooldown · waiting for the server; retry in 60 seconds");return
    end
   end
  end
  if now<(progressFarm.clickAt or 0)then return end
  for _,button in ipairs(progressFarm.widgets)do
   if button.Parent and button:IsA("TextButton")and button:IsDescendantOf(dialogue)and progressFarm.visible(button)and allowed[Core.styleKey(button.Text)]then
    local p,s=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize
    progressFarm.click(Vector2.new(p.X+s.X/2,p.Y+s.Y/2),now)
    progressFarm.note("Dojo: читаю реальный диалог / жду подтверждения задания");return
   end
  end
  progressFarm.note("Dojo: ответ тренера / перерыв / требования. Если диалог изменился, выберите Training вручную.");return
 end
 if npc~=progressFarm.npc then
  progressFarm.npc=npc
  if progressFarm.scanJob then task.cancel(progressFarm.scanJob)end
  local generation=progressFarm.generation
  progressFarm.scanJob=perf.walk(npc,function(object)
   if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")then progressFarm.npcPrompt=object;return false end
  end,function()return state.dojo and progressFarm.generation==generation end,function()progressFarm.scanJob=nil end)
 end
 local prompt=progressFarm.npcPrompt
 if prompt and prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled and now>=(progressFarm.clickAt or 0)then
  progressFarm.prompt=prompt;progressFarm.promptUntil=now+prompt.HoldDuration+.1
  prompt:InputHoldBegin();progressFarm.clickAt=progressFarm.promptUntil+1.5
 else
  local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
  elite.aim({part=body})
  if camera then local p,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(body.Position);if visible and p.Z>0 then progressFarm.click(Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y),now)end end
 end
 progressFarm.note("Dojo Trainer · откройте окно скрипта в сторону от NPC; жду реального задания")
end
function progressFarm.delegateEvent(row,root,human)
 if not progressFarm.event then
  progressFarm.previousEvent=eventFarm.selected;progressFarm.previousSea=eventFarm.sea
  progressFarm.event=true;eventFarm.generation=(eventFarm.generation or 0)+1
 end
 eventFarm.selected=row;eventFarm.sea=3;state.events=true
 eventFarm.step()
 progressFarm.note("Dojo · "..tostring(eventFarm.label and eventFarm.label.Text or "жду морское событие"))
end
function progressFarm.sailStop()
 local seat=progressFarm.sailSeat
 if seat and seat.Parent then
  pcall(function()
   seat.Throttle=0;seat.Steer=0
   local root=seat.AssemblyRootPart or seat
   if progressFarm.sailDriving then
    local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,velocity.Y,0)
   end
  end)
 end
 progressFarm.sailSeat=nil;progressFarm.sailDriving=false;progressFarm.sailDirection=nil;progressFarm.sailAt=0;progressFarm.sailStarted=nil
end
function progressFarm.sail(root,human,now)
 progressFarm.releaseDelegate();progressFarm.manual=true
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
 local seat=human.SeatPart
 if not seat or not seat:IsA("VehicleSeat")or seat.Occupant~=human or not boatSpeed.modelFor(seat)then
  progressFarm.sailStop()
  progressFarm.note("Beyond the Horizon · sit in your boat driver seat; sailing then continues automatically")
  return
 end
 if progressFarm.sailSeat~=seat then
  progressFarm.sailStop();progressFarm.sailSeat=seat;progressFarm.sailStarted=now
  local look=seat.CFrame.LookVector;local direction=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  if direction.Magnitude<.01 then return end
  progressFarm.sailDirection=direction.Unit
 end
 if not progressFarm.sailDirection then return end
 if now<(progressFarm.sailAt or 0)then return end
 progressFarm.sailAt=now+.2
 local danger
 for _,widget in ipairs(progressFarm.widgets or{})do
  if widget.Parent and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
   local name=Core.styleKey(widget.Name);local message=string.lower(widget.Text or "")
   if name:find("danger",1,true)or message:find("danger level",1,true)then
    danger=tonumber(message:match("([0-6])"))or danger
   end
  end
 end
 local body=seat.AssemblyRootPart or seat
 if body.Anchored then progressFarm.note("Dojo · waiting for the boat to be released");return end
 local velocity=body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
 local unknown=not danger and now-(progressFarm.sailStarted or now)>10
 local speed=(unknown or danger and danger>=4)and 0 or math.clamp(tonumber(seat.MaxSpeed)or 60,20,100)
 local direction=progressFarm.sailDirection
 seat.Throttle=0;seat.Steer=0
 body.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(direction.X*speed,velocity.Y,direction.Z*speed)
 progressFarm.sailDriving=true
 progressFarm.note(unknown and "Dojo · stopped boat: Danger HUD unavailable; waiting for streaming"
  or danger and danger>=4 and "Dojo · holding boat in Danger "..danger.."; waiting for real quest completion"
  or "Dojo · sailing toward deep sea; waiting for Danger 4–6 HUD")
end

function progressFarm.dojo(root,human,now)
 progressFarm.inventoryRead(now);progressFarm.hud(now)
 if not progressFarm.inventory then progressFarm.note("Читаю пояса из инвентаря сервера");return end
 local stage=progressFarm.beltStage()
 if stage>8 then progressFarm.stop("Получен Black Belt · пояса Dojo завершены");return end
 if progressFarm.stage~=stage then
  progressFarm.sailStop();progressFarm.checkTrainerAt=0
  progressFarm.releaseDelegate();progressFarm.stage=stage;progressFarm.accepted=nil;progressFarm.questSeenAt=nil;progressFarm.questDone=false;progressFarm.manual=false;progressFarm.clickAt=0
 end
 local tool,mastery=progressFarm.talon()
 if not tool then progressFarm.note("Нужен уже полученный Dragon Talon · его отдельное получение пока не реализовано");return end
 if not mastery then progressFarm.note("Жду настоящее значение мастерства Dragon Talon");return end
 if mastery<500 then progressFarm.levelFarm(root,human,tool);return end
 if not progressFarm.questAccepted(stage)or progressFarm.questDone
  or not progressFarm.questVisible and now>=(progressFarm.checkTrainerAt or 0)then
  progressFarm.checkTrainerAt=now+30;progressFarm.sailStop()
  progressFarm.releaseDelegate();progressFarm.manual=false;progressFarm.trainer(root,stage,now);return
 end
 if stage==1 then progressFarm.levelFarm(root,human);return end
 if stage==2 then
  progressFarm.seaRow=progressFarm.seaRow or{name="Dojo Water Warrior",enemies={"Shark","Piranha","Fish Crew Member"},skills=true}
  progressFarm.delegateEvent(progressFarm.seaRow,root,human);return
 end
 if stage==4 then progressFarm.sail(root,human,now);return end
 if stage==6 then
  if not progressFarm.elite then progressFarm.elite=true;state.elite=true;elite.phase="hunter";elite.lastRequest=-math.huge end
  elite.step();progressFarm.note("Dojo Hanto · выполняю Elite Hunter; пояс подтверждает сервер");return
 end
 if stage==7 then
  progressFarm.terrorRow=progressFarm.terrorRow or{name="Dojo Teitoku / Terrorshark",enemies={"Terrorshark"},skills=true}
  progressFarm.delegateEvent(progressFarm.terrorRow,root,human);return
 end
 progressFarm.releaseDelegate();progressFarm.manual=true;releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
 if stage==3 then progressFarm.note("Diplomacy: нужен успешный обмен с другим игроком. После обмена модуль продолжит сам.")

 elseif stage==5 then progressFarm.note("Saikeirei: другой игрок должен передать фрукт, затем забрать его обратно. После этого продолжу.")
 else progressFarm.note("Black Belt: нужно пройти Prehistoric Island и собрать новые Dinosaur Bones. Автопрохождение пазла пока не реализовано.")end
end
-- Mirage shares the resource-farm movement owner; no parallel farm or raid worker.

function progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat()
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if not m then return end
 if not disposed then
  local boat,seat=m.boat or m.candidate,m.seat or m.candidateSeat
  if boat and boat.Parent and seat and seat.Parent and progressFarm.mirageOwned(boat)then
   progressFarm.islandBoatMemory={boat=boat,seat=seat,sea=game.PlaceId}
  end
 end
 m.driving=false
 if m.boatAdded then m.boatAdded:Disconnect();m.boatAdded=nil end
 for _,key in ipairs({"velocity","gyro","orientation","headingAttachment"})do
  if m[key]then m[key]:Destroy();m[key]=nil end
 end
 for object,entry in pairs(m.changed or{})do
  if object.Parent then pcall(function()
   if object[entry.property]==entry.applied then object[entry.property]=entry.original end
   if entry.touchOriginal~=nil and object.CanTouch==false then object.CanTouch=entry.touchOriginal end
  end)end
 end
 if m.body and m.body.Parent and m.commanded then
  pcall(function()local v=m.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity;m.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,v.Y,0);m.body.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.new()end)
 end
 m.changed={};m.commanded=false;m.assembly=nil;m.body=nil;m.boat=nil;m.seat=nil;m.direction=nil;m.height=nil;m.partsAt=0
end
function progressFarm.mirageReset()
 if progressFarm.mirage and progressFarm.mirage.portalJob then task.cancel(progressFarm.mirage.portalJob)end
 if Core.cancelGameCall then Core.cancelGameCall("islandBoat")end
 local previous=progressFarm.mirage
 if previous and previous.shopJob then task.cancel(previous.shopJob);previous.shopJob=nil end
 if progressFarm.mouse then pcall(progressFarm.mouse.backend.mouse,false,progressFarm.mouse.point);progressFarm.mouse=nil end
 progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI(disposed)
 progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat()
 progressFarm.mirage={changed={},scanAt=0,phase="boat",nextAt=0,intent=progressFarm.islandPendingPurchase}
end
function progressFarm.mirageOwned(boat)
 for _,name in ipairs({"Owner","OwnerName","OwnerUserId","UserId"})do
  local value=boat:GetAttribute(name)
  local child=boat:FindFirstChild(name)
  if child and child:IsA("ValueBase")then value=child.Value end
  if value==localPlayer or value==localPlayer.Name or(type(value)=="number"or type(value)=="string")and tonumber(value)==localPlayer.UserId then return true end
 end
 return false
end
function progressFarm.mirageBoat(root,human,now)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 local memory=progressFarm.islandBoatMemory
 local occupied=human.SeatPart
 if occupied and occupied:IsA("VehicleSeat")and occupied.Occupant==human then
  local boat=boatSpeed.modelFor(occupied)
  if boat and progressFarm.mirageOwned(boat)and progressFarm.islandBoatEligible(boat)then return boat,occupied end
 end
 if memory then
  local boat,seat=memory.boat,memory.seat
  if memory.sea~=game.PlaceId or not boat or not boat.Parent or not seat or not seat.Parent
   or not seat:IsDescendantOf(boat)or not progressFarm.mirageOwned(boat)or not progressFarm.islandBoatEligible(boat)then
   progressFarm.islandBoatMemory=nil
  elseif not seat.Occupant or seat.Occupant==human then
   m.candidate=boat;m.candidateSeat=seat;return boat,seat
  end
 end
 if now<(m.scanAt or 0)then
  if m.candidate and m.candidate.Parent and m.candidateSeat and m.candidateSeat.Parent
   and progressFarm.mirageOwned(m.candidate)and progressFarm.islandBoatEligible(m.candidate)and not m.candidateSeat.Occupant then return m.candidate,m.candidateSeat end
  return
 end
 m.scanAt=now+1;m.candidate=nil;m.candidateSeat=nil
 local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Boats");local distance=math.huge
 for _,boat in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren()or{})do
  if boat:IsA("Model")and progressFarm.mirageOwned(boat)and progressFarm.islandBoatEligible(boat)then
   local seat=boat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat",true)
   if seat and(not seat.Occupant or seat.Occupant==human)then
    local d=(seat.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
    if d<distance then distance=d;m.candidate=boat;m.candidateSeat=seat end
   end
  end
 end
 return m.candidate,m.candidateSeat
end
function progressFarm.mirageGround(island,root)
 local frame,size
 if island:IsA("BasePart")then frame,size=island.CFrame,island.Size
 else frame,size=island:GetBoundingBox()end
 if not frame or not size then return nil end
 local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances={island};params.IgnoreWater=true;params.RespectCanCollide=true
 local best,distance=nil,math.huge
 for _,offset in ipairs({{0,0},{-.25,0},{.25,0},{0,-.25},{0,.25},{-.25,-.25},{.25,.25},{-.25,.25},{.25,-.25}})do
  local point=frame.Position+Vector3.new(size.X*offset[1],size.Y*.5+64,size.Z*offset[2])
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(point,Vector3.new(0,-math.min(size.Y+256,4096),0),params)
  if progressFarm.islandSafeGround(hit,island)then
   local parent=hit.Instance.Parent;local actor=false
   while parent and parent~=island do
    if parent:IsA("Model")and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then actor=true;break end
    parent=parent.Parent
   end
   local key=Core.styleKey(hit.Instance.Name)
   if not actor and not key:find("leaf",1,true)and not key:find("leaves",1,true)then
    local d=(hit.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
    if d<distance then distance=d;best=hit end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
function progressFarm.mirageChange(object,property,value)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if not m.changed[object]then m.changed[object]={property=property,original=object[property],applied=value}end
 object[property]=value
end
function progressFarm.islandWatchBoat(object)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if not m or not m.boat or object==m.velocity or object==m.orientation or not object:IsDescendantOf(m.boat)then return end
 if object:IsA("BasePart")then
  progressFarm.mirageChange(object,"CanCollide",false)
  local entry=m.changed[object]
  if entry.touchOriginal==nil then entry.touchOriginal=object.CanTouch end
  object.CanTouch=false
 elseif object:IsA("BodyVelocity")or object:IsA("BodyPosition")then progressFarm.mirageChange(object,"MaxForce",Vector3.new())
 elseif object:IsA("BodyGyro")or object:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity")then progressFarm.mirageChange(object,"MaxTorque",Vector3.new())
 elseif object:IsA("BodyForce")or object:IsA("BodyThrust")then progressFarm.mirageChange(object,"Force",Vector3.new())
 elseif object:IsA("LinearVelocity")or object:IsA("AlignPosition")or object:IsA("AlignOrientation")or object:IsA("AngularVelocity")or object:IsA("VectorForce")or object:IsA("Torque")then progressFarm.mirageChange(object,"Enabled",false)end
end
function progressFarm.mirageDrive(boat,seat,root,human,now)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if seat.Occupant~=human or human.SeatPart~=seat or not progressFarm.mirageOwned(boat)then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();return end
 if m.boat~=boat or m.seat~=seat then
  progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();m.boat=boat;m.seat=seat
  local body=seat.AssemblyRootPart
  if not body or not body:IsDescendantOf(boat)then body=boat.PrimaryPart or seat end
  if not body:IsDescendantOf(boat)or body.Anchored then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();progressFarm.note("Auto Island · waiting for the boat assembly");return end
  m.body=body;m.height=body.Position.Y;m.assembly=seat.AssemblyRootPart or body
  local look=seat.CFrame.LookVector;local horizontal=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  if horizontal.Magnitude<.01 then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();return end
  m.direction=state.events and eventFarm.course or horizontal.Unit
  -- Attach to the DRIVER SEAT: hull axes can be rotated relative to the seat.
  m.headingAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment");m.headingAttachment.Name="ViltrumIslandHeading";m.headingAttachment.Parent=seat
  m.orientation=Instance.new("AlignOrientation");m.orientation.Name="ViltrumIslandUpright"
  m.orientation.Mode=Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment;m.orientation.Attachment0=m.headingAttachment
  m.orientation.RigidityEnabled=true;m.orientation.ReactionTorqueEnabled=false
  m.orientation.Responsiveness=80;m.orientation.MaxTorque=1e10;m.orientation.MaxAngularVelocity=4
  m.orientation.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(),m.direction);m.orientation.Parent=body
  m.velocity=Instance.new("BodyVelocity");m.velocity.Name="ViltrumMirageDrive";m.velocity.Parent=body
  for _,object in ipairs(boat:GetDescendants())do progressFarm.islandWatchBoat(object)end
  m.boatAdded=boat.DescendantAdded:Connect(progressFarm.islandWatchBoat)
 end
 local body=m.body
 if not body or not body.Parent or body.Anchored or body.AssemblyMass==math.huge then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();return end
 local force=math.max(100000,body.AssemblyMass*workspace.Gravity*12)
 local speed=state.boatspeed and math.clamp(CONFIG.BoatSpeed,1,550)or math.clamp(tonumber(seat.MaxSpeed)or 60,30,100)
 m.velocity.MaxForce=Vector3.new(force,force,force)
 m.commanded=true;m.driving=true
 progressFarm.islandBoughtBoat=boat
 m.intent=nil;progressFarm.islandPendingPurchase=nil
 progressFarm.islandPhysics()
 progressFarm.note("Auto Island · "..progressFarm.islandChoice().name.." · straight / noclip · "..math.floor(speed).." studs/s · "..progressFarm.islandChoice().hint)
end
function progressFarm.islandPhysics()
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if not Core.boatAutomationActive() or not m or not m.driving then return end
 local human=localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if disposed or not human or human.Health<=0 or not m.boat or not m.boat.Parent or not m.body or not m.body.Parent
  or not m.seat or m.seat.Occupant~=human or human.SeatPart~=m.seat or not progressFarm.mirageOwned(m.boat)then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();return end
 if m.body.Anchored or(m.seat.AssemblyRootPart or m.body)~=m.assembly
  or not m.orientation or not m.orientation.Parent or not m.velocity or not m.velocity.Parent
  or not m.headingAttachment or not m.headingAttachment.Parent then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();return end
 -- No discovery here: only reassert cached collision/engine overrides each physics step.
 for object,entry in pairs(m.changed)do
  if object.Parent and object:IsDescendantOf(m.boat)then
   object[entry.property]=entry.applied
   if entry.touchOriginal~=nil then object.CanTouch=false end
  end
 end
 local speed=state.boatspeed and math.clamp(CONFIG.BoatSpeed,1,550)or math.clamp(tonumber(m.seat.MaxSpeed)or 60,30,100)
 local direction=m.direction;local body=m.body
 local velocity=Vector3.new(direction.X*speed,math.clamp((m.height-body.Position.Y)*4,-15,15),direction.Z*speed)
 m.seat.Throttle=0;m.seat.Steer=0
 m.orientation.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(),direction)
 m.velocity.Velocity=velocity;body.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.new();body.AssemblyLinearVelocity=velocity
end

function progressFarm.islandMoney()
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
 return value and tonumber(value.Value)
end
function progressFarm.islandPrice(text)
 if type(text)~="string"then return nil end
 local short=text:match("([0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*)[kK]")
 if short then return tonumber(short)*1000 end
 local amount=text:match("([0-9][0-9,.]*)")
 return amount and tonumber((amount:gsub("[,.]","")))
end
function progressFarm.islandText(object)
 if object:IsA("TextLabel")or object:IsA("TextButton")then return object.Text or ""end
 return ""
end
function progressFarm.islandPurchaseButton(button)
 local text=progressFarm.islandText(button);local key=Core.styleKey(text)
 return key=="yes"or key=="да"or key:find("buy",1,true)==1 or key:find("purchase",1,true)==1
  or key:find("spawn",1,true)==1 or key:find("купить",1,true)==1
  or progressFarm.islandPrice(text)==5000 and not text:match("[A-Za-z]")
end
function progressFarm.islandShop(widgets)
 for _,widget in ipairs(widgets)do
  if widget.Parent and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
   local key=Core.styleKey(progressFarm.islandText(widget))
   if key:find("boatdealer",1,true)then
    local parent=widget.Parent;local result
    for _=1,3 do
     local name=parent and Core.styleKey(parent.Name)
     if parent and parent~=playerGui and parent:IsA("GuiObject")and name~="main"and name~="mainframe"then result=parent;parent=parent.Parent else break end
    end
    if result then return result end
   end
   local name=Core.styleKey(widget.Name)
   if widget:IsA("GuiObject")and not widget:IsA("GuiButton")and(name=="boatshop"or name=="boatselection"or name=="boatmenu"or name=="shipshop"or name=="boatdealer"or name=="boatdealergui")then return widget end
  end
 end
end
function progressFarm.islandTextMeta(widget)
 local text=progressFarm.islandText(widget);local key=Core.styleKey(text);local role=Core.styleKey(widget.Name)
 local amount=progressFarm.islandPrice(text)
 local priced=role:find("price",1,true)or role:find("cost",1,true)or text:find("$",1,true)or text:match("^[0-9,. ]+$")
 local action=key=="yes"or key=="да"or key:find("buy",1,true)==1 or key:find("purchase",1,true)==1 or key:find("spawn",1,true)==1 or key:find("купить",1,true)==1
 local unlocked=key=="unlocked"or key=="available"or key=="owned"
 local locked=not unlocked and(key:find("locked",1,true)or key:find("requires",1,true)or key:find("gamepass",1,true)or key:find("unlock",1,true)or key:find("robux",1,true)or text:find("R$",1,true))
 local utility=key=="no"or key=="нет"or key=="back"or key=="cancel"or key=="nevermind"or key=="close"or key=="next"or key==">"or key=="↓"
  or key=="shop"or key=="browse"or key=="boats"or key=="viewboats"or key=="continue"or key=="buyaboat"or key=="confirm"or key=="confirmation"
 local name
 if not action and not utility and key~="select"and key~="price"and key~=""and not key:find("boatdealer",1,true)
  and(widget:IsA("GuiButton")or role=="title"or role=="name"or role=="boatname"or role=="itemname")then
  local title=text:match("^([^$0-9]+)")
  if title then name=title:gsub("[^A-Za-z ]","");if Core.styleKey(name)==""then name=nil end end
 end
 -- Native NPC confirmations often put both the ship name and cost in Description.
 if not name then
  for _,ship in ipairs({"Grand Brigade","Beast Hunter","Guardian","Sentinel","Miracle","Sleigh","Speedboat","Lantern","Swan","Brigade","Dinghy","Sloop"})do
   if key:find(Core.styleKey(ship),1,true)then name=ship;break end
  end
 end
 return {text=text,parent=widget.Parent,widget=widget,key=key,name=name,price=priced and amount or nil,
  locked=locked,action=action,purchase=action or widget:IsA("GuiButton")and amount==5000 and not text:match("[A-Za-z]")}
end
function progressFarm.islandIndex(widgets,valid)
 local index={rows={},buttons={},actions={},titles={},widgets=widgets,shop=progressFarm.islandShop(widgets)}
 local slice=os.clock();local count=0
 for _,widget in ipairs(widgets)do
  if widget.Parent and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
   if widget:IsA("GuiButton")then
    table.insert(index.buttons,widget)
    local role=Core.styleKey(widget.Name)
    index.actions[widget]=index.actions[widget]or progressFarm.islandPurchaseButton(widget)or role=="buy"or role=="buybutton"or role=="purchasebutton"or role=="spawnbutton"
   end
   if widget:IsA("TextLabel")or widget:IsA("TextButton")then
    local info=progressFarm.islandTextMeta(widget);local parent=widget
    for _=1,6 do
     if not parent or parent==playerGui then break end
     local row=index.rows[parent]
     if not row then row={names={},nameCount=0,stamps={},count=0};index.rows[parent]=row end
     row.count=row.count+1
     if row.count<=64 then table.insert(row.stamps,info)end
     if info.price then if row.price and row.price~=info.price then row.mixed=true end;row.price=info.price end
     row.locked=row.locked or info.locked
     if info.name then
      local nameKey=Core.styleKey(info.name)
      if not row.names[nameKey]then row.names[nameKey]=true;row.nameCount=row.nameCount+1;row.name=info.name;row.key=nameKey end
     end
     if parent:IsA("GuiButton")then
      if info.action or parent==widget and info.purchase then index.actions[parent]=true end
      if info.name then index.titles[parent]=info.name end
     end
     parent=parent.Parent
    end
   end
  end
  count=count+1
  if valid and count%64==0 and os.clock()-slice>=.0015 then
   task.wait();slice=os.clock();if not valid()then return nil end
  end
 end
 return index
end
function progressFarm.islandRowLive(row)
 if not row or row.count>64 then return false end
 for _,info in ipairs(row.stamps)do
  if info.widget.Parent~=info.parent or not progressFarm.visible(info.widget)or progressFarm.islandText(info.widget)~=info.text then return false end
 end
 return true
end
function progressFarm.islandIndexedOffer(button,shop,index)
 if button:GetAttribute("Locked")==true or button:GetAttribute("Unlocked")==false or button:GetAttribute("GamepassRequired")==true then return nil end
 local parent=button
 for _=1,4 do
  if not parent then break end
  local row=index.rows[parent]
  local intent=progressFarm.mirage and progressFarm.mirage.intent
  local inspect=progressFarm.mirage and progressFarm.mirage.inspectKey
  -- A whole dialogue may serve as a confirmation only for the boat we just selected.
  local confirmation=parent~=shop or index.actions[button]and row and(row.key==inspect or intent and row.key==intent.key)
  if row and confirmation and row.price==5000 and row.nameCount==1 and not row.locked and not row.mixed and progressFarm.islandRowLive(row)then
   return {name=row.name,key=row.key,button=button,purchase=index.actions[button]}
  end
  if parent==shop then break end
  parent=parent.Parent
 end
end
-- Compatibility helper; production uses the already-built asynchronous index directly.
function progressFarm.islandOffer(button,shop,widgets)
 local cache=progressFarm.offerIndex
 if not cache or cache.widgets~=widgets then cache=progressFarm.islandIndex(widgets);progressFarm.offerIndex=cache end
 local offer=progressFarm.islandIndexedOffer(button,shop,cache)
 if offer then return offer end
 cache=progressFarm.islandIndex(widgets);progressFarm.offerIndex=cache
 return progressFarm.islandIndexedOffer(button,shop,cache)
end
function progressFarm.islandRefreshShop(now)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if m.shopJob or now<(m.shopScanAt or 0)then return end
 m.shopScanAt=now+1
 local generation=progressFarm.generation;local widgets={};local visited=0
 local function valid()return not disposed and state.mirage and progressFarm.mirage==m and progressFarm.generation==generation and not m.driving end
 local previous=m.snapshot and m.snapshot.shop
 local scope=previous and previous.Parent and progressFarm.visible(previous)and previous or playerGui
 m.shopJob=perf.walk(scope,function(object)
  if object==gui then return false end
  if object:IsA("GuiObject")and not object.Visible or object:IsA("ScreenGui")and not object.Enabled then return false end
  local key=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
  if key=="experiencechat"or key=="bubblechat"or key=="chat"or key=="playerlist"then return false end
  visited=visited+1
  if visited>8192 then return false end
  if object~=playerGui then table.insert(widgets,object)end
 end,valid,function()
  if not valid()then if progressFarm.mirage==m then m.shopJob=nil end;return end
  local index=progressFarm.islandIndex(widgets,valid)
  if not valid()then return end
  m.snapshot=index;m.shopJob=nil
 end)
end

function progressFarm.islandBoatEligible(boat)
 if boat==progressFarm.islandBoughtBoat then return true end
 if boat:GetAttribute("Price")==5000 or boat:GetAttribute("Cost")==5000 then return true end
 local m=progressFarm.mirage;local intent=m and m.intent
 if not intent then return false end
 local name=Core.styleKey(boat:GetAttribute("BoatName")or boat.Name)
 if name==intent.key or(name=="swan"and intent.key=="guardian")or(name=="guardian"and intent.key=="swan")then return true end
 local money=progressFarm.islandMoney()
 return intent.sent and money and intent.before and intent.before-money>=5000 and not intent.known[boat]
end
function progressFarm.islandShopClick(button,shop,now)
 if raidHost.scrollStorage(button,shop)then return false end
 local p,size=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize
 return progressFarm.click(Vector2.new(p.X+size.X/2,p.Y+size.Y/2),now)
end
function progressFarm.mirageDealer(root,now)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if now<(m.dealerAt or 0)then return end
 m.dealerAt=now+.3
 local money=progressFarm.islandMoney()
 if m.intent and m.intent.sent then progressFarm.note("Auto Island · purchase sent; waiting for your boat");return end
 if not money or money<5000 then progressFarm.note("Auto Island · waiting for $5,000 Beli");return end
 local npc,body=m.dealerNPC,m.dealerBody
 if not npc or not npc.Parent or not body or not body.Parent or now>=(m.npcAt or 0)then
  m.npcAt=now+1.5;local distance=math.huge;npc=nil;body=nil
  local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
  for _,object in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren()or{})do
   if Core.styleKey(object.Name):find("boatdealer",1,true)then
    local part=raidCombat.body(object)
    if part and(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<distance then npc=object;body=part;distance=(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude end
   end
  end
  m.dealerNPC=npc;m.dealerBody=body
 end
 if not body then
  local position=progressFarm.island("Castle on the Sea")
  progressFarm.travel(root,position and position+Vector3.new(0,12,0),"Auto Island · finding Boat Dealer");return
 end
 if(root.Position-body.Position).Magnitude>6 then
  m.docked=false
  progressFarm.travel(root,body.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,4),"Auto Island · flying to Boat Dealer");return
 end
 if not m.docked then stopHover();stopMovement();root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new();m.docked=true end
 progressFarm.islandRefreshShop(now)
 local index=m.snapshot;local shop=index and index.shop
 if shop and shop.Parent and progressFarm.visible(shop)then
  for pass=1,2 do
   for _,button in ipairs(index.buttons)do
    if button.Parent and button:IsDescendantOf(shop)and progressFarm.visible(button)then
     local offer=progressFarm.islandIndexedOffer(button,shop,index)
     if offer and(pass==1 and offer.purchase or pass==2 and not offer.purchase)and(not m.intent or m.intent.key==offer.key)then
      local intent=m.intent
      if not intent then
       intent={name=offer.name,key=offer.key,before=money,known={}}
       local boats=workspace:FindFirstChild("Boats")
       for _,boat in ipairs(boats and boats:GetChildren()or{})do intent.known[boat]=true end
       m.intent=intent
      end
      if progressFarm.islandShopClick(button,shop,now)then
       m.scanAt=0;m.shopScanAt=0
       if offer.purchase then intent.sent=true;progressFarm.islandPendingPurchase=intent end
      end
      progressFarm.note("Auto Island · "..(offer.purchase and "buying "or "selecting ")..offer.name.." · $5,000");return
     end
    end
   end
  end
  local summary=index.rows[shop]
  if m.inspectKey and summary and(summary.price and summary.price~=5000 or summary.locked)then
   for _,button in ipairs(index.buttons)do
    local key=Core.styleKey(progressFarm.islandText(button))
    if button:IsDescendantOf(shop)and(key=="back"or key=="no"or key=="nevermind"or key=="cancel")then
     if progressFarm.islandShopClick(button,shop,now)then m.inspectKey=nil;m.shopScanAt=0 end
     progressFarm.note("Auto Island · declining a locked boat or a price other than $5,000");return
    end
   end
  end
  -- A classic NPC dialog lists boat names before showing their individual price.
  if not m.intent and now>=(m.inspectAt or 0)then
   m.inspectTried=m.inspectTried or{}
   for _,button in ipairs(index.buttons)do
    if button.Parent and button:IsDescendantOf(shop)and progressFarm.visible(button)then
     local title=index.titles[button]or progressFarm.islandText(button);local key=Core.styleKey(title)
     if(key=="guardian"or key=="swan"or key=="beasthunter"or key=="sentinel"or key=="lantern")and not m.inspectTried[key]
      and button:GetAttribute("Locked")~=true and button:GetAttribute("GamepassRequired")~=true then
      if progressFarm.islandShopClick(button,shop,now)then m.inspectTried[key]=true;m.inspectKey=key;m.inspectAt=now+2.5;m.shopScanAt=0 end
      progressFarm.note("Auto Island · checking "..title.." in the NPC dialogue; price must be $5,000");return
     end
    end
   end
  end
  for _,button in ipairs(index.buttons)do
   if button.Parent and button:IsDescendantOf(shop)and progressFarm.visible(button)then
    local key=Core.styleKey(progressFarm.islandText(button));local name=Core.styleKey(button.Name)
    local browse=key=="boats"or key=="shop"or key=="browse"or key=="viewboats"or key=="buyaboat"
     or key=="buy"and summary and summary.nameCount==0 and not summary.price and not m.intent
    local nextPage=key=="next"or key==">"or key=="↓"or name=="nextpage"or name=="nextboats"or name=="nextbutton"or name=="downarrow"or name=="downbutton"
    if(browse or nextPage and(m.pages or 0)<6)and now>=(m.pageAt or 0)then
     if progressFarm.islandShopClick(button,shop,now)then m.pageAt=now+2;m.pages=(m.pages or 0)+1;m.shopScanAt=0 end
     progressFarm.note("Auto Island · opening boat choices / next shop page");return
    end
   end
  end
  progressFarm.note("Auto Island · waiting for an unlocked $5,000 boat choice or price confirmation");return
 end
 if m.shopJob then progressFarm.note("Auto Island · reading Boat Dealer dialogue…");return end
 if m.intent then
  m.intent.sent=true;progressFarm.islandPendingPurchase=m.intent;progressFarm.note("Auto Island · waiting for the selected boat to spawn");return
 end
 if now<(m.openAt or 0)or now<(progressFarm.clickAt or 0)then return end
 m.openAt=now+3
 local prompt=npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
 if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
  progressFarm.prompt=prompt;progressFarm.promptUntil=now+prompt.HoldDuration+.1
  prompt:InputHoldBegin();progressFarm.clickAt=progressFarm.promptUntil+1.5
 else
  elite.aim({part=body});local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
  if camera then local p,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(body.Position);if visible and p.Z>0 then progressFarm.click(Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y),now)end end
 end
 progressFarm.note("Auto Island · opening Boat Dealer dialogue")
end

function progressFarm.mirageStep(root,human,now)
 local m=progressFarm.mirage
 if not m then progressFarm.mirageReset();m=progressFarm.mirage end
 progressFarm.manual=true
 if now<(m.nextAt or 0)then return end
 m.nextAt=now+.1
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();stopMovement()
 if now>=(m.islandAt or 0)then m.detectedIsland=progressFarm.mirageIsland();m.islandAt=now+1 end
 local island=m.detectedIsland
 if island and not island.Parent then island=nil;m.detectedIsland=nil end
 if island then
  if m.island~=island or now>=(m.groundAt or 0)then
   m.island=island;m.ground=progressFarm.mirageGround(island,root);m.groundAt=now+.75
  end
  if m.ground and m.ground.Instance.Parent then
   progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();m.phase="landing"
   human.Sit=false
   if human.SeatPart then human:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp);progressFarm.note("Island found · leaving the boat");return end
   local feet=surfaceWalk.feet(localPlayer.Character,human,root)
   local destination=m.ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,feet+.2,0)
   if m.settleUntil and now<m.settleUntil then
    restoreCollisions();stopHover()
    if human.FloorMaterial and human.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and(root.Position-destination).Magnitude<4 then
     human:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
     progressFarm.stop(progressFarm.islandChoice().name.." найден · высадка завершена")
    else progressFarm.note("Auto Island · waiting for feet to touch island ground")end
    return
   end
   disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character)
   if not progressFarm.travel(root,destination,"Island found · landing on the island")then return end
   if(root.Position-destination).Magnitude>2 then return end
   stopHover();restoreCollisions();root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new()
