   human:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall);m.settleUntil=now+3
   return
  end
  progressFarm.note("Island detected · waiting for solid island ground to stream in")
 elseif m.phase=="landing"then
  stopHover();restoreCollisions();m.phase="boat";m.island=nil;m.ground=nil;m.settleUntil=nil;m.scanAt=0
 end
 if m.phase=="landing"then return end
 local boat,seat=progressFarm.mirageBoat(root,human,now)
 if boat and seat then
  progressFarm.islandBoatMemory={boat=boat,seat=seat,sea=game.PlaceId}
  m.portalComplete=true
  if human.SeatPart~=seat or seat.Occupant~=human then
   progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character)
   human.Sit=false
   local boarding=seat.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,0)
   progressFarm.travel(root,boarding,"Auto Island · boarding your boat")
   if(root.Position-boarding).Magnitude<=3 then
    stopHover();restoreCollisions();seat:Sit(human)
   end
   return
  end
  stopHover();restoreCollisions()
  progressFarm.mirageDrive(boat,seat,root,human,now);return
 end
 progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();human.Sit=false
 if progressFarm.islandPortal(root,now)then return end
 progressFarm.islandBuyDirect(root,now)
end

function progressFarm.step()
 if not state.resourcefarm or disposed then return end
 if progressFarm.sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then progressFarm.stop("Море изменилось · остановлено");return end
 local character=localPlayer.Character;local human=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or not human or human.Health<=0 then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();progressFarm.sailStop();releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();stopHover();progressFarm.note("Жду возрождения — затем продолжу");return end
 if not combatAssist.inputReady()then progressFarm.mirageReleaseBoat();progressFarm.sailStop();releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();if not human.SeatPart then holdPosition(root,root.Position,nil)end;return end
 if state.mirage then progressFarm.mirageStep(root,human,os.clock());return end
 if progressFarm.mode=="allisland"then progressFarm.allIslandStep(root,human,os.clock());return end
 if progressFarm.mode=="chest"then progressFarm.chestStep(root,human,os.clock());return end
 if not progressFarm.manual then human.Sit=false end
 stopMovement();ensureAura(character,true)
 -- Manual Dojo stages keep character collisions and boat controls available.
 if not progressFarm.manual then disableCollisions(character)end
 if state.dojo then progressFarm.dojo(root,human,os.clock());return end
 local row=progressFarm.presets[progressFarm.mode]
 if not progressFarm.fight(root,human,row.enemies)then
  local position=progressFarm.mode=="metal"and row.fallback or progressFarm.island(row.island)
  progressFarm.travel(root,position and position+Vector3.new(0,35,0),"Жду NPC · "..row.island.." · фарм продолжится после спавна")
 end
end

function teleport.mapIsland(row)
 local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
 if not map then return nil end
 local names={[Core.styleKey(row.name)]=true}
 for _,source in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[row.sea]or{})do
  if source[1]==row.name then for _,alias in ipairs(source[3]or{})do names[Core.styleKey(alias)]=true end end
 end
 for _,object in ipairs(map:GetChildren())do if names[Core.styleKey(object.Name)]then return object end end
end
function teleport.basePoint(row)
 if row.fallback then return Vector3.new(row.fallback[1],row.fallback[2],row.fallback[3])end
 local object=teleport.mapIsland(row)or row.marker
 if object and object.Parent then
  if object:IsA("BasePart")then return object.Position end
  if object:IsA("Model")then return object:GetPivot().Position end
 end
end
function teleport.safeDestination(row,position)
 local root=localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or(root.Position-position).Magnitude>600 then row.safePoint=nil;return position+Vector3.new(0,100,0)end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now<(row.safeAt or 0)then return row.safePoint or position+Vector3.new(0,100,0)end
 row.safeAt=now+.75;row.safePoint=nil
 local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
 if not map then return position+Vector3.new(0,100,0)end
 local filter={map};if workspace:FindFirstChild("Terrain")then table.insert(filter,workspace.Terrain)end
 local rays=RaycastParams.new();rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include;rays.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter;rays.IgnoreWater=true;rays.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new();overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include;overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter;overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 local human=localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local feet=human and surfaceWalk.feet(localPlayer.Character,human,root)or 3
 for _,offset in ipairs({{0,0},{12,0},{-12,0},{0,12},{0,-12},{32,32},{-32,32},{32,-32},{-32,-32},{70,0},{0,70}})do
  local submerged=row.name=="Submerged Island"
  local origin=position+Vector3.new(offset[1],submerged and 80 or 350,offset[2])
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(origin,Vector3.new(0,submerged and -250 or -800,0),rays)
  if hit and hit.Normal.Y>.65 and hit.Material~=Enum.Material.Water then
   local point=hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,feet+.6,0)
   local clear=true
   for _,part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,1,0)),Vector3.new(5,math.max(5,feet*2),5),overlap))do
    if part.CanCollide and part~=hit.Instance then clear=false;break end
   end
   if clear then row.safePoint=point;return point end
  end
 end
 return position+Vector3.new(0,100,0)
end
function teleport.submergedHere(root)
 return root.Position.Y< -1000 and(root.Position-Vector3.new(10780,-2088,9260)).Magnitude<5000
end
function teleport.transportActive(session)
 return not disposed and(state.farm and teleport.levelTransport==session or teleport.flight and teleport.flight.transport==session or state.resourcefarm and progressFarm.transport==session)
end
function teleport.levelAccess(root,human,now)
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();deactivateWeapon()
 teleport.levelTransport=teleport.levelTransport or{}
 local done,message=teleport.submergedStep(teleport.levelTransport,root,human,now)
 status(message)
 return done
end
function teleport.releaseTransport(session)
 if not session then return end
 session.contact=false
 if session.prompt then pcall(function()session.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);session.prompt=nil end
 if session.scan then task.cancel(session.scan);session.scan=nil end
end
function teleport.transportClick(session,point)
 if not teleport.transportActive(session)or not combatAssist.inputReady()then return false end
 local saved=gui.Enabled;gui.Enabled=false
 initializeInput();local clicked=false
 for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
  if pcall(backend.aim,point)and pcall(backend.mouse,true,point)then
   task.wait(.05);pcall(backend.mouse,false,point);clicked=true;break
  end
  pcall(backend.mouse,false,point)
 end
 if gui.Parent and not disposed then gui.Enabled=saved end
 return clicked
end
function teleport.transportText(widget)
 if(widget:IsA("TextLabel")or widget:IsA("TextButton"))and widget.Text~=""then return widget.Text or ""end
 for _,child in ipairs(widget:GetDescendants())do
  if child:IsA("TextLabel")and progressFarm.visible(child)and child.Text~=""and not tonumber(child.Text)then return child.Text end
 end
 return ""
end
function teleport.dialogueKey(text)
 return Core.styleKey(text):gsub("[^a-z0-9]","")
end
function teleport.transportChoice(key,exiting)
 if key=="no"or key=="cancel"or key=="nevermind"or key=="exit"or key=="notnow"then return nil end
 if exiting and(key=="tikioutpost"or key=="returntotikioutpost"or key=="backtotikioutpost")then return 1 end
 if not exiting and(key=="submergedisland"or key=="traveltosubmergedisland"or key=="takemetosubmergedisland")then return 1 end
 local choices={yes=true,sure=true,okay=true,ok=true,continue=true,travel=true,letsgo=true,letsgothen=true,
  take=true,takeme=true,takemethere=true,proceed=true,dive=true,go=true,ready=true,imsure=true}
 if choices[key]then return 2 end
end

function teleport.submergedStep(session,root,human,now)
 session.contact=false
 local exiting=session.destination=="Tiki Outpost"
 local arrived=exiting and root.Position.Y> -500 and(root.Position-Vector3.new(-16224,65,439)).Magnitude<3500
  or not exiting and teleport.submergedHere(root)
 if arrived then teleport.releaseTransport(session);return true,(exiting and "Tiki Outpost"or "Submerged Island")..": transport confirmed"end
 if session.prompt and now>=(session.promptUntil or 0)then pcall(function()session.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);session.prompt=nil end
 if not combatAssist.inputReady()then stopHover();return false,"Submarine: finish typing / close menu"end
 local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
 if now>=(session.npcAt or 0)then
  session.npcAt=now+1;session.npc=nil;session.body=nil
  for _,npc in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren()or{})do
   if Core.styleKey(npc.Name)=="submarineworker"then
    local body=raidCombat.body(npc)
    if body and(exiting and body.Position.Y< -500 or not exiting and body.Position.Y> -500)then session.npc=npc;session.body=body;break end
   end
  end
 end
 local body=session.body
 if not body or not body.Parent then
  local tiki=exiting and Vector3.new(10780,-2050,9260)or Vector3.new(-16541,80,1051)
  if(root.Position-tiki).Magnitude>200 then disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character);holdPosition(root,tiki,nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
  else session.contact=true;stopHover();restoreCollisions(true)end
  return false,"Flying to Submarine Worker · "..(exiting and "Submerged Island exit"or "Tiki Outpost")
 end
 if(root.Position-body.Position).Magnitude>9 then
  human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character);holdPosition(root,body.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,6),nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
  return false,"Flying to Submarine Worker · Tiki Outpost"
 end
 session.contact=true;stopHover();stopMovement();restoreCollisions(true)
 if now<(session.retryAt or 0)then return false,session.message or "Submarine: waiting for dialogue"end
 if not session.scan and now>=(session.uiAt or 0)then
  session.uiAt=now+.2;local widgets={}
  session.scan=perf.walk(playerGui,function(widget)
   if widget==gui then return false end
   if widget:IsA("GuiObject")and not widget.Visible or widget:IsA("ScreenGui")and not widget.Enabled then return false end
   if widget:IsA("TextLabel")or widget:IsA("GuiButton")then table.insert(widgets,widget)end
  end,function()return teleport.transportActive(session)end,function()session.widgets=widgets;session.scan=nil end)
 end
 local dialogue
 for _,widget in ipairs(session.widgets or{})do
  if widget.Parent and progressFarm.visible(widget)and teleport.dialogueKey(teleport.transportText(widget)):find("submarineworker",1,true)==1 then
   local parent=widget.Parent
   for _=1,5 do
    if not parent or parent==playerGui or parent:IsA("ScreenGui")then break end
    dialogue=parent;if Core.styleKey(parent.Name):find("dialog",1,true)then break end;parent=parent.Parent
   end
   break
  end
 end
 if dialogue then
  for _,widget in ipairs(session.widgets or{})do
   if widget.Parent and widget:IsDescendantOf(dialogue)and progressFarm.visible(widget)then
    local key=teleport.dialogueKey(teleport.transportText(widget))
    if key:find("notenoughfuel",1,true)or key:find("occupied",1,true)or key:find("defeatthetyrant",1,true)then
     session.retryAt=now+30;session.message="Submarine Worker: complete the game's Tyrant / fuel requirement";return false,session.message
    end
   end
  end
  if now>=(session.clickAt or 0)then
   for pass=1,2 do for _,button in ipairs(session.widgets or{})do
    if button.Parent and button:IsA("GuiButton")and button:IsDescendantOf(dialogue)and progressFarm.visible(button)then
     local key=teleport.dialogueKey(teleport.transportText(button))
     if teleport.transportChoice(key,exiting)==pass then
      if session.choiceButton==button and session.choiceKey==key and now-(session.choiceAt or 0)<.9 then return false,"Waiting for Submarine Worker response"end
      local point,size=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize
      if teleport.transportClick(session,Vector2.new(point.X+size.X/2,point.Y+size.Y/2))then session.clickAt=now+.35;session.uiAt=0;session.choiceButton=button;session.choiceKey=key;session.choiceAt=now end
      return false,"Submarine Worker: confirming travel · waiting for server transport"
     end
    end
   end end
  end
  return false,"Submarine Worker: waiting for dialogue / travel requirements"
 end
 if now>=(session.openAt or 0)then
  session.openAt=now+3
  local prompt=session.npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
  if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
   if pcall(function()prompt:InputHoldBegin()end)then session.prompt=prompt;session.promptUntil=now+prompt.HoldDuration+.1 end
  else
   local point=elite.aim({part=body})
   if point then local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera;local p,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(body.Position);if visible then teleport.transportClick(session,Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y))end end
  end
 end
 return false,"Opening Submarine Worker dialogue · no direct underwater flight"
end

function progressFarm.selectFarmIsland(row)
 if not row or row.sea~=SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]then return end
 local running=state.allisland
 if running then progressFarm.stop("Changing farm island")end
 progressFarm.farmIsland=row
 if progressFarm.redrawFarmIsland then progressFarm.redrawFarmIsland()end
 if running then progressFarm.start("allisland")end
end
function progressFarm.islandGroup(name)
 local groups={Cafe="Kingdom of Rose",Docks="Kingdom of Rose",Factory="Kingdom of Rose",
  ["Swan Mansion"]="Kingdom of Rose",["Don Swan Room"]="Kingdom of Rose",
  Mansion="Floating Turtle",["Secret Temple"]="Hydra Island",["Tushita Temple"]="Hydra Island",
  ["Hot Side"]="Hot and Cold",["Cold Side"]="Hot and Cold"}
 return groups[name]or name
end
function progressFarm.onFarmIsland(candidate,row)
 local position=candidate.part.Position
 local declared=candidate.model:GetAttribute("Island")or candidate.model:GetAttribute("Location")
 if type(declared)=="string"then return Core.styleKey(declared)==Core.styleKey(row.name)end
 local island=teleport.mapIsland(row)
 if island then
  local frame,size
  if island:IsA("Model")then frame,size=island:GetBoundingBox()
  elseif island:IsA("BasePart")then frame,size=island.CFrame,island.Size end
  if frame and size and size.X>100 and size.Z>100 then
   local point=frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
   return math.abs(point.X)<=size.X/2+100 and math.abs(point.Z)<=size.Z/2+100 and math.abs(point.Y)<=size.Y/2+350
  end
 end
 local center=teleport.basePoint(row)
 if not center or(position-center).Magnitude>3000 then return false end
 local nearest,distance=nil,math.huge
 for _,source in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[row.sea]or{})do
  if source[2]then
   local d=(position-Vector3.new(source[2][1],source[2][2],source[2][3])).Magnitude
   if d<distance then nearest=source[1];distance=d end
  end
 end
 return progressFarm.islandGroup(nearest)==progressFarm.islandGroup(row.name)
end
function progressFarm.allIslandStep(root,human,now)
 local row=progressFarm.farmIsland
 if not row or row.sea~=progressFarm.sea then progressFarm.stop("Select an island in the current sea");return end
 if row.name=="Submerged Island"and not teleport.submergedHere(root)then
  progressFarm.transport=progressFarm.transport or{}
  local done,message=teleport.submergedStep(progressFarm.transport,root,human,now)
  progressFarm.note(message);if not done then return end
 end
 local center=teleport.basePoint(row)
 if not center then stopHover();progressFarm.note("Waiting for selected island to stream in");return end
 if not progressFarm.allIslandArrived then
  local destination=teleport.safeDestination(row,center)
  disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character);human.Sit=false
  holdPosition(root,destination,nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
  if not row.safePoint or(root.Position-destination).Magnitude>15 then progressFarm.note("Flying to "..row.name.." · waiting for clear ground");return end
  progressFarm.allIslandArrived=true
 end
 ensureAura(localPlayer.Character,true);disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character);human.Sit=false
 local names={};local filter=function(candidate)return progressFarm.onFarmIsland(candidate,row)end
 for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates(root)or{})do
  if candidate.health>0 and filter(candidate)then table.insert(names,candidate.name)end
 end
 if #names>0 and progressFarm.fight(root,human,names,nil,nil,filter)then return end
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release()
 local destination=teleport.safeDestination(row,center)
 holdPosition(root,destination+Vector3.new(0,20,0),nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
 progressFarm.note(row.name.." · no live NPCs · waiting for respawn")
end

function progressFarm.chestStop()
 local c=progressFarm.chests
 if not c then return end
 if c.scan then task.cancel(c.scan);c.scan=nil end
 for _,connection in ipairs(c.connections or{})do connection:Disconnect()end
 if c.prompt then pcall(function()c.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);c.prompt=nil end
 progressFarm.chests=nil
end
function progressFarm.chestGone(entry)
 return not entry.object.Parent or not entry.part.Parent or entry.object:GetAttribute("Collected")==true
  or entry.object:GetAttribute("Opened")==true or entry.part.Transparency>=1
end
function progressFarm.chestPart(object)
 if not object or not object.Parent or object:GetAttribute("Collected")==true then return nil end
 local key=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
 if not(key:match("^chest[123]?$")or key=="goldchest"or key=="silverchest"or key=="diamondchest"or key=="treasurechest")then return nil end
 if object:IsA("Tool")then return nil end
 local ancestor=object.Parent
 for _=1,6 do
  if not ancestor or ancestor==workspace then break end
  if ancestor==localPlayer.Character or ancestor.Name=="Enemies"or ancestor.Name=="NPCs"or ancestor.Name=="Boats"or ancestor:IsA("Tool")then return nil end
  local name=Core.styleKey(ancestor.Name)
  if name:match("^chest[123]?$")or name=="goldchest"or name=="silverchest"or name=="diamondchest"or name=="treasurechest"then return nil end
  ancestor=ancestor.Parent
 end
 local part=object:IsA("BasePart")and object or object:IsA("Model")and(object.PrimaryPart or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true))
 if part and part.Transparency>=1 and object:IsA("Model")then
  for _,child in ipairs(object:GetDescendants())do if child:IsA("BasePart")and child.Transparency<1 then part=child;break end end
 end
 if not part or part.Transparency>=1 or not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then return nil end
 return part
end
function progressFarm.chestAdd(c,object)
 local part=progressFarm.chestPart(object)
 if not part then return end
 for _,entry in ipairs(c.entries)do if entry.object==object then entry.part=part;return end end
 table.insert(c.entries,{object=object,part=part,nextAt=0})
end
function progressFarm.chestDiscover(c,now)
 if c.scan or now<(c.scanAt or 0)then return end
 c.scanAt=now+8
 c.scan=perf.walk(workspace,function(object)
  if object==localPlayer.Character or object.Name=="Enemies"or object.Name=="NPCs"or object.Name=="Boats"or object:IsA("Tool")then return false end
  progressFarm.chestAdd(c,object)
 end,function()return state.chest and progressFarm.chests==c and not disposed end,function()
  if progressFarm.chests~=c then return end
  c.scan=nil;local live={}
  for _,entry in ipairs(c.entries)do if entry.object.Parent then table.insert(live,entry)end end
  c.entries=live
 end)
end
function progressFarm.chestAccess(root,human,destination,now)
 if progressFarm.sea~=3 then return false end
 local underwater=teleport.submergedHere(root)
 if(destination.Y< -1000)~=underwater then
  local name=underwater and "Tiki Outpost"or "Submerged Island"
  if progressFarm.transport and progressFarm.transport.destination~=name then teleport.releaseTransport(progressFarm.transport);progressFarm.transport=nil end
  progressFarm.transport=progressFarm.transport or{destination=name}
  local done,message=teleport.submergedStep(progressFarm.transport,root,human,now)
  progressFarm.note(message)
  if done then teleport.releaseTransport(progressFarm.transport);progressFarm.transport=nil end
  return true
 end
 if progressFarm.transport then teleport.releaseTransport(progressFarm.transport);progressFarm.transport=nil end
 return false
end
function progressFarm.chestPatrol(c,root,human,now)
 if not c.route then
  c.route={}
  for _,source in ipairs(TELEPORT_LOCATIONS[progressFarm.sea]or{})do
   if source[2]then
    table.insert(c.route,Vector3.new(source[2][1],source[2][2]+60,source[2][3]))
   end
  end
  c.routeIndex=1;local nearest=math.huge
  for index,point in ipairs(c.route)do if(point-root.Position).Magnitude<nearest then nearest=(point-root.Position).Magnitude;c.routeIndex=index end end
 end
 local destination=c.route[c.routeIndex]
 if not destination then stopHover();progressFarm.note("Auto Farm Chest · waiting for loaded chests");return end
 if(root.Position-destination).Magnitude<100 then
  c.pauseUntil=c.pauseUntil or now+.15
  if now>=c.pauseUntil then c.routeIndex=c.routeIndex%#c.route+1;c.pauseUntil=nil;destination=c.route[c.routeIndex]end
 end
 if progressFarm.chestAccess(root,human,destination,now)then return end
 disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character);holdPosition(root,destination,nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
 progressFarm.note("Auto Farm Chest · "..c.collected.." collected · exploring island "..c.routeIndex.." / "..#c.route)
end
function progressFarm.chestMoney()
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data");local value=data and data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
 return value and tonumber(value.Value)
end
function progressFarm.chestStep(root,human,now)
 local c=progressFarm.chests
 if not c then
  c={entries={},connections={},collected=0,scanAt=0};progressFarm.chests=c
  table.insert(c.connections,workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
   if state.chest and progressFarm.chests==c then progressFarm.chestAdd(c,object)end
  end))
 end
 releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();human.Sit=false;disableCollisions(localPlayer.Character)
 if c.prompt and now>=(c.promptUntil or 0)then pcall(function()c.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);c.prompt=nil end
 local target=c.target
 local money=progressFarm.chestMoney()
 local paid=target and target.touchAt and target.balanceBefore and money and money>target.balanceBefore
 if target and(progressFarm.chestGone(target)or paid)then
  if target.touchAt and(root.Position-target.anchor).Magnitude<25 then c.collected=c.collected+1 end
  target.nextAt=now+20;target.touchAt=nil;target.balanceBefore=nil
  if c.prompt then pcall(function()c.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);c.prompt=nil end
  c.target=nil;target=nil
 end
 progressFarm.chestDiscover(c,now)
 if target and(not target.part.Parent or not progressFarm.chestPart(target.object))then c.target=nil;target=nil end
 if not target then
  local nearest=math.huge
  for _,entry in ipairs(c.entries)do
   if not progressFarm.chestGone(entry)and now>=(entry.nextAt or 0)then
    local d=(root.Position-entry.part.Position).Magnitude
    if d<nearest then target=entry;nearest=d end
   end
  end
  c.target=target
 end
 if not target then progressFarm.chestPatrol(c,root,human,now);return end
 local destination=target.part.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
 if progressFarm.chestAccess(root,human,destination,now)then return end
 holdPosition(root,destination,nil,CONFIG.TravelSpeed)
 if(root.Position-destination).Magnitude<=5 then
  if not target.touchAt then target.touchAt=now;target.balanceBefore=progressFarm.chestMoney()end;target.anchor=target.part.Position
  local prompt=target.object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
  if prompt and prompt.Enabled and not c.prompt and now>=(c.promptAt or 0)then
   if pcall(function()prompt:InputHoldBegin()end)then c.prompt=prompt;c.promptUntil=now+prompt.HoldDuration+.1;c.promptAt=now+2 end
  end
  if now-target.touchAt>=5 then
   target.nextAt=now+20;target.touchAt=nil;c.target=nil;stopHover()
   progressFarm.note("Chest pickup not confirmed · checking another chest");return
  end
  progressFarm.note("Auto Farm Chest · collecting "..target.object.Name.." · "..c.collected.." confirmed")
 else
  target.touchAt=nil;progressFarm.note("Auto Farm Chest · flying to "..target.object.Name.." · "..c.collected.." collected")
 end
end

-- Found encounters only. Replicated health / telegraphs are evidence; streamed-out parts are not kills.
function leviFarm.note(message)
 if leviFarm.label and leviFarm.label.Text~=message then leviFarm.label.Text=message end
end
function leviFarm.stop(message)
 local active=state.leviathan;state.leviathan=false;leviFarm.generation=(leviFarm.generation or 0)+1
 if leviFarm.scanJob then task.cancel(leviFarm.scanJob);leviFarm.scanJob=nil end
 for _,entry in pairs(leviFarm.watched or{})do for _,connection in ipairs(entry.connections)do connection:Disconnect()end end
 leviFarm.watched={};leviFarm.targets={};leviFarm.hazards={};leviFarm.scanAt=0;leviFarm.encounter=nil
 leviFarm.lastHazard=nil;leviFarm.evadeUntil=0;leviFarm.complete=false;leviFarm.known={};leviFarm.defeated={};leviFarm.anchor=nil
 leviFarm.idleRoot=nil;leviFarm.idlePosition=nil;leviFarm.escapePosition=nil;leviFarm.attackOrigin=nil;leviFarm.cue=nil
 if active then fruit.release();releaseNativeClick();deactivateWeapon();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions();cancelAuraRequest()end
 if controls.leviathan and not disposed then controls.leviathan(false)end
 if message then leviFarm.note(message)end
end
function leviFarm.start()
 if game.GameId~=994732206 or SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]~=3 then leviFarm.note("Leviathan: нужно третье море");return false end
 teleport.cancel();stopFarm();stopRaid();elite.stop();berry.stop();autoFruits.stop();boss.stop();swordFarm.stop();gunFarm.stop();eventFarm.stop();progressFarm.stop();autoKill.stop()
 leviFarm.stop();state.leviathan=true;leviFarm.sea=3;leviFarm.side=1
 speedHack.restore();slotCharacter=nil;lastAttack=-math.huge
 if controls.leviathan then controls.leviathan(true)end
 leviFarm.note("Жду найденного Leviathan · навыки Auto Farm · уклонение по видимым сигналам")
 return false
end
function leviFarm.kind(model)
 local key=Core.styleKey(model.Name)
 if key:find("segment",1,true)or key:find("body",1,true)or key:find("tail",1,true)then return "segment"end
 if key:find("head",1,true)then return "head"end
 -- A root merely containing segment models is a container, not a damageable head.
 for _,child in ipairs(model:GetChildren())do
  if child:IsA("Model")and Core.styleKey(child.Name):find("segment",1,true)then return "container"end
 end
 return key:find("leviathan",1,true)and "head"or "segment"
end
function leviFarm.inEncounter(object)
 local node=object;local found
 while node and node~=workspace do
  if node==localPlayer.Character or node.Name=="Boats"or node.Name=="NPCs"or node:IsA("Model")and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(node)then return nil end
  local name=Core.styleKey(node.Name)
  if name:find("leviathan",1,true)and not name:find("shield",1,true)and not node:IsA("Tool")then found=node end
  node=node.Parent
 end
 if not found then return nil end
 local parent=found.Parent
 if parent==workspace or parent==workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")or parent==workspace:FindFirstChild("SeaBeasts")then return found end
 if found:IsDescendantOf(workspace:FindFirstChild("SeaBeasts")or found)or found:IsDescendantOf(workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")or found)then return found end
end
function leviFarm.health(entry)
 if not entry.model.Parent or not entry.part.Parent or entry.part~=entry.model and not entry.part:IsDescendantOf(entry.model)then return nil end
 return eventFarm.health(entry.model)
end
function leviFarm.damageable(entry)
 local health=leviFarm.health(entry)
 if not health or health<=0 or entry.model:GetAttribute("Invulnerable")==true or entry.model:GetAttribute("CanDamage")==false
  or entry.model:GetAttribute("Diving")==true or entry.model:GetAttribute("Submerged")==true then return false end
 local encounter=leviFarm.inEncounter(entry.model)
 if encounter and(encounter:GetAttribute("Diving")==true or encounter:GetAttribute("Submerged")==true or encounter:GetAttribute("Invulnerable")==true)then return false end
 -- Invisible geometry is often the dive phase. Keep its health record and wait.
 return entry.part.Transparency<.98 or entry.model:GetAttribute("Visible")==true
end
function leviFarm.watch(entry)
 if leviFarm.watched[entry.model]then return end
 local watch={connections={}};leviFarm.watched[entry.model]=watch
 local generation=leviFarm.generation
 local function cue(reason)
  if state.leviathan and leviFarm.generation==generation and entry.model.Parent then
   leviFarm.evadeUntil=math.max(leviFarm.evadeUntil or 0,os.clock()+2)
   leviFarm.attackOrigin=entry.part.Position;leviFarm.cue=reason;leviFarm.side=-(leviFarm.side or 1)
  end
 end
 for _,name in ipairs({"UsingSkill","Attacking","Diving"})do
  table.insert(watch.connections,entry.model:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
   if entry.model:GetAttribute(name)==true then cue(name)end
  end))
  if entry.model:GetAttribute(name)==true then cue(name)end
 end
 local human=entry.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local function healthChanged()
  if not state.leviathan or leviFarm.generation~=generation then return end
  local health=eventFarm.health(entry.model)
  if health and health<=0 then leviFarm.defeated[entry.model]=true end
 end
 if human then table.insert(watch.connections,human:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(healthChanged))
 else
  local value=entry.model:FindFirstChild("Health")
  if value and(value:IsA("NumberValue")or value:IsA("IntValue"))then table.insert(watch.connections,value:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(healthChanged))end
  table.insert(watch.connections,entry.model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(healthChanged))
 end
 healthChanged()
 local animator=(human and human:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator"))or entry.model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator",true)
 if animator then
  local function played(track)
   local animation=track.Animation
   if animation and Core.npcSkillCue({name=animation.Name,playing=track.IsPlaying,isSkill=animation:GetAttribute("IsSkill"),
    key=animation:GetAttribute("SkillKey"),kind=animation:GetAttribute("AttackType")})then cue("skill animation")end
  end
  table.insert(watch.connections,animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(played))
  local ok,tracks=pcall(function()return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()end)
  if ok then for _,track in ipairs(tracks)do played(track)end end
 end
end
function leviFarm.telegraph(object)
 if not object:IsA("BasePart")or object.Transparency>=.95 then return false end
 local key=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
 local named=key:find("telegraph",1,true)or key:find("warning",1,true)or key:find("indicator",1,true)or key:find("redcircle",1,true)
 local tagged=object:GetAttribute("IsAttackTelegraph")==true
 if not named and not tagged then return false end
 local color=object.Color
 return color.R>.65 and color.G<.4 and color.B<.4 and math.max(object.Size.X,object.Size.Z)>8
end
function leviFarm.discover(now,root)
 if leviFarm.scanJob or now<(leviFarm.scanAt or 0)then return end
 leviFarm.scanAt=now+1.5
 local generation=leviFarm.generation;local targets,hazards={},{}
 local enemies=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies");local beasts=workspace:FindFirstChild("SeaBeasts")
 local effects=workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin");local visual=workspace:FindFirstChild("Effects")
 leviFarm.scanJob=perf.walk(workspace,function(object)
  if object.Parent==workspace and object~=enemies and object~=beasts and object~=effects and object~=visual
   and not Core.styleKey(object.Name):find("leviathan",1,true)then return false end
  if object:IsA("Tool")or object==localPlayer.Character then return false end
  if object:IsA("Model")or object:IsA("BasePart")then
   local encounter=leviFarm.inEncounter(object)
   if encounter then
    local health,human=eventFarm.health(object)
    local body=object:IsA("BasePart")and object or raidCombat.hitPart(object)or raidCombat.body(object)or object.PrimaryPart
    if body and body.Transparency>=.98 and object:IsA("Model")then
     for _,part in ipairs(object:GetChildren())do if part:IsA("BasePart")and part.Transparency<.98 then body=part;break end end
    end
    if health and body and body:IsA("BasePart")and leviFarm.kind(object)~="container"then
     local distance=(body.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
     if not leviFarm.encounter and distance<=2200 or leviFarm.encounter==encounter
      or leviFarm.anchor and(body.Position-leviFarm.anchor).Magnitude<1400 then
      if not leviFarm.encounter then leviFarm.encounter=encounter;leviFarm.anchor=body.Position end
      local entry={model=object,part=body,kind=leviFarm.kind(object),realHuman=human,humanoid=human or{Health=health}}
      targets[object]=entry;leviFarm.known[object]=entry;leviFarm.watch(entry)
      if encounter~=object then
       local anchor=raidCombat.body(encounter)or encounter.PrimaryPart
       if anchor then leviFarm.watch({model=encounter,part=anchor})end
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
  if leviFarm.telegraph(object)then
   local linked=leviFarm.inEncounter(object)==leviFarm.encounter or object:GetAttribute("Boss")=="Leviathan"
   local entry=leviFarm.encounter and(leviFarm.encounter.PrimaryPart or raidCombat.body(leviFarm.encounter))
   if linked or entry and(object.Position-entry.Position).Magnitude<800 then table.insert(hazards,object)end
  end
 end,function()return state.leviathan and leviFarm.generation==generation end,function()
  if leviFarm.generation~=generation then return end
  leviFarm.scanJob=nil;leviFarm.targets=targets;leviFarm.hazards=hazards
  for model,watch in pairs(leviFarm.watched)do
   if not model.Parent then for _,connection in ipairs(watch.connections)do connection:Disconnect()end;leviFarm.watched[model]=nil end
  end
 end)
end
function leviFarm.choose(root)
 local target,nearest=nil,math.huge;local segments=false;local unknown=false;local headAlive=false;local hasHead=false
 for model,entry in pairs(leviFarm.known)do
  local health=leviFarm.health(entry)
  if health and health<=0 then leviFarm.defeated[model]=true end
  if entry.kind=="segment"and not leviFarm.defeated[model]then segments=true end
  if not health and not leviFarm.defeated[model]then unknown=true end
  if entry.kind=="head"then hasHead=true;if not leviFarm.defeated[model]then headAlive=true end end
 end
 for _,entry in pairs(leviFarm.targets)do
  if(entry.kind=="segment"or not segments and not unknown)and leviFarm.damageable(entry)then
   local distance=(entry.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
   if distance<nearest then target=entry;nearest=distance end
  end
 end
 if not target and hasHead and not segments and not headAlive and not unknown then leviFarm.complete=true end
 return target,unknown
end
function leviFarm.escape(root,target,now)
 for _,part in ipairs(leviFarm.hazards or{})do
  if part.Parent and leviFarm.telegraph(part)then
   -- Oriented rectangle: escaping upward while still inside a red footprint is insufficient.
   local localPoint=part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
   local halfX,halfZ=part.Size.X/2+24,part.Size.Z/2+24
   if math.abs(localPoint.X)<halfX and math.abs(localPoint.Z)<halfZ then
    local x=(localPoint.X<0 and -1 or 1)*(halfX+45)
    local z=(localPoint.Z<0 and -1 or 1)*(halfZ+45)
    local point
    if halfX-math.abs(localPoint.X)<halfZ-math.abs(localPoint.Z)then point=Vector3.new(x,0,localPoint.Z)
    else point=Vector3.new(localPoint.X,0,z)end
    local world=part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(point)
    leviFarm.escapePosition=Vector3.new(world.X,math.max(root.Position.Y,target and target.part.Position.Y+65 or world.Y+80),world.Z)
    leviFarm.lastHazard=part;leviFarm.evadeUntil=now+1.5
    return leviFarm.escapePosition,"красная зона — ухожу за её границу"
   end
  end
 end
 if now<(leviFarm.evadeUntil or 0)then
  if leviFarm.lastHazard and leviFarm.lastHazard.Parent and leviFarm.escapePosition then return leviFarm.escapePosition,"выхожу из опасной зоны"end
  local center=leviFarm.attackOrigin or target and target.part.Position or root.Position
  local away=Vector3.new(root.Position.X-center.X,0,root.Position.Z-center.Z)
  if away.Magnitude<1 then away=Vector3.new(1,0,0)end
  local side=Vector3.new(-away.Z,0,away.X).Unit*(leviFarm.side or 1)
  return center+away.Unit*180+side*90+Vector3.new(0,85,0),leviFarm.cue or "сигнал атаки"
 end
 leviFarm.lastHazard=nil;return nil
end
function leviFarm.step()
 if disposed or not state.leviathan then return end
 if SEA_BY_PLACE[game.PlaceId]~=3 then leviFarm.stop("Нужно третье море");return end
 local character,human,root=combatAssist.localBody()
 if not character then fruit.release();stopHover();leviFarm.note("Жду возрождения · найдённый бой сохранён");return end
 human.Sit=false;stopMovement();disableCollisions(character)
 local now=os.clock();leviFarm.discover(now,root)
 local target,unknown=leviFarm.choose(root)
 local escape,reason=leviFarm.escape(root,target,now)
 if escape then fruit.release();releaseNativeClick();holdPosition(root,escape,nil,222);leviFarm.note("Уклонение: "..reason);return end
 if not target then
  fruit.release();releaseNativeClick()
  if leviFarm.idleRoot~=root then leviFarm.idleRoot=root;leviFarm.idlePosition=root.Position end
  holdPosition(root,leviFarm.idlePosition,nil)
  leviFarm.note(leviFarm.complete and "Leviathan: здоровье всех известных частей = 0 · жду выключения"or unknown and "Часть Leviathan не видна · жду загрузки; смерть не подтверждена"or "Жду доступный сегмент / голову найденного Leviathan")
  return
 end
 leviFarm.idleRoot=nil
 local angle=now*.55;local center=target.part.Position
 local orbit=center+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*60,65,math.sin(angle)*60)
 holdPosition(root,orbit,nil,222)
 if not combatAssist.inputReady()then fruit.release();return end
 local mode=CONFIG.WeaponType;local tool,why=prepareFirstSlot(character,human,now,mode)
 if not tool then leviFarm.note(why or "Нужен предмет из Auto Farm");return end
 if not raidCombat.auraReady(character)then leviFarm.note("Жду включения Haki");return end
 if(center-root.Position).Magnitude>145 then fruit.release();leviFarm.note("Лечу к "..target.kind);return end
 if not leviFarm.damageable(target)then fruit.release();return end
 local health=leviFarm.health(target);if not target.realHuman then target.humanoid.Health=health end
 local point,message=elite.aim(target)
 local skills=mode=="Fruit"and(fruit.skillsSelected()and CONFIG.FruitSkills or elite.defaultFruitSkills)or{Z=true,X=true,C=true,V=true}
 if point then
  message=fruit.cast(tool,target,now,skills)
  if fruit.held and fruit.held.target==target.model then
   local generation=leviFarm.generation
   fruit.held.healthCheck=function()return state.leviathan and leviFarm.generation==generation and leviFarm.damageable(target)end
  end
 end
 leviFarm.note("Leviathan "..target.kind.." · HP "..math.ceil(health).." · "..tostring(message or "жду навык"))
end

function autoKill.note(message)
 if autoKill.label and autoKill.label.Text~=message then autoKill.label.Text=message end
end
function autoKill.releaseWatch()
 for _,connection in ipairs(autoKill.connections or{})do connection:Disconnect()end
 autoKill.connections={};autoKill.character=nil;autoKill.evadeUntil=0;autoKill.escapePosition=nil
end
function autoKill.releaseTool()
 if autoKill.tool then pcall(function()autoKill.tool:Deactivate()end);autoKill.tool=nil end
end
function autoKill.pause(message)
 autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.releaseWatch();autoKill.paused=true;autoKill.retryAt=os.clock()+2
 autoKill.generation=(autoKill.generation or 0)+1
 releaseNativeClick();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions()
 autoKill.note("Пауза: "..tostring(message).." · модуль остаётся включённым")
end
function autoKill.stop(message)
 local active=state.autokill;state.autokill=false;autoKill.generation=(autoKill.generation or 0)+1
 autoKill.releaseWatch();autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.lastPunch=-math.huge;autoKill.paused=false;autoKill.retryAt=0
 if active then releaseNativeClick();fruit.release();stopMovement();stopHover();restoreCollisions();cancelAuraRequest()end
 if controls.autokill and not disposed then controls.autokill(false)end
 if message then autoKill.note(message)end
end
function autoKill.start()
 if not autoKill.player or autoKill.player==localPlayer or autoKill.player.Parent~=Players then autoKill.note("Сначала выберите игрока");return false end
 teleport.cancel();stopFarm();stopRaid();elite.stop();berry.stop();autoFruits.stop();boss.stop();swordFarm.stop();gunFarm.stop();eventFarm.stop();progressFarm.stop();leviFarm.stop()
 autoKill.stop();state.autokill=true;autoKill.side=1;slotCharacter=nil;speedHack.restore()
 if controls.autokill then controls.autokill(true)end
 autoKill.note("Лечу к @"..autoKill.player.Name.." · "..(autoKill.weaponType or "Melee").." M1 до выключения");return false
end
function autoKill.select(player)
 if player==localPlayer or player.Parent~=Players then return end
 local running=state.autokill;autoKill.stop();autoKill.player=player;autoKill.selectedUserId=player.UserId
 if running then autoKill.start()else autoKill.note("Выбран @"..player.Name)end
 if autoKill.redrawPlayers then autoKill.redrawPlayers()end
end
function autoKill.target()
 local player=autoKill.player
 if not player or player==localPlayer or player.Parent~=Players then return end
 local model=player.Character;local human=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local part=model and raidCombat.body(model)
 if human and human.Health>0 and part then return{player=player,model=model,human=human,part=part}end
end
function autoKill.watch(target)
 if autoKill.character==target.model then return end
 autoKill.releaseWatch();autoKill.character=target.model
 local generation=autoKill.generation
 local function cue()
  if state.autokill and autoKill.generation==generation and autoKill.character==target.model then
   autoKill.evadeUntil=os.clock()+.85;autoKill.side=-(autoKill.side or 1);autoKill.escapePosition=nil
  end
 end
 table.insert(autoKill.connections,target.model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("UsingSkill"):Connect(function()
  if target.model:GetAttribute("UsingSkill")==true then cue()end
 end))
 local animator=target.human:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
 if animator then
  local function played(track)
   local animation=track.Animation
   if not animation then return end
   local key=Core.styleKey(animation.Name.." "..tostring(track.Name or ""))
   if Core.npcSkillCue({name=animation.Name,playing=track.IsPlaying,isSkill=animation:GetAttribute("IsSkill"),
    key=animation:GetAttribute("SkillKey"),kind=animation:GetAttribute("AttackType")})
    or key:find("punch",1,true)or key:find("slash",1,true)or key:find("attack",1,true)or key:find("kick",1,true)then cue()end
  end
  table.insert(autoKill.connections,animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(played))
  local ok,tracks=pcall(function()return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()end)
  if ok then for _,track in ipairs(tracks)do played(track)end end
 end
end
function autoKill.chooseWeapon(mode)
 if mode~="Melee"and mode~="Fruit"then return end
 autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.releaseWatch();autoKill.weaponType=mode
 autoKill.generation=(autoKill.generation or 0)+1;autoKill.lastPunch=-math.huge;slotCharacter=nil
 if autoKill.redrawWeapon then autoKill.redrawWeapon()end
 autoKill.note(mode=="Fruit"and "Fruit · M1 второго слота; фрукт должен иметь M1"or "Melee · M1 первого слота")
end
function autoKill.weapon(tool,character)
 if(autoKill.weaponType or "Melee")=="Melee"then return combatAssist.melee(tool,character)end
 if not tool or tool.Parent~=character or tool.Enabled==false or not tool:IsA("Tool")then return false end
 local category=tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType")or tool:GetAttribute("Category")or tool:GetAttribute("Type")
 return Core.weaponMatches("Fruit",tool.Name,tool.ToolTip,category)
end
function autoKill.valid(target,character,human,root,tool,generation)
 return not disposed and state.autokill and autoKill.generation==generation and autoKill.player==target.player
  and target.player.Parent==Players and target.player.Character==target.model and target.model.Parent~=nil
  and target.human.Parent==target.model and target.human.Health>0 and target.part.Parent==target.model
  and not target.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")and localPlayer.Character==character and human.Health>0
  and(target.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=8 and autoKill.weapon(tool,character)
  and combatAssist.inputReady()and os.clock()>=(autoKill.evadeUntil or 0)and raidCombat.auraReady(character)
end
function autoKill.step()
 if disposed or not state.autokill then return end
 if os.clock()<(autoKill.retryAt or 0)then return end
 if not autoKill.player or autoKill.player.Parent~=Players then autoKill.paused=true;autoKill.releaseTool();stopHover();restoreCollisions();autoKill.note("Цель вышла · выберите другого игрока; модуль остаётся включённым");return end
 local character,human,root=combatAssist.localBody();local target=autoKill.target()
 if not character or not target then
  autoKill.paused=true;autoKill.releaseTool();stopHover();restoreCollisions();autoKill.releaseWatch()
  autoKill.note("Жду живого персонажа / возрождения выбранного игрока");return
 end
 autoKill.watch(target)
 local now=os.clock()
 if not combatAssist.inputReady()then autoKill.paused=true;autoKill.releaseTool();stopHover();restoreCollisions();return end
 autoKill.paused=false;human.Sit=false;stopMovement();disableCollisions(character)
 if now<(autoKill.evadeUntil or 0)then
  autoKill.releaseTool()
  if not autoKill.escapePosition then
   local forward=target.part.CFrame.LookVector;forward=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
   if forward.Magnitude<.1 then forward=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)end
   local side=Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)*(autoKill.side or 1)
   autoKill.escapePosition=target.part.Position+side*32-forward*14+Vector3.new(0,10,0)
  end
  holdPosition(root,autoKill.escapePosition,nil,222);autoKill.note("Уклонение от видимого сигнала атаки @"..target.player.Name);return
 end
 local forward=target.part.CFrame.LookVector;forward=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
 if forward.Magnitude<.1 then forward=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)end
 holdPosition(root,target.part.Position+forward.Unit*4+Vector3.new(0,1,0),nil)
 if(target.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>8 then autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.note("Лечу к @"..target.player.Name);return end
 if target.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")then autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.note("Жду окончания защиты возрождения");return end
 local tool,reason=prepareFirstSlot(character,human,now,autoKill.weaponType or "Melee")
 if not autoKill.weapon(tool,character)then autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.note(reason or "Жду выбранный Melee / Fruit · только M1");return end
 if not raidCombat.auraReady(character)then autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.note("Жду включения Haki");return end
 local interval=autoKill.mode=="Fast Attack"and .05 or .35
 local generation=autoKill.generation
 local function ready()return autoKill.valid(target,character,human,root,tool,generation)end
 if now-(autoKill.lastPunch or -math.huge)<interval or not ready()then return end
 autoKill.lastPunch=now;autoKill.tool=tool
 elite.aim({part=target.part})
 local position=Vector3.new(target.part.Position.X,root.Position.Y,target.part.Position.Z)
 if(position-root.Position).Magnitude>.01 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,position)end
 tool:Deactivate()
 if not ready()then return end
 tool:Activate() -- Selected player only, native Tool M1 for Fruit. No skill keys, NPC fallback or radius setting.
 if autoKill.mode=="Fast Attack"and(autoKill.weaponType or "Melee")=="Melee"and ready()then
  local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules");local net=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("Net")
  local attack=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterAttack");local hit=net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit")
  if attack and hit and attack:IsA("RemoteEvent")and hit:IsA("RemoteEvent")then
   attack:FireServer(interval)
   if ready()then local part=raidCombat.hitPart(target.model)or target.part;hit:FireServer(part,{{target.model,part}})end
  end
 end
 autoKill.note("@"..target.player.Name.." · "..autoKill.mode.." · "..(autoKill.weaponType or "Melee").." M1")
end

function combatPassives.note(kind,message)
 local label=combatPassives.labels and combatPassives.labels[kind]
 if label and label.Text~=message then label.Text=message end
end
function combatPassives.reset()
 if Core.cancelGameCall then Core.cancelGameCall("autoPvp")end
 combatPassives.generation=(combatPassives.generation or 0)+1
 if combatPassives.scanJob then task.cancel(combatPassives.scanJob);combatPassives.scanJob=nil end
 if combatPassives.mouse then
  pcall(combatPassives.mouse.backend.mouse,false,combatPassives.mouse.point);combatPassives.mouse=nil
 end
 combatPassives.widgets=nil;combatPassives.scanAt=0;combatPassives.nextAt=0;combatPassives.clickAt=0;combatPassives.character=nil
end
function combatPassives.set(kind,enabled)
 if kind~="autohaki"and kind~="autopvp"then return false end
 state[kind]=enabled==true
 if kind=="autopvp"then
  combatPassives.reset();combatPassives.activationPending=enabled==true
  if enabled then task.defer(function()if state.autopvp then combatPassives.tick(os.clock())end end)end
 end
 if kind=="autohaki"and enabled then auraRequestedCharacter=nil;combatPassives.nextAt=0 end
 if controls[kind]and not disposed then controls[kind](state[kind])end
 combatPassives.note(kind,enabled and "Включено · продолжит после возрождения"or "Выключено")
 return false
end
function combatPassives.findPvp(now)
 if combatPassives.scanJob or now<(combatPassives.scanAt or 0)then return end
 combatPassives.scanAt=now+3;local generation=combatPassives.generation;local widgets={}
 combatPassives.scanJob=perf.walk(playerGui,function(object)
  if object==gui then return false end
  local key=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
  if key:find("pvp",1,true)or object:IsA("TextButton")and Core.styleKey(object.Text):find("pvp",1,true)then table.insert(widgets,object)end
 end,function()return not disposed and state.autopvp and combatPassives.generation==generation end,function()
  if combatPassives.generation==generation then
   combatPassives.scanJob=nil;combatPassives.widgets=widgets
   if state.autopvp and combatPassives.activationPending then
    combatPassives.nextAt=0;task.defer(function()
     if state.autopvp and combatPassives.generation==generation then combatPassives.tick(os.clock())end
    end)
   end
  end
 end)
end
function combatPassives.tick(now)
 if combatPassives.mouse and now>=combatPassives.mouse.untilTime then
  if pcall(combatPassives.mouse.backend.mouse,false,combatPassives.mouse.point)then combatPassives.mouse=nil end
 end
 if disposed or now<(combatPassives.nextAt or 0)then return end
 combatPassives.nextAt=now+.5
 local character,human=combatAssist.localBody()
 if not character then
  if state.autohaki then combatPassives.note("autohaki","Жду возрождения — затем включу Haki")end
  if state.autopvp then combatPassives.note("autopvp","Жду возрождения — затем включу PvP")end
  return
 end
 if state.autohaki then
  local ready=ensureAura(character,true)
  combatPassives.note("autohaki",ready and "Haki включено · контроль после смерти активен"or "Включаю Haki · "..auraStatus)
 end
 if not state.autopvp then return end
 if combatPassives.character~=character then combatPassives.character=character;combatPassives.activationPending=true;combatPassives.scanAt=0 end
 local main=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
 local disabled=main and main:FindFirstChild("PvpDisabled")
 if disabled and disabled.Visible==false and combatPassives.pvpRequestedFor==character then
  combatPassives.activationPending=false;combatPassives.note("autopvp","PvP enabled · watching for respawn");return
 end
 if combatPassives.activationPending or disabled and disabled.Visible then
  local generation=combatPassives.generation
  if Core.gameCall("autoPvp","EnablePvp",{},function()return state.autopvp and combatPassives.generation==generation and localPlayer.Character==character end,function(ok,result)
   combatPassives.note("autopvp",ok and "PvP activation requested · waiting for disabled banner to disappear"or("PvP activation failed: "..tostring(result)))
  end,5)then combatPassives.pvpRequestedFor=character;return end
 end
 combatPassives.findPvp(now)
 local banner,button,icon
 for _,object in ipairs(combatPassives.widgets or{})do
  if object.Parent and progressFarm.visible(object)then
   local name=Core.styleKey(object.Name)
   local value=(object:IsA("TextLabel")or object:IsA("TextButton"))and Core.styleKey(object.Text)or ""
   if name=="pvpdisabled"or value:find("pvpdisabled",1,true)then banner=object end
   if object:IsA("GuiButton")and(value:find("enablepvp",1,true)or name=="enablepvp")then button=object end
   if name:find("pvp",1,true)then
    local candidate=object:IsA("GuiButton")and object or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton",true)
    if candidate and progressFarm.visible(candidate)then icon=candidate end
   end
  end
 end
 if banner and not button then
  if banner:IsA("GuiButton")then button=banner
  else
   -- Actual game's clickable enable control, confined to the disabled banner.
   button=banner:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton",true)
  end
 end
 if not button and combatPassives.activationPending then button=icon end
 if not banner and not button then combatPassives.note("autopvp","Проверяю PvP: нет видимой кнопки включения / защиты после смерти");return end
 if not button or not progressFarm.visible(button)then combatPassives.note("autopvp","PvP выключено · жду доступную кнопку включения игры");return end
 if now<(combatPassives.clickAt or 0)or combatPassives.mouse then return end
 if not combatAssist.inputReady()then return end
 local p,s=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize;local point=Vector2.new(p.X+s.X/2,p.Y+s.Y/2)
 if not combatAssist.pointerSafe(point)then combatPassives.note("autopvp","Кнопка PvP закрыта окном скрипта · сдвиньте / сверните окно");return end
 initializeInput()
 for _,backend in ipairs(slotInputBackends)do
  if pcall(backend.aim,point)then
   combatPassives.mouse={backend=backend,point=point,untilTime=now+.1}
   if pcall(backend.mouse,true,point)then
    combatPassives.clickAt=now+3;combatPassives.activationPending=false
    combatPassives.note("autopvp","Нажал включение PvP · жду изменения интерфейса игры");return
   end
   pcall(backend.mouse,false,point);combatPassives.mouse=nil
  end
 end
 combatPassives.note("autopvp","Не удалось нажать кнопку PvP · нужен доступ к вводу")
end

connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function()
    local now=os.clock()
    if raidHost.mouse and now>=raidHost.mouse.untilTime then
        pcall(raidHost.mouse.backend.mouse,false,raidHost.mouse.point);raidHost.mouse=nil;raidHost.restoreGUI()
    end
    if raidHost.prompt and now>=(raidHost.promptUntil or 0)then
        pcall(function()raidHost.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);raidHost.prompt=nil
    end
    if progressFarm.mouse and now>=progressFarm.mouse.untilTime then
        if pcall(progressFarm.mouse.backend.mouse,false,progressFarm.mouse.point)then progressFarm.mouse=nil;progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI()end
    end
    if progressFarm.islandSavedGUI~=nil and not progressFarm.mouse then progressFarm.mirageRestoreGUI()end
    if progressFarm.prompt and now>=(progressFarm.promptUntil or 0)then
        pcall(function()progressFarm.prompt:InputHoldEnd()end);progressFarm.prompt=nil
    end
    if state.autohaki or state.autopvp or combatPassives.mouse then
        local ok,message=pcall(combatPassives.tick,now)
        if not ok then combatPassives.reset();combatPassives.note("autopvp","Ошибка проверки: "..tostring(message))end
    end
end)

worker=task.spawn(function()
    while not disposed do
        task.wait((teleport.flight or state.autofruits or state.berry or state.elite or state.boss or state.swordfarm and acquisition.active(swordFarm) or state.gunfarm and acquisition.active(gunFarm) or state.resourcefarm or state.leviathan or state.autokill and not autoKill.paused or state.events or state.farm or state.raid)and (state.raid and RAID_ATTACK_INTERVAL or CONFIG.WorkerInterval)or .15)
        if teleport.flight then
            local ok,message=pcall(teleport.tick)
            if not ok then teleport.cancel("Flight error: "..tostring(message))end
        elseif state.autofruits then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(autoFruits.step)
            if not ok then autoFruits.stop("Teleport Fruit error: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.berry then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(berry.step)
            if not ok then berry.stop("Auto Farm Berry error: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.autokill then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(autoKill.step)
            if not ok then autoKill.pause("Auto Kill: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.leviathan then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(leviFarm.step)
            if not ok then leviFarm.stop("Leviathan: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.resourcefarm then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(progressFarm.step)
            if not ok then progressFarm.stop("Farm: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.events then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(eventFarm.step)
            if not ok then eventFarm.stop("Auto Farm Events error: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.gunfarm then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(gunFarm.step)
            if not ok then acquisition.error(gunFarm,"Auto Farm Gun: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.swordfarm then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(swordFarm.step)
            if not ok then acquisition.error(swordFarm,"Farm Sword error: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.boss then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(boss.step)
            if not ok then boss.stop("Farm Boss error: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.elite then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(elite.step)
            if not ok then elite.stop("Elite Hunter error: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        elseif state.farm then
            local ok, errorMessage=pcall(farmStep)
            if not ok then stopFarm("Auto Farm error: "..tostring(errorMessage)) end
        elseif state.raid then
            local ok,errorMessage=pcall(raidStep)
            if not ok then stopRaid("Auto Raid error: "..tostring(errorMessage))end
        end
    end
end)
local function statsStep()
 if disposed or not state.stats then return end
 local data=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
 local points=data and data:FindFirstChild("Points")
 local available=points and tonumber(points.Value)
 if not available or available~=available or available==math.huge or available<0 then statsStatus("Жду Data.Points персонажа");return end
 available=math.floor(available)
 if statsPointsLabel and statsPointsLabel.Text~=tostring(available)then statsPointsLabel.Text=tostring(available)end
 local now=os.clock()
 if statsJob then return end
 local request=statsSchedule.pending
 if request then
  local value=statsSchedule.statValue(data,request.rule)
  if available<request.points or value and request.value and value>request.value then
   statsSchedule.pending=nil
  elseif now-request.at<6 then statsStatus("Жду подтверждения поинтов от сервера");return
  else
   statsSchedule.pending=nil;statsSchedule.retryAt=now+10
   statsStatus("Поинты не изменились: возможен максимум характеристики / отказ сервера. Повторю через 10 секунд.")
   return
  end
 end
 if now<(statsSchedule.retryAt or 0)or now-statsLastTick<.35 then return end
 local rule=statsSchedule.rule(statsSchedule.selected)
 if not rule then statsStatus("Выберите характеристику для всех поинтов");return end
 if available<=0 then statsStatus("Нет свободных поинтов · новые автоматически пойдут в "..rule.label);return end
 local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
 local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")then
  statsSchedule.retryAt=now+3;statsStatus("Жду CommF_ · повтор через 3 секунды");return
 end
 statsLastTick=now
 local generation=statsSchedule.generation;local thread
 thread=task.defer(function()
  if disposed or not state.stats or statsJob~=thread or statsSchedule.generation~=generation or statsSchedule.selected~=rule.key then
   if statsJob==thread then
    statsJob=nil;if statsTimer then task.cancel(statsTimer);statsTimer=nil end
   end
   return
  end
  local amount=tonumber(points.Value)
  amount=amount and amount==amount and amount~=math.huge and math.floor(amount)or 0
  if amount<=0 then
   statsJob=nil;if statsTimer then task.cancel(statsTimer);statsTimer=nil end
   return
  end
  local pending={points=amount,rule=rule,value=statsSchedule.statValue(data,rule),at=os.clock()}
  statsSchedule.pending=pending
  local ok,message=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer("AddPoint",rule.remote,amount)end)
  if statsJob~=thread then return end
  statsJob=nil;if statsTimer then task.cancel(statsTimer);statsTimer=nil end
  if statsSchedule.pending==pending then pending.at=os.clock()end
  if not disposed and state.stats then
   statsStatus(ok and rule.label..": запрошено +"..amount.." · жду изменения поинтов"or "Сервер не ответил: "..tostring(message).." · проверяю поинты перед повтором")
  end
 end)
 statsJob=thread
 statsTimer=task.delay(8,function()
  if statsJob~=thread then return end
  statsTimer=nil;task.cancel(thread);statsJob=nil
  statsSchedule.retryAt=os.clock()+3
  statsStatus("Таймаут AddPoint · проверяю реальные поинты перед повтором")
 end)
end

statsWorker=task.spawn(function()
    while not disposed do
        task.wait(.1)
        if state.stats then
            local ok,message=pcall(statsStep)
            if not ok then stopStats("Auto Stats error: "..tostring(message))end
        end
    end
end)
local function cleanup()
    if disposed then return end
    if raidHost.reset then raidHost.reset()end
    disposed=true
    if syncedTheme.job then task.cancel(syncedTheme.job);syncedTheme.job=nil end
    if fruitEsp.discoveryJob then task.cancel(fruitEsp.discoveryJob);fruitEsp.discoveryJob=nil end
    if playerEsp.loadingJob then task.cancel(playerEsp.loadingJob);playerEsp.loadingJob=nil end
    menuTransition+=1
    if menuHideTask then task.cancel(menuHideTask);menuHideTask=nil end
    combatAssist.setAim(false);combatAssist.setTrigger(false);combatAssist.clearPlayers()
    teleport.cancel()
    raceV4.stop()
    for _,connection in ipairs(teleport.playerConnections or{})do connection:Disconnect()end
    for key in pairs(Core.gameCalls or{})do Core.cancelGameCall(key)end
    autoFruits.stop()
    speedHack.restore();boatSpeed.restore();surfaceWalk.reset();boss.stop();swordFarm.stop();gunFarm.stop();eventFarm.stop();progressFarm.stop();leviFarm.stop();autoKill.stop();state.autohaki=false;state.autopvp=false;combatPassives.reset();autoKill.clearPlayers();haki.cancel()
    if boss.clearUI then boss.clearUI()end
    if swordFarm.clearUI then swordFarm.clearUI()end
    if gunFarm.clearUI then gunFarm.clearUI()end
    if eventFarm.clearUI then eventFarm.clearUI()end
    if fruitEsp.set then fruitEsp.set(false)end
    if berryEsp.set then berryEsp.set(false)end
    if fruitPrice.set then fruitPrice.set(false)end
    stopFarm()
    stopRaid()
    elite.stop()
    berry.stop()
    stopStats()
    if teleport.clearUI then teleport.clearUI()end
    if worker then task.cancel(worker) end
    if statsWorker then task.cancel(statsWorker)end
    for _,tween in pairs(uiTweens)do tween:Cancel()end
    table.clear(uiTweens)
    if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
    for _, tag in pairs(tags) do tag.gui:Destroy() end
    table.clear(tags)
    gui:Destroy()
end
connect(shutdown.Event, cleanup)
connect(close.Activated, cleanup)
connect(gui.Destroying, cleanup)
connect(localPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function()
    combatAssist.releaseAim();combatAssist.releaseTrigger();combatAssist.trigger.nextScan=0
    raceV4.reset()
    if autoFruits.release then autoFruits.release()end
    autoFruits.target=nil;autoFruits.arrivedAt=nil
    if berry.release then berry.release()end
    berry.current=nil;berry.idlePosition=nil;berry.idleRoot=nil
    elite.cancelRequest()
    elite.phase="hunter";elite.target=nil;elite.targetName=nil;elite.searchAt=nil
    elite.lastRequest=-math.huge;elite.hintAt=nil;elite.questScanAt=nil;elite.questLabel=nil
    speedHack.restore();boatSpeed.restore();surfaceWalk.reset();boss.stop("Character removed · stopped");swordFarm.pauseCharacter();gunFarm.pauseCharacter();eventFarm.stop("Character removed · stopped");progressFarm.releaseDelegate();autoKill.releaseTool();autoKill.releaseWatch();combatPassives.reset();haki.cancel()
    teleport.cancel()
    dodge.reset()
    fruit.target=nil
    releaseNativeClick();combatProbe=nil;raidRunning=false
    stopMovement(); stopHover(); restoreCollisions();cancelAuraRequest();auraRequestedCharacter=nil;deactivateWeapon(); watchedMob=nil
end)
